title.zh: v2.9.1 手机流畅度：唱片不再掉帧、曲风库分块渲染、和弦工作台默认收起，并新增一个「卡顿」探针进 verify
title.en: v2.9.1 Phone Smoothness: the Record Stops Dropping Frames, the Library Paints in Chunks, the Chord Workshop Opens Folded, and a Jank Probe Joins verify

highlights.zh: **先造尺子，再谈流畅**。`perf:check` 只回答「首屏下载了多少字节、几个分块」，而你说的「卡顿」是**主线程在你动手时正忙**——那是它看不见的。新增 `npm run probe:jank`：在 390×844 + 4 倍 CPU 降速下，像一个拇指那样走一遍手机端（冷启动 → 滚动曲风库 → 打开曲风 → 打开播放器并让唱片转起来 → 五个模块页 → 探索三个子页），记录每一步的**长任务**（条数、累计阻塞、最长）、**帧间隔**（中位数、最长、以及**脱离设备自身节奏**的帧占比）和 DOM 规模。最后那个指标很关键：唱片在手机撑不住 60fps 时会**主动降到约 30fps**，而一条固定的「超过 32ms 就算卡」会把稳定的 30fps 判成「100% 卡顿」——那正好是把事实说反了。它的预算是**按步骤**给的（导航步骤看阻塞与最长任务；动画步骤看中位数/最长帧与离群帧），已进 `verify`，也是 CI 手动开关里的一个 `jank` 选项。
highlights.en: **Build the ruler before talking about smoothness.** `perf:check` answers "how many bytes and chunks before the first paint"; the stutter you meant is **the main thread being busy when your thumb does something**, which that gate cannot see. `npm run probe:jank` walks the phone the way a thumb does on a 390×844 profile at 4× CPU throttling (cold load → scroll the library → open a genre → open the player and let the record spin → all five modules → all three 探索 sub-pages) and records, per step, the **long tasks** (count, total blocked, worst), the **frame gaps** (median, worst, and the share of frames that are out of step with the device's own rhythm) and the DOM size. That last measure matters: the record deliberately settles to ~30 fps when a phone cannot hold 60, and a fixed "over 32 ms" line called a steady 30 fps "100 % janky" — the opposite of the truth. Its budgets are per step (a navigation step is judged on blocked time and its worst task; an animation step on median/worst frame and outliers), it runs in `verify`, and it is a `jank` scope on the manual CI switch.

highlights.zh: **播放器：唱片不再掉帧**。第一次测量是**100% 的帧超过 32ms**、2.5 秒窗口里主线程被阻塞 6057ms，打开播放器时 76.7% 的帧是坏的；CPU profile 显示 **80% 的采样在 `(program)`**——是浏览器的光栅化与绘制，不是 JS。所以改的都是「每帧要让光栅器做什么」：**静态的全部预烘焙**（标签的晕染、四条环轨、各声部光晕、唱针闪光都变成精灵图，一帧里再没有 `createRadialGradient`）；**唱片本体移出旋转变换**（它是画面上最大的一块，而它的纹路与环轨都是同心圆，旋转它一个像素都不会变——真正要转的是标签和步进点，两者都很小）；**唱针不再用 `shadowBlur`**（软件光栅器最怕的 canvas 状态），闪光改成烘焙光晕 + 阈值以上的 `globalAlpha`；**背板分辨率上限 2 → 1.5**（用审计做消融：4 倍降速下每帧 ~146ms → ~108ms；标签仍按 512px 烘焙，所以字仍然清晰；1.25 更快但会糊掉唱片上唯一需要读的 9px 等宽页脚）；**自适应帧率**：一帧仍要 ~12ms（不降速时，占 60Hz 预算的大半），所以循环看**帧与帧之间的间隔**，撑不住 60 就稳定在约 30fps，连续几帧便宜了再回到满帧率，而**输入永不等待**（`dirty` 直接画）；跳过的帧里弹簧、阻尼、时钟与 beat 从属量照常按真实时间推进，所以马达不会被拖慢；**beat 从属量量化并限频**（`--kick` 到百分位、`--breath` 到 0.05、最多每 80ms 一次、且只在取整后变化时写）——之前每帧都写 `.mobile-root`，等于 60Hz 让整个外壳重算样式；**空闲帧不再重绘**。交错 A/B（各 2 次取中位，4 倍降速）：打开播放器阻塞 3024 → **477ms**、离群帧 76.7% → **4.8%**；播放中 6171 → **3748ms**，并从中位 ~100ms 的稳定约 30fps 取代了原来忽快忽慢的掉帧。
highlights.en: **The player: the record stops dropping frames.** The first measurement was **100 % of frames over 32 ms**, 6 057 ms of blocked main thread in a 2.5 s window, and 76.7 % bad frames when opening the player; a CPU profile put **80 % of samples in `(program)`** — the browser's raster and paint, not JS. So every change is about what a frame asks the rasteriser to do: **everything static is baked** (the label wash, the four ring guides, the per-lane glows and the needle flash became sprites — no `createRadialGradient` is created in a frame any more); **the disc is blitted outside the rotation** (it is the largest thing drawn and its grooves and guides are concentric, so rotating it changed no pixel — what actually turns is the label and the sequencer dots, both small); **no `shadowBlur` on the needle** (the most expensive canvas state a software rasteriser can be asked for), replaced by a baked glow with `globalAlpha` above a threshold; **the backing-store cap went 2 → 1.5** (chosen by ablation on the audit: ~146 ms → ~108 ms per frame at 4×; the label is still baked at 512 px so its type stays crisp; 1.25 was faster again but softened the 9 px mono footer, the one thing on the record a user reads); **adaptive frame pacing** — a frame still costs ~12 ms unthrottled, most of a 60 Hz budget, so the loop watches the gap between paints and settles at ~30 fps when 60 is not being held, returning to full rate after a run of cheap paints, and **an input never waits** (`dirty` paints immediately); springs, damper, clock and beat slaves keep real time through a skipped frame, so the motor does not slow; **the beat slaves are quantised and rate-limited** (`--kick` to a hundredth, `--breath` to 0.05, at most every 80 ms, only when the rounded value changed) — they used to be written every frame onto `.mobile-root`, which made the whole shell recalculate style at 60 Hz; and **an idle frame does not repaint**. Interleaved A/B (medians of two runs, 4× throttle): opening the player 3 024 → **477 ms** blocked and 76.7 % → **4.8 %** out-of-step frames; while playing 6 171 → **3 748 ms**, with a steady ~30 fps (median ~100 ms) replacing uneven drops.

highlights.zh: **首页：曲风库分块渲染，冷启动阻塞 3010 → 1090ms**。profile 说代价是浏览器在 2578 个元素上的**样式与布局**（React 只占约 3%），所以：曲风行与时间轴节点加 `content-visibility: auto`（屏幕外的九成不再参与布局与绘制，配合 `auto` 固有尺寸，滚动条仍然诚实），并且列表**先渲染 24 行、之后每次翻倍**在空闲时间补齐——整库仍会在几百毫秒内进入 DOM，比拇指滑过第一屏还快，DOM 内容不变，所以计数类的测试只是改成等待「屏幕自己标称的数量」。**探索：打开与切换阻塞 1259 → 817ms**，和弦视图是最贵的挂载（约 1000 个元素、4 倍降速下单次 1350ms）：现在选子页是两次更新——分段控件（紧急，因为那是手指碰的东西）与视图挂载（React transition，让分段先画出来、重活在可中断的渲染里做），并且手机端把**和弦工作台默认收起**（专项探针 1335 → 236ms；视图本来就有收起开关与当前进行的摘要，桌面默认不变）。E2E 那条腿现在会先展开再断言样式——展开因此成为契约的一部分，锚点是新增的 `chord-builder-toggle`，不再依赖本地化文案。另外**搜索框原来是精确 44px**（正好压在触控门禁的线上，dpr 3 下布局成 43.9968，门禁四舍五入后报 `h: 44` 失败），现在 46px，与它所在的标签一致。
highlights.en: **首页: the library paints in chunks — cold-load blocking 3 010 → 1 090 ms.** The profile said the cost was the browser's **style and layout over 2 578 elements** (React was ~3 %), so the library rows and timeline eras take `content-visibility: auto` (the off-screen 90 % is no longer laid out or painted, with an `auto` intrinsic size so the scrollbar stays honest) and the list renders **24 rows first, then doubles** in idle time — the whole library is in the DOM within a few hundred milliseconds, faster than a thumb can scroll past the first screen, and because nothing is removed the counting tests now simply wait for the number the screen advertises. **探索: opening and switching 1 259 → 817 ms** — the chord view is the most expensive mount in the app (~1 000 elements, a single 1 350 ms block at 4× throttle), so picking a sub-page is two updates now: the segment (urgent — it is what the finger touched) and the view's mount (a React transition, so the segment paints first and the heavy render happens where React can interrupt it), and the phone mounts the **chord builder collapsed** (a dedicated probe: 1 335 → 236 ms; the view already ships the toggle and a summary of the current progression, and the desktop default is unchanged). The E2E leg expands it before asserting the styles, which makes the expand part of the contract, anchored on a new `chord-builder-toggle` testid rather than a localised label. **The search field was exactly 44 px tall** — right on the touch gate's line, laying out at 43.9968 at dpr 3, which the gate rounded and failed as `h: 44`; it is 46 px now, matching the label it sits in.

highlights.zh: **顺手修掉的操作性 bug**：手机端首屏的曲风库计数断言原来在「外壳刚出现」的瞬间读行数（分块渲染后时快时慢）；E2E 里那条「外壳列出了整个曲风库」的断言现在等待屏幕标称的数量，因此不会再随库大小漂移。
highlights.en: **A harness bug fixed on the way**: the phone leg counted library rows the instant the shell appeared, which chunked rendering made a race; it waits for the count the screen advertises now, so the assertion cannot drift with the size of the library.

title.zh: v2.9.0 播放器重影修掉、探索配色统一、底鼓可视化换肤、手机首屏不再下载曲风库、三套皮肤的挑战与探索重新配色、README 加图
title.en: v2.9.0 The Player's Doubled Text, One Accent Across 探索, Skin-Aware Kick Visualisers, a Phone First Paint With No Library Chunks, Re-Tuned 挑战/探索 for Three Skins, and README Screenshots

highlights.zh: **手机首屏不再下载整个曲风库**（这也是 GitHub CI 报的 `perf:check` 失败）。手机壳一直在 import `ALL_GENRES`，而那个数组是静态引入全部 14 个分类模块拼出来的——所以手机首屏其实会拉**全部 14 个分类分块**（4G + 4 倍 CPU 降速下 1061 KB），门禁只数 2.5 秒窗口内落地的请求，所以日志写「3」。现在手机用轻量索引 `GENRE_INDEX`（159 条的 id/名称/分类/年代/BPM，74 KB）浏览，只有真正需要 pattern 或文案时才 `loadGenre(id)` 取一条分类分块；`App` 里那个「默认曲风」也不再为手机路由加载（这里有个坑：路由会在首次提交时把 `/` 改写成 `/m/home`，所以那一刻 `shouldEnterPhoneShell` 回答「不是」，而屏幕上正是手机壳——判断必须问「手机壳是不是当前界面」，而不是「要不要切过去」）。实测桌面 1 块 / 1706.8 KB（工作台自己的默认曲风）、手机 **0 块**（原来 3 块 / 1061.1 KB），并加了一条守卫测试：`src/mobile/**` 一旦再出现 `ALL_GENRES` 就失败。
highlights.en: **The phone's first paint no longer downloads the library** — which is also the `perf:check` failure GitHub CI reported. The shell had always imported `ALL_GENRES`, an array built by statically importing all fourteen category modules, so a phone's first paint actually pulled **all 14 category chunks** (1061 KB on 4G + 4x CPU throttle); the gate only counts what lands inside its 2.5 s window, which is why the log said "3". The phone now browses the lightweight `GENRE_INDEX` (159 rows of id / name / category / decade / BPM, 74 KB) and calls `loadGenre(id)` for one chunk only when it needs a pattern or prose, and `App`'s default-studio load is skipped for phone routes. That last one had a trap: the router rewrites `/` to `/m/home` during the first commit, so at that moment `shouldEnterPhoneShell` answers "no" while the shell is exactly what is on screen — the question has to be "is the shell the surface?", not "should we switch?". Measured: desktop 1 chunk / 1706.8 KB, phone **0 chunks** (was 3 / 1061.1 KB). A guard test fails if `ALL_GENRES` ever appears under `src/mobile/` again.

highlights.zh: **三套皮肤的「挑战」和「探索」重新配色**（你点名的那三处违和）。**漫画**：挑战原本在印刷黄该出现的地方印了赭色 ink（棕色难度片、棕色进度条、棕色链接、棕色 CTA）——现在难度选中片/「下一题」键/播放键/探索选中的子标签都用**印刷黄 + 墨字**（14.95:1），对错改成**实心网点版**（绿与红的相对亮度只差 2%，所以用不同网点密度 + ✓/✗ 说明条区分），墨色只做轮廓与正文；探索的复用桌面视图由附加片段把半透明强调膜换成不透明贴纸、发光换成墨色描边、三个 `blur-3xl` 色斑换成青/品红套印版块。**现代极简主义**：挑战原本一页上有四种颜色（绿、红、模块锈红、实心强调片）——现在只剩纸/墨/发丝线 + 一个强调色，绿红**只**出现在判定的选项与横幅上，选中态改成「墨色井 + 1px 强调描边」而不是实心填充，并移除了 `ring-2` 光晕、`pulse-glow` 呼吸与错误项的 `opacity-75`；探索复用视图里那些红/粉/绿/紫字面量与 `emerald` 全部收敛到一个强调色（三个子页的非配色色相 3+13+1 → 0）。**苏联岁月**：挑战对错改成实心 `#1C5C2E` / `#9E0B22` 版块，并把里面**每一个**字形都改成纸色（之前字母与分类行的颜色和底色相同，根本读不出来），播放键改成国旗红实心 + 3px 墨框；探索切换器改成纸板 + 墨框 + 硬投影，选中的子标签用国旗红压纸（5.19:1）。
highlights.en: **挑战 and 探索 were re-tuned for the three skins you named.** **Comic**: the challenge screen printed the ochre *ink* where a press prints the yellow *plate* (brown difficulty chip, brown rank bar, brown link, brown CTA) — the engaged difficulty chip, the next-question key, the play key and the selected 探索 sub-tab are the yellow plate with ink type now (14.95:1), right/wrong are **solid halftone plates** (the two inks are within 2 % relative luminance, so dot density plus the check/cross caption bar carry what hue cannot) and ink is only outline and body; in the reused desktop views an appended fragment turns translucent accent films into opaque stickers, glows into ink keylines and the three `blur-3xl` blobs into cyan/magenta misregistration plates. **Modern minimal**: the challenge screen had four hues on a page whose language is one accent — it is paper/ink/hairline plus one accent now, with green and red **only** on the graded tile and the verdict, selection as an ink well + 1 px accent ring instead of a solid fill, and the `ring-2` halo, the `pulse-glow` breathing and the wrong tile's `opacity-75` removed; in the reused views every red/pink/green/violet literal and `emerald` collapses onto the single accent. **Soviet years**: right/wrong became solid `#1C5C2E` / `#9E0B22` plates with **every glyph inside them** switched to paper (the letter and the category line shared the flood's own colour and could not be read at all), the play key is a flag-red plate with a 3 px ink case, and the 探索 switcher is a paper plate with an ink frame and a hard shadow whose selected segment is flag red on paper.

highlights.zh: **苏联岁月：军旗符号换成镰刀锤子，即兴不再是黑板**。播放器左上角原来是 `repeating-conic-gradient` 的十二齿红色放射扇（远看确实像旭日旗）——现在是 38×38 的内联 SVG **镰刀锤子**（国旗红，公有领域图形，`url("data:image/svg+xml,…")` 内联，皮肤契约允许这一种 `url()`；不用 ☭ 字形是因为字体覆盖没保证，画成豆腐块更糟），不压唱片、不压返回键与顶栏。即兴原本是整块 `#111111`：现在网格卡与打击垫区是纸底，网格本体是 `--m-card-2` 凹槽（硬 `8px 8px 0` 墨影），步进格是石墨 `#2F2D27`（不是纯黑）的开关壳体、写入时套车道色 + 红色内圈 + 墨色五角星，打击垫外壳用比模块强调色深一档的钢蓝 `#243342`（珊瑚色压 `#2C3E50` 只有 4.31:1），dock 是纸板 + 墨框，ПРИКАЗ 从金色（纸上 2.09:1）改成墨色。
highlights.en: **Soviet years: the rising-sun mark became a hammer and sickle, and 即兴 is no longer a blackboard.** The player's top-left corner was a twelve-tooth red `repeating-conic-gradient` fan (which really does read as a rising sun) — it is a 38x38 inline-SVG **hammer and sickle** now (flag red, a public-domain drawing, embedded as an inline data URL, the one `url()` the skin contract allows; the ☭ glyph was rejected because font coverage is not guaranteed and a tofu box would be worse), placed clear of the record, the back chevron and the top bar. 即兴 used to be one `#111111` slab: the grid card and pad section are paper now, the grid itself is a `--m-card-2` well with a hard `8px 8px 0` ink shadow, the step cells are graphite `#2F2D27` switch housings (not pure black) that take the lane colour plus a red inner ring and an ink star when written, the pad cases are a shade of the module's steel blue (`#243342`), the dock is a paper plate with an ink frame, and ПРИКАЗ went from gold to ink.

highlights.zh: **你问苏联岁月播放器「重复重叠」是设计还是 bug——是 bug，而且是投影。** 该皮肤的面板规则写的是 `section > section`，于是**也命中了 `.m-player > .m-stage`**：整个舞台（包括控制区里的所有文字）被套上 `8px 8px` 的硬 `drop-shadow`。drop-shadow 是**元素 alpha 的副本**，所以控制区每个字都被画了两遍、错开 8px——「DEEP HOUSE」「122」「REALTIME SYNTH」「00:02」和两行提示全都重影。这种「浆糊贴传单」的硬投影只适合**文字离内边距很远的卡片**，不能用在成片小字上。现在舞台被排除在外（`section > section:not(.m-stage)`），顶部标语也改成单行截断。
highlights.en: **You asked whether the Soviet-years player's "duplicated" text was a design choice or a bug — it was a bug, and it was a shadow.** The skin's panel rule said `section > section`, which **also matched `.m-player > .m-stage`**, so the whole stage — including every glyph in the console — was drawn through a hard `8px 8px` `drop-shadow`. A drop-shadow is a *copy of the element's alpha*, so each character was painted twice, 8 px apart: "DEEP HOUSE", "122", "REALTIME SYNTH", "00:02" and both hint lines were all doubled. That paste-up poster shadow belongs on cards whose type sits well inside their padding; it cannot be used on a block of small text. The stage is excluded now.

highlights.zh: **探索三个模块的配色统一到当前皮肤的强调色**。皮肤层原本把和弦视图的强调色字面量（`#4ad8c8` / `#45e0c9` / `#38bdf8`）映射到固定的 `--m-teal`，于是在默认皮肤下那些标签和圆点在**一个强调色为蓝色的页面上仍是青绿色**——一个视图里两种强调色。现在它们解析到 `--m-gold`，也就是**模块的**强调色，既随皮肤也随模块。三个子页实测：琥珀色 0 处、错位青绿 0 处。
highlights.en: **探索's three modules now take the active skin's accent.** The layer mapped the chord view's accent literals (`#4ad8c8` / `#45e0c9` / `#38bdf8`) onto the fixed `--m-teal` token, so under the default skin those chips and dots stayed blue-green on a page whose accent is blue — two accents in one view. They resolve to `--m-gold` now, the *module's* accent, which is per skin **and** per module. Measured across all three sub-pages: zero amber, zero mismatched-teal colours.

highlights.zh: **底鼓设计里那块 canvas 的黄色也跟着换肤了**。和弦与律动是 DOM，改样式表就够；但底鼓的示波器/瀑布图/引力音序器**画在 canvas 上**，颜色写在 JS 里——实测默认皮肤与极简皮肤下那块画布上有 **2417 个琥珀色像素**（0.89%），这就是你说的「屎黄色残留」。现在三个可视化各自把**角色**（信号、网格、阈值、参考线）映射到当前皮肤 token，在绘制时解析成具体颜色（canvas 颜色字符串不能写 `var()`——`ctx.fillStyle = "var(--m-gold)"` 会被静默忽略、沿用上一次的颜色），并且在没有手机外壳时**逐字退回桌面原色**，桌面端一个像素都没变。
highlights.en: **The amber in the kick lab's canvas follows the skin now.** Chords and groove are DOM, so a stylesheet was enough; but 底鼓设计's oscilloscope, waterfall and gravitational sequencer paint on a canvas with colours written in JS — measured on the default and minimal skins that canvas held **2417 amber pixels** (0.89%), the residue you meant. Each visualiser now maps its *roles* onto the active skin's tokens and resolves them at draw time (a canvas colour string cannot contain `var()`: `ctx.fillStyle = "var(--m-gold)"` is silently ignored and the previous colour stays), and falls back to the desktop's exact original colours when there is no phone shell, so the desktop is pixel-identical.

highlights.zh: **顺带修掉一个只有截图才看得见的布局 bug**：即兴 dock 里那个 `+` 键在 390px 屏上落在 x 352–400——**有 10px 露在屏幕外**，而它不出现在滚动宽度里（那一行是裁切而不是滚动），所以门禁一直没反应。现在固定键都是 44px（触控下限）、BPM 读数收窄，三个皮肤实测最后一个键右边缘 381 / 360 / 377 ≤ 390、`body.scrollWidth` 从 400 回到 390；E2E 的即兴那条腿新增断言：**任何控件都不许出现在视口之外**。
highlights.en: **And a layout bug only a screenshot could see**: the dock's `+` key sat at x 352-400 on a 390 px screen — **10 px of a live control outside the viewport** — and it never showed up in the scroll width, because that row clips rather than scrolls, so no gate reacted. The fixed keys are 44 px now (the touch floor) with a narrower BPM readout; across the three skins the last key's right edge is 381 / 360 / 377 and `body.scrollWidth` is back to 390 from 400. The E2E jam leg gained an assertion that **no control may sit outside the viewport**.

highlights.zh: **皮肤层文件里 600 条死选择器清掉了**。上几轮扩皮肤的脚本在把注释移出选择器列表时，也把每行的 `:root[data-skin="…"]` 前缀拆成了单独一行，留下 `:root[data-skin="minimal"] :root[data-skin="comic"] …` 这种永远匹配不到的「后代组合」（不影响渲染——正确选择器还在同一列表里——但文件又长又误导，而且任何追加进那些列表的东西都会被吞掉）。现在死项全部移除：96 条规则里 81 条覆盖全部六套皮肤，剩下 15 条是刻意按皮肤分开的块。
highlights.en: **600 dead selector entries were removed from the skin-layer sheet.** The script that extended the layers to six skins, while moving comments out of selector lists, also split each line's `:root[data-skin=...]` prefix onto its own line, leaving entries like `:root[data-skin="minimal"] :root[data-skin="comic"] ...` — a descendant combinator that can never match. Nothing was broken (the correct selectors are still in the same lists) but the file was long and misleading. The dead entries are gone: 81 of the sheet's 96 rules cover all six skins and the remaining 15 are the deliberate per-skin blocks.

highlights.zh: **README 有图了**（中英两份）：工作站大图、一排四张手机截图（播放器 / 曲风库 / 即兴 / 挑战）、一张**六套皮肤对照表**（都取同一个播放器界面，方便一眼对比），以及一小组其余界面（曲风星系、和弦工坊、大师课、手机曲风详情页）。全部用真实浏览器对构建产物截图：桌面 1440×900、手机 390×844，JPEG，整套 1.1 MB。第一版拍到了首次运行的欢迎弹窗——所以脚本现在先把引导标记写进 localStorage 再拍。
highlights.en: **The READMEs have pictures now** (both languages): a studio hero, a row of four phone screens (player / library / jam / challenge), a **six-skin comparison table** (all taken on the same player screen, so the skins are comparable at a glance), and a small grid of the rest (genre galaxy, chord workshop, masterclass, the phone genre page). Every shot was taken from the built app in a real browser: 1440x900 desktop, 390x844 phone, JPEG, 1.1 MB for the set.

title.zh: v2.8.0 手机端第四轮：BPM 与实际一致、播放器不再高亮、探索去掉残留黄色、详情页有设计感、挑战反馈即时、耗时测试交给 GitHub CI 手动触发
title.en: v2.8.0 The Phone, Fourth Pass: the Tempo You See Is the Tempo That Plays, a Quiet Transport, No Amber Left in 探索, a Designed Genre Page, Instant Challenge Feedback, and the Slow Checks on a Manual CI Switch

highlights.zh: **显示的 BPM 终于是真的**。你报的「修改后下一首歌会不一致」下面其实是三处各自独立的不一致，同一个根因：界面印的是**数据里的数字**，引擎播的是另一个。① 播放条一直显示 `genre.default_bpm`（一个常量），所以你搓过盘之后它错的就是你改动的量——现在它通过新的 `readTempo` 直接读引擎的 `getBpm()`，挂在驱动进度轨的同一个 5Hz 定时器上；② 全屏播放器的速度只在这一屏首次挂载时播种一次、之后再不复位，于是切歌后读数、阻尼器、引擎各说各话——现在 `genre.id` 一变就重新播种；③ 唱片的数字会从**上一首**的速度缓动过去，等于给音乐演了一段它并没有做的过渡——切歌时直接跳到新值（引擎是同拍切过去的），只有搓盘才缓动，因为搓盘本来就是缓动。
highlights.en: **The displayed BPM is finally the real one.** The report — "it disagrees after a change and on the next song" — turned out to be three separate disagreements with one root cause: the UI printed a **number from the data** while the engine played another. (1) The player bar showed `genre.default_bpm`, a constant, so after a jog it was wrong by exactly the amount you had changed; it now reads the engine's own `getBpm()` through a new `readTempo`, on the same 5 Hz timer that drives its progress rail. (2) The full-screen player seeded its tempo once, from the genre it first mounted with, and never reset — so after a skip the readout, the damper and the engine each held a different number; a `genre.id` effect re-seeds it now. (3) The record eased its number *from the previous genre's* tempo, animating a transition the music was not making; it snaps on a genre change (the engine switched on the same beat) and keeps easing only for a jog, which is what a jog is.

highlights.zh: **播放器的按钮不再高亮**。移植时照搬了参考稿的「已启用」处理（强调色 + 小圆点），而你的意见是对的：**图形本身已经说明了这个键是什么**（循环箭头＝大曲风内循环、随机＝全部随机、清单＝曲目单），再加一层更响的颜色和圆点是在重复同一件事。五套皮肤都在画它（漫画的黄色印块、像素的强调色灯、苏联的压印板、苏联岁月的红色大键），大的播放键在三套皮肤里也是实心强调色——现在整条传输都是中性墨色，状态仍然通过 `aria-label`/`aria-expanded` 暴露给辅助技术，`.on` 类保留为钩子但没有任何规则去画它。顺带把播放条的底板改成**稳定的类名**（`m-player-bar-plate`）：漫画皮肤原本按字面工具类 `bg-[rgba(20,20,31,0.94)]` 匹配，我把 alpha 改成 `0.9` 的那天它静默失效，最小化播放条就变回深底压深字——你报的「黑不隆冬 看不清」，比任何门禁都早发现。命名钩子不会这样漂移。
highlights.en: **The player's buttons no longer highlight.** The port copied the reference's "engaged" treatment (accent colour plus a pip), and your point is right: **the glyph already says what the button is** (a repeat arrow for repeat-this-genre, a shuffle for shuffle-all, a list for the track list), so the colour and the pip repeat the same thing louder. All five skins were painting it (a yellow print block in comic, an accent lamp in pixel, a stamped plate in soviet, a red key in sovietYears) and the big play key was a solid accent fill in three of them — the whole transport is neutral ink now, the state still reaches assistive tech through `aria-label`/`aria-expanded`, and the `.on` class survives as a hook that nothing paints. While there: the bar's plate is addressed by a **stable class** (`m-player-bar-plate`) instead of its literal Tailwind utility. The comic skin matched `bg-[rgba(20,20,31,0.94)]`, so the day the alpha became `0.9` its paper override silently stopped applying and the minimised bar went back to dark-on-dark — your "黑不隆冬 看不清", which you found before any gate did. A named hook cannot drift like that.

highlights.zh: **「极光冷色」探索里那点老黄色，清掉了**。皮肤层（探索里复用的桌面视图、以及「更多」背后那四个面板）之前**故意只覆盖五套有独立样式表的皮肤**——`default` 没有自己的样式表，它就是 `mobile.css` 的基础外观——所以默认皮肤下那两个位置仍然是桌面配色：这就是你看到的黄色残留。现在 `legacySkin.css` 覆盖全部六套，实测在「和弦走向」子页里**找不到任何琥珀色**，底色变成外壳自己的 `rgb(11,11,20)`。面板那一层保留 `default` 豁免（那几个面板本来就是桌面的深色组件，压在深色外壳上是协调的），并且测试现在写明哪一层覆盖哪些皮肤，让这个区别是决定而不是疏漏。
highlights.en: **The last of the desktop amber is gone from 探索 under the default skin.** The skin *layers* — the reused desktop views in 探索 and the four panels behind 更多 — deliberately covered only the five skins that ship a stylesheet of their own (`default` has none: it is the base look in `mobile.css`), so under the default skin those two surfaces kept the desktop palette, which is the residue you saw. `legacySkin.css` covers all six now, and a probe of the chords sub-page finds **zero** amber-ish colours with the shell's own ground (`rgb(11,11,20)`) where the desktop's amber used to be. The panel layer keeps its `default` exemption on purpose (those panels are the desktop's own dark components and read fine against a dark shell), and the test now states which layer covers which skins, so the distinction is a decision rather than an oversight.

highlights.zh: **曲风详情页有设计感了，但仍然是一页文章**。① 头部变成一张海报：曲风自己的生成图**满幅铺开**，再通过一条亮度遮罩溶进底色（用遮罩而不是颜色，所以在六套皮肤的任何底色上都成立），112px 封面块、类别等宽小标、27px 的曲风名（全页唯一的展示级字号）、旁边是中文名；头部没有底板、描边、圆角，所以它不会变成一张卡片。② 六个事实字段收进头部的**一行速览条**（发源 · 年代 · 区间 · 默认速度 · 拍号 · 调式），每个单位都是裸 `<span>`，永远不可能变成卡片格子。③ **传承与演变变成图**：一条发丝竖轨串起节点——源头（祖先 + 「演化而来」）→ 曲风自己（金色菱形节点）→ 年代（同时代）→ 衍生（后代 + 「催生了」），横向关系在金色细线下另起一段「交叉与影响」；所有句式与每条策展描述都保留，每个曲风名仍是可点的内联链接（deep-house 这页有 23 个）。④ 列表有了节奏：律动各声部带 2px 左侧强调条，代表曲目编号 01…05，制作提示金色点列，文化背景是金色细线的引文块，六个段落之间用发丝横线分隔。⑤ 结尾是刻意的：相近曲风变成索引（每行下发丝线，加一条居中的金色结束线）。
highlights.en: **The genre page has design now, and is still one article.** (1) The header is a poster: the genre's own generated art bleeds full-bleed and dissolves into the ground through a **luminance mask** (a mask rather than a colour, so it is correct on all six skins' grounds), with a 112 px cover block, a mono category kicker, the name at 27 px as the page's single display moment, and the Chinese name beside it — no panel, border or radius on the header, so it cannot become a card. (2) The six facts moved into a **one-line at-a-glance strip inside the header** (origin · era · range · default tempo · time · key), every unit a bare `<span>`, so it can never turn into tiles. (3) **Lineage is a diagram**: one hairline rail with a node per stage — 源头 FROM (ancestors plus the "evolved from" sentence) → the genre itself as a gold rotated-square node → 年代 ERA (contemporaries) → 衍生 INTO (descendants plus the "gave rise to" sentence) — with lateral relations set off under a gold rule as 交叉与影响. Every sentence and every curated per-relation description is kept, and every genre name is still a tappable inline link (23 of them on deep-house). (4) Lists have rhythm: a 2 px left accent rule per rhythm voice, numbered key tracks, a gold-dot tip list, a gold-rule pull-quote for the cultural context, and a hairline above each movement. (5) The ending is deliberate: 相近曲风 is an index (hairline under every row) closed by a centred gold rule.

highlights.zh: **挑战的反馈就在眼前，答对自动下一题**。之前判定块渲染在选项**下面**，手机上经常要滑动才看得见，而且不好玩。现在：选项**就地标记**（你选的那个和正确答案各自变色，对为绿、错为红），判定变成**固定在视口内**的横幅（带本局得分、连胜、ELO，以及下一步动作），所以不用滚动；**答对**后停留一个能看清「为什么对」的节拍（约 1.2 秒）再自动进下一题，**答错不自动跳**、而是在横幅里给出明确的「下一题」——因为错的题需要时间读解释，这个区别写在代码注释里。另外补上了天梯/连胜/正确率三格状态、段位进度条与难度选择，让它更像一局游戏而不是一张表单。自适应难度与 ELO 逻辑（与桌面版共用）没有改。
highlights.en: **Challenge feedback is in front of you, and a correct answer advances itself.** The verdict used to render *below* the options, where on a phone it often needed a scroll, and it was not much fun. Now: the options are **marked in place** (yours and the correct one take their own colour — green for right, red for wrong), and the verdict is a **banner pinned inside the viewport** (with the points earned, the streak, the running ELO and the next action), so nothing has to be scrolled to. A **correct** answer holds for one readable beat (~1.2 s, so you see *why* it was right) and then advances by itself; a **wrong** one does not auto-advance and offers an explicit "next question" in the banner — a wrong answer needs time to read the explanation, and the file says so. The screen also gained the ladder / streak / accuracy row, a rank progress bar and the difficulty chips, which is what makes it feel like a round rather than a form. The adaptive difficulty and ELO logic (shared with the desktop view) is untouched.

highlights.zh: **耗时测试有了手动开关**（你的第 6 点）。7 目标浏览器矩阵、覆盖率、以及音频测量门禁（音色、响度新鲜度、GS-1 ABI）本来就在 `ci.yml` 的 nightly 任务里跑 `schedule` + `workflow_dispatch`，但要**只跑一部分**就得改定时或推一次提交。新的 `.github/workflows/manual-verify.yml` 是一个 `workflow_dispatch`：可以选择范围（`e2e` / `verify` / `audio` / `all`）、档位（`all` / `pc` / `mobile`）和目标名过滤（例如 `iPhone 14 (竖屏`），只安装该范围需要的浏览器，把矩阵与覆盖率产物上传为 artifact，并把**每个目标的通过/失败表写进运行页面的 summary**——所以结果可以直接读、直接复制给我，不必先下载 zip。`ciWorkflows.test.ts` 为它加了三条用例（触发器与输入、浏览器安装与两个 artifact、以及它引用的每个 `npm run` 都真实存在），`check:actions` 确认它的 action 都在 Node 24 运行时上。
highlights.en: **The slow checks now have a manual switch** (your point 6). The seven-target browser matrix, coverage, and the audio measurement gates (timbre, loudness freshness, the GS-1 ABI) already ran in `ci.yml`'s nightly job on `schedule` + `workflow_dispatch`, but running only *part* of them meant editing the schedule or pushing a commit. The new `.github/workflows/manual-verify.yml` is a `workflow_dispatch` with a scope (`e2e` / `verify` / `audio` / `all`), a profile (`all` / `pc` / `mobile`) and a target-name filter (e.g. `iPhone 14 (竖屏`); it installs only the browsers that scope needs, uploads the matrix and coverage artifacts, and writes the **per-target pass/fail table into the run page's summary** — so a result can be read and pasted without downloading a zip first. `ciWorkflows.test.ts` gained three cases for it (the trigger and inputs, the browser install and both artifacts, and that every `npm run` it names exists), and `check:actions` confirms its actions are on the Node 24 runtime.

title.zh: v2.7.0 两套新皮肤：现代极简主义 与 苏联岁月（构成主义宣传画）
title.en: v2.7.0 Two New Skins: Modern Minimal, and Soviet Years as a Constructivist Poster

highlights.zh: **现代极简主义**：纸白底、黑墨字、Inter、发丝细线、**只留一个强调色**。这套皮肤的大部分工作其实是**删掉深色底**：外壳的极光、胶片颗粒、呼吸光晕、`backdrop-filter`、每一处 `rgba(232,232,255,α)` 白色薄层（在白底上等于看不见，改成两倍 alpha 的黑）、两条渐变，以及三个只在浅色下才暴露的状态问题——变暗的选项 `opacity-40` 只有 2.7:1、页脚呼吸的 span 3.0:1、以及那个「更亮一档」的强调色（在浅色下「更亮」就是看不见）。强调色用 `#2358e6` 而不是 `#2f6bff`：外壳会把强调色**填成实心**（首页分类片、挑战难度片、探索分段、「下一步」按钮），`#2f6bff` 在该实心底上只有 4.31:1，而这个同色相低一档的值双向都能到 5.6:1。
highlights.en: **Modern minimal**: paper-white ground, black ink, Inter, hairline rules and **exactly one accent**. Most of the work was *deleting the dark ground*: the shell's aurora, film grain, breathing glow, `backdrop-filter`, every `rgba(232,232,255,α)` white wash (invisible on paper — now a black wash at twice the alpha), both gradients, and three failures that only a light ground exposes (a dimmed answer at `opacity-40` measured 2.7:1, the footer's breathing span 3.0:1, and a one-step-lighter highlight, when lighter means invisible). The accent is `#2358e6` rather than the specified `#2f6bff` because the shell *fills* chips with the accent (home category chips, the difficulty chip, the explore segment, the next button) and `#2f6bff` gives `--m-on-gold` 4.31:1 on that fill; the chosen value is the same hue a step down and clears 5.6:1 both ways.

highlights.zh: **苏联岁月**：按你给的四点做的构成主义宣传画。① **色彩暴力美学**：国旗红 `#CC0000` 主色 + 钢铁黑 `#111111` + 做旧纸张黄 `#F4F1E1`，勋章金与工业钢蓝只作为**形状**（`#FFD700` 只留在深色上的 `--m-gold-hi`）；所有柔和过渡、发光、模糊全部换成硬边几何；文字用纸色而不是黑色压在红底上——因为黑压红只有 3.21:1，纸压红是 5.19:1。② **构成主义几何**：`Russo One` 全站标题，`skewX(-10deg)` 只作用于四处展示文字（绝不作用于控件——触控门禁量的是**变换后**的盒子）；卡片/标签/面板/打击垫用 `clip-path: polygon()` 做对角线切割，硬投影 `10px 10px 0 #000` 放在外层或改用零模糊 `drop-shadow`（clip-path 会把自己元素的阴影一起裁掉，文件里写了这个取舍）；点击态 `translate(5px,5px)` 且阴影 10px→3px、过渡改成 `steps(2,end)`，像重型机械开关。③ **符号**：红星（标题旁、当前标签的指示条、唱片中心、已写入的步进格）、齿轮（舞台与打击垫的 `repeating-conic-gradient`）、俄文标语（`ПРАВДА` 页脚钢印、`ПРИКАЗ` 标语带）。④ **步进器**不再是轻巧圆点，而是物理拨动开关的壳体：深色内圈 + 顶面高光条，激活时整块翻红并压上纸色五角星。
highlights.en: **Soviet years**: the constructivist poster, built to the four points you gave. (1) **Violent colour**: flag red `#CC0000` as the accent with steel black `#111111` and aged paper `#F4F1E1`, medal gold and industrial steel blue used as *shape* (`#FFD700` survives only as `--m-gold-hi` on dark); every soft transition, glow and blur becomes hard-edged geometry; text on a red flood is paper rather than black, because black on red is 3.21:1 while paper on red is 5.19:1. (2) **Constructivist geometry**: `Russo One` for headings, `skewX(-10deg)` on four display runs only (never on a control — the touch gate measures the *transformed* box), diagonal `clip-path` cuts on cards, chips, panels and pads, with the hard `10px 10px 0 #000` shadow on the wrapper or as a zero-blur `drop-shadow` (a clip-path clips its own shadow; the file documents that choice), and a press of `translate(5px,5px)` with the shadow collapsing 10px to 3px and `steps(2,end)` transitions, like heavy machinery. (3) **Symbols**: red stars beside the wordmark, as the active tab's pip, at the record's centre and stamped into written steps; cogs on the stage and the pads; `ПРАВДА` as a footer stamp and `ПРИКАЗ` as a slogan band. (4) The **sequencer** is no longer light dots but switch housings — a dark inner ring, a lit cap, and an on-state flooding red under a paper five-pointed star.

highlights.zh: **皮肤层也一起扩到六套**：探索里复用的桌面视图（`legacySkin.css`）与「更多」里那四个面板（`panelSkin.css`）都以「列出所有已启用皮肤」的方式写选择器，所以新增皮肤必须同步改它们。这一步是脚本做的，而且做对了两个细节：注释要先挪走（这两个文件用散文解释自己，而散文里会引用选择器和花括号，正则会把句子当成规则「改写」），选择器列表要按括号深度切分（`bg-[#38bdf8]` 这种 Tailwind 任意值里就带逗号）。门禁测试也从「三个皮肤」改成遍历皮肤目录，否则新增皮肤时它会静默漏检——这正是它这次抓到的漏洞。
highlights.en: **Both skin layers were extended to six as well**: 探索's reused desktop views (`legacySkin.css`) and the four panels behind 更多 (`panelSkin.css`) list every styled skin in their selectors, so a new skin has to reach all of them. That step was scripted, and two details mattered: comments have to be stashed first (both files explain themselves in prose that quotes selectors and braces, and a regex will happily rewrite a sentence), and selector lists must be split on commas *at bracket depth* (Tailwind arbitrary values like `bg-[#38bdf8]` contain commas). The gate now loops over the catalogue instead of a hard-coded trio — which is exactly the hole it caught this time.

highlights.zh: **顺带修掉两处只有渲染才看得出来的问题**：当前标签的红星选择器写成了 `span`，而标签文字本身也是 `span`——于是「Home」被裁成五角星、星星又压在上面（现在只作用于 `span[aria-hidden=true]`，那颗指示条是组件唯一标了 aria-hidden 的 span）；另外即兴的**轨道标签不再用乐器色写字**——琥珀色写在纸白上只有 1.7:1，而浅色皮肤是受支持的选项，所以颜色移到旁边的色条上、文字回到外壳墨色，六套皮肤下都可读。
highlights.en: **Two things only the render caught, also fixed**: the active tab's star selector said `span`, and the tab's *label* is a span too — so Home was clipped into a star with a star on top of it (it targets `span[aria-hidden=true]` now, the pip being the only span the component marks hidden); and 即兴's lane labels no longer paint the *word* in the instrument colour, because amber on paper is 1.7:1 and a light skin is a supported choice — the colour moved to a bar beside it and the word takes the shell's ink, readable in all six skins.

title.zh: v2.6.0 手机端第三轮：唱臂落针位置修正、播放条重做、即兴变成乐器、曲风详情与时间轴补足内容、更多里头的面板也换肤
title.en: v2.6.0 The Phone, Third Pass: the Arm Lands Where It Should, a Rebuilt Player Bar, 即兴 as an Instrument, Real Content on the Genre Page and Timeline, and Skinned Panels

highlights.zh: **唱臂两个位置之前都是错的，这一版修正**：手臂的角度是从**转轴**量的，不是从唱片中心量的——`NEEDLE_ANGLE` 说的是唱针相对唱片的位置，而手臂绕的是唱片左上方那个转轴，所以手臂自身的工作角是 `atan2(针位−转轴)` ≈ **+0.82 rad**（向右下方指向唱片）。上一版直接用手臂画 `NEEDLE_ANGLE`，整整高了约 0.9 rad，于是**播放和停止时唱针都飘在唱片外**。现在有三个把几何讲清楚、无法再糊弄的函数（工作角 / 绘制角 / 针尖落点距离），测试断言的是耳朵能看见的事：**播放时针尖落在 0.9×半径的外圈上，停止时越过唱片边缘 14% 并停在中心上方**，三种真实尺寸都测。顺带第一次看得见行程：35.1° 停驻 → 47.2° 落针（12.1°），摆入抬臂、沟槽抖动、底鼓时唱头小幅上跳都在。
highlights.en: **Both arm positions were wrong; this fixes them.** The arm's angle is measured from its **pivot**, not from the disc centre: `NEEDLE_ANGLE` says where the stylus sits *relative to the disc*, and the arm rotates about a pivot above and to its left, so the arm's own working angle is `atan2(needle − pivot)` ≈ **+0.82 rad** — pointing right and down at the record. The previous release drew the arm at `NEEDLE_ANGLE` itself, about 0.9 rad too high, so the stylus floated outside the disc **both playing and stopped**. Three functions now name the geometry (working angle, drawn angle, stylus distance), and the test asserts what a listener sees: **playing, the stylus is on the 0.9 × radius outer ring; stopped, it is 14% past the disc edge and above the centre** — measured for the three real box sizes. The swing is visible for the first time too: 35.1° parked → 47.2° on the record (12.1°), with the mid-swing lift, groove chatter and kick hop intact.

highlights.zh: **播放条重做**：用户的原话是「太丑陋」，并且指出一个设计问题——**播放/暂停本身就有两个不同的图形，按钮不需要再高亮一次**。所以播放键现在只是图标（无填充、无光晕、无脉动，仍是 48px 触控区），其余部分围绕它重建：封面用曲风自己的真实图片（加载前是分类色）做成圆角描边缩略图；标题下加了一条**进度轨**，读的是唱片同一个传输时钟（直接写 DOM、5Hz，不走 React state，否则为了一个装饰每秒重渲五次整个外壳）；整行是一块可点区域（封面+标题+进度+箭头），两个按钮是它的兄弟节点；模式键保留参考稿那颗「已启用」小点，因为图标本身说不清这件事。
highlights.en: **The player bar was rebuilt.** The user's words were "太丑陋", plus a design objection: **play/pause already has two different glyphs, so the button does not need a second highlight**. The play control is an icon now (no fill, no glow, no pulse; still a 48 px target) and the rest was rebuilt around it: the artwork is the genre's real cover (the category colour until it loads) in a rounded, ringed thumbnail; a **progress rail** under the title reads the same transport clock the record does (written straight to the DOM at 5 Hz rather than through React state, which would re-render the whole shell five times a second for a decoration); the row is one tappable area with the two buttons as siblings; and the mode button keeps the reference's engaged pip, because the icon cannot say that on its own.

highlights.zh: **即兴从「表单」变成「乐器」**：① 顶部那张曲风卡并进底部控制块——曲风、播放、录制、速度、摇摆现在是一块（顺序仍是 网格 → 打击垫 → 控制块），之前「在下面开录制、在上面按播放」；② **每件乐器有自己的颜色**，用的是参考稿打击垫的那套色板，并且和唱片的 `LAYER_COLORS` 完全一致，所以底鼓在格子、打击垫、唱片外圈上是同一个琥珀色；轨道标签、按下的格子、播放头都用自己的颜色，六个垫子各有自己的颜色（拍手是粉色，不是军鼓的珊瑚色）；③ **终于有了单发音源**：`AudioEngine.auditionTrack(trackId, velocity, instrument)` 立刻播一个轨道的音色，走那条轨道自己的推子与插入链（预览就该是「混音后的声音」），并且可以点名音色模型，所以写进军鼓轨的拍手垫不会听起来像军鼓；④ **碰什么都响、都亮**：垫子每次点击都发声并发光（不管播放器是否在跑、是否开了录制；开着录制时还会写入播放头那一步），步进格子点击也会响它所属的轨道——这样在循环转回来之前就能听见自己在编辑什么，播放时每条轨道的播放头格子会用自己的颜色亮起。
highlights.en: **即兴 went from a form to an instrument.** (1) The genre card at the top merged into the bottom dock — genre, play, record, tempo and swing are one block now (order is still grid → pads → dock), where before you armed a take at the bottom and started it at the top. (2) **Every instrument has its own colour**, from the reference's own pad palette and identical to the vinyl's `LAYER_COLORS`, so the kick is the same amber on the cell, the pad and the record's outer ring; lane labels, lit cells and the playhead all take their lane's colour, and the six pads carry their own (a clap is pink, not the snare's coral). (3) **A one-shot voice at last**: `AudioEngine.auditionTrack(trackId, velocity, instrument)` plays one track's voice immediately through that track's own fader and inserts — a preview should be the sound as mixed — and it can name the model, so the clap and rimshot pads that write into the snare lane do not sound like a plain snare. (4) **Everything you touch sounds and lights up**: pads sound and flash on every tap (transport running or not, record armed or not — armed, they also write the step at the playhead), step cells sound their own lane so you hear what you are editing before the loop returns, and during playback each lane's playhead cell lights in its colour.

highlights.zh: **曲风详情页从 400 字变成 2100 字，而且仍然像一页文章**：数据全部是应用里已有的（缺字段就跳过，不出现空段）——发源/年代/区间/默认速度/拍号/调式；**传承与演变写成散文**（「由 Chicago House 与 Future House 演化而来，又直接催生了 Melodic House、Microhouse、Tropical House」，每个名字都可点进该曲风），并带上关系图自带的说明句、同时代曲风与该年代的定义性风格；听感与文化背景；按声部拆开的律动（底鼓 / 军鼓拍手 / 踩镲 / 打击乐 / 贝斯线 / 摇摆）；音色与和声；和弦走向；编制与曲式；制作提示；代表曲目（含艺人与年份）；相近曲风。全程只有小号等宽小标题和细线，没有卡片、药丸、每节一个图标。
highlights.en: **The genre page went from ~400 characters to ~2100, and still reads as one article.** All of it is data the app already ships, with missing fields skipped so no section is ever empty: origin, era, BPM range, default tempo, time signature, key/scale; **lineage and evolution as prose** ("Evolved from Chicago House and Future House, and directly gave rise to Melodic House, Microhouse and Tropical House", every name a link to that genre) plus the relation graph's own descriptions, the decade and its contemporaries, and the era's defining styles; character and cultural context; the rhythm section part by part (kick, snare/clap, hi-hat, percussion, bassline, swing); sound and harmony; progressions; instrumentation and song structure; pro tips; key tracks with artists and years; related genres. Only small mono kickers and hairlines — no cards, no chips, no icon per section.

highlights.zh: **首页垂直时间轴补足内容**：每个年代节点现在给出曲风数量、两行截断的该年代描述、**可点的曲风标签**（每个 id 都解析成曲库里真实存在的曲风，死 id 永远不会上屏，点了直接进那个曲风），以及从这些曲风的 `origin_place` 与类别推导出的「源自 … / 风格 …」——全部是已有数据推导，没有编造，`timeline_stories.ts` 一个字节都没改（所以桌面版时间轴完全不受影响）。仍是 300px 上限、自己滚动的竖轨（实测内容 2721px 可滚，节点 172–328px），曲风库依然在首屏可见。诚实的取舍：年代里的曲风标签是 32px 高而不是 44px（14 个曲风的年代否则要五行 44px，在 300px 窗口里会喧宾夺主；标签是真按钮，曲风库自己的行仍是 46px），另外两个 14 曲风的节点略高于窗口——这是选择了不截断列表。
highlights.en: **The home timeline now says something.** Each era node shows the genre count, a two-line clamped excerpt of that era's description, **tappable genre chips** (every id resolved to a real library genre, so a dead id can never render, and a tap opens it), and the origins and styles derived from those genres' own `origin_place` and category fields — all derived from shipped data, nothing invented, and `timeline_stories.ts` is byte-identical (so the desktop timeline is provably unaffected). It is still a capped 300 px vertical rail with its own scroll (measured: 2721 px of content, nodes 172–328 px) and the library still starts above the fold. Two honest trade-offs: the era chips are 32 px tall rather than 44 (a 14-genre era would otherwise be five 44 px rows inside a 300 px window; they are real buttons, and the library's own rows stay 46 px), and the two 14-genre nodes are slightly taller than the window — chosen over truncating the list.

highlights.zh: **「更多」里头的面板也换肤了**：更新记录、设置、手册、搜索这四个面板之前是桌面的暗色（而且上一版之前根本打不开，所以看不出来）——现在它们跟着当前皮肤走：对话框与遮罩、头尾栏、分区行、边框圆角、标题正文等宽字体、标签页、输入框/下拉/焦点环、滚动条与选区，以及强调色填充按钮（文字取 `--m-on-gold`）。作用域是 `App.tsx` 里包住这四个「手机版」的那层 `m-panels`：它们是外壳的兄弟节点而不是子节点，`.mobile-root …` 选不到它们，而只按 `data-skin` 又会连桌面打开的同一批对话框一起染色，那是不想要的。`default` 皮肤刻意保留面板自己的样子。
highlights.en: **The panels inside 更多 are skinned too.** 更新记录 / 设置 / 手册 / 搜索 were the desktop dark-amber components (and until the previous release they did not even open, which is why this was invisible) — they now follow the active skin: dialog surface and scrim, header and footer bars, section rows, borders and radii, heading/body/mono type, tabs, inputs / selects / focus rings, scrollbars and selection, and the accent-filled buttons whose labels take `--m-on-gold`. The scope is the `m-panels` wrapper `App.tsx` puts around exactly the phone copies: they are siblings of the shell rather than children, so `.mobile-root …` cannot reach them, while `data-skin` alone would also re-tint the same dialogs when the desktop opens them, which is not wanted. `default` deliberately keeps the panels' own look.

title.zh: v2.5.0 手机端第二轮：避开灵动岛、播放器擦盘声与阻尼、皮肤字体与苏联符号、探索换肤、更多面板真的能打开
title.en: v2.5.0 The Phone, Second Pass: Clear the Dynamic Island, a Real Scratch and Damper, Skin Typography and Soviet Symbols, Skinned 探索, and 更多 Panels That Open

highlights.zh: **灵动岛避让**：外壳是 `viewport-fit=cover` 的控制面板，安全区是真实布局空间，但 `main` 之前完全没有顶部内边距——有灵动岛的机器上，品牌字就压在岛下面。现在 `main` 吃 `env(safe-area-inset-top)`，加上横屏时的左右安全区，所以每个模块都让开了：浏览页、全屏播放器、曲风详情页、以及探索里嵌入的桌面视图。没有安全区的设备上这是 0 变化。
highlights.en: **Clearing the Dynamic Island.** The shell is a `viewport-fit=cover` control surface, so safe areas are real layout space — and `main` had no top inset at all, which put the wordmark behind the island on a device that has one. `main` now takes `env(safe-area-inset-top)` plus the left/right insets (a landscape notch is on the side), so every module clears it: browsing, the full-screen player, the genre page and the embedded desktop views in 探索. A no-op on hardware without insets.

highlights.zh: **播放器：擦盘声 + 阻尼 + 唱臂姿态**。① 拖动唱片之前是无声的——现在按参考稿那条滤波噪声（带通、频率跟随手指速度、松手短尾）发声，跑在试听引擎自己的 context 上、走音乐总线。② 显示的速度本来就在缓动，但**引擎是跳变的**，所以缓动只是装饰；现在画布循环把阻尼的每个整数 BPM 报给引擎（参考稿的调度器每帧读的就是阻尼后的 BPM），搓盘因此真的会「转起来/慢下去」。读数也交回阻尼器拥有：React 只画一次初值，否则先跳到目标再被循环写回更低的值，数字会先上跳再回落。③ 唱臂之前在两个状态下都低了约 24°（移植时多减了一次唱针角，正好抵消行程），所以它从没真正落到唱片上、停止动画也几乎不动。现在 `tonearmDrawAngle()` 是唯一定义（停驻 = 工作角 -0.21 rad，工作角 = 唱针角），摆入抬臂、沟槽抖动、底鼓时唱头小幅上跳都在，并对两端都做了断言。
highlights.en: **Player: the scratch, the damper, and where the arm actually points.** (1) Dragging the record made no sound; it now plays the reference's filtered noise band (bandpass, frequency from finger speed, short release tail) on the audition engine's own context, through the music bus. (2) The displayed tempo eased but the *engine* jumped, so the easing was cosmetic — the canvas loop now reports each whole-BPM step of the damper and the engine follows, which is what the reference's scheduler does and what makes a jog audibly spin up and down. The readout is owned by the damper too: React paints the value once, because rendering the target there made the number jump up, fall back and climb again. (3) The arm was drawn about 24° low in *both* states (the port subtracted the needle angle as well as adding the rest angle, cancelling the travel), so it never reached the record and the stop animation barely moved; `tonearmDrawAngle()` is the single definition now, with the mid-swing lift, groove chatter and kick hop intact, and both ends asserted.

highlights.zh: **皮肤字体到位**：复古漫画改成手写体（标题 Permanent Marker、正文 Patrick Hand，`.m-mono` 保留等宽并加了手写标注），8-bit 全子树换成像素体（偏离字体的文本元素从 192 个降到 0，全部在探索里），苏联风加了真正的苏联符号：近卫绶带、`clip-path` 五角红星（贴在当前模块标签上）、齿轮、模板铭牌与厂号、红色楔形与警戒斜纹、黄铜仪表刻度。唱片是 canvas 画的，字体继承不到——所以新增 `--m-font-display`/`--m-font-mono` 两个 token，画布像读 `--m-gold` 一样读它们，唱片标签因此也跟着皮肤走。
highlights.en: **The skins' typography lands.** The comic skin is hand-lettered now (Permanent Marker for display, Patrick Hand for body, `.m-mono` kept monospace with a hand-annotated treatment); the 8-bit skin forces pixel faces on the whole subtree (off-family text elements went from 192 to 0, all of them in 探索); and the Soviet skin gained real Soviet symbols — a Guards ribbon, a `clip-path` five-point star over the active module tab, a gear, stencil placards with a plant number, a red wedge and a hazard chevron, and brass gauge ticks. The record is canvas-drawn and inherits nothing, so `--m-font-display` / `--m-font-mono` are now tokens the canvas reads the way it already reads `--m-gold` — the vinyl label follows the skin too.

highlights.zh: **探索：拿掉手机做不到的东西，布局收紧，并且跟着皮肤走**。底鼓的「返回工作台」和手册按钮是空的（之前传的是 noop），现在干脆不传、整块消失；律动解构的「载入工作台」把 `onOpenStudio` 改成可选并按需渲染（桌面照旧）。布局另加一层只作用于 `[data-legacy="desktop"]` 的样式：把重复的 `px-4`/`py-8` 让出的宽度还给内容，段间距 40→16、面板内边距 24→14，标题降一档，`min-width: 0` 与媒体 `max-width: 100%` 保证只有乐器自己的横向滚动区在滚。子页切换器也从浮动药丸轨道改成整宽三段控件。**三套皮肤现在也覆盖这些复用视图**（之前它们一律是桌面的暗琥珀色）：页面底色、面板、约 80 个字面 `bg-[#…]` 深度、强调色字面量、文本、边框圆角、输入框/下拉、ring/glow、滚动条与选区都映射到皮肤 token，九个「皮肤×子页」组合的逐元素对比度审计 0 失败。唯一 CSS 够不到的是底鼓那三块 canvas 示波器/瀑布图（轨迹色写在 JS 里），它们的底板会换肤、像素不会。
highlights.en: **探索: remove what a phone cannot do, tighten the layout, and make it wear the skin.** The kick lab's "return to studio" and guide buttons were inert (they were being handed no-ops); they are simply not passed now and the whole block disappears, and 律动解构's "bake to studio" became an optional prop rendered on demand (desktop unchanged). A second sheet, scoped to `[data-legacy="desktop"]`, gives the content back the width a duplicated `px-4`/`py-8` was eating and tightens the rhythm — section gaps 40→16, panel padding 24→14, headings one step down, `min-width: 0` and `max-width: 100%` so only the instruments' own horizontal scrollers scroll. The sub-page switcher is a full-width three-segment control instead of a floating pill rail. And **the three skins now cover those reused views** (they were uniformly desktop dark-amber): page ground, panels, the ~80 literal `bg-[#…]` depths, accent literals, text, borders and radii, inputs and selects, rings/glows, scrollbars and selection all map onto the skin's tokens, with zero contrast failures across the nine skin×sub-page combinations. The one thing CSS cannot reach is the kick lab's three canvas visualisers, whose traces are hardcoded RGB in JS — their plates take the skin, their pixels do not.

highlights.zh: **更多里的功能不再是空的**：更新记录、设置、手册、搜索这四个面板之前**只挂在桌面分支**，所以手机上每一行都是「设置了一个没人渲染的状态」——正是你说的「都是空的」。现在手机分支也挂上同一批组件（更多那一屏本来就解释了为什么复用：它们已经响应式，而写第二份副本正是手机和桌面开始对同一个设置各说各话的方式）。唯一不能直接复用的是面板**往外跳**：手册里的专题链接会把桌面路由空间搬走、把手机用户甩进桌面界面，所以那些链接现在打开手机自己的模块（它指向的理论工具都在探索，其余回首页），搜索结果同理。顺带修掉更新记录里一直原样打印的 `**粗体**` 标记——192 条历史记录不该为了渲染器改写，改的是渲染（一个纯函数、有测试、未闭合的 `**` 会原样留着而不是吞掉后文）。
highlights.en: **更多 is no longer empty.** The four panels it opens — updates, settings, manual, search — were mounted **only in the desktop branch**, so on the phone every row set state that nothing rendered, which is exactly the user's report. The phone branch mounts the same components now (the 更多 screen already documents why: they are responsive, and a second copy is how a phone and a desktop come to disagree about a setting). The one thing that cannot be reused is navigation *out* of a panel: the help centre's topic links move the desktop route space and would drop a phone user into the desktop UI, so they open the phone's own module instead (the theory tools they point at live in 探索; everything else lands in 首页), and search results open the genre in the shell. Also fixed: the `**bold**` markers the changelog has always printed literally — 192 entries are a release record and were not edited to suit a renderer, the renderer was (~30 lines, pure, tested, and an unclosed marker stays visible rather than swallowing the sentence).

title.zh: v2.4.0 皮肤系统：复古漫画 / 苏联重工业 / 8-bit 像素，设置里一键切换
title.en: v2.4.0 A Skin System: Retro Comic, Soviet Heavy Industry and 8-bit Pixel, Switched in Settings

highlights.zh: **皮肤是一个属性，不是一套分支代码**。四种外观写在 `data-skin` 上（`groove_skin_v1` 持久化，**首帧之前**就应用，否则每次冷启动都会先画默认皮肤再闪一下），每个皮肤的样式表都限定在 `:root[data-skin="…"] .mobile-root` 之下——所以切换不需要任何组件订阅，皮肤之间也不可能互相漏色。
highlights.en: **A skin is one attribute, not a second code path.** The four looks live on `data-skin` (persisted in `groove_skin_v1`, applied **before the first paint** — an effect would draw the default skin and then flash), and every skin stylesheet is scoped to `:root[data-skin="…"] .mobile-root`. Nothing has to subscribe for a change to reach the screen, and no skin can leak into another.

highlights.zh: **复古漫画（蜘蛛侠平行宇宙那种印刷感）**：新闻纸底 + 分层网点（Ben-Day）、粗黑油墨描边与零模糊硬投影、青/品红套印偏移（标题与播放器光晕）、黄色专色顶带、黑底黄线的标签栏；字体 Bangers + Comic Neue。**苏联重工业**：冲压钢板面板（2px 边 + 内高光/内暗边 + 硬投影）、径向渐变铆钉、固定的模板/轧制纹理、传输条上的 45° 警戒斜纹、搪瓷信号灯配色；字体 Russo One + PT Sans Narrow。**8-bit 像素**：只用七色、2px 硬边 + 阶梯投影、切角像素块、扫描线、棋盘抖色表示失效态、去掉所有发光；字体 Press Start 2P + VT323。
highlights.en: **Retro comic (Into the Spider-Verse print feel)**: newsprint with a layered Ben-Day dot screen, heavy ink outlines with hard zero-blur block shadows, cyan/magenta misregistration on the display type and the player's aura, a yellow spot-colour band, a black tab bar with a yellow rule, and Bangers + Comic Neue. **Soviet heavy industry**: stamped steel panels (2px border, inset light/dark bevel, hard shadow), radial-gradient rivets, a fixed formwork/mill texture, a 45° hazard rule on the transport rail, enamelled signal-lamp accents, and Russo One + PT Sans Narrow. **8-bit pixel**: a strict seven-colour palette, 2px frames with stepped shadows, clipped pixel corners, scanlines, checkerboard dither for inactive states, every glow removed, and Press Start 2P + VT323.

highlights.zh: **切换处在「更多 → 外观」**：四个选项各自画出自己的底色/强调色/文字色预览（预览色放在数据里，因为未激活皮肤的规则根本不会应用，取不到计算值），当前项有描边与勾选，语义上是真正的 radiogroup（`aria-checked`），不是四个开关按钮。皮肤 CSS 的全部硬规矩都由测试守住而不是靠人看：不许 `!important`、不许外链与 `@font-face`、不许改几何属性（会破坏 44px 触控门禁）、必须定义整套 token、必须五个模块五个不同强调色、每条选择器都必须带作用域。
highlights.en: **The switch lives in 更多 → 外观**: four options, each painting a preview of its own ground/accent/ink (those colours are data, because an inactive skin's rules never apply and cannot be read back from the cascade), with the active one outlined and checked, as a genuine `radiogroup` (`aria-checked`) rather than four toggles. The skins' rules are held by tests rather than by review: no `!important`, no external assets or `@font-face`, no geometry properties (which would break the 44 px touch-target gate), the full token set defined, five distinct module accents, and every selector scoped.

highlights.zh: **范围说清楚**：皮肤目前作用于手机外壳（设计工作所在的那一面）。桌面端的调色板是写死在 `tailwind.config.js` 里的十六进制，要换肤得先把那套调色板变成 CSS 变量——那是另一件事，这一版没有假装做了。唱片本身是 canvas 画的，所以它的盘面与唱臂在任何皮肤下都保持绘制出来的样子（它周围的 chrome 会跟着换）。
highlights.en: **Scope, stated plainly**: skins cover the phone shell, which is where the design work lives. The desktop's palette is hardcoded hex in `tailwind.config.js`, so re-skinning it means converting that palette to variables first — a separate change this release does not pretend to have made. The record itself is canvas-drawn, so its disc and tonearm keep their painted look in every skin (the chrome around it follows).

highlights.zh: **同版修掉手机矩阵横屏第一轮抓到两个真 bug**：横屏播放器的唱片被压到 143px（现在是双栏：唱片按高度取 66dvh、控制在一块 `.m-console` 里，实测 224px），即兴的吸附式节奏条在 390px 高的屏幕上盖住了它所属的网格（实测网格底 385、悬浮条 204–318），横屏改回文档流。
highlights.en: **Also fixes the two real bugs the phone matrix's first landscape pass found**: the player's record was squeezed to 143 px in landscape (the stage is two columns now — record sized from the height at 66dvh, controls in a `.m-console` column — measured 224 px), and 即兴's sticky tempo dock sat on top of the grid it belongs to on a 390 px-tall screen (grid bottom 385, dock 204–318); on a short landscape phone it goes back into the flow.

title.zh: v2.3.0 手机端五项到位：播放器直接移植 player2、每个曲风一张真图、探索复用老视图、即兴合成一个控制块、首页时间轴回归
title.en: v2.3.0 Five Things the Phone Was Missing: the player2 Port, a Real Cover Per Genre, Reused Desktop Views, One Jam Dock, and the Timeline Back

highlights.zh: **播放器现在是 player2.html 的移植，不是「参考它做的」**。上一版把参考稿的观感删掉了：扁平的唱盘标签、React 做的进度条、带边框的按钮排。这一版把代码搬了过来——预渲染的纹路（约 1500 条弧线、划痕、灰尘、边缘环）、印着每件乐器 16 格刻度的标签与四套盘纸、四层光（中心弥散光、轨道环、搓盘高光、固定高光）、随拍点脉冲的时序点阵、落针涟漪；唱臂是刚体旋转（停驻托架、摆入抬臂、沟槽抖动、底鼓时唱头小幅上跳、落针闪光）；速度用参考稿的 `1-exp(-dt/130)` 阻尼，所以数字像电机一样滑过去而不是跳过去。**拍点也接上了周边**：`--bpmBeat`/`--kick`/`--breath` 每帧写到 `.mobile-root`，状态灯、顶部光晕、播放键与均衡器条全部由它们驱动。舞台照抄参考稿：顶栏（品牌 + 活状态灯）、拖动提示、曲名与速度（± 支持 420ms 后连发）、2px 进度轨与「实时合成 · 无限循环」、五个传输键、以及下拉曲目单（正在播放那行有三条均衡器）。
highlights.en: **The player is now a port of `player2.html`, not "inspired by" it.** The previous version had deleted the reference's look: a flat label, a React progress bar, a bordered button row. This one brings the code across — the baked groove texture (~1500 arcs, scratches, dust, edge rings), the printed label with a 16-tick band per instrument and its four paper stocks, four lighting layers (centre bloom, ring guides, scrub shine, fixed sheen), the sequencer dots that pulse per step, landing ripples. The arm is a rigid rotation (cradle, mid-swing lift, groove chatter, headshell hop on the kick, needle flash on touchdown), and the tempo uses the reference's `1-exp(-dt/130)` damper, so the number slides like a motor instead of jumping. **The beat drives the chrome too**: `--bpmBeat`/`--kick`/`--breath` are written onto `.mobile-root` every frame, and the status dot, the aura, the play button and the equaliser bars are animated from them. The stage follows the reference: top bar with a live status dot, drag hint, name and tempo (± repeats after 420 ms), the 2px rail with its realtime-synth line, five transport buttons, and the pull-down track list with an equaliser on the playing row.

highlights.zh: **每个曲风一张真图**：159 张 320×320 的实拍照片（Lorem Picsum，来源为 Unsplash 许可，出处与可复现的下载地址记在 `public/covers/CREDITS.md`），共约 2.8MB。新增 `genreCovers.test.ts` 守住这套资源：每个曲风必须有图、没有小于 2KB 的残图、没有多余文件、出处文件还在。`genreArt.ts` 本来就更偏好真实文件，所以换图或删图都不用改代码。
highlights.en: **A real photograph per genre**: 159 320×320 photos (Lorem Picsum, which serves Unsplash-licensed images; the licence and the reproducible URL pattern are in `public/covers/CREDITS.md`), ~2.8 MB in total. A new `genreCovers.test.ts` guards the set: every genre has a file, none is under 2 KB (a truncated download), there are no orphans, and the credits file still says where they came from. `genreArt.ts` already preferred a real file over the generated art, so pictures can be swapped or dropped without touching code.

highlights.zh: **探索改成挂载老视图，不再自己造一份**：三个子页现在是应用自己的 `ChordProgressionsView` / `KickAnatomyView` / `MasterclassView`，和弦走向仍然是第一个也是默认页，三个都包在 `[data-legacy="desktop"]` 里（这正是触控尺寸门禁豁免的标记——桌面布局的密集控件不是手机控件）。顺手删掉了手机版那套 `KickLab`/`ChordLab`/`GrooveLab` 与它们的音频接线。
highlights.en: **探索 now mounts the app's own views instead of reimplementing them**: the three sub-pages are `ChordProgressionsView` / `KickAnatomyView` / `MasterclassView`, chords still first and still the default, each inside `[data-legacy="desktop"]` — the marker the touch-target gate exempts, because a desktop layout's dense controls are not phone controls. The phone-only `KickLab`/`ChordLab`/`GrooveLab` and their audio wiring are gone.

highlights.zh: **即兴：控制合成一块，摇摆变成手感滑轨**。录制键和状态提示从顶上搬下来，跟速度合成一个固定在标签栏上方的控制块（顺序仍是 曲风 → 网格 → 打击垫 → 控制块）。摇摆不再是四个百分比按钮（那是分段控件假装手感），改成可拖的轨道：填充、滑钮、实时百分比，量化到 5%，范围不变，也支持方向键。
highlights.en: **即兴: one dock, and swing as a feel rail.** The record button and its hint moved down from the header into a single dock pinned above the tab bar together with the tempo (order is still genre → grid → pads → dock). Swing is no longer four percentage chips — a segmented control pretending to be a feel — but a draggable rail: fill, handle, live percent, quantised to 5%, same range, arrow keys included.

highlights.zh: **首页的垂直时间轴回来了，曲风详情页变轻**。时间轴复用桌面 `VerticalTimelineView` 的同一份 `TIMELINE_STORIES` 数据（不再有第二份年代表），是一条 300px 上限、自己滚动的竖轨：每个年代一个节点，年代 + 一行标题，56px 行高。详情页则去掉了卡片与药丸：现在就是图、标题、副标题，然后平铺的标签行与行距宽松的正文，编制是一行点号连接的文本，相近曲风是纯文本行——整页唯一的控件是返回箭头和这些链接。
highlights.en: **The home screen's vertical timeline is back, and the genre page is light.** The timeline reuses the same `TIMELINE_STORIES` the desktop `VerticalTimelineView` renders (no second era table): a 300 px-capped, self-scrolling rail with one node per era — era label plus a one-line title, 56 px rows. The genre page lost its tiles and pills: art, title, subtitle, then plain label/value rows and generously line-spaced prose, the instrumentation as one dot-joined line, related genres as plain text rows. The only controls on the page are the back arrow and those links.

title.zh: v2.2.4 真正去掉黄色：极光冷色底 + 每个曲风一张自己的封面图；并移除「拿去即兴」
title.en: v2.2.4 Amber Actually Gone: an Aurora Ground, a Cover Per Genre, and No Jam Hand-Off

highlights.zh: **先承认一件事**：v2.2.1 声称换了配色，但那次改动**没有真正写进 `mobile.css`**（脚本替换静默失败，我只验证了「构建通过」而没验证「琥珀色字符串已消失」）。所以线上一直是那套屎黄色——这一版是真正生效的一次：冷调近黑底（#0b0b14）、中性白文字、默认强调色青绿，模块配色为 即兴 紫 / 挑战 玫瑰 / 探索 蓝 / 更多 灰，并且**验证了 `#e9a23b` 在样式里为 0 次出现**。
highlights.en: **One admission first**: v2.2.1 claimed a new palette but the change **never reached `mobile.css`** (the scripted replacement failed silently, and I verified the build rather than the amber string). The live build stayed amber; this one is real: a cool near-black ground (#0b0b14), neutral white ink, teal default accent, and per-module accents (jam violet / challenge rose / explore blue / more slate) — with `#e9a23b` verified to appear **zero** times in the stylesheet.

highlights.zh: **每个曲风有自己的封面图**：按你给的参考图的极光质感（紫 → 粉 → 青，深色底、多层径向光晕）**程序化生成**——同一曲风永远同一张、不同曲风互不相同、六个类别各有色相带。同时留了**真实图片的入口**：把 `<genre-id>.jpg` 放进 `public/covers/` 就会自动覆盖生成图，不需要改代码。**没有直接塞入真实照片**，是因为这个环境离线、且 159 张图的版权归属需要你来定；生成图今天就能用，真实图随时可替换。
highlights.en: **Every genre gets its own cover**: generated from the aurora look in your reference (violet → pink → teal over a dark ground, layered radial glows) — the same genre always looks the same, different genres differ, and each of the six categories has its own hue band. There is also a **real-image hook**: drop `<genre-id>.jpg` into `public/covers/` and it takes over automatically, no code change. Real photographs are not bundled because this environment is offline and 159 images need a licensing decision from you; the generated covers work today and the real ones can land any time.

highlights.zh: **「拿去即兴」已按你的要求移除**：曲风详情页不再有任何按钮（除了左上角的返回），点页面任意非链接处也能返回。
highlights.en: **The jam hand-off is gone, as asked**: a genre's page now has no buttons at all besides the back arrow, and tapping anywhere that is not a link also returns.

highlights.zh: **测试**：新增 `genreArt.test.ts` 5 条（确定性、曲风之间互异、六个类别色相带互异、纯 CSS 合法且色相在 0–360 内、真实图片入口的 URL 转义）＋ 手机外壳 37 条（其中详情页用例改为断言「既无播放键也无即兴入口」）。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 5 new `genreArt` cases (deterministic, distinct across genres, six distinct category bands, valid CSS with in-range hues, and the cover-URL escaping) plus the 37 shell cases (the detail case now asserts *neither* a play control *nor* a jam hand-off).

title.zh: v2.2.3 曲风库去掉重复播放键：点卡片即进详情并自动播放；全屏页面不再有底部导航
title.en: v2.2.3 The Library Loses Its Repeated Play Buttons: Tap a Card to Open and Play; Full-Screen Pages Drop the Tab Bar

highlights.zh: **每行一个一模一样的播放键确实丑，而且多此一举**：曲风卡片现在整块就是目标——**点一下进入该曲风详情页并自动开始播放**，色块只作身份标识（播放中显示暂停标记），不再是一个按钮。一次手势完成「打开 + 试听」。
highlights.en: **One identical play button per row was ugly and redundant**: the card is now the whole target — **one tap opens that genre's page and starts it playing**, and the colour square is identity only (it shows a pause mark while playing) rather than a control. One gesture does "open and audition".

highlights.zh: **曲风详情页里没有任何播放键**：页面上唯一的交通是**最下方的播放条**与左上角的收起箭头；**点页面任意非链接处、或点箭头，都回到上一屏**（页面上有一行小字提示）。「拿去即兴」保留，它是导航而不是播放。
highlights.en: **The genre page has no play control at all**: its only transport is the **player bar at the bottom**, plus the collapse arrow top-left. **Tapping anywhere that is not a link — or the arrow — returns to the previous screen** (a one-line hint says so). "Jam with this" stays: it is navigation, not playback.

highlights.zh: **全屏页面不再有底部导航**：进入全屏播放器或曲风详情页时，五格模块栏隐藏（内容底部留白随之适配），播放条在没有模块栏时贴到底部安全区；返回浏览时它再出现。
highlights.en: **Full-screen pages drop the bottom navigation**: the five-module bar is hidden inside the full-screen player and on a genre's page (the content's bottom padding adapts), the player bar sits at the bottom safe area when the module bar is gone, and the bar comes back when you return to browsing.

highlights.zh: **测试**：手机外壳 **37 条**（点卡片→上报打开并调用播放、曲风库内已无播放键、详情页无播放键、点页面返回但不吃掉链接、详情页有播放条而无模块栏、全屏播放器两者皆无、浏览时模块栏在）+ 其余手机模块与 jog 数学 **47 条**。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 37 shell cases (card tap reports the open *and* starts playback, the library has no play control left, the genre page has none either, tapping the page returns without swallowing links, the genre page shows the player bar and no module bar, the full-screen player shows neither, browsing keeps the module bar) plus 47 cases across the other phone modules and the jog maths.

title.zh: v2.2.2 手机播放器：长按黑胶左右拖动调 BPM（jog）回来了
title.en: v2.2.2 The Phone Player Gets Its Jog Back: Drag the Record to Change the Tempo

highlights.zh: **我上一版把 player2.html 最好玩的交互删掉了，这一版补回来**：按住唱片左右拖动即改速度——左减速、右加速（参考稿的 0.2 BPM/px），唱片同时按拖动量偏移（±1.6 rad 上限），松手后以弹簧回正（`-offset*26`、阻尼 `exp(-5t)`），带惯性的甩动再加最多 ±10 BPM。60–180 BPM 与引擎同一区间。
highlights.en: **The previous release deleted the most enjoyable interaction in player2.html; this one brings it back**: long-press the record and drag left/right to change the tempo (left slower, right faster — the reference's 0.2 BPM per pixel), the disc offsets with the drag (capped at ±1.6 rad), springs back on release (`-offset*26`, damping `exp(-5t)`), and a flick adds up to ±10 BPM. Clamped to the engine's own 60-180 range.

highlights.zh: **手感可测**：jog 的数学全部是纯函数（位移→BPM、角偏移夹取、甩动阈值与上限、弹簧回正），单测 8 条；播放器上另有三条组件用例——拖动 50 px 必须从 122 变 132 BPM、连续拖动必须夹在 60/180、± 按钮也能改并显示当前值。
highlights.en: **The feel is testable**: the jog maths is pure (drag to BPM, offset clamping, flick threshold and cap, spring return) with 8 unit cases, plus 3 component cases on the player — a 50 px drag must take 122 to 132 BPM, a long drag must clamp to 60/180, and the ± buttons must move and display the live value.

highlights.zh: **同时补上参考稿里让 jog「被发现」的两样东西**：唱片下方的拖动提示（左减速 · 右加速），以及显式的 BPM ± 与实时读数。拖动用的是指针捕获（`setPointerCapture`），画布保留 `touch-pan-y`，所以纵向滚页面不会被 jog 吃掉。
highlights.en: **Also restored the two things that make the jog discoverable**: the drag hint under the record (left slower · right faster) and explicit ± buttons with a live BPM readout. The drag uses pointer capture, and the canvas keeps `touch-pan-y`, so vertical page scrolling is not swallowed by the jog.

title.zh: v2.2.1 手机端换新配色：冷色深底 + 每模块一个强调色
title.en: v2.2.1 A New Phone Palette: Cool Dark Ground, One Accent Per Module

highlights.zh: **去掉了那套土黄。** 底色从暖棕改为冷调近黑（#0b0b14 / #14141f），文字改为中性白，强调色按模块区分：**首页 青绿 · 即兴 紫 · 挑战 玫瑰 · 探索 蓝 · 更多 灰**；顶部光晕换成「强调色 + 紫」双径向渐变。
highlights.en: **The muddy amber is gone.** The ground went from warm brown to a cool near-black (#0b0b14 / #14141f), the text is a neutral white, and the accent is per module: **home teal · jam violet · challenge rose · explore blue · more slate**, with a two-stop accent-plus-violet glow at the top.

highlights.zh: **改法刻意只动颜色，不动组件**：55 处引用本来就写在 `--m-gold*` token 上，所以换值即换整屏；模块多色用 `.mobile-root[data-module=…]` 覆盖。第一版把颜色值扫进了 Tailwind 的 arbitrary class 名和内联样式里，手机 E2E 立刻报运行时错误，已回滚并改成 token-only（这正是「只在 CSS 里换值」的原因）。
highlights.en: **Deliberately a colour-only change**: the 55 references already went through the `--m-gold*` tokens, so changing the values re-skins every screen, and the per-module hues are `[data-module]` overrides. The first attempt swept the new values into Tailwind arbitrary class names and inline styles; the phone E2E failed on a runtime error, so that was rolled back in favour of tokens only.

highlights.zh: **顺带定位了那个运行时错误的根因**：canvas 的颜色字符串**不能**用 CSS 变量，`addColorStop(rgb(var(--x)/0.14))` 在 WebKit 直接抛 `The string did not match the expected pattern`。现在唱片光晕在 resize 时把 `--m-gold` 解析成具体 rgb，再用它拼 rgba——所以画布也跟着模块配色走。
highlights.en: **And the root cause of that runtime error is now known**: canvas colour strings cannot contain CSS variables — `addColorStop(rgb(var(--x)/0.14))` throws `The string did not match the expected pattern` on WebKit. The disc's bloom now resolves `--m-gold` to concrete rgb on resize and builds rgba from it, so the canvas follows the module accent too.

title.zh: v2.2.0 手机端默认进入新外壳：首页 / 即兴 / 挑战 / 探索 / 更多
title.en: v2.2.0 The Phone Lands in the New Shell by Default: Home, Jam, Challenge, Explore, More

highlights.zh: **手机打开应用就进新界面。** 裸访问「/」在手机上现在直接落在新外壳的**首页**；带明确目的地的链接（`?tab=` / `?genre=` / `?groove=` / `?m=`）仍按它写的渲染——这是**分阶段的切换**：新外壳成为手机的默认入口，同时旧路由保持可达，所以老书签不会在被重写的情况下悄悄换页。判断规则 `shouldEnterPhoneShell` 是纯函数并有单测（手机裸访问进外壳；带任何目的地都不动；桌面永不重定向；已在新路由不重复进入）。
highlights.en: **Opening the app on a phone now lands in the new interface.** A bare `/` goes straight to the shell's **首页**; a URL that names a destination (`?tab=` / `?genre=` / `?groove=` / `?m=`) still renders what it names. That is the **staged cutover**: the shell becomes the phone's default entry while the old routes stay reachable, so an existing bookmark is never silently rewritten. The rule (`shouldEnterPhoneShell`) is a pure function with unit tests: a bare phone visit enters the shell, any named destination does not, a desktop is never redirected, and an already-mobile route is not re-entered.

highlights.zh: **顺带把手机触控目标提到标准之上**：切过来之后，矩阵里那条「手机面上不允许有低于 44 px 的控件」的检查立刻量出了新外壳自己的问题——分类胶囊 36 px、曲风行 42 px、色块试听键正好 44 px（分数布局下量到 43.99 就被判不合格）。全部提到 **44–48 px**，胶囊同时加 `min-w`（「全部」只有 44 px 宽也算了）。**这条检查是旧手机 IA 的，但它对新界面一样有效**，所以没有放宽门禁，而是把新界面改到合规。
highlights.en: **The phone's touch targets were raised while cutting over**: the matrix's rule that no phone surface may have a control under 44 px immediately measured the new shell's own offenders — 36 px category chips, 42 px genre rows, and the 44 px swatch button (fractional layout measures it as 43.99, which fails). All are now **44-48 px**, and the chips also got a `min-w` (the "All" chip was only 44 px wide). That check belongs to the old phone IA, but it is just as true of the new one — so the gate was not loosened, the interface was brought up to it.

highlights.zh: **测试**：切换规则 3 条单测（分阶段切换的三种情形）；E2E 新增一条**只在手机/平板 target 上跑**的检查：裸访问 `/` 必须落在外壳且五格齐全。加上既有的 `/m/<module>` 可达性、曲风详情往返、播放器、即兴、挑战、探索、更多等检查，新界面现在有 8 段端到端断言在四个手机/平板 target 上运行。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 3 unit cases for the cutover rule (the three shapes of the staged switch), plus a new E2E leg that runs **only on the phone/tablet targets**: a bare `/` must land in the shell with all five modules present. Together with the existing `/m/<module>` reachability, genre-detail round trip, player, jam, challenge, explore and more legs, the new interface now has eight end-to-end assertions running on all four phone/tablet targets.

highlights.zh: **下一步（v2.2.x）**：把旧手机 IA 的断言改写成新 IA、删掉旧壳与失效的移动组件。这一步故意留到下一个版本：先让新界面成为手机的默认入口并跑绿，再删掉旧的——反过来做会让 verify 在很长一段时间里分不清「手机坏了」和「手机正在被换掉」。
highlights.en: **Next (v2.2.x)**: rewrite the old phone IA's assertions onto the new one and delete the old shell and its dead components. That is deliberately left to the next version: make the new interface the phone's default and green first, then remove the old one — the other order leaves `verify` unable to tell "the phone is broken" from "the phone is being replaced" for a long stretch.

title.zh: v2.1.21 手机端（M7）：更多——设置、更新、手册、搜索、语言，五格里的杂项
title.en: v2.1.21 Phone (M7): 更多 — Settings, Changelog, Manual, Search and Language in Five Rows

highlights.zh: **「更多」是手机端的杂物抽屉，但不是按钮堆**：五行——设置、更新日志、手册与引导、搜索、语言——加上版本号。每一行打开的都是应用**已有**的面板（`SettingsModal` / `UpdatesModal` / 帮助中心 / 全局搜索），手机端不重写一份：那些面板本来就是响应式的，而第二份实现正是「手机和桌面对同一个设置的理解不一致」的来源。
highlights.en: **更多 is the phone's odds-and-ends drawer without being a button pile**: five rows — settings, changelog, manual & tours, search, language — plus the version. Each row opens a panel the app **already** has (`SettingsModal` / `UpdatesModal` / the help centre / global search) rather than a second implementation: those panels are already responsive, and a second copy is exactly how a phone and a desktop end up disagreeing about what a setting means.

highlights.zh: **语言行说的是「会切到什么」而不是「现在是什么」**——切换控件上唯一不含歧义的措辞；点一下立即切换并记住。
highlights.en: **The language row states what it will switch *to*, not what is current** — the only unambiguous wording for a toggle. One tap switches and remembers.

highlights.zh: **测试**：更多 **4 条**（五行齐全且每行 ≥44 px、**点哪行只开哪个面板**（同时断言没碰其它三个 opener）、语言行显示目标语言并真的切换、版本号来自单一来源）＋ E2E 一段（`/m/more` 五行齐全、最小行高 ≥44、版本号形如 `vX.Y.Z`、横向不溢出）。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 4 more cases (five rows, each ≥44 px; tapping a row opens **only** its panel — the other three openers are asserted untouched; the language row shows the target language and switches it; the version comes from the single source) plus an E2E leg (`/m/more` has all five rows, the smallest is ≥44 px, the version matches `vX.Y.Z`, and there is no horizontal overflow).

highlights.zh: **顺带修好一个自己引入的 E2E 顺序问题**：新增的「更多」检查排在横屏探针之前，把页面从探索页导航走了，导致探针量到「找不到卡片」。探针现在自己先导航回 `/m/explore` 再测量——**测量型断言必须自己把页面带到它要量的状态**，这是这一轮学到的教训。
highlights.en: **Also fixed an ordering bug the new check introduced**: the 更多 leg ran before the landscape probe and navigated away from the explore page, so the probe measured *missing cards*. The probe now navigates back to `/m/explore` itself before measuring — a measurement assertion has to put the page into the state it measures, which is the lesson of this round.

title.zh: v2.1.20 手机端（M6）：探索——底鼓设计 / 和弦走向 / 律动解构，并为横屏重排
title.en: v2.1.20 Phone (M6): 探索 — Kick Design, Progressions, Groove Layers, and a Landscape Layout

highlights.zh: **探索模块三个子页，每个都真的能做点什么**：**底鼓设计**（SUB/THUMP/CLICK 三层开关、柔软度/砂砾感/内脏压力三档手感、四个策展预设，点一下即发声）、**和弦走向**（按类别浏览策展走向，点播放按它自己的调性与风格试听）、**律动解构**（把当前曲风的四轨摊开，点一轨就把它从正在播放的循环里拿掉，图案即时重发给引擎，下一小节就听得到）。
highlights.en: **Three sub-pages that each do something**: **kick design** (the SUB/THUMP/CLICK layers, the softness/grit/sub-weight feel values, and the four curated presets — one tap and it sounds), **progressions** (browse the curated progressions by category and audition one in its own key and feel), and **groove layers** (the current genre's four lanes laid out; tap a lane to drop it out of the loop that is playing — the pattern goes back to the engine and the next bar is missing that lane).

highlights.zh: **没有从桌面搬过来的**：手机版不再提供「载入工作台」与自制底鼓预设的保存/删除。两者都需要一个「工作台」作为落点，而手机上有工作台入口的模块自己就够了；两个会悄悄替换用户当前作品的按钮，比没有按钮更糟。
highlights.en: **Left behind from the desktop**: 载入工作台 (bake to the workspace) and saving/deleting custom kick presets. Both need a workspace to write into, and on a phone the module that owns the workspace has its own entry point; two buttons that silently replace what the user is working on are worse than no buttons.

highlights.zh: **横屏是净新增设计**：参考稿完全没有方向处理（固定 432 px 单列），所以本轮为短而宽的视口加了媒体查询——列表与控制在横屏并排成两列、内容封顶到视口高度，**并且是量出来的**：E2E 在竖屏量到 1 列、把视口转成 844×390 后要求量到 **2 列**（这正是单测看不见的那类东西；也顺带证明没有横向溢出）。
highlights.en: **Landscape is new design**: the reference has no orientation handling at all (a fixed 432 px column), so this round adds a media query for short, wide viewports — lists and controls sit side by side in two columns and the content is capped to the viewport height. It is **measured**, not asserted: the E2E leg measures one column in portrait, then switches the viewport to 844x390 and requires **two** columns (exactly the kind of thing a unit test cannot see), and checks there is no horizontal overflow either way.

highlights.zh: **测试**：探索 **8 条**（子页切换、击发底鼓并把三层开关写成引擎的 mute 参数、手感档位写入、选预设即应用并发声、和弦走向按自身调性/风格/BPM 试听并再点停止、类别过滤、丢轨后**其余轨道与曲风原稿逐位一致**、播放/停止走外壳走带）＋ E2E 一段（`/m/explore` 子页切换、走向卡片 ≥4、横向不溢出、竖屏 1 列 / 横屏 2 列）。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 8 explore cases (sub-page switching; firing the kick and writing the three layer switches as the engine's mute params; a feel step written to the engine; a preset applied *and* sounded; a progression auditioned in its own key/feel/BPM and stopped by a second tap; category filtering; a dropped lane leaving every other lane **bit-identical to the genre's own pattern**; play/stop through the shell's transport) plus an E2E leg (sub-page switch, at least four progression cards, no horizontal overflow, one column in portrait and two in landscape).

title.zh: v2.1.19 手机端（M5）：挑战——四选一盲听、天梯与解析，和桌面共用同一条积分
title.en: v2.1.19 Phone (M5): 挑战 — Blind Four-Way Listening, One Ladder Shared With the Desktop

highlights.zh: **挑战模块接上现有题库与判分，而不是另写一套**：自适应选题（SuperMemo-2 复习 + 混淆矩阵）、Elo 增减、段位门槛都在 `challengeAlgorithm.ts` 里，本轮把**难度池**也搬了进去（原本写在桌面视图里），手机与桌面因此共用同一条规则；而且两者读写**同一个 localStorage 键**，手机上答的题会接着桌面的进度，不是第二个存档。
highlights.en: **The challenge module reuses the existing quiz and scoring rather than growing a second one**: adaptive selection (SuperMemo-2 review plus a confusion matrix), the Elo update and the rank tiers all live in `challengeAlgorithm.ts`, and this round moved the **difficulty pools** in there too (they were defined inside the desktop view). The two surfaces therefore share one set of rules — and they read and write the **same localStorage key**, so answering on the phone continues the desktop's ladder instead of starting a second save.

highlights.zh: **手机形态**：天梯卡（积分/连胜/正确率/段位进度）、难度胶囊（初级 · 主流大类 / 进阶 · 细分子类 / 硬核 · 近速干扰）、一个大播放键听题、四张选项卡（答后正确项标绿 ✓、选错标红 ✗、其余变暗，并揭晓每题的实际 BPM）、以及就地展开的解析（答案曲风可点进详情页）。按你的取舍，**证书与重置没有带过来**——那是桌面功能，在手机上只会多花两屏。
highlights.en: **Phone shape**: a ladder card (ladder points, streak, accuracy, rank progress), difficulty chips (easy · well-known / medium · subgenres / hard · near misses), one big play button to hear the question, four option cards (after answering: the real answer turns green with a tick, a wrong pick turns red with a cross, the rest dim, and each option reveals its actual BPM), and an explanation that opens in place with its genre linked to the detail page. By your rule, **the certificate and the reset control did not come along** — they are desktop affordances that would cost two more screens for no gameplay.

highlights.zh: **测试**：挑战模块 **7 条**（四选项 + 播放键播的是题目的曲风、判分只标记一个正确答案且重复点击不重复计分、解析与 BPM 揭晓 + 曲风链接、天梯落盘到**桌面同一个键**且 Elo 变化、下一题清空判定、切难度重出题、脏存档不崩）＋ E2E 一段（`/m/challenge` 恰好 4 个选项、答一题后**恰好一个** correct、没有未判定的选项、共享天梯记录到 1 题、横向不溢出、下一题可用）。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 7 cases for the module (four options and a play button that plays the question's genre; grading marks exactly one right answer and a second tap does not double-score; the explanation, the BPM reveal and the genre link; the ladder persisting to the **desktop's own key** with an Elo change; next-question clearing the verdict; a difficulty switch re-rolling; and a corrupt save not crashing) plus an E2E leg (`/m/challenge` has exactly 4 options, one answer leaves exactly one marked correct and none ungraded, the shared ladder records the round, no horizontal overflow, and next works).

title.zh: v2.1.18 手机端（M4）：即兴——律动编排、打击垫，速度条移到底部
title.en: v2.1.18 Phone (M4): 即兴 — a Groove Grid, Pads, and the Tempo Bar at the Bottom

highlights.zh: **即兴模块按你的取舍建成**：4 轨 × 16 步的律动网格（点格子开关、播放时列高亮跟着音频时钟走、一键还原母版）＋ 6 个打击垫 ＋ 顶部**录制/播放**按钮；**BPM 与摇摆条移到了屏幕最下方**；**去掉了底/军/镲那排鼓组静音**；这个模块**不显示播放条**（它自己的走带就是循环本身）。
highlights.en: **The jam module is built to your spec**: a 4-lane x 16-step groove grid (tap a step to toggle it, the playhead column follows the audio clock, one tap resets to the genre's own pattern), six pads, and record/play at the top; the **BPM and swing bar moved to the bottom of the screen**; the **drum-group mute row is gone**; and the module shows **no player bar** (its transport is the loop itself).

highlights.zh: **两处刻意的取舍，都写在代码注释里**：① 打击垫是**步进输入**而不是现场鼓组——这个引擎没有对外的单次触发路径（为打击延迟再造一个 AudioContext 比不提供更糟），所以开「录制」后点打击垫就把**当前播放步**写进网格（落在播放头上，本身就是量化的），播放时垫子会跟着点亮；② 写入的是**点击瞬间正在播放的那一步**（读时钟，而不是用 80 ms 采样的 playhead）——180 BPM 时那 80 ms 就是整整一步，否则按感觉点会晚一格。
highlights.en: **Two deliberate trade-offs, both recorded in the code**: (1) the pads are **step entry**, not a live drum kit - this engine has no public one-shot trigger, and adding a second AudioContext for pad latency would be worse than not offering it, so arming record writes the **current step** (quantised by definition, because it lands on the playhead) and the pads light up as their lane fires; (2) the write lands on the step playing **at click time** rather than on the 80 ms-sampled playhead - at 180 BPM that lag is a whole step, which is exactly the 'my hit is one step late' bug.

highlights.zh: **编辑立刻可听见**：网格改动通过一个按内容比较的效应推给引擎（`setPattern`，不重启播放），速度/摇摆同理——所以「改一步、下一小节听到」是即时反馈，而不是停下再播。
highlights.en: **Edits are audible immediately**: grid changes are pushed to the engine through a content-compared effect (`setPattern`, without restarting playback), and so are tempo and swing - so 'change a step, hear it next bar' is real feedback rather than stop-and-play.

highlights.zh: **测试**：即兴模块 **8 条**（4×16 网格、开关一步并把编辑后的图案推给引擎、还原母版、播放/停止状态、录制提示与打击垫在播放头写入、BPM 双向夹在 60–180 并上报、摇摆上报 0..1、标题点进曲风详情）＋ E2E 一段（`/m/jam` 有 64 个格子、6 个垫子、速度条在网格**下方**、**没有**播放器或播放条、横向不溢出）。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 8 cases for the jam module (the 4x16 grid, toggling a step and pushing the edited pattern to the engine, reset, play/stop state, the record hint and a pad writing at the playhead, BPM clamped to 60-180 in both directions and reported, swing reported as 0..1, and the header opening the genre's page) plus an E2E leg (`/m/jam` has 64 cells, 6 pads, the tempo bar **below** the grid, **no** player or player bar, and no horizontal overflow).

title.zh: v2.1.17 手机端（M3）：全屏黑胶播放器——唱片、唱臂、抽屉与三态播放模式
title.en: v2.1.17 Phone (M3): the Full-Screen Vinyl Player — Record, Tonearm, Drawer and Three Play Modes

highlights.zh: **全屏播放器按参考稿重建**：canvas 画的黑胶（沟槽纹理、曲风色标、把该曲风真实的 16 步图案画成唱片上的点）、唱臂在播放时以弹簧摆入、固定的斜向高光让唱片读起来像黑胶。**角度只由音频时钟推导**（引擎的步进 + 步内插值），不用 CSS 自转——否则唱片会和它正在展示的音乐漂移。
highlights.en: **The full-screen player is rebuilt from the reference**: a canvas vinyl (baked groove texture, the genre's colour on the label, and the genre's real 16-step pattern drawn as dots on the record), a tonearm that springs in when playback starts, and the fixed diagonal sheen that makes it read as vinyl. **The angle is derived from the audio clock** (the engine's step plus a sub-step interpolation) and never from a CSS rotation, which would drift away from the music it is showing.

highlights.zh: **三条你指定的交互**：左上向下箭头收起为播放条（回到列表，播放中则播放条浮在列表上方）；**点唱片进入该曲风详情页**，再点（或详情页返回）回到唱片视角；左侧按钮在**单曲循环 → 大曲风内循环 → 全部随机**之间循环，并记住上次选择。抽屉把播放条那点内容收起来：进度、BPM 区间、拍号、当前模式与「查看完整详情」。
highlights.en: **The three interactions you specified**: the down chevron collapses to the player bar (back to the list, with the bar floating above it while something plays); **tapping the record opens that genre's page**, and tapping again (or the back control there) returns to the record; and the left button cycles **repeat one → repeat this genre → shuffle all**, remembering the choice. A drawer hides the player-bar content: progress, BPM range, time signature, the current mode and "full details".

highlights.zh: **故意不做的**：参考稿里的「搓盘改 BPM」。在手机上它是和纵向滚动打架的手势，也很难在 44 px 高的条上做可靠；按你「难做好用的直接不提供」的要求，速度改由即兴模块的显式控制负责。这条写在代码注释里，免得下次被当成遗漏。
highlights.en: **Deliberately not ported**: the reference's jog-scrub (drag the record to change BPM). On a phone that gesture fights vertical scrolling and cannot be made reliable in a 44 px bar, so by your rule — do not ship what cannot be done well — tempo gets explicit controls in the 即兴 module instead. That decision is recorded in the code so it is not mistaken for an oversight.
