highlights.zh: **测试**：黑胶数学 **16 条纯函数用例**（几何把唱片关在框内、每步恰好转 1/16 圈、步内插值、唱臂落到位且不会永远震荡、超大帧间隔不会被甩出轨道、唱针半径、步点在圈内、模式三循环、队列按模式前后走），外壳 +7 条（全屏渲染、收起、点唱片、抽屉默认收起、模式循环并持久化、按模式切歌、找不到曲风），E2E 再加一段：直接打开 `/m/home?player=1&genre=…` → 唱片存在且有尺寸 → 点唱片进详情 → 箭头收起回列表 → 横向不溢出。
highlights.en: **Tests**: **16 pure-function cases** for the vinyl maths (geometry keeps the disc in its box, one step turns exactly 1/16, sub-step interpolation, the arm reaches the groove and stops oscillating, a huge frame delta cannot fling it out of travel, needle radius, dots inside the disc, the three-cycle mode, and the queue walking forwards and backwards), 7 more for the shell (full-screen render, collapse, record tap, drawer closed by default, mode cycling with persistence, mode-driven skipping, missing genre), and an E2E leg: open `/m/home?player=1&genre=…` → the vinyl exists and has size → tap the record → detail → chevron → back to the list → no horizontal overflow.

title.zh: v2.1.16 手机端（M2）：每个曲风都有自己的详情页，加上常驻播放条
title.en: v2.1.16 Phone (M2): a Page for Every Genre, and a Player Bar

highlights.zh: **每个曲风都有详情页**：概览（年代、BPM 区间、拍号）、听感特征、文化背景、编制标签，以及**相近曲风**——每一条都能点进它自己的详情页，横向浏览不会走进死路。参考稿里根本没有单曲风页面（它唯一的单曲风视图是 A/B 对比页），所以这是设计出来的，不是移植过来的。
highlights.en: **Every genre has a page of its own**: overview facts (era, BPM range, time signature), character, cultural context, instrumentation chips, and **related genres** — each of which links to its own page, so browsing sideways never dead-ends. The reference design has no per-genre page at all (its only per-genre view is an A/B compare screen), so this is designed rather than ported.

highlights.zh: **相近曲风取自关系表，而不是曲风对象。** 数据库里每个曲风自己的 `related_genres`/`subgenres` 都是空的，策展好的 300 条关系（带权重与双语说明）在独立的表里；读对象会安静地渲染出一个空区块。第一次跑测试就抓到了这一点（相关曲风 0 条）。
highlights.en: **Related genres come from the relations table, not from the genre object.** Every genre's own `related_genres`/`subgenres` arrays are empty in the database; the curated 300 relations (weighted, with bilingual descriptions) live in their own table. Reading the object would have silently rendered an empty section — which the first test run caught.

highlights.zh: **常驻播放条**：一行显示正在试听的曲风（色块 + 名称 + BPM/分类），点整行进详情页，右侧按钮停止。它**只由「正在播放的是谁」驱动**并自己解析曲风，所以在播放中重新进入外壳也能正确显示；只出现在**首页**（即兴有自己的走带，你要求那里不要播放条）；如果正在播放的 id 已不在曲风库里，就**不渲染**这条播放条，而不是显示一条没有名字的条。
highlights.en: **A persistent player bar**: one row showing the auditioning genre (swatch, name, BPM/category), tapping the row opens its detail page, and the button on the right stops it. It is driven by **what is playing** and resolves its own genre, so a shell that mounts mid-playback still shows the right thing; it appears on **首页 only** (即兴 has its own transport and the bar was to be removed there), and a playing id that is no longer in the library renders **no** bar rather than a nameless one.

highlights.zh: **测试**：外壳文件 21 条（播放条的出现/只出现在首页/停止/未知 id、详情页字段、相近曲风链接、试听、移交给即兴、找不到曲风）+ 每个 target 上的 E2E 往返：展开一行 → 进详情页 → 读到一个字段 → 返回，并检查横向不溢出。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 21 cases in the shell file (bar presence, bar only on 首页, stop, unknown id, detail facts, related-genre links, audition, jam hand-off, missing genre) plus an E2E round trip on every target: expand a row, open the detail page, read a fact, go back, and check there is no horizontal overflow.

title.zh: v2.1.15 手机端重构第一步：五格新外壳与曲风库（/m/home 可访问）
title.en: v2.1.15 Phone Rebuild, Step One: the Five-Module Shell and the Genre Library (/m/home)

highlights.zh: **手机端按新 IA 重建，第一步是外壳 + 曲风库。** 底部五个模块：**首页 · 即兴 · 挑战 · 探索 · 更多**（设置、更新、帮助等杂项归入「更多」）。新的界面是独立的一层（`src/mobile/`），用自己的路由 `/m/<module>` 访问：**现有手机界面照旧工作、照旧被 E2E 覆盖**，新界面一个模块一个模块替换上去；等五个模块都真实可用，再把开关切过去、删掉旧壳。手机上现在就能打开 `/m/home` 试用。
highlights.en: **The phone UI is being rebuilt on the new IA, starting with the shell and the genre library.** Five modules at the bottom: **Home · Jam · Challenge · Explore · More** (settings, updates and help live under More). The new surface is its own layer (`src/mobile/`) on its own route, `/m/<module>`: **the existing phone UI keeps working and keeps being covered by E2E** while the new one replaces it module by module. When all five modules are real, the switch flips and the old shell is deleted. On a phone, `/m/home` can be opened now.

highlights.zh: **首页就是曲风库**：分类胶囊（六大类，色块与参考稿一致）、搜索（同时匹配英文名与中文别名）、以及每个曲风一行——色块方块兼作试听按钮（走真实引擎的 `useGenreAudition`）、英文名 + 中文名、等宽小字元信息（年代 · BPM · 分类）。点整行**就地展开**该曲风的摘要（听感要点、BPM 区间、拍号、发源地），而不是跳走——参考稿里没有任何从列表看详情的入口，这是净新增的交互。
highlights.en: **Home is the genre library**: category chips (six categories, swatches matching the reference), search (English names and Chinese aliases), and one row per genre — the colour square doubles as the audition button (through the real engine via `useGenreAudition`), then English name plus Chinese name and a monospace meta line (era · BPM · category). Tapping the row **expands that genre's summary in place** (character, BPM range, time signature, origin) instead of navigating away: the reference has no way at all to see a genre's details from its list, so this interaction is new rather than ported.

highlights.zh: **规格照手机来**：底部栏每格 ≥56 px、五个模块各带可见文字标签（没有 hover 的设备上，纯图标不可发现）、`aria-current` 标记当前模块；外壳只用自己的设计令牌（深棕 + 琥珀，作用域在 `.mobile-root`，不动桌面），数字一律等宽对齐；横向不溢出、焦点进搜索框不触发 iOS 缩放（输入 16 px）；放大镜与双指缩放由既有的 `user-scalable=no` 拦住。
highlights.en: **Built to phone specs**: every tab is ≥56 px with a visible text label (an icon-only bar is undiscoverable on a device with no hover) and `aria-current` marks the active module; the shell carries its own design tokens (dark brown plus amber, scoped to `.mobile-root`, the desktop untouched) with tabular monospace numerals; no horizontal overflow, and the search field is 16 px so focusing it cannot trigger iOS zoom. Pinch zoom and the magnifier stay blocked by the existing `user-scalable=no`.

highlights.zh: **测试**：外壳与首页 12 条单测（模块集合与顺序、每个 tab 的触控高度、当前项标记、点击上报、搜索/分类过滤、一次只展开一个、试听状态翻转、空结果提示）+ 路由 6 条（`/m/<module>` 解析、未知模块回落、格式化成路径、往返一致、不污染桌面路由）；E2E 增加一条「新外壳可达」检查（五个 tab 存在且顺序正确、≥44 px、有文字标签、首页列出 ≥50 个曲风、横向不溢出），在每个 target 上运行——否则这个只靠 URL 到达的界面在切换开关之前没有任何门禁看着它。
highlights.en: **Tests**: 12 unit cases for the shell and home (module set and order, per-tab touch height, active marking, tap reporting, search and category filtering, one-at-a-time expansion, audition state flip, empty-result message) plus 6 router cases (`/m/<module>` parsing, unknown-module fallback, path formatting, round-trip, no leakage into desktop routes); and one E2E "the new shell is reachable" check (five tabs present and in order, ≥44 px, labelled, home lists ≥50 genres, no horizontal overflow) on every target — because a surface reachable only by URL would otherwise have no gate watching it before the switch flips.

title.zh: v2.1.14 追到「同一个页面渲染久了会变声」的根因：GS-1 的 WASM 内存预算
title.en: v2.1.14 Root Cause of "a Long-Lived Page Renders Differently": the GS-1 WASM Memory Budget

highlights.zh: **上一版只是绕开，这一版追到了根因。** 把同一曲风按轨道拆开量（先量一遍 → 渲染 60 个别的曲风 → 再量一遍）：bass 与 fx 两根轨道**逐位相同**（Δ 0.000 dB），而 GS-1 负责的 chords **+13.050 dB**、lead **−16.555 dB**；limiter 两次都是 worklet、真峰都钉在 −1.30 dBTP，把 makeup 拉到 −12 dB（限幅器完全不介入）依然漂 +1.849 dB——所以差异在**内容**，不在母带链。给 host 创建的 `catch` 加上原因打印后真相就一句话：`WebAssembly.instantiate(): Out of memory: Cannot allocate Wasm memory for new instance`。
highlights.en: **The previous release worked around it; this one found the cause.** Measuring one genre track by track (before, then after rendering 60 other genres) shows bass and fx **bit-identical** (Δ 0.000 dB) while the two GS-1-routed roles move: chords **+13.050 dB**, lead **−16.555 dB**. The limiter is the worklet both times and the peak stays pinned at −1.30 dBTP; with makeup at −12 dB (limiter disengaged) the drift is still +1.849 dB — so it is the *content*, not the master chain. Instrumenting the host-creation catch gave one line: `WebAssembly.instantiate(): Out of memory: Cannot allocate Wasm memory for new instance`.

highlights.zh: **一个页面能建约 124 个 GS-1 host，之后怎么拆都拿不回来**（每个策略开全新浏览器实测）：keep / keep+gc / `dispose()` / dispose+gc / dispose+`close()` 全部在第 124–125 个失败——`OfflineAudioContext` 上**根本没有 `close()`**，`host.dispose()` 只断开节点。只有刷新页面能释放，这正解释了为什么它看起来是「页面级」的、以及为什么上一轮的 dispose 实验无效。
highlights.en: **A page builds ~124 GS-1 hosts and then never another one**, measured with a fresh browser per policy: keep, keep+gc, `dispose()`, dispose+gc and dispose+`close()` all fail at instance 124-125 — `OfflineAudioContext` has no `close()` at all, and `host.dispose()` only disconnects the node. Only reloading the page frees it, which is why the effect looked page-scoped and why last round's dispose experiment changed nothing.

highlights.zh: **修法一：stem 渲染不再为用不到的轨道建 host。** 调度第一行就丢掉非本轨的轨，但 host 循环过去对每个 GS-1 角色都建一个，于是「母带 + 8 stems」一次导出白建 14 个 host（共 18 个）。现在只建 4 个：同一页面可导出的次数从约 7 次变成约 31 次。4 条单测钉住，删掉那行跳过会让其中 3 条立刻红。
highlights.en: **Fix one: a stem render no longer builds hosts it cannot use.** The scheduling loop drops every track but its own on the first line, yet the host loop built one per GS-1 role anyway, so one "master + 8 stems" export built 14 hosts that could never sound (18 in total). It now builds 4: roughly 7 exports per page become roughly 31. Four unit cases pin it; deleting the skip fails three of them.

highlights.zh: **修法二：量测装置不再允许「偷偷换了合成器」的行进入基线。** 报告过去完全无视 `onGs1HostFailures`，所以一行在 WASM 预算耗尽后录出来的数据看起来毫无异常（峰值 −1.3 dBTP、无 clamp、与 `genreMix.ts` 自洽），只有这个计数说明 chords/lead 换成了内置合成器。现在任何一行丢了 GS-1 音色就**逐曲风 fail-fast、整轮中止且不写报告**，并且每行都记录 `gs1HostFailures`。用「把失败数 +1」验证过：`--sample=1` 立刻以 `1 of 1 genre(s) lost a GS-1 voice` 中止。
highlights.en: **Fix two: the measuring device can no longer let a row that silently swapped synths into a baseline.** The report ignored `onGs1HostFailures` entirely, so a row recorded after the WASM budget ran out looked completely normal — peak at −1.3 dBTP, no clamp hits, consistent with `genreMix.ts` — and only that counter said the chords/lead had become the built-in synth. Now any row that loses a GS-1 voice aborts the run fail-fast, per genre, writing nothing, and every row records `gs1HostFailures`. Exercised by forcing the count up: `--sample=1` aborts with `1 of 1 genre(s) lost a GS-1 voice`.

highlights.zh: **仍然存在的限制（应用侧无法根治）**：同一会话里导出约 30 次之后，chords/lead 会退化为内置合成器，直到刷新页面。导出完成时的提示已经会告诉用户「请刷新页面后重新导出」。根因要么在 GS-1 上游（降低每个 WASM 实例的预留），要么在宿主（可回收的离线渲染 worker），两条都记在计划里。
highlights.en: **Remaining limit, not fixable inside the app**: after roughly 30 exports in one session the chords/lead tracks fall back to the built-in synth until the page is reloaded, and the export toast already tells the user to reload. The real fix is either upstream in GS-1 (smaller per-instance WASM reservation) or a recyclable offline-render worker; both are recorded in the plan.

title.zh: v2.1.13 离线导出的天花板补上了；顺便发现「同一个页面渲染久了会变声」，并据此重录响度基线、重拟合全部 trim
title.en: v2.1.13 The Offline Export Ceiling Is Real Now — Plus a Measured Discovery: a Long-Lived Page Renders Differently, Which Invalidated the Loudness Baseline

highlights.zh: **导出文件终于一定满足 −1 dBTP。** 离线渲染只有在平台接受 `audioWorklet.addModule` 时才装得上真峰限幅器，装不上就走 DynamicsCompressor 回退——而回退路径**没有天花板**（它自己的告警就这么写）。于是「导出的天花板」变成了「平台支持程度的性质」：把回退路径变成确定事件后 A/B，**6/6 个热曲风超过 −1 dBTP**，arranged 最差 +2.22 dBTP、trim 之后最差 **+0.95 dBTP（tropical-house）**——正是上一版记录到、但当时无法复现的那个数字；补上守卫后 **0/6**，全部 −1.30 dBTP。守卫用的是**限幅器自己的内核**（同一个 `limitBuffers`、同一个 −1.3 dBTP 内部天花板），所以两条路径承诺同一个文件。
highlights.en: **Exports now always hold -1 dBTP.** The offline renderer could only install the true-peak limiter when the platform accepted `audioWorklet.addModule`; otherwise the graph ran the DynamicsCompressor fallback, which has **no ceiling at all** (its own warning says so). The export ceiling was therefore a property of platform support, not of the renderer: forcing the fallback makes the A/B deterministic, and it measured **6/6 hot genres above -1 dBTP**, arranged worst +2.22 dBTP and **+0.95 dBTP after trim on tropical-house** -- exactly the number the previous release recorded but could not reproduce. With the guard, **0/6**, every one at -1.30 dBTP. The guard runs the limiter's own kernel (`limitBuffers`, same -1.3 dBTP internal ceiling), so both paths promise the same file.

highlights.zh: **发现并量到一条更根本的问题：同一个页面渲染约 50–75 次之后，同一个曲风会渲染成另一个东西。** `alternative-rock` 在新页面里连测三次都是 −12.711 LUFS；在同一个页面渲染过 118 个别的曲风之后再连测三次都是 **−10.259**（reload 之后又变回 −12.711）。起跳点实测在 45–75 次之间，峰值仍然钉在 −1.30 dBTP，图案没有被改写，`limiter.dispose()` + `ctx.close()` 挡不住，只有换页面能清除。这意味着**两小时的量测会在中途悄悄换掉「它测的是什么」**：第一次重录的 12 个抽样里有 5 个偏 0.5–2.5 dB。量测装置现在每 12 次测量换一次页面、换完丢弃一次冷渲染，并在每次换页后重测哨兵曲风，漂移超过 0.3 dB 就中止且不写任何文件。
highlights.en: **A more fundamental problem, found and measured: after ~50-75 renders in one page, the same genre renders as something else.** `alternative-rock` measures -12.711 LUFS three times over in a fresh page and **-10.259** three times over after 118 other genres have rendered in that page (a reload restores -12.711). The onset is between 45 and 75 renders, the true peak stays pinned at -1.30 dBTP, the pattern is unmutated, `limiter.dispose()` plus `ctx.close()` does not help, and only a page reload clears it. A two-hour run therefore silently changes *what it measures*: 5 of 12 re-checked rows in the first re-record were 0.5-2.5 dB off. The measuring device now recycles its page every 12 measurements, discards the fresh page's cold render, and re-measures a sentinel genre after every recycle -- more than 0.3 dB of drift aborts the run and writes nothing.

highlights.zh: **响度基线重录 + 全部 trim 重拟合：旧基线本身就是「长页面」量出来的。** 把新基线（新页面、可复现）与已提交基线对比：`ambient` −13.77 → **−18.11**、`kawaii-future-bass` −11.77 → **−15.55**、`chillwave` −17.04 → **−19.65**、`alternative-rock` −10.42 → **−12.71**。污染值偏响 → 拟合出的 trim 偏狠 → 实际播出比类别目标低最多 3.8 dB（这正是 G.51 当年记下的「基线过时」症状，方向刚好对上）。最极端的 `ghetto-house`：它的目标就是它自己能达到的电平，trim 本该是 0，已提交的却是 **−7.84 dB**。新基线 159/159 行、0 个 clamp、真峰最差 −1.275 dBTP、77 条 trim 非零（旧 96 条），71 个曲风变响、19 个变安静。
highlights.en: **The loudness baseline was re-recorded and every trim refitted: the old baseline had itself been recorded on a long-lived page.** Fresh page versus committed table: `ambient` -13.77 to **-18.11**, `kawaii-future-bass` -11.77 to **-15.55**, `chillwave` -17.04 to **-19.65**, `alternative-rock` -10.42 to **-12.71**. Contaminated values ran loud, so the fitted trims cut too hard, which is why those genres sat up to 3.8 dB below their category target -- exactly the symptom G.51 recorded, in the matching direction. The extreme case is `ghetto-house`: its target is its own achievable level, so its trim should be 0, and the shipped value was **-7.84 dB**. The new baseline is 159/159 rows, 0 trim clamp hits, worst true peak -1.275 dBTP, with 77 non-zero trims against 96 -- 71 genres louder, 19 quieter.

highlights.zh: **门禁不再只看「报告和自己一致」。** `check:loudness` 只把报告与报告、报告与 `genreMix.ts` 对照——一份描述了**另一种渲染口径**的报告可以一路全绿（旧基线就是这样活下来的）。新的 `check:loudness:fresh` 按全库口径在新页面重渲染 3 个均匀分布的曲风，超过 ±0.35 dB 即失败，已接进 `npm run verify`（约 60 秒）。对当前基线：3/3 Δ **0.00 dB**；扩到 12 个抽样也是 12/12 Δ 0.00 dB。
highlights.en: **A gate no longer checks only that a report agrees with itself.** `check:loudness` compares the report with itself and with `genreMix.ts` -- a report describing a *different rendering regime* passes all of it, which is how the old baseline survived. The new `check:loudness:fresh` re-renders three uniformly spread genres in a fresh page at full-library scale and fails past ±0.35 dB; it now runs inside `npm run verify` (~60 s). Against the current baseline: 3/3 at **0.00 dB**, and 12/12 at 0.00 dB when widened.

highlights.zh: **每行测量数据现在都写明自己走的是哪条限幅器路径**（`worklet` / `fallback` / 两者都有），`--force-fallback` 让「平台装不上」变成可复现的确定事件（顺带记下：用 Playwright 的 `page.route` 拦 worklet 模块**无效**，模块是音频线程取的），并且整轮运行只要有任何一行不是纯 worklet 就**逐曲风 fail-fast**、不写报告——回退路径是另一个渲染器（实测整体响 2.36 dB），混在一起的行不是同一个测量。
highlights.en: **Every measured row now says which limiter path produced it** (`worklet`, `fallback`, or both), `--force-fallback` turns "the platform will not load the worklet" into a reproducible event (and records that intercepting the worklet module with Playwright's `page.route` does **not** work -- the audio thread fetches it), and a run aborts fail-fast, without writing, as soon as any row is not pure worklet: the fallback is a different renderer (measured 2.36 dB louder overall), so rows from both are not one measurement.

title.zh: v2.1.12 量测装置修两处；并拦下一个更严重的发现：离线渲染里的限幅器对热素材不生效
title.en: v2.1.12 Two Measurement Fixes, and a Bigger Find: the Offline Limiter Does Not Hold for Hot Material

highlights.zh: **本来要重录响度基线，结果拦下了一个真问题。** 重录跑完后门禁报出 **9 个曲风超过 0 dBFS 采样峰 / −1 dBTP 天花板**，最差 **tropical-house +0.95 dBTP——而且这是 trim 之后**（未 trim 时 +1.75 dBTP）。同一曲风在已提交的基线里是 −13.01 LUFS / −1.3 dBTP，今天重录是 **−10.30 LUFS（响 2.7 dB）/ +1.75 dBTP**：**一个不受限的渲染既更响又更亮**，所以「基线过时」的读数里混着这个缺陷。**这份重录没有发布**（否则就是把削波写进基线），基线已还原。复现：`node scripts/measure_genre_loudness.mjs --genres=tropical-house --port=3170`。
highlights.en: **This round set out to re-record the loudness baseline and stopped on something worse.** The re-record made the gate report **9 genres over 0 dBFS sample peak and the −1 dBTP ceiling**, worst **tropical-house at +0.95 dBTP — after its trim** (+1.75 dBTP before it). That genre's committed row is −13.01 LUFS / −1.3 dBTP; today it renders at **−10.30 LUFS (2.7 dB louder) / +1.75 dBTP**. **An unlimited render is both louder and brighter**, so the “stale baseline” reading was contaminated by this. **The re-record was not published** (it would have written clipping into the baseline) and the committed one was restored. Reproduce with `node scripts/measure_genre_loudness.mjs --genres=tropical-house --port=3170`.

highlights.zh: **我自己的改动被 A/B 排除了。** 把 `MasterLimiter.ts` 与 `public/limiterWorklet.js` 换成单调队列（M14）**之前**的版本，结果逐位相同（trim 后 +0.95 dBTP）→ 不是队列改写的锅，问题在限幅器是否真正接进离线渲染路径、或它在热素材上的行为。**下一轮第一件事**：修限幅器 → 再重录 → 再更新 trim。
highlights.en: **My own change was ruled out by A/B**: swapping `MasterLimiter.ts` and `public/limiterWorklet.js` for their pre-M14 (monotonic deque) versions gives byte-identical results (trimmed +0.95 dBTP). So it is not the deque rewrite — it is whether the limiter is really in the offline render path, or how it behaves on hot material. **First thing next round**: fix the limiter, then re-record, then update the trims.

highlights.zh: **量测装置修了两处。** ① **首帧回退**：全新页面里的第一次离线渲染不走限幅器 worklet（模块惰性注册），落到 compressor 回退路径，对顶到天花板的素材差 **2.87 dB**（`kawaii-future-bass` 冷 −15.55 / 热 −12.68 LUFS，各测三次）。脚本现在先做一次**丢弃的预热渲染**；导出路径早有 `limiterKind: "fallback"` 的明确提示。② **`check:loudness:fresh`**：现有门禁只检查「报告与自己一致」，所以一份过时的报告能一路放行——新模式按**全库口径**重渲染 N 个**均匀分布**的曲风与报告比对，超过 ±0.35 dB 即失败（纯逻辑 9 条单测，含抽样覆盖与「不会空转」自检）。**暂不接入 verify**（限幅器修好前必然红），脚本留着，下一轮接线。
highlights.en: **Two measurement fixes.** (1) **First-render fallback**: the first offline render in a fresh page does not use the limiter worklet (its module registers lazily) and falls back to the compressor — a **2.87 dB** difference on ceiling-pinned material (`kawaii-future-bass` at −15.55 cold vs −12.68 warm, three runs each). The script now performs a discarded **warm-up render** first; the export path already tells the user via `limiterKind: "fallback"`. (2) **`check:loudness:fresh`**: the existing gate only checks the report against itself, which is how a stale report sails through. The new mode re-renders N **evenly spread** genres at **full-catalogue** scale and fails past ±0.35 dB (nine unit tests cover the sampling and the drift rule, including a “not vacuous” self-check). It is **not wired into verify yet** — it would fail until the limiter is fixed — but the script and its npm entry are in place.

highlights.zh: **更正上一版的一条记录**：v2.1.11 里说响度基线对 5 个曲风过时、最差 −3.78 dB——那些数字来自子集测量，是冷启动假象。全库同口径的真实比较（已提交基线 vs 全量重录）是 **mean |Δ| 0.256 dB、max 2.71 dB、136/159 在 0.35 dB 内**，最响的几个漂移为 tropical-house +2.71、cool-jazz +2.55、cumbia +2.31、motown +2.21、bebop +2.07；被点名的那 5 个曲风确实也在漂（−0.24…−2.11 dB），但幅度不可信，而且这个读数里混着上面的限幅器缺陷。**教训**：不同口径（目录规模）量出的绝对电平不可比较；只做「报告与自己一致」的门禁会把过时报告放行到底。
highlights.en: **Correcting a claim from the previous release**: v2.1.11 said the loudness baseline was stale for five genres by up to −3.78 dB. Those numbers came from subset runs and were a cold-start artifact. The true same-scale comparison (committed baseline vs a full re-record) is **mean |Δ| 0.256 dB, max 2.71 dB, 136/159 within 0.35 dB**, the loudest drifts being tropical-house +2.71, cool-jazz +2.55, cumbia +2.31, motown +2.21 and bebop +2.07; the five named genres do drift (−0.24 to −2.11 dB) but not by the stated amounts, and this reading is itself contaminated by the limiter defect above. **Two lessons**: absolute levels measured at different catalogue scales are not comparable, and a gate that only checks a report against itself will wave a stale report through.

title.zh: v2.1.11 钟声终于有了金属：不谐分音，以及一条本来只管鼓的规则
title.en: v2.1.11 The Bell Finally Has Metal: Inharmonic Partials, and a Rule That Only Covered Drums

highlights.zh: **计划里那条「不谐分音」待办，核实后比它写的更糟。** 计划说钟只能用「两个不成整数比的振荡器」近似——而 `bell_lead` 的第二振荡器是 **+1900 cents**，也就是 2.997:1，**就是第三谐波**（只是缺了第二谐波）。那是一张标准谐波谱，听起来像管风琴。**「不成整数比」这句话本身是错的。**
highlights.en: **The plan's “inharmonic partials” item was worse than it read.** It said a bell could only be approximated by “two oscillators at a non-integer ratio” — but `bell_lead`'s second oscillator was **+1900 cents**, i.e. 2.997:1, which is **the third harmonic** with the second missing. That is a textbook harmonic spectrum and it sounds like an organ. **The claim itself was wrong.**

highlights.zh: **现在是真正的金属**：预设新增 `partials`（非整数比、各自增益与衰减），voice builder 建「每个偏音一个正弦」的 bank，取管钟的 hum / prime / tierce / quint / nominal / upper = **0.56 / 1.0 / 1.19 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.74**，越高的分音衰减越早——这是「钟在响」而不是「嗡嗡响」的原因。bank 按**能量**（Σ gain²·decayScale）而不是幅度和对旧的 0.8² + 0.4² 配平（≈2.18），否则同一峰值增益下会低好几分贝、改变用到它的曲风的混音平衡。
highlights.en: **It is real metal now**: presets gained `partials` (non-integer ratios, each with its own gain and decay), and the voice builder turns that into one sine per partial — a tubular bell's hum / prime / tierce / quint / nominal / upper at **0.56 / 1.0 / 1.19 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.74**, with the upper ones decaying first, which is what makes a bell *ring* rather than buzz. The bank is matched to the old pair's **energy** (Σ gain²·decayScale against 0.8² + 0.4², ≈ 2.18) rather than its summed amplitude, or the same peak gain would land several dB quieter and change the mix balance of the genres that use it.

highlights.zh: **分音两个一组汇入**，不是一次性相加：一个节点把 3 个以上**不同频率**的振荡器相加时 Chrome 的离线渲染不可复现（实测 10 次渲染的哈希：1/2 个振荡器 1 种、3/4/5/6 个 3/7/9/10 种、4 个分两个节点 1 种）。这条规则存在很久，但**此前只覆盖鼓**——这次把 `oscillatorFanIn.test.ts` 扩到**整张合成器预设表**（39 → 91 条），并加了一条**自检**：手工搭一个「3 个不同频率振荡器汇入一个 gain」的图，必须被报出来。文件自己的注释早就写着这条规则是为了阻止「再加一个偏音让音色更丰富」的改动。
highlights.en: **Partials are summed two per node**, never all at once: a node summing three or more *differently-tuned* oscillators does not render reproducibly in Chrome's offline context (ten renders hash to 1 distinct result for 1–2 oscillators, 3/7/9/10 for 3/4/5/6, and 1 again for four oscillators fanned in two per node). The rule had existed for a while but **only covered drums** — `oscillatorFanIn.test.ts` now builds every synth preset (39 → 91 cases) and gained a **self-check**: a hand-built three-oscillator fan-in must be reported. That file's own comment already said the rule exists to stop “add another partial for richness”.

highlights.zh: **新测试 13 条**（`inharmonicPartials.test.ts`）：偏音表的归一化/上限/衰减排序；图上「每个偏音一个正弦、频率 = f0 × ratio、不得走 `createPeriodicWave`」；**不谐性谓词与它的自检**——喂 `[1,3]`（旧钟）与 `[1..5]` 必须判为「没有金属」，否则「钟有金属」这句话可以对着谐波谱通过；同音高两次调度逐项一致。**音色基线全量重录**（实测这个音色确实在音色测量路径里：改电平会改变 bandDb 与质心）。
highlights.en: **Thirteen new tests** in `inharmonicPartials.test.ts`: the bank's normalisation, cap and decay ordering; the graph (one sine per partial at `f0 × ratio`, never a `createPeriodicWave`); the inharmonicity predicate **and its self-check** — fed `[1,3]` (the old bell) and `[1..5]` it must report “no metal”, otherwise “the bell has metal” could pass against a harmonic spectrum; and two schedules at one pitch matching exactly. The **timbre baseline was re-recorded in full**, because this voice is inside the timbre measurement path (changing its level moves `bandDb` and the centroid).

highlights.zh: **顺带量出一件与本次改动无关的事：响度基线对 5 个曲风已经过时。** 三个对照曲风与基线差 ±0.04 dB，而 kawaii-future-bass / idm / trap-rap / chicago-drill / brooklyn-drill 差 **−0.57 ~ −3.78 dB**；**A/B 证明与钟无关**（旧预设、新 bank 2.18、bank 0.001 三次渲染同一曲风都是 −15.546，而且响度测量路径根本不渲染这个音色）。这 5 个曲风的 commit trim 是按旧测量拟合的，而 trim 只能压不能提 → 它们现在比类别目标低最多 ~3.8 dB。修法（全量重录响度 + 更新 `genreMix.ts`）**单独一轮**，不把音色改动和 159 条 trim 混进同一版本；证据与数字记在 G.51。
highlights.en: **And it measured something unrelated to this change: the loudness baseline is stale for five genres.** Three control genres sit within ±0.04 dB of the baseline while kawaii-future-bass / idm / trap-rap / chicago-drill / brooklyn-drill are **−0.57 to −3.78 dB** off. **A/B ruled the bell out** — the old preset, the new bank at 2.18 and at 0.001 all render that genre at −15.546, and the loudness path does not render this voice at all. Those five genres' committed trims were fitted to the old measurement and a trim can only cut, so they currently sit up to ~3.8 dB below their category target. The fix (a full loudness re-record plus `genreMix.ts`) is **its own round** rather than being mixed into a timbre release; the evidence is in G.51.

title.zh: v2.1.10 会话状态搬出视图；「删掉一端仍能编译」变成机械门禁
title.en: v2.1.10 Session State Out of the View; “Delete a Surface and It Still Compiles” Becomes a Gate

highlights.zh: **判据是可执行的，就不该靠人读代码来相信。** 计划里那条「删掉某一端整个目录后 `src/features` 与 `src/audio` 仍应能编译通过」现在是一条门禁：`check:isolation` 把 `src`（连同 GS-1 host 相对引用的 `vendor/`）复制一份，**删掉 `components/`、`views/`、`ui/`、`App.tsx`、`test/`**，再跑 `tsc --noEmit`。7.5 秒，已进 `verify`。失败可证：往 `src/features` 放一个 `import … from "../../components/…"` 的探针，立刻报 `TS2307: Cannot find module`；删掉即绿。用真复制而不是路径改写，因为改写会让 `tsc` 用不同的解析规则，那样「隔离通过」证明不了任何事。
highlights.en: **A criterion that can be executed should not rest on someone reading the code.** The plan's rule — *delete a surface's whole directory and `src/features` plus `src/audio` still compile* — is now a gate: `check:isolation` copies `src` (plus the `vendor/` directory the GS-1 host imports by relative path), **deletes `components/`, `views/`, `ui/`, `App.tsx` and `test/`**, and runs `tsc --noEmit`. It takes 7.5 s and sits inside `verify`. It can fail: a probe file in `src/features` importing from `../../components/…` immediately reports `TS2307: Cannot find module`; remove it and the gate is green. It copies rather than rewriting paths because a rewritten tree resolves modules differently, and an isolated build that resolves differently proves nothing.

highlights.zh: **三组状态搬出 `StudioView`**，进 `features/sequencer/hooks/useStudioSession.ts`：`usePlaybackSettings({ genre })`（鼓组起始值来自曲风默认，drums-only 与录音待命**都不持久化**——静默重新待命比忘掉更糟）、`useKeyboardPerformance()`（FAB 偏好是存的，本标签页的自定义事件与跨标签页的 `storage` 两条同步路径都归它管）、`useInspectorCursor()`（重排后检查器跟着**音轨**而不是行号）。新增 11 条测试**不再需要渲染整个工作室**——这才是「下一端能复用」的实际含义。
highlights.en: **Three groups of state moved out of `StudioView`** into `features/sequencer/hooks/useStudioSession.ts`: `usePlaybackSettings({ genre })` (the kit starts at the genre's default; drums-only and record-arm are **never persisted** — silently re-arming is worse than forgetting), `useKeyboardPerformance()` (the FAB preference is stored, and both sync paths belong to it: the in-tab custom event and the cross-tab `storage` event) and `useInspectorCursor()` (after a row reorder the inspector follows the *track*, not the index). The eleven new tests need **no studio render** — which is what “the next surface can reuse it” actually means.

highlights.zh: **顺手收掉一个静默 bug 的温床**：FAB 偏好的事件名原本是两处字面量（写方 `dispatchEvent`、听方 `addEventListener`），打错一个字母不会有任何报错——读者只会继续显示旧值。现在是一个常量 `FAB_PREF_CHANGED_EVENT`。
highlights.en: **And one silent-bug trap closed**: the FAB preference's event name was a string literal in two places (the writer's `dispatchEvent`, the listener's `addEventListener`). A typo in one of them raises nothing — the reader simply keeps showing the old value. It is now the constant `FAB_PREF_CHANGED_EVENT`.

highlights.zh: **门禁自己也有人看着**：`surfaceIsolation.test.ts`（4 条）断言被删的 surface 清单与 `check_layers.mjs` 的 `UI_DIR_PREFIXES` 一致（新加一个 `src/screens` 只改一处会让实验悄悄变弱）、`check:isolation` 确实在 `verify` 里，另有一个毫秒级直接 import 扫描，且**带扫描器自检**（喂 surface 引用必须命中、喂 `utils/haptics` 必须放行）。有意**没有**搬走项目抽屉的那个布尔值：它没有规则可复用，手机端本来就会渲染自己的抽屉。
highlights.en: **The gate is watched too**: four tests in `surfaceIsolation.test.ts` assert that the list of deleted surfaces matches `check_layers.mjs`'s `UI_DIR_PREFIXES` (adding a `src/screens` in one file only would quietly weaken the experiment), that `check:isolation` really is in `verify`, and a millisecond-level direct-import scan **with its own self-check** (a surface specifier must be caught, `utils/haptics` must pass). Deliberately *not* moved: the project drawer's boolean — it has no rule to reuse, and the phone will render its own drawer anyway.

title.zh: v2.1.9 CI 的 Node 版本：jsdom 30 需要 Node 22，而 CI 跑在 Node 20
title.en: v2.1.9 CI's Node Version: jsdom 30 Needs Node 22, and CI Ran on Node 20

highlights.zh: **CI 红不是代码错。** `npm run test:coverage` 报 190 条 `webidl.util.markAsUncloneable is not a function`，**一个测试都没跑**，覆盖率 0% 撞阈值——于是 CI 只留下「覆盖率不达标」这句话，和真实原因毫无关系。原因是 **CI 用 Node 20 跑只有 Node 22 才能跑的 jsdom 30**：它内置的 `undici` 8 在 `cachestorage.js` 里调用 `worker_threads.markAsUncloneable`，这个导出 Node 20 没有。所以 `rm -rf node_modules` 重装解决不了——同样的依赖会在同样的旧 Node 上再装出来。
highlights.en: **The red CI was not a code failure.** `npm run test:coverage` reported 190 `webidl.util.markAsUncloneable is not a function` errors with **no test executed** and 0 % coverage, so the only visible message was a coverage-threshold failure that had nothing to do with the cause. CI ran **Node 20** for `jsdom` 30, which needs Node 22: the `undici` 8 it vendors calls `worker_threads.markAsUncloneable` in `cachestorage.js`, and Node 20 does not export it. Reinstalling `node_modules` cannot help — the same dependencies install again on the same old Node.

highlights.zh: **证据**：`jsdom@30.0.1` 的 `engines.node` 是 `^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`；它内置的 `undici@8.10.2` 要求 `>=22.19.0`；`cachestorage.js:20` 正是那一句调用；而 `typeof worker_threads.markAsUncloneable` 在 Node 22.22.3 上是 `function`、在 Node 20 上是 `undefined`。本地 Node 22.22.3 上 `npm run test:coverage` **exit 0**：192 文件 / 2185 用例，覆盖率 lines 90.58% / branches 75.31% / functions 66.08%（阈值 78 / 60 / 58）——**阈值没问题，问题只在环境**。
highlights.en: **The evidence**: `jsdom@30.0.1` declares `engines.node: ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`; the `undici@8.10.2` it vendors requires `>=22.19.0`; `cachestorage.js:20` is exactly that call; and `typeof worker_threads.markAsUncloneable` is `function` on Node 22.22.3 and `undefined` on Node 20. Locally on Node 22.22.3 `npm run test:coverage` exits 0 with 192 files / 2185 tests and lines 90.58 % / branches 75.31 % / functions 66.08 % against thresholds of 78 / 60 / 58 — **the thresholds were fine; only the environment was not**.

highlights.zh: **修法**：两个 CI job 都改为 `node-version-file: ".nvmrc"`，`.nvmrc` = `22.22.2`（正是 jsdom 声明的**下限**，所以 CI 跑「最低支持版本」，谁把要求悄悄抬高都会先红）；`package.json` 加 `engines.node`；`.npmrc` 开 `engine-strict`，不支持的 Node 在**安装阶段**就报 `EBADENGINE`（实测：`engines` 临时改成 `>=99` 时 `npm install --engine-strict` 立即失败）；新增 `npm run check:node` 作为 verify 第一步——它不自己实现 semver 范围判断，而是**直接构造一个 JSDOM**，环境能不能跑问它本人，顺带覆盖「在别的 Node 上装好的 node_modules 拿来跑」这种情况。README（中英）的「Node 20 或更新」改成「22.22.2 或更新」并写明原因。
highlights.en: **The fix**: both CI jobs now use `node-version-file: ".nvmrc"` with `.nvmrc` = `22.22.2` — exactly the floor jsdom declares, so CI runs the *minimum* supported version and anyone quietly raising the requirement goes red first; `package.json` gains `engines.node`; `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict`, so an unsupported Node fails at **install** time with `EBADENGINE` (verified: with `engines` temporarily set to `>=99`, `npm install --engine-strict` fails immediately); and `npm run check:node` runs first in `verify` — it does not re-implement a semver range check, it *constructs a JSDOM* and asks the environment directly, which also covers a `node_modules` installed on one Node and run on another. Both READMEs change from “Node 20 or newer” to “22.22.2 or newer” with the reason.

highlights.zh: **门禁**：`toolchainNode.test.ts`（5 条）把四份配置的关系钉住——`.nvmrc` 必须是具体版本且被 `package.json#engines` 逐字包含；同一串版本也必须逐字出现在 `node_modules/jsdom` 的 `engines` 里（这条解释「为什么是这个数」）；`.npmrc` 必须 `engine-strict=true`；每个 `Setup Node.js` 必须读 `.nvmrc`，且工作流里**不得再出现硬编码的 `node-version:`**。
highlights.en: **The gate**: five tests in `toolchainNode.test.ts` pin the relationship between the four files — `.nvmrc` must be a concrete version contained verbatim in `package.json#engines`; that same string must appear verbatim in `node_modules/jsdom`'s `engines` (which is *why* it is that number); `.npmrc` must set `engine-strict=true`; and every `Setup Node.js` must read `.nvmrc`, with no hardcoded `node-version:` allowed anywhere in the workflow.

title.zh: v2.1.8 走带条钉在页眉之下——顺带发现 `position: sticky` 在这个应用里从来没生效过
title.en: v2.1.8 The Transport Is Pinned Under the Header — and `position: sticky` Never Worked Anywhere in This App

highlights.zh: **走带条现在常驻页眉之下（约 52px）**：播放 / BPM / 小节 / 图案槽 / 撤销重做被提取成一条独立的 sticky 条，编辑 / 视图 / 工程组照旧随页面滚——常驻的是一行，不是整条工具栏。之前滚到底时传输组在 `top −247`、中心命中为空；现在停在页眉下方，命中测试打在它自己身上。
highlights.en: **The transport now parks under the header (~52 px).** Play / BPM / bar / pattern slots / undo-redo moved into their own sticky strip, while the edit, view and project groups still scroll with the page — one row is permanent, not a whole toolbar. Before, scrolled to the bottom, the group sat at `top −247` and hit-tested as nothing; now it stops right below the header and the hit test lands on it.

highlights.zh: **实现时才查出真因：这个应用里没有任何 `position: sticky` 生效过。** `<body>` 上挂着 `overflow-x-hidden`，而 `overflow: hidden` 会让元素成为滚动容器——body 因此成了所有 sticky 后代的最近 scrollport，偏偏 body 是随页面一起滚的，于是连声明了 `sticky top-0 z-50` 的应用页眉也在滚 400px 后停在 `top −400`。改用 `overflow-x: clip`（裁剪同样像素，但不创建滚动容器）后 sticky 恢复工作，**页眉第一次真的会吸顶**。`hidden` 作为老 Safari 的回退保留在前。
highlights.en: **Implementing it uncovered the real cause: `position: sticky` had never worked anywhere in this app.** `<body>` carried `overflow-x-hidden`, and `overflow: hidden` makes an element a scroll container — so `body` became the nearest scrollport for every sticky descendant, and since `body` scrolls *with* the page rather than inside it, even the app header (declared `sticky top-0 z-50`) sat at `top −400` after a 400 px wheel. Switching to `overflow-x: clip` — same clipping, no scroll container — restored sticky positioning, and **the header sticks now**. The `hidden` line stays first as the fallback for older Safari.

highlights.zh: **门禁是失败可证的**：E2E 在 5 个桌面/iPad 目标上断言 `--app-header-h` 等于页眉实测高度、滚到底后走带条在视口内**且中心命中它自己**（在视口里但被页眉盖住是点不到的，纯几何测不出来）、并停靠在页眉之下 0–8px。把 `sticky` 从条上拿掉重建，它报 `top −462, at its centre nothing`。`stickyAnchors.test.ts`（7 条）把 `<body>` 不得再用 `overflow-x-hidden`、样式表必须用 `clip`、两个 sticky 元素锚定同一 token、走带条必须是工具栏的**同级兄弟**（sticky 只能在自己父盒内移动，工具栏只有 116px 高，这是第一版失败的原因）钉在源码上。
highlights.en: **The new gates can fail.** The E2E asserts, on five desktop/iPad targets, that `--app-header-h` equals the header's rendered height, that the transport is inside the viewport **and that the point in its middle resolves to it** (an element in the viewport but behind the header cannot be clicked, and geometry alone would pass it), and that it parks 0–8 px under the header. Removing `sticky` from the strip and rebuilding makes it fail with `top −462, at its centre nothing`. Seven source tests in `stickyAnchors.test.ts` pin the enablers: no `overflow-x-hidden` on `<body>`, `clip` in the stylesheet, both sticky elements anchored to the same token, and the strip a **sibling** of the toolbar (sticky can only travel inside its parent's box, and the toolbar is 116 px tall — the reason the first attempt did nothing).

highlights.zh: **顺手修掉两处**：侧栏 dossier 的 `top-16`（64px）比页眉（69px）少 5px，现在两个 sticky 元素共用 `top-[var(--app-header-h)]`；`probe:toolbar` 原本用「传输组的最近 `div.flex.flex-col`」定位工具栏，条搬走后它爬进了面板外层、报出 **155 控件 / 1105px 的「工具栏」**——工具栏与条现在都有稳定 testid，探针量两者并集：16 控件 / 2 行 / 110px，与改前一致。
highlights.en: **Two incidental fixes.** The dossier sidebar's `top-16` (64 px) was 5 px short of the header (69 px); both sticky elements now share `top-[var(--app-header-h)]`. And `probe:toolbar` located the toolbar by walking up from the transport group to the nearest `div.flex.flex-col` — once the strip moved out, that walk climbed past the toolbar into the panel wrapper and reported a **155-control, 1105 px “toolbar”**. Both elements have stable test ids now, and the probe measures their union: 16 controls / 2 rows / 110 px, unchanged from before.

highlights.zh: **顺带修掉一个被「程序化可滚」藏住的缺陷：iPad 竖屏的页眉有八个控件落在屏幕外。** 页眉内容固定 1153px 宽，834px 视口下有搜索、随机、语言、设置、版本、帮助、上手引导、快捷键八项在视口右侧之外，1024px 下还剩四项。**用户根本够不到语言切换和设置面板**，而 E2E 一直是绿的——因为 `<body>` 的 `overflow-x: hidden` 允许*程序化*横向滚动，Playwright 的点击把 body 滚过去点中了按钮，没有任何手指能到那里。换成 `clip` 后同一句点击失败，缺陷才浮出来。修法是给页眉加 `flex-wrap`（768 / 834–1100 / 1194+ 分别为三行 / 两行 / 一行，视口外控件归零），并让页眉用 `ResizeObserver` 把自己的实测高度写进 `--app-header-h`（样式表里的 69px 只是首帧值）。E2E 现在逐个断言页眉控件都在视口内。
highlights.en: **And it fixed a defect that “programmatically scrollable” had been hiding: eight header controls sat outside an iPad-portrait viewport.** The header's contents are 1153 px wide regardless of viewport, so at 834 px eight of them — search, random, language, settings, version, help, onboarding, shortcuts — were past the right edge, and four still were at 1024 px. **A user on an iPad in portrait could not reach the language switch or the settings panel at all**, while the E2E stayed green: `<body>`'s `overflow-x: hidden` still allows *programmatic* horizontal scrolling, so Playwright's click scrolled the body sideways onto a button no finger could reach. Replacing it with `clip` made the same click fail, which is how this surfaced. The fix is `flex-wrap` on the header (three rows / two rows / one row at 768 / 834–1100 / 1194+, with zero controls outside the viewport), plus the header writing its measured height into `--app-header-h` through a `ResizeObserver` (the 69 px in the stylesheet is only the first-paint value). The E2E now asserts every header control is inside the viewport.

title.zh: v2.1.7 工作室两列左右互换：一次我自己引入、上线了二十多个版本的回归
title.en: v2.1.7 The Studio's Two Columns Were Swapped: a Regression I Shipped and Left Live for Twenty Releases

highlights.zh: **在 1440px 宽的屏幕上，编辑器只有 352px。** 工作室在 `lg` 是两列（`352px 1fr`），而实测出来是：信息栏 `aside@x400 1012px`、编辑器 `div@x28 352px`——**左右互换**。截图里编辑器只剩三格步进、工具栏折成窄条，信息栏占了整个右半屏。
highlights.en: **On a 1440 px screen the editor was 352 px wide.** The studio is two columns at `lg` (`352px 1fr`), and the measurement was: dossier `aside@x400 1012px`, editor `div@x28 352px` — **swapped**. The screenshot shows three step cells per track, the toolbar folded into a narrow strip, and the info panel owning the whole right half.

highlights.zh: **根因是我在 v2.0.88 引入的**：那一轮为了在面板上方放首屏提示与保存指示器，把原本直接作为网格子项的 `SequencerPanel` 包进了一个 wrapper，而 `order-1 lg:order-2` 留在了 `section` 上——`section` 现在是 wrapper 的子节点，**不是网格项**。于是 `InfoDossier` 的 `lg:order-1` 排在默认 `order: 0` 的 wrapper 前面，抢到了第一列。修复是一行：`order` 属于网格项，把两个类放到 wrapper 上。重建后 1440×900 为信息栏 352 左 / 编辑器 1012 右。
highlights.en: **The cause was mine, from v2.0.88.** That round added the first-run hint and the save indicator above the panel by wrapping the previously direct grid child in a `<div>`, and the `order-1 lg:order-2` classes stayed on the `section` — which is now a child of that wrapper, **not a grid item**. So the dossier's `lg:order-1` sorted ahead of the wrapper's default `order: 0` and took the first track. The fix is one line: `order` belongs to the grid item, so both classes moved to the wrapper. Re-measured at 1440×900: dossier 352 left, editor 1012 right.

highlights.zh: **为什么 190 个文件、2172 条测试、7 个目标全绿却没发现**：所有量测都发生在面板**内部**——间距探针量的是面板里的冻结列与网格间距（它报「frozen column [45, 237) = 192px」，两个数字都落在 352px 的窄列里，自洽得看不出问题）、工具栏探针量的是面板里的按钮密度、手机面审计量的是手机壳。**没有任何一条门禁比较「两个网格项谁宽」**。这是「相对断言在整体错位后仍然自洽」的教科书例子：量测需要一个绝对锚点。
highlights.en: **Why 190 files, 2172 tests and 7 targets stayed green:** every measurement happened *inside* the panel — the gutter probe measured the frozen column and grid gap within it (it reported “frozen column [45, 237) = 192 px”, both numbers inside the 352 px column, self-consistent and therefore silent), the toolbar probe measured button density inside it, the phone audit measured the phone shell. **No gate compared the two grid items to each other.** A textbook case of relative assertions staying consistent while the whole layout is wrong: measurement needs an absolute anchor.

highlights.zh: **两条新门禁，一条会失败才算证据。** E2E 在 5 个目标（桌面 3 + iPad 2）比较两个网格项：≥1024px 断言第一项是信息栏、第二项更宽且在其右侧、编辑器 ≥ 55% 视口；<1024px 断言单列且编辑器在上。**在故意还原回归的构建上它确实失败**：`The studio's columns are swapped on Desktop Chromium / Chrome: aside@400 852px then div@28 352px`。`src/test/studioColumns.test.ts`（4 条）把 contract 钉在源码结构上：order 类必须在网格项上、面板必须在该 wrapper 内。
highlights.en: **Two new gates, and one of them had to fail to count as evidence.** The E2E compares the two grid items on five targets (3 desktop + 2 iPad): above 1024 px the first item must be the dossier, the second wider and to its right, the editor at least 55 % of the viewport; below 1024 px there is one column with the editor first. **On a build with the regression deliberately restored it fails**: `The studio's columns are swapped on Desktop Chromium / Chrome: aside@400 852px then div@28 352px`. Four tests in `src/test/studioColumns.test.ts` pin the contract at the source: the order classes must sit on the grid item, with the panel inside it.

highlights.zh: **仍然开着的一件事**：修完仍是事实——PC/iPad 上走带条会随页面滚走（1440×900 滚到底后走带组 `top −247`，命中测试为空；量测脚本 `scripts/probe_transport_reach.mjs`）。把它钉在页眉之下需要接受工具栏那一行 **105px ≈ 12% 视口**常驻，这属于产品取舍，先问用户。手机端一行未动（冻结）。
highlights.en: **One thing is still open**: the transport does still scroll away on PC/iPad (at 1440×900, scrolled to the bottom, the transport group sits at `top −247` and hit-tests as nothing; measured by `scripts/probe_transport_reach.mjs`). Pinning it under the header means accepting a permanent **105 px ≈ 12 % of the viewport** toolbar row, which is a product trade-off — asked rather than assumed. No mobile code was touched (frozen).

title.zh: v2.1.6 跨语言常量只留一份：数字由 TS 写进 CSS
title.en: v2.1.6 One Copy of Each Cross-Language Constant: TS Writes the Numbers into CSS

highlights.zh: **同一个数字写两遍，靠一条测试钉住——这是第三次了。** 手机宽/高断点（639 / 500）和共享底栏里走带条的宽度（320）都在 CSS 与 TS 各有一份，前两次的处理都是再写一条「两份必须相等」的守卫。问题是它防不住**第三份**：新加一个跨语言常量时，除非作者记得补一条守卫，没有任何东西会失败——而当年 480/500 那次（横屏 490px 视口拿到压缩样式表、JS 仍当它是高手机）就是人工发现的。
highlights.en: **The same number written twice and pinned by a test — for the third time.** The phone width and height boundaries (639 / 500) and the shared bottom row's transport width (320) each existed on both sides of the CSS/TS line, and the first two rounds answered with another "the two copies must match" guard. What that cannot catch is the **third copy**: add a cross-language constant and nothing fails unless the author remembers a new guard — and the 480/500 drift (a 490 px-tall landscape viewport getting the compressed stylesheet while JS still called it a tall phone) was found by hand, not by a test.

highlights.zh: **所以只留一份**：三个数字搬进 `src/platform/layoutTokens.ts`，`scripts/layout_tokens.mjs` 把它们写进 `src/index.css`（`npm run layout:sync`），`npm run check:layout` 接进 `verify`——与 `ROADMAP_V2.md` 的版本头同一套办法。**媒体查询不能读 CSS 变量**（`@media (max-width: var(--x))` 不合法），所以生成的是数字本身；`--mobile-transport-row-w` 才是真正的变量，也由同一份 token 写。
highlights.en: **So there is one copy.** The three numbers live in `src/platform/layoutTokens.ts`; `scripts/layout_tokens.mjs` writes them into `src/index.css` (`npm run layout:sync`), and `npm run check:layout` sits inside `verify` — the same arrangement as the version header in `ROADMAP_V2.md`. **A media query cannot read a custom property** (`@media (max-width: var(--x))` is not valid), so what gets generated is the number itself; `--mobile-transport-row-w` is a real variable and is written from the same token.

highlights.zh: **匹配锚在规则语法上，删掉规则也算漂移。** 三条模式都锚定 `@media (max-width: …) {` 这样的完整规则，而不是搜 `d+`——否则释义注释里的 639、以及无关的 `--trk-head-w: 142px` 都会被改写，门禁就变成在检查自己。反过来，模式完全匹配不上时报 `found: null` 并失败：把媒体查询整块删掉，不该因为「没有可比的东西」而通过。
highlights.en: **The patterns are anchored to rule syntax, and a deleted rule counts as drift.** All three match a complete rule such as `@media (max-width: …) {` rather than searching for `\d+` — otherwise the 639 inside an explanatory comment, or the unrelated `--trk-head-w: 142px`, would be rewritten and the gate would end up checking itself. In the other direction, a pattern that matches nothing reports `found: null` and fails: deleting the media query must not pass by having nothing left to compare.

highlights.zh: **守卫是换了，不是删了。** 新增 `layoutCss.test.ts` 9 条：token 自洽、一致时报零漂移、**三处手工改错各自被点名**、**删掉媒体查询报 null**、注释与无关数字不被改写、重写幂等、真实 `src/index.css` 三条规则都在且与 token 一致。原来那两条「两份相等」的守卫改成它们真正还能证明的事：hook 的查询是**由 token 拼出来的**（`DEVICE_QUERIES`），面板仍在用 `min(var(--mobile-transport-row-w), 55vw)`。范围没有扩大：`--trk-head-w`、步进格高度、密度档位只在 CSS 内部消费，留在原处。
highlights.en: **The guards were replaced, not deleted.** Nine new tests in `layoutCss.test.ts`: the tokens are self-consistent, an agreeing stylesheet reports nothing, **each of the three hand-edited numbers is named**, **a deleted media query reports null**, comments and unrelated numbers survive, the rewrite is idempotent, and the real `src/index.css` has all three rules in sync. The two old "the copies match" guards now assert what they can still prove: the hook's queries are **built from the tokens** (`DEVICE_QUERIES`), and the panel still sizes the slot with `min(var(--mobile-transport-row-w), 55vw)`. The scope stayed narrow — `--trk-head-w`, the step-cell heights and the density tiers are consumed by CSS alone and stayed where they were.

highlights.zh: **端到端自证**：手工把 `@media (max-height: 500px)` 改成 480，`check:layout` 退出 1 并打出「stylesheet says 480, PHONE_MAX_HEIGHT_PX says 500」；`layout:sync` 改回后 `git diff src/index.css` 为空（逐字节还原）。手机端代码一行未动（用户冻结）。
highlights.en: **Proved end to end**: changing `@media (max-height: 500px)` to 480 by hand makes `check:layout` exit 1 with "stylesheet says 480, PHONE_MAX_HEIGHT_PX says 500"; after `layout:sync` the file is byte-identical (`git diff` empty). No mobile code was touched (frozen by the user).

title.zh: v2.1.5 参数条与钢琴键都能用键盘了；音长作用于整个选区
title.en: v2.1.5 The Parameter Lane and the On-Screen Piano Are Playable; Length Reaches the Selection

highlights.zh: **参数条不再是指针专属**：十六个拖拽目标、没有入口。现在它是**一个 tab 停留点 + 一个光标**——每列是 `role="slider"`（带 `aria-orientation="vertical"` 与 `aria-valuemin/max/now/valuetext`），上下键改值、左右键换列、Shift 与 PageUp/PageDown 走大步、Home/End 到两端，每次改动由 live region 播报「第 N 步 · 力度 101」。**0 个新 DOM 节点**，指针的拖拽与横扫一行未改。
highlights.en: **The parameter lane is no longer pointer-only**: sixteen drag targets and no way in. It is now **one tab stop with a cursor** — each column is a `role="slider"` (with `aria-orientation="vertical"` and `aria-valuemin/max/now/valuetext`), Up/Down change the value, Left/Right move between columns, Shift and PageUp/PageDown take bigger steps, Home/End jump to the ends, and a live region says “step N · velocity 101” after each change. **Zero new DOM nodes**, and the pointer's drag and swipe are untouched.

highlights.zh: **四个维度四套刻度，本来写了两份。** 同一列里画力度（1..127）、音长（0.1..2.0 步）、概率（0..100%）、滚奏（1,2,3,4,8）：指针有自己一套换算，键盘要再加一套，柱高与读数是第三套——拖拽改 100、按键改 101 这类分叉就是这样长出来的。四套刻度现在收在 `laneValues.ts` 一处，**公式是从组件里搬出来的，不是重写的**（拖到 100 仍然画到 100，测试逐条钉住四个换算、四种柱高、四种读数）。滚奏是**一张清单**而不是 1..8 的区间，所以键盘沿清单走，导入进来的非法值先吸附再走，不会造出引擎没有定义的连音数。
highlights.en: **Four dimensions, four scales, two copies of each.** One column draws velocity (1..127), length (0.1..2.0 steps), probability (0..100 %) and ratchet (1, 2, 3, 4, 8): the pointer had one set of conversions, a keyboard path would need a second, and the bar height and readout a third — which is exactly how “drag says 100, key says 101” grows. The four scales now live in one place, `laneValues.ts`, and **the formulas were moved out of the component rather than rewritten** (a drag that painted 100 still paints 100; tests pin all four conversions, four bar heights and four readouts). Ratchet is a **list**, not a 1..8 range, so the keyboard walks the list, and a value imported from somewhere else snaps to the nearest entry instead of inventing a ratchet the engine cannot play.

highlights.zh: **音长 `[`/`]` 现在和力度一样作用于整个选区** —— 这是 U10 里最后一个真缺口：选区可以被键盘调响，却只能一个字一个字地调长。新增 `scaleNotesLength` 与 `scaleNotesVelocity` 同形（选区 → 步集合、相对增量、同一处钳位），播报改成「2 个音 · 音长 1.8 步」，并补上选区版的钳位测试（0.1 步下限、一小节上限）。
highlights.en: **Length (`[`/`]`) now reaches the whole selection, exactly like velocity** — the last real gap in U10: a selection could be nudged louder from the keyboard but only lengthened one note at a time. The new `scaleNotesLength` mirrors `scaleNotesVelocity` (selection → set of steps, relative delta, the same clamp), the announcement became “2 notes · length 1.8 steps”, and the selection's clamps (0.1-step floor, one-bar ceiling) have their own test.

highlights.zh: **左侧钢琴键可以用键盘弹了**：以前只能点，于是键盘用户想听一个音必须先写出一个音——顺序正好反了，那排琴键存在的意义就是「先听再决定」。现在是 roving tab stop：上下键走一个半音**并试听**（与指针横扫等价），Shift 或 PageUp/PageDown 走一个八度，Enter/Space 重弹当前键并播报音名。琴键上的方向键归琴键——有选区时也不会误移音符（`stopPropagation`，测试钉住）。
highlights.en: **The on-screen piano can be played from the keyboard**: it used to be click-only, so a keyboard user had to *write* a note before hearing one — backwards, since those keys exist to listen before deciding. It is now a roving tab stop: Up/Down walk a semitone **and sound it** (the same thing a pointer drag across the keys does), Shift or PageUp/PageDown move an octave, and Enter/Space re-sounds the focused key and announces its name. On the gutter the arrows belong to the keys — a selection is not moved by accident, which has its own test.

highlights.zh: **三条路径同一条规矩：带焦点环的那个东西，才是按键作用的对象。** 键盘处理器从 DOM 上读列/键的索引，而不是只信组件 state（两者只在焦点被别人挪走时才会分歧，那时 DOM 是对的）。门禁：`laneValues.test.ts` 12 条、`velocityLaneKeyboard.test.tsx` 8 条、`pianoRollLane.test.tsx` 新增 8 条、`rollKeyboard.test.ts` 新增 3 条。全量 **189 文件 / 2164 用例**，`npm run verify` 全绿。手机端代码一行未动（用户冻结）。
highlights.en: **One rule across all three paths: whatever wears the focus ring is what the key acts on.** The handlers read the column or key index off the DOM rather than trusting component state alone (the two only disagree once focus moved without the component hearing about it — and then the DOM is right). Gates: 12 tests in `laneValues.test.ts`, 8 in `velocityLaneKeyboard.test.tsx`, 8 new in `pianoRollLane.test.tsx`, 3 new in `rollKeyboard.test.ts` — **189 files / 2164 tests**, `npm run verify` green. No mobile code was touched (frozen by the user).

title.zh: v2.1.4 两个音质门禁接进 verify；顺手清掉计划里六处过时的「未做」
title.en: v2.1.4 Two Audio Gates Wired into verify; Six Stale “Not Done” Claims Corrected

highlights.zh: **两个一直存在、一直通过、却从来不在 `verify` 里的门禁**：`check_loudness_spread.mjs`（按大类分档的响度）与 `check_timbre_spread.mjs`（159 曲风的音色指纹）此前只能靠人记得手动跑，没有 npm script。现在有 `check:loudness` / `check:timbre`，并接进 `verify`（`check:gs1` 之后、E2E 之前）。两者只读已提交的基线与源码、不启浏览器，实测 0.06 s 与 0.15 s。**「代码改了、基线没重录」从此每次发版都会被抓住。**
highlights.en: **Two gates that had always existed, always passed, and were never in `verify`**: `check_loudness_spread.mjs` (per-category loudness) and `check_timbre_spread.mjs` (the 159 genres' timbre fingerprints) could only be run by whoever remembered them — they had no npm script. Now `check:loudness` and `check:timbre` exist and sit inside `verify` (after `check:gs1`, before E2E). Both only read committed baselines and sources, launch no browser, and take 0.06 s and 0.15 s. **“Code changed, baseline not re-recorded” is now caught on every release.**

highlights.zh: **一次计划核对，翻出六处过时说法。** 全量响度测量其实早已跑完并写入基线（6 个类别中位数、69/159 因自身峰均比顶到上限、**159 条 trim 与报告完全一致**、0/159 削波、峰值最差 −1.242 dBTP）；音色基线也已重录，门禁还顺带断言 `src/data/genres/**` 与录音逐字节一致；「限幅器起音平滑」不是待办而是**已结案**（有前瞻时瞬时起音正是让天花板成为硬墙的做法，真正该修的每样本滑窗最小值已换成单调队列）。**手机端代码一行未动。**
highlights.en: **A plan audit turned up six stale claims.** The full loudness measurement had in fact finished and been baked into the baseline (six category medians, 69/159 capped by their own crest factor, **all 159 trims matching the report**, 0/159 clipping, worst true peak −1.242 dBTP); the timbre baseline had been re-recorded too, and that gate also asserts `src/data/genres/**` is byte-identical to the recording; and “limiter attack smoothing” is not a pending task but **closed** (with lookahead an instantaneous attack is exactly what makes the ceiling a hard wall — the real defect, a per-sample sliding-window minimum, is now a monotonic deque). **No mobile code was touched.**

highlights.zh: **同一份文档自己跟自己矛盾**：状态块写着「首屏单一动作（U1/U2）、术语表、工具栏 `?` 入口、Modal 栈仍未做」，而上面的 U 表早就记着四项都已交付（G.23/G.25/G.26、U9、G.28、G.24）。§3.5 与 §4 那份「均未开始」的清单也多数已完成（齐奏/立体声展开、键盘跟踪、立体声完整性、延迟不重建图、`toolbarTiers`、密度设置、iOS 静音无声）；**真正仍未做的只有波表与鼓组采样层（需要素材与许可）和混响 IR 移出主线程（已降级）**。
highlights.en: **The document contradicted itself**: a status block still claimed the first-screen single action (U1/U2), the glossary, the toolbar `?` entry point and the modal stack were undone, while the U table above had long recorded all four as delivered (G.23/G.25/G.26, U9, G.28, G.24). The “nothing started” list for §3.5 and §4 was likewise mostly finished (unison/stereo spread, key tracking, stereo integrity, delay without rebuilding the graph, `toolbarTiers`, the density setting, iOS silent-switch playback); **the only genuine remainders are the wavetable and drum-sample layers (they need assets and licensing) and moving the reverb IR off the main thread (downgraded).**

highlights.zh: **「计划里写着未做」只等于「某人某天认为没做」。** 六处里五处是过时、一处是自相矛盾，所以这一轮的产物不是功能，而是一份**能与代码对上的计划**：每处更正都附了可重跑的核实命令或断言来源，并加了两道门禁防止再次漂移。
highlights.en: **“The plan says it is not done” only means “someone believed so on some day”.** Five of the six were stale and one was self-contradictory, so this round's output is not a feature but a plan that **matches the code**: every correction carries a re-runnable command or the assertion behind it, plus two gates to keep it from drifting again.

title.zh: v2.1.3 中文术语统一：工作台 / 律动星系 / 音长
title.en: v2.1.3 One Name per Concept: 工作台, 律动星系, 音长

highlights.zh: **同一个东西四五个名字，教程说的在界面上找不到。** 按用户拍板的用词统一：工作室 → **工作台**（退役：律动工作台/编曲工作台/编曲台/编曲室）、星系 → **律动星系**（退役：星系云团/星系图谱/曲风星谱/宇宙星图）、音符时长 → **音长**（退役：门限时值/门限/长度/时长的那层意思）。**47 处替换**，覆盖 8 个 i18n 文件、帮助中心、Kick Lab、力度条、文档数据，以及 **6 个断言旧中文文案的测试**——它们正是「改了界面却忘了教程」的来源。
highlights.en: **The same thing had four or five names, so what the tutorial said could not be found in the interface.** Unified to the words the user chose: 工作室 → **工作台** (retiring 律动工作台 / 编曲工作台 / 编曲台 / 编曲室), 星系 → **律动星系** (retiring 星系云团 / 星系图谱 / 曲风星谱 / 宇宙星图), note length → **音长** (retiring 门限时值 / 门限 / 长度 / 时长 in that sense). **47 replacements** across eight locale files, the help centre, Kick Lab, the velocity lane, the manual data and **six tests that asserted the old Chinese copy** — which is exactly how an interface gets renamed while the tutorial keeps the old word.

highlights.zh: **一张允许表，而不是把规则放宽**：分不清「同名不同义」的扫描器只能一路放宽到什么都不查。所以**门限混响**（gated reverb，159 个曲风的文案里到处都是）、音轨**循环长度/步长**、**物理长度**、**衰减长度**，以及曲风 `origin_place` 里的「工作室」（一个**地点**，不是这个应用的编曲页）都保留，并把理由写进测试注释；扫描范围也据此排除 `src/data/genres/**`。
highlights.en: **An allowlist instead of a loosened rule**: a scanner that cannot tell look-alikes apart can only be relaxed until it checks nothing. So 门限混响 (gated reverb, all over the 159 genres' copy), a track's loop/step 长度, 物理长度, 衰减长度, and a genre's `origin_place` 工作室 (a *place*, not this app's studio view) all stay, with the reasons in the test's comments — and the scan scope excludes `src/data/genres/**` for the same reason.

highlights.zh: **门禁 `terminology.test.ts`（3 条）**：① 在**键上**断言三个正名（并在三个「长度」键上断言含「音长」），这样「改成第三个新词」也会失败，而不只是「改回旧词」；② 扫描界面文案里的退役名与音符门限语义的「门限」，报出 `文件:行号 词`；③ **扫描器自检**——对 `门限混响`/`循环长度`/`物理长度` 必须放行，对 `返回编曲台`/`门限: {gate} 步` 必须命中。没有第 ③ 条，前两条只是「当前为真的断言」，不是检查。
highlights.en: **The gate (`terminology.test.ts`, three tests)**: (1) the three canonical names are asserted **by key** — and the three length keys must contain 音长 — so picking a *third* word fails too, not just reverting to an old one; (2) the interface copy is scanned for the retired names and for 门限 in the note-gate sense, reporting `file:line term`; (3) the **scanner checks itself** — 门限混响 / 循环长度 / 物理长度 must pass, while 返回编曲台 / 门限: {gate} 步 must be caught. Without the third, the first two are just assertions that happen to be true today.

highlights.zh: **扫描抓到了手动清单漏掉的三处**：`LanguageContext.tsx` 里另有一份应用标题（「音乐曲风探索与律动工作台」），`help.ts` 里还有两处（「一键烘焙入编曲工作台」、「一键烘焙至编曲台与三维流派引力传承图谱」）。**这正是门禁存在的理由**：手动清单总会漏，扫描器不会。手机端代码一行未动（用户已冻结手机端）。
highlights.en: **The scan caught three sites the hand-written list had missed**: a second copy of the app title in `LanguageContext.tsx` (音乐曲风探索与律动工作台) and two more in `help.ts` (一键烘焙入编曲工作台, 一键烘焙至编曲台与三维流派引力传承图谱). **That is why the gate exists**: a hand-written list always misses some, a scanner does not. No mobile code was touched — the phone surface is frozen by the user.

title.zh: v2.1.2 手机档进了发布门禁：一次发版跑 7 个目标
title.en: v2.1.2 The Phone Targets Joined the Release Gate: Seven Devices per Version

highlights.zh: **一条不在发布链里的门禁，就是一条迟早会被跳过的门禁。** 手机端已经是这个产品的一半界面（11 个面的 44 px 规则、预算棘轮、页眉与 sheet 的交互断言都在手机档里），但一直是我**手工**跑。现在 `verify` 结尾多了 `npm run test:e2e:mobile`：每次发版跑 **3 个桌面引擎 + 4 个手机/平板目标**（iPhone 竖/横、iPad 竖/横）。实测耗时从约 5.5 min 变成约 11 min，其中手机档 ~290 s。
highlights.en: **A gate that is not in the release chain is a gate that will eventually be skipped.** The phone surface is half of this product's interface now — the eleven-surface 44 px rule, the budget ratchet and the header/sheet interaction assertions all live in the mobile profile — yet it was being run by hand. `verify` now ends with `npm run test:e2e:mobile`, so every version is checked on **three desktop engines plus four phone/tablet targets** (iPhone portrait and landscape, iPad portrait and landscape). Measured: verify grew from about 5.5 to about 11 minutes, ~290 s of it the mobile step.

highlights.zh: **先把已知的 flake 修掉，再把它放进门禁。** G.40 记下的线索是 `100 → 52`（向上拖却变小）——真因不是「拖拽偶发」，而是**比较了两个不同的音符**：改前读的是元素句柄，改后却用选择器**重新查询**；这次运行前面已经编辑过 pattern，力度条的顺序会变，于是两个数字来自不同音符。现在：前后都读**同一个句柄**，盒子反复读到你它不再移动（`scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` + 睡 150 ms 不是布局已稳定的承诺），并且按下之前用 `elementFromPoint` **核实落点就在这根条上**（和点击用的同一套「验证送达」契约）。
highlights.en: **Fix the known flake before putting it in the gate.** The clue recorded in G.40 was `100 → 52` — an upward drag that went down. The cause was not drag flakiness but **comparing two different notes**: the before-read used the element handle while the after-read re-queried by selector, and since the run edits the pattern earlier, the lane's bars re-order, so the two numbers came from different notes. Now both reads use the same handle, the box is re-read until it stops moving (`scrollIntoViewIfNeeded` plus a 150 ms sleep is not a promise that layout has settled), and the press point is verified with `elementFromPoint` — the same delivery contract the click helper uses.

highlights.zh: **顺带核对：目标里的两条要求其实早有测试**——`deviceCapabilities.test.ts` 已经断言 viewport meta 的 `maximum-scale=1` + `user-scalable=no`（并写明为什么是刻意的），`mobileShell.test.tsx` / `mobileTransportBar.test.tsx` 已经断言底栏**在 pointerup 提交**而不是 click。所以本轮没有加重复测试，只把这次核对写进计划：**先看有没有，再决定加不加。**
highlights.en: **And a check that saved a duplicate**: two requirements from the objective turned out to be tested already — `deviceCapabilities.test.ts` asserts the viewport meta's `maximum-scale=1` and `user-scalable=no` (and records why that is deliberate), and `mobileShell.test.tsx` / `mobileTransportBar.test.tsx` assert that the bottom bars commit on **pointerup** rather than click. No duplicate tests were added; the check itself is recorded in the plan: look for the test before writing one.

highlights.zh: **证据**：`npm run verify` 现在一次跑完 3 个桌面引擎 + 4 个手机/平板目标，全绿（exit 0），186 文件 / 2130 用例。
highlights.en: **Evidence**: `npm run verify` now runs three desktop engines and four phone/tablet targets in one pass, all green (exit 0), 186 files / 2130 tests.

title.zh: v2.1.1 手机端：门禁覆盖 11 个面，还没决定的四页用预算钉住
title.en: v2.1.1 The Phone Gate Covers Eleven Surfaces; Four Await a Decision Under Budget

highlights.zh: **还没拍板的四页不能无人看管。** E2E 的手机门禁现在走 **11 个面**：7 个走 44 px 硬规则，4 个（horizontal-timeline / vertical-timeline / compare / analyzer）走**预算**。预算是棘轮不是免责：数字是今天的实测值，**变差就失败**，变好会提示收紧，并且每次都打印。它按**方向**分开记，因为两种布局本来就不同——analyzer 横屏只剩 2 个、竖屏 13 个；vertical-timeline 横屏 1 个、竖屏 6 个。
highlights.en: **The four undecided pages cannot be left unguarded.** The E2E phone gate now walks **eleven surfaces**: seven under the 44 px rule and four (horizontal-timeline, vertical-timeline, compare, analyzer) under a **budget**. A budget is a ratchet, not an excuse: the numbers are today's measurements, **worse fails the run**, better says so, and every one is printed. They are recorded per orientation because the layouts differ — the analyzer has 2 left in landscape against 13 in portrait, and vertical-timeline 1 against 6.

highlights.zh: **一个教训：门禁必须自己拥有它执行的数字。** 第一版预算抄了审计脚本的数，一跑就红——门禁量到的 compare 是 **15**（审计 14）、analyzer 横屏是 **2**（审计 0）。差异来自口径：审计要求元素**中心**真的在视口内且多等一会儿布局稳定，门禁只要求矩形与视口相交。两者都对，但「照这个数执行」的那个数必须来自执行者本身。
highlights.en: **A lesson: a gate has to own the numbers it enforces.** The first budget copied the audit's figures and failed immediately — the gate measured **15** for compare against the audit's 14, and **2** for the analyzer in landscape against the audit's 0. The rules differ: the audit requires the element's *centre* to be inside the viewport and waits longer for layout to settle, while the gate only requires the rect to intersect it. Both are defensible, but the number a gate enforces has to come from the gate.

highlights.zh: **顺带抓到一个真实的 ResizeObserver 循环**：门禁走到 analyzer 后，E2E 开始报 `ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications`。**没有过滤这条消息**，而是找到源头——三个分析画布在自己的 observer 回调里写 `canvas.style.width/height`，而容器尺寸又跟着画布走，于是在自己的通知里改变了被观察元素。修法是把回调**推迟一帧**（三处），第二遍本来就会因守卫变成 no-op。E2E 的 `pageerror` 收集保持严格，没加白名单。
highlights.en: **And it caught a real ResizeObserver loop**: once the gate reached the analyzer, the E2E began reporting `ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications`. **The message was not filtered** — the source was found instead: three analyser canvases write `canvas.style.width/height` inside their own observer callback, while the container's size follows the canvas, so the callback resizes the element it is observing. Deferring the callback by one frame (three files) settles it, since the handler's own guard makes the second pass a no-op. The E2E's `pageerror` collection stays strict, with no allowlist.

highlights.zh: **下一步**：G.39 的取舍提案仍在等确认（analyzer 手机只留波形档；compare 与两条时间线手机端不提供）。定了以后，对应预算收紧到 0，或者整面从「手机可达」里移除。
highlights.en: **Next**: G.39's keep/drop proposal still awaits confirmation (keep only the analyzer's waveform mode on a phone; do not offer compare or either timeline). Once decided, the matching budgets tighten to zero — or the surface leaves the phone-reachable set entirely.

title.zh: v2.1.0 手机端：曲风制作器、挑战与大师课都按得到了；顺手修掉一个会空转的检查
title.en: v2.1.0 On a Phone: The Genre Maker, Challenge and Masterclass Are Hittable Too

highlights.zh: **三个视图 8 + 5 + 1 → 0**：**maker** 的 fork 下拉只有 140×**18**、Fork 43×24、`New Blank Genre`/`Saved`/`Poster & Share`/`Workshop Guide`/`Open in Studio` 一排 34 px，还有元数据表单里 316×38 的名称输入；**challenge** 的证书按钮 34 px、重置 32×32、三档难度 32–34 px；**masterclass** 的 Guide 128×30。同一形状的表单控件（名称/分类/作者/BPM/音阶/拍号）一并按 44 px 处理——它们只是再往下滚一屏的同一种东西，不修就是「量不到就不算」的自欺。
highlights.en: **Three views went 8 + 5 + 1 → 0**: the **maker**'s fork select was 140×**18**, Fork 43×24, and the `New Blank Genre` / `Saved` / `Poster & Share` / `Workshop Guide` / `Open in Studio` row 34 px tall, plus a 316×38 name field in the metadata form; **challenge**'s certificate button was 34 px, reset 32×32 and the three difficulty buttons 32–34 px; **masterclass**'s guide was 128×30. The identically shaped form controls (name, category, author, BPM, scale, meter) were done in the same pass — they are the same thing one screen further down, and skipping them would be measuring only what happens to be on screen.

highlights.zh: 四个文件都从 `useDeviceCapabilities()` 读 `isMobile`，**桌面路径一行未改**。量后：maker 15 控件 / 0 低于 44，challenge 12 / 0，masterclass 10 / 0，横屏同样 0；E2E 手机门禁现在覆盖 **7 个面**。
highlights.en: All four files read `isMobile` from `useDeviceCapabilities()` and **the desktop path is untouched**. After: maker 15 controls / 0 under 44, challenge 12 / 0, masterclass 10 / 0, and 0 in landscape; the E2E phone gate now covers **seven surfaces**.

highlights.zh: **顺手修掉一个「构造上就会空转」的检查**：加完 7 面门禁后，iPhone 两个方向都报 `genre switch 1: navigations=0 patternFlips=0`。加了诊断一量才发现：那个 chip **本来就是当前曲风**——检查固定点 `chipSelectors[1]` 并假定它一定是别的曲风，而 App 把当前曲风存在 state 里，前面几步（这一轮新加的门禁会走一遍 maker）已经切到过它，于是点击是**合法的 no-op**。现在从排除当前曲风后的头三个 chip 里逐个试，只要有一个真的换了曲风就通过；真坏掉的处理器仍然会失败。
highlights.en: **A check that was vacuous by construction got fixed along the way**: after the seven-surface gate landed, both iPhone orientations reported `genre switch 1: navigations=0 patternFlips=0`. A three-line diagnostic showed the chip **was already the current genre** — the check always clicked `chipSelectors[1]` and assumed that was a different genre, while the app keeps its genre in state, and the earlier steps (this round's gate walks the maker) had already visited it, making the click a legitimate no-op. It now tries up to three chips with the current one excluded and passes if any of them really switches; a genuinely broken handler still fails, because none of them change anything.

highlights.zh: **另一个真实缺陷**：未保存确认框改成**等它出现**（`waitForSelector` 1.5 s）而不是睡 400 ms —— 诊断显示它有时出现得更晚，于是对话框留在屏幕上、切换被挡下，这是这个检查**第二次**空转的原因。修完的日志本身成了证据：`guard asked — discarding` → `navigations=1 patternFlips=1` → 跳到前几步在 maker 里建的那个曲风。
highlights.en: **And a second real defect**: the unsaved-changes guard is now **waited for** (`waitForSelector`, 1.5 s) instead of a 400 ms sleep — the diagnostic showed it sometimes appears later, leaving the dialog open and the switch blocked, which is how this check went vacuous the *second* time. The fixed log is its own evidence: `guard asked — discarding` → `navigations=1 patternFlips=1` → the URL moving to the genre the earlier maker step had created.

highlights.zh: **剩余三页的取舍方案写进了计划（G.39）**，作为提案等确认：analyzer 手机上只留波形/电平档；compare 与两条时间线在手机端**不提供**（A/B 盲听与 1850–2025 长卷放不进 390 px），给出说明与替代路径。这改变的是「手机上有什么」，不只是一种排版。
highlights.en: **The plan's G.39 now carries the proposal for the last four pages**: keep only the waveform/level mode of the analyzer on a phone, and **do not offer** compare and both timelines there (A/B blind listening and an 1850–2025 scroll do not fit 390 px), with a note and an alternative path instead. That changes *what exists on a phone*, not just a layout.

title.zh: v2.0.99 手机端：和弦台与 Kick Lab 的控件都按得到了
title.en: v2.0.99 On a Phone: The Chord Studio and Kick Lab Controls Are All Hittable

highlights.zh: **和弦台（Tools 落地页）3 → 0**：Harmony Guide（139×26）与调号/调式两个下拉（119×32）在手机上都到 44 px——这两个下拉正是手机用户在这页最先要动的东西。
highlights.en: **The chord studio (the Tools landing page) went from 3 to 0**: the Harmony Guide (139×26) and the key/mode selects (119×32) now clear 44 px — and those selects are the first thing a phone user reaches for on that page.

highlights.zh: **Kick Lab 7 → 0**：Kick Lab Guide（140×26）、Return to Studio（156×24）、CRT/WATERFALL 两个可视化模式、INITIATE PULSE（146×30），以及全页最小的两个目标——**TEMPO 数字输入 48×17** 与 **YT/XY 波形切换 57×33**——都到 44 px。
highlights.en: **Kick Lab went from 7 to 0**: the Kick Lab Guide (140×26), Return to Studio (156×24), the two visualiser modes, INITIATE PULSE (146×30), and the two smallest targets on the page — the **TEMPO number field at 48×17** and the **YT/XY waveform toggle at 57×33** — all reach 44 px.

highlights.zh: 四个文件（`ChordProgressionsView`、`KickAnatomyView`、`GravitationalSequencer`、`PhosphorOscilloscope`）都从 `useDeviceCapabilities()` 读 `isMobile`，**桌面路径一行未改**。量后：chords 10 控件 / 0 低于 44，kick 12 / 0，横屏同样 0。
highlights.en: The four files (`ChordProgressionsView`, `KickAnatomyView`, `GravitationalSequencer`, `PhosphorOscilloscope`) read `isMobile` from `useDeviceCapabilities()`; **the desktop path is untouched**. After the change: chords 10 controls / 0 under 44, kick 12 / 0, and 0 in landscape too.

highlights.zh: **门禁现在逐个量四个面**：studio、explore、chords、kick，失败信息带页面名。仍待处理（计划 G.37 的表）：maker 8、challenge 5、masterclass 1、horizontal-timeline 12、vertical-timeline 6、compare 14、analyzer 13。
highlights.en: **The gate now measures four surfaces by name**: studio, explore, chords and kick, with the surface named in every failure. Still on the list (the plan's G.37 table): maker 8, challenge 5, masterclass 1, horizontal-timeline 12, vertical-timeline 6, compare 14, analyzer 13.

highlights.zh: **下一步的判断写进了计划**：后四页（两条时间线、compare、analyzer）合计 45 个低于 44 px 的控件，且都是桌面级信息密度的视图。按目标里「难做好用的直接不提供」，它们更该走**手机端不提供**（像硬件调音台与钢琴卷帘那样给出说明并指向可用路径），而不是把每个按钮撑到 44 px 再塞回 390 px 宽的屏幕。
highlights.en: **The next call is recorded in the plan**: the last four pages (both timelines, compare, analyzer) hold 45 controls under 44 px between them and are all desktop-grade information density. Per the objective's "do not offer what cannot be done well", they should be **not offered on a phone** — the way the hardware console and the piano roll already are, with a note and a usable path — rather than padding every button to 44 px and pushing it back onto a 390 px screen.

title.zh: v2.0.98 手机端：Explore 页收拾干净，并把每个视图都量了一遍
title.en: v2.0.98 The Phone Explore Page Is Clean, and Every View Has Been Measured

highlights.zh: **量具能走别的页了**：`measure_phone_surface.mjs` 新增 `--tabs=a,b,c`。一量之下，**除了 studio 之外的每个视图都有低于 44 px 的控件**——合计 **89 个**：chords 3、kick 7、maker 8、challenge 5、masterclass 1、horizontal-timeline 12、vertical-timeline 6、compare 14、analyzer 13，Explore 9。前两轮修好的是手机端的「主页」，其余页面从来没按手机标准量过。完整表格写进了计划的 G.37，它就是接下来几轮的工作清单。
highlights.en: **The measuring tool can walk other pages now**: `measure_phone_surface.mjs` takes `--tabs=a,b,c`. Measuring them showed that **every view except the studio has controls under 44 px** — **89 of them** in total: chords 3, kick 7, maker 8, challenge 5, masterclass 1, horizontal-timeline 12, vertical-timeline 6, compare 14, analyzer 13 and Explore 9. The previous two rounds fixed the phone's *home*; the other pages had never been measured against the phone standard. The full table is in the plan's G.37 and is the work list for the next rounds.

highlights.zh: **Explore 从 9 个降到 0**（studio 之外使用频率最高的页面，选曲风的地方）。六个星云分类 chip（39–134×**29**）、`Show all`、列表视图、年代回放按钮（28×28）都到了 44 px——它们在一行横向滚动里，变高不会挤坏布局。
highlights.en: **Explore went from nine to zero** — it is the busiest page after the studio, the one where a genre gets picked. The six nebula category chips (39–134 × **29**), the `Show all` chip, the list-view button and the era-replay button (28×28) all reach 44 px; they live in a horizontally scrolling row, so growing taller costs no layout.

highlights.zh: **3D 投影标签在手机上改成纯视觉元素**（`pointer-events-none` + `tabIndex={-1}` + `aria-hidden`）。理由是它们**长不大**：渲染循环用 `translate3d(x, y-28) translate(-50%,-100%)` 把标签底边锚在投影点上，加高只会把文字整体上移；而 39×29 的按钮在手机上本来就点不准。手机改用 chip 行与列表视图选曲风（两者现在都是 44 px），标签留在屏幕上当信息。
highlights.en: **The projected 3D labels became visual-only on a phone** (`pointer-events-none` + `tabIndex={-1}` + `aria-hidden`). They *cannot* grow: the render loop anchors each label's **bottom** edge to the projected point with `translate3d(x, y-28) translate(-50%,-100%)`, so a taller box only lifts the text; and a 39×29 button was not tappable anyway. The phone picks a genre from the chips row or the list view (both 44 px now) and keeps the labels as information.

highlights.zh: **一个陷阱**：那 6 个标签在**渲染循环里每帧**被写 `el.style.pointerEvents = vis ? "auto" : "none"`，所以类名上的 `pointer-events-none` 会被内联样式覆盖（探针里 7 个标签只有 1 个读到 `none`）。改成循环里读一个 `phoneSurfaceRef`（`isMobile` 的 ref 副本，避免重建渲染循环）才真的生效。
highlights.en: **A trap worth naming**: those labels get `el.style.pointerEvents = vis ? "auto" : "none"` written **every frame** by the render loop, so a class-based `pointer-events-none` is overridden by the inline style — a probe found only one of seven labels reading `none`. Reading a `phoneSurfaceRef` (a ref copy of `isMobile`, so the loop is not rebuilt) is what actually took effect.

highlights.zh: **门禁**：审计与 E2E 都新增一条规则——**`pointer-events: none` 的元素不是目标**（按定义按不到），这正是只读标签能合法地从目标清单里消失的机制，而不是把规则放宽。E2E 的手机门禁也从「只量 studio」扩成**按名字逐个量**，这一轮起覆盖 `studio` 与 `explore`，报错带上页面名。
highlights.en: **Gates**: both the audit and the E2E now treat **`pointer-events: none` as not a target** (by definition nothing can tap it) — that is the mechanism by which a read-only label legitimately leaves the list, rather than a loosened rule. The E2E's phone gate also went from measuring only the studio to **measuring named surfaces**, covering `studio` and `explore` from this release, with the page name in every failure message.

title.zh: v2.0.97 手机端：轨道头的检查器入口从 4×20 px 变成按得到的目标
title.en: v2.0.97 The Phone Track Header: A 4×20 px Inspector Button Becomes a Real Target

highlights.zh: **上一轮的门禁有个盲区**：它把整个 `[role="grid"]` 子树排除在外（步进格子是 `role="gridcell"`），可**轨道头就在同一个容器里**——于是五个控件（折叠 14×14、检查器入口 **4×20**、`L:16` 30×36、Mute/Solo 36×36）从来没被量到。把排除范围缩到 `role="gridcell"` 本身之后，竖屏控件数从 16 变成 44，低于 44 px 的从 2 变成 **29**。
highlights.en: **The previous round's gate had a blind spot**: it skipped the whole `[role="grid"]` subtree (the step cells are `role="gridcell"`), but **the track headers live inside that same container** — so five controls (fold 14×14, the inspector opener **4×20**, `L:16` 30×36, mute and solo 36×36) had never been measured. Narrowing the skip to `role="gridcell"` itself took the portrait count from 16 to 44 controls and the under-44 count from 2 to **29**.

highlights.zh: **142 px 的固定列放不下三个 44 px 目标**，所以这一行只能减东西——减什么有依据：检查器入口是 `flex-1 min-w-0`，被同排的 `L:16`/M/S 挤成 4 px（也就是轨名被挤成 0 宽）。现在轨道头是**一个大检查器目标（≥44×44，轨名重新可见）+ 44×44 的 Mute**；Solo 去掉（`TrackInspector` 里写着 "Always visible: muting or soloing must not require finding the right tab"，那是重复的）；逐轨折叠去掉（工具栏有 Fold All）；`L:16` 变成**只读徽标**，改长度留给桌面。顺带把 Ruler 的「复制 B1」（58×30）提到 44 px。
highlights.en: **A 142 px fixed column cannot hold three 44 px targets**, so the row had to lose something — and which somethings is argued: the inspector opener was `flex-1 min-w-0` squeezed to 4 px by the `L:16`/mute/solo beside it (the track name was squeezed to zero width too). The phone row is now **one big inspector target (≥44×44, with the name visible again) plus a 44×44 mute**; solo is gone (the inspector says "Always visible: muting or soloing must not require finding the right tab", so it was a duplicate); the per-track fold is gone (the toolbar has Fold All); `L:16` became a **read-only badge** and editing a track's length stays on the desktop. The ruler's "Dup B1" pill (58×30) also reached 44 px.

highlights.zh: **横屏另有一处泄漏**：`.trk-head-desktop-only` 的隐藏规则是 `max-width: 639px`，而横屏手机是 **750 px 宽**——于是七个 16 px 控件（含一个 16×16 的「打开检查器」）在横屏回到屏幕上。这正是能力钩子注释里说的「两条规则一个按宽、一个按高」。现在短横屏也隐藏它们（用 `pointer: coarse` 限定，短桌面上窗口不受影响）。**结果：竖屏低于 44 px 的 29 → 3，横屏 → 1**，剩下三个都在冻结文件里（传输条 32×44、工具栏 Fold All 126×22），在门禁里具名豁免。
highlights.en: **Landscape had a leak of its own**: the rule hiding `.trk-head-desktop-only` is a `max-width: 639px` query, and a landscape phone is **750 px wide** — so seven 16 px controls (including a 16×16 "open inspector") came back on screen in landscape. That is exactly the width-vs-height disagreement the capability hook's comment warns about. A short landscape phone now hides them too (gated on `pointer: coarse`, so a short *desktop* window is unaffected). **Result: portrait under-44 controls 29 → 3, landscape → 1**, and all three survivors are in frozen files (the transport's 32×44 bar buttons and the toolbar's 126×22 Fold All), named explicitly in the gate.

highlights.zh: **一个值得记下的教训**：第一版把新布局挂在 `isCompact` 上，构建、测量之后数字一点没变——因为 `isCompact` 是逐轨「紧凑行」密度开关（`SequencerPanel` 传的是 `compactTracks[trackIdx]`），不是「这是不是手机」。改成从 `useDeviceCapabilities()` 读 `isMobile` 才对。**没有重新测一遍，就会以为改好了。**
highlights.en: **A lesson worth recording**: the first version hung the new layout on `isCompact`, and after building and measuring, nothing had changed — because `isCompact` is the per-track density toggle (`SequencerPanel` passes `compactTracks[trackIdx]`), not "is this a phone". Reading `isMobile` from `useDeviceCapabilities()` was the fix. **Without re-measuring, it would have looked done.**

highlights.zh: **门禁与测试**：`E2E_PROFILE=mobile` 上新增的「网格之外、在屏控件 ≥44×44」规则现在真的覆盖轨道头（这正是它上一轮漏掉的）；桌面与平板路径一行未改（`isCompact` 的既有语义保持），既有单测全绿。
highlights.en: **Gates and tests**: the mobile "every on-screen control outside the grid is ≥44×44" rule now genuinely covers the track headers — which is precisely what it missed last round. The desktop and tablet paths are untouched (the existing `isCompact` meaning is preserved) and the existing unit tests stay green.

title.zh: v2.0.96 手机端：页眉变回标题栏，控件都能按得到
title.en: v2.0.96 On a Phone: The Header Is a Title Bar Again, and Every Control Is Hittable

highlights.zh: **先量，再改。** 新工具 `scripts/measure_phone_surface.mjs` 在真实构建产物上量 iPhone 14 竖/横两屏：可触摸控件数（分「工作区」与「两条栏」）、每个控件的盒子与是否 < 44 px、横向溢出、固定栏占比、最小字号。竖屏基线：**22 个控件，11 个低于 44 px，其中 9 个在页眉**（Search 36×28、设置 30×30、版本 24×20…）。缩放已被 `user-scalable=no` 挡住 ✓，无横向溢出 ✓。
highlights.en: **Measure first, then change.** The new `scripts/measure_phone_surface.mjs` reads the real build at iPhone 14 portrait and landscape: how many controls are touchable (split into working area and the two bars), every control's box and whether it is under 44 px, horizontal overflow, fixed-chrome share, smallest font. Portrait baseline: **22 controls, 11 of them under 44 px, 9 of those in the header** (Search 36×28, Settings 30×30, the version button 24×20 …). Zoom is already blocked by `user-scalable=no`, and there is no horizontal overflow.

highlights.zh: **页眉在手机上变回标题栏**：只留品牌 + 一个 **44×44 的「全部板块」按钮**，打开 App 自己的 sections sheet；原本 9 个桌面控件与页眉自带的抽屉不再渲染。删减是有依据的：逐条比对后 **sheet 是页眉抽屉的超集**（chords/kick/maker/challenge/masterclass/两条时间线/compare/analyzer/search/settings/help/updates 全在里面），语言开关在 Settings、引导在帮助中心、随机曲风在 Explore 自己那里。类型栏的筛选框与骰子也从 36 px 提到 **44 px**。**低于 44 px 的控件从 11 个降到 2 个**，剩下两个是冻结文件里手机传输条的上一/下一小节（32×44），在门禁里**具名豁免**。
highlights.en: **The phone header is a title bar again**: the brand plus one **44×44 "All sections" button** that opens the app's own sheet; the nine desktop controls and the header's own drawer are no longer rendered. The removal is backed by a line-by-line comparison: **the sheet is a superset of that drawer** (chords, kick, maker, challenge, masterclass, both timelines, compare, analyzer, search, settings, help, updates), the language switch lives in Settings, the tour in the Help centre and a random genre in Explore. The genre rail's category picker and dice also went from 36 px to **44 px**. **Controls under 44 px fell from 11 to 2**, and the two survivors are the frozen transport bar's bar-step buttons (32×44), named explicitly in the gate rather than tolerated by a loose rule.

highlights.zh: **新门禁**（只在手机目标上跑）：页眉最多 2 个控件；步进网格之外、当前在屏的每个控件都 ≥ 44×44；并把原来「页眉必须有全局设置入口」改成设备相关——手机上从页眉的「全部板块」进 sheet 再进设置，桌面/平板仍走页眉。三条在 iPhone 竖/横两屏跑通（`E2E_PROFILE=mobile` 4/4）。
highlights.en: **New gates**, mobile targets only: at most two controls in the header; every on-screen control outside the step grid at least 44×44; and the old "the header must have a global settings entry point" assertion made device-aware — a phone goes header → All sections → Settings, desktop and tablet still go through the header. All three pass on iPhone portrait and landscape (`E2E_PROFILE=mobile`, 4/4).
