title.zh: v2.0.73 页面双指滚动失效的根因（根样式 overscroll-behavior），以及让同一鼓件的连续敲击不再完全相同
title.en: v2.0.73 The Root Cause of Dead Trackpad Scrolling (overscroll-behavior on the Root), and Per-Hit Variation So Repeated Drum Strokes Stop Being Identical

highlights.zh: **页面在 macOS Chrome 上无法双指滚动，根因是根样式的 `overscroll-behavior: none`**（用户本人在真机二分确认）。这个属性的字面定义只是「禁止滚动链与回弹」，但 **Chrome 在支持触摸的桌面硬件上同样采纳它**，于是纵向的那一半把最基础的页面手势一并关掉了；Safari 宽松，所以同一份代码在 Safari 上正常。用户实测的四条对照解释了它为什么难查：`touch-action: auto` 正常、`overflow: auto` 正常、**程序化滚动正常**（`scrollY` 能改）、但**双指手势被静默忽略**。
highlights.en: **Two-finger trackpad scrolling was dead on macOS Chrome, and the cause was `overscroll-behavior: none` on the root** (bisected by hand on the affected machine). The property's definition is only "no scroll chaining, no affordance", but **Chrome honours it on touch-capable desktop hardware**, so the vertical half of the shorthand took the page's most basic gesture with it; Safari is laxer, which is why the same code was fine there. The user's four-way comparison explains why it hid for so long: `touch-action: auto` fine, `overflow: auto` fine, **programmatic scrolling fine** (`scrollY` moved), and the **two-finger gesture silently ignored**.

highlights.zh: **修法按轴拆开，且保留横向是刻意的**：`overscroll-behavior-x: none; overscroll-behavior-y: auto`。横向仍要挡——步进格子本身有横向平移，放开双指横滑会不断触发浏览器的历史导航（后退/前进）。值得一提的是 `src/index.css` 里**早就有正确写法的同类规则**（`.overscroll-x-contain`，步进面板在用），也就是说这个教训此前只在**局部**应用过，**根部**没跟上。代价已写进文档：纵向还给浏览器后，触摸设备上向下拖可能重新触发下拉刷新，这一轮取桌面可用。
highlights.en: **The fix splits by axis, and keeping the horizontal half is deliberate**: `overscroll-behavior-x: none; overscroll-behavior-y: auto`. Horizontal still needs suppressing — the step grid pans horizontally, so allowing the two-finger horizontal swipe would fire the browser's history navigation (Back/Forward) constantly. Worth noting: `src/index.css` **already contained the correct form of this rule** (`.overscroll-x-contain`, used by the sequencer pane), so the lesson had been applied *locally* while the root never followed. The cost is documented: with vertical returned to the browser, a downward drag on a touch device can pull-to-refresh again; this round chooses desktop usability.

highlights.zh: **我的诊断脚本给出的结论是错的，错法可复现**：它当时报「5 个变体都能滚动」，我据此说过「可能不是主因」。原因是它的每条探针都用 `window.scrollTo` **程序化**滚动或判断 `scrollHeight > clientHeight`——而 `overscroll-behavior` 管的是**手势与回弹**，不是滚动范围也不是滚动 API，所以它能诚实地报「都能滚」而真机纹丝不动。**教训：绕过输入路径的探针测不出输入路径的 bug。** 该脚本这一版加了一条读**计算样式**的结论行（`overscroll-x/y` 与 `touch-action`），不需手势与硬件，命中已知坏配置直接 `exit 1`。
highlights.en: **My own diagnostic reached the wrong conclusion, and the way it was wrong is reproducible**: it reported "all five variants scroll", and I told the user this might not be the main cause. Every probe in it scrolled **programmatically** (`window.scrollTo`) or asked whether `scrollHeight > clientHeight` — but `overscroll-behavior` gates the *gesture* and the affordance, not the scroll range or the scroll API, so it could honestly report "everything scrolls" while the real machine sat frozen. **The lesson: a probe that bypasses the input path cannot test an input-path bug.** The script now ends with a readout of the *computed* gesture properties, needing no gesture and no hardware, and exits 1 on the known-bad configuration.

highlights.zh: **顺带修掉一条「永不失败」的守卫**：同一份测试里守卫「根部不得有 `touch-action`」的断言写的是 `css.slice(css.indexOf("html,"), …)`，而 `src/index.css` 里**没有 `html,` 这个选择器**，于是 `indexOf` 返回 -1、`slice` 返回空字符串、`expect("").not.toMatch(...)` **恒真**。一条用来防真实回归的守卫从不失败，比没有守卫更糟——它让人以为已经复核过。现改为按选择器解析真实声明块，**选择器改名即抛错**，并实跑验证过两种坏写法（shorthand `none`、`-y: none`）都会失败。
highlights.en: **A guard that could never fail is fixed alongside it**: the sibling assertion forbidding root-level `touch-action` ran against `css.slice(css.indexOf("html,"), …)`, and `src/index.css` contains no `html,` selector — so `indexOf` returned -1, `slice` returned the empty string, and `expect("").not.toMatch(...)` was **vacuously true**. A regression guard that never fails is worse than none: it makes people believe something was re-verified. It now parses the real declaration blocks and **throws if a selector is renamed**, and I confirmed by running it that both broken forms (the `none` shorthand and `-y: none`) fail it.

highlights.zh: **音质：同一鼓件的连续敲击不再逐次完全相同。** `DrumKitModels` 是 100% 合成，同一音乐位置产出的参数逐位相同，只有噪声读取偏移在变——一小节八次同力度闭合踩镲就是同一个 60ms 片段放八遍，而**加花力度也去不掉**，因为问题不在力度上。新增 `hitVariation(position)`：三个参数各取**独立的哈希盐**，音高 ±6 音分、音量 ±0.28dB、长度 ±4%。参数独立是有意的——一击同时更高更短更响会听成**另一面鼓**，恰好是这件事要避免的反面。键仍然只用**音乐位置**（不含时钟），所以现场引擎与离线导出必然一致，导出对齐不被破坏。
highlights.en: **Audio: repeated strokes of the same drum are no longer identical.** `DrumKitModels` is 100 % synthesis, so the same musical position produced bit-identical parameters with only the noise read offset changing — eight same-velocity closed hats in a bar were one 60 ms slice played eight times, and **no amount of velocity programming removes it**, because velocity is not where the problem lives. New `hitVariation(position)`: three parameters, each with its **own hash salt** — pitch ±6 cents, level ±0.28 dB, length ±4 %. The independence is intentional: a hit that is higher *and* shorter *and* louder reads as **a different drum**, the exact opposite of the goal. The key is still only the **musical position** (no clock), so the live engine and the offline exporter necessarily agree and export parity holds.

highlights.zh: **每一族都接通了**：底鼓、军鼓（808/909/acoustic/cyber 四支共用入口处一次计算）、踩镲（长度与音量；**不动滤波器中心**，那是「另一件乐器」而不是「另一击」），以及打击乐六族（在 `synthesizePercussion` 里对 `timbre` 与 `mult` 各折一次，所以 cowbell/clap/composite/membrane/metal/wood **全部覆盖**，包括没有噪声层可变的族）。测试既测纯函数性质（确定性、三边界、跨小节不复用、三参数不联动、非有限值防护），也测**接线**——纯函数正确但没人调用，正是本项目反复清理的「死配置」味道。
highlights.en: **Every family is wired**: kick, snare (computed once at the entry shared by the 808/909/acoustic/cyber branches), hi-hat (length and level; the **filter centre is deliberately left alone** — that would be a different instrument, not a different stroke), and all six percussion families (folded once into `timbre` and `mult` inside `synthesizePercussion`, so cowbell/clap/composite/membrane/metal/wood are **all covered**, including families with no noise layer to vary). Tests cover both the pure function (determinism, the three bounds, no reuse across bars, the parameters not moving in lockstep, non-finite guards) and the **wiring** — a correct pure function nobody calls is the dead-configuration smell this project keeps removing.

highlights.zh: **一处必须说清的边界**：所有鼓件函数的位置参数默认值都是 `0`，所以 `0` 必须表示「没有给定位置」，否则**每个从没要求过人性化的调用方**都会静默获得一个固定失谐，改动前那些「参数逐字不变」的基线也不再可复现。代价是每个 pattern 有**一击**不变（第一轨第 0 步）——单次敲击而非一段律动，是最便宜的一处损失，已在代码与文档写明。相应的 `percussionModels.test.ts` 基线也从「断言字面量 1.15」改为「按同一显式位置的 `decayScale` 反算，并断言与 1.15 的偏差 ≤ 0.65 × `HIT_VARIATION_MAX_DECAY`」。
highlights.en: **One boundary that has to be stated**: every drum voice defaults its position argument to `0`, so `0` must mean "no position supplied" — otherwise **every caller that never asked for humanisation** silently acquires a fixed detune and the pre-change exact-parameter baselines stop being reproducible. The cost is that **one hit per pattern** stays unvaried (track 0, step 0): a single stroke rather than a groove, the cheapest place to lose it, and it is written down in both the code and the docs. The matching `percussionModels.test.ts` baseline changed from asserting the literal 1.15 to deriving it from the `decayScale` at the same explicit position and asserting the deviation from 1.15 is ≤ 0.65 × `HIT_VARIATION_MAX_DECAY`.

title.zh: v2.0.72 文档引用门禁：文档声明的文件必须真的存在（7 处过期引用已修）
title.en: v2.0.72 A Documentation-Reference Gate: a File the Docs Claim Must Exist (Seven Stale Ones Fixed)

highlights.zh: **为什么文档在这里是承重的**：好几份文档是「这个设计为什么长这样」的唯一记录，而计划文档还负责写明**什么没做**。所以过期的文件引用是有害的——读者照着 `scripts/check_gs1.mjs` 去找，找不到，且**无法判断**它是从未建、被删除、还是被改名。手工一查找到 **7 处**。
highlights.en: **Why the docs here are load-bearing**: several are the only record of why a design is the way it is, and the plan document is also where "what is *not* done" lives. A stale file reference is therefore actively harmful — a reader follows `scripts/check_gs1.mjs` and finds nothing, and **cannot tell** whether it was never built, was deleted, or was renamed. A manual pass found **seven**.

highlights.zh: **已修正的引用**：① 门禁脚本真名是 `check-gs1.mjs`（连字符），文档写成了下划线——这是**唯一一处与可执行链路相关**的过期引用；② 更新记录的机制描述仍写着「编译进 bundle」，而它早已改成走网络的 `/version.json` + `/changelog.json`，被引用的那个模块也已不存在（已改写为实际机制，并保留当年那样做的理由与被取代的原因）；③ 一条测试覆盖的引用指向不存在的文件名（实际覆盖在另外两个文件里）；④ 计划表里一行「新 `…/SequencerStoreProvider.tsx`」被读成了断言，已明确标为计划。
highlights.en: **References corrected**: (1) the gate script is `check-gs1.mjs` (hyphen) and the doc wrote an underscore — the only stale reference tied to an executable path; (2) the release-notes mechanism was still described as "compiled into the bundle" when it has long since become `/version.json` + `/changelog.json` fetched over the network, and the module it named no longer exists (rewritten to the real mechanism, keeping both why it was done that way and why it was replaced); (3) a test-coverage reference named a file that does not exist, where the coverage actually lives in two other files; (4) a plan-table row reading "新 `…/SequencerStoreProvider.tsx`" was being read as a claim, and is now marked as the plan it is.

highlights.zh: **关键设计决定：不从散文里推断意图。** 计划文档本来就会提到尚未创建的文件，所以朴素检查会被误报淹没。我试了两次「按措辞判断这是不是计划」，**两次都是「失败开放」**：第一次按整行判断，于是同一行里另一个**过期**路径被顺带豁免；第二次把范围收到路径之前的从句，结果从句边界又把标记挤出范围，反而把真正的计划报成错误。两个方向都错，而**第一个是危险的那个**（过期引用可以搭上任何含「新增」二字的行）。因此现在：**缺失路径一律是问题**，除非它被显式登记在脚本的 `PROPOSED` 表里——登记是一条**可见的决定**而不是猜测，这也正是它能被复审的原因。当前登记 5 条，每条都写明「尚未建、现有实现是什么」。
highlights.en: **The design decision that matters: intent is not inferred from prose.** A plan document legitimately names files that do not exist yet, so a naive check drowns in false positives. I tried twice to decide "is this line a plan?" from its wording and **both attempts failed open**: line-wide, a planning word excused a *different*, stale path on the same line; scoped to the clause before the path, a clause boundary pushed the marker out of range and a genuine proposal was reported as broken. Both directions are wrong, and **the first is the dangerous one** — a stale reference can ride along on any line containing a planning word. So now: **a missing path is always a finding**, unless it is listed explicitly in the script's `PROPOSED` map, where the entry is a **visible decision** rather than a guess — which is also what makes the list reviewable. Five are listed, each stating that it is unbuilt and what exists instead.

highlights.zh: **门禁与红线**：`check:docs:refs` 接入 `verify`（红线 R6g 守住），扫描 21 份文档里的 **260 处**文件引用。已实测它会拦住新增的坏引用（往文档里塞一个不存在的路径 → 退出码 1 并指出是哪一行）。
highlights.en: **Gate and red line**: `check:docs:refs` is wired into `verify` (guarded by red line R6g) and checks **260** file references across 21 documents. Verified to catch a newly introduced broken one: appending a document line that names a nonexistent path makes it exit 1 and name the line.

title.zh: v2.0.71 抽出 useEffectsRack：效果器架的状态与撤销联动不再写在视图里
title.en: v2.0.71 Extracting useEffectsRack: the FX Rack's State and Undo Coupling Leave the View

highlights.zh: **为什么效果器架不是普通 `useState`**：每个消费方都接受一个 React setter，所以它必须留在 React state 里（否则所有调用点都要改）；但**它同时属于 pattern，必须进撤销栈**。以前没有这层联动时，Ctrl+Z 会把音符回滚而把效果改动留在原地——**半撤销比不能撤销更糟**，因为它看起来像是成功了。
highlights.en: **Why the FX rack is not a plain `useState`**: every consumer takes a React setter, so it has to stay in React state (or every call site changes) — but **it also lives inside the pattern, so it must be in the undo stack**. Before that coupling existed, Ctrl+Z rolled the notes back and left the FX change in place: a **half-undo, which is worse than no undo** because it looks like it worked.

highlights.zh: **两个隐患被收进 hook，不再散在调用点**：① **在 state updater 里提交是副作用**，而 React 可能把它跑两次（StrictMode），一次改动会压入两条历史——表现为「第一次 Ctrl+Z 好像没反应」。所以下一个值从 ref 计算，不在 updater 里提交。② **历史会在界面底下移动**：撤销/重做把另一个 rack 放回 store 时，本地状态必须跟随，否则面板显示旧 rack、下一次编辑从错误的基础上提交。同时，**没发生恢复时绝不能覆盖用户的本地编辑**——否则控件会在手指底下弹回去。
highlights.en: **Two hazards are handled inside the hook instead of at each call site**: (1) **committing from inside a state updater is a side effect React may run twice** (StrictMode double-invokes updaters), so one change could push two history entries — which presents as "the first Ctrl+Z did nothing". The next value is therefore computed from a ref, not committed inside the updater. (2) **History moves underneath the UI**: when a restore puts a different rack back in the store, the local state has to follow, or the panel shows the old rack and the next edit commits from the wrong base. Equally, a restore that *hasn't* happened must never overwrite a local edit, or the control snaps back under the user's finger.

highlights.zh: **测试钉住的是隐患，而不是「它能存一个值」**：一次改动只提交一次（用 updater 形式，正是过去危险的形状）；同一 tick 内的两次改动会**复合**而不是都从旧值出发；十次连续改动**只用一个历史键**（拖一次滑块 = 一次撤销）；历史恢复后界面跟随；以及**没有恢复时本地编辑必须存活**。
highlights.en: **The tests pin the hazards, not "it can store a value"**: one change commits once (passing an updater, which is the shape that used to be dangerous); two changes in one tick **compose** rather than both starting from the old value; ten consecutive changes use **one history key** (a slider drag is one undo step); the UI follows a restored rack; and a **local edit survives** when no restore happened.

highlights.zh: **视图又小了 21 行**（1175 → 1154），且这类「撤销与界面如何联动」的知识现在只写在一处、有测试覆盖——这正是三端复用所需要的：手机界面接上这个 hook 就得到同样的撤销语义，不需要重新推导那两条隐患。
highlights.en: **The view is 21 lines smaller** (1175 → 1154), and this kind of knowledge — how undo and the UI interact — now lives in one tested place, which is what the three surfaces need: a phone shell that mounts this hook gets the same undo semantics without re-deriving those two hazards.

title.zh: v2.0.70 滑动条不再吞掉整页滚动；步进网格的滚轮改为按主轴方向判断
title.en: v2.0.70 Sliders Stop Swallowing Page Scrolling, and the Step Grid's Wheel Handler Becomes Axis-Aware

highlights.zh: **`input[type=range]` 上的 `touch-action: none` 改成了 `pan-y`**。`none` 意味着**从滑动条上开始的任何手势都无法滚动页面**，而工作台里渲染了 **22 个**滑动条（每轨音量与声像、送出、Swing、速度、插入级、调音台），这些「手势死区」因此铺满整个界面——这正是「页面某些区域双指滚动失效」的形状。这是本次唯一确定能解释该症状的规则。
highlights.en: **`touch-action: none` on `input[type=range]` became `pan-y`.** `none` meant that **any gesture starting over a slider could not pan the page at all**, and the studio renders **22** of them (per-track volume and pan, sends, swing, tempo, insert stages, mixer), so those gesture dead zones were spread across the whole surface — which is exactly the shape of "two-finger scrolling stops working over parts of the page". This is the one rule found that genuinely explains that symptom.

highlights.zh: **方向说明（重要，我不想含糊过去）**：你反馈探针五屏都能滚，我据此判断**样式表整体不是元凶**，并用 `scripts/diagnose_page_scroll.mjs` 独立验证：把构建后的样式表按族剥离（全部 / 去掉 touch-action / 去掉 overscroll / 两者都去掉 / 去掉 position:fixed）分别加载真实应用，**每一族都可滚动**（`scrollHeight=1417 > clientHeight=900`，`scrollTo(200)` 生效）。所以滑动条这条是在**修一个真实但可能不是你所遇症状主因**的缺陷——请刷新后确认是否还有问题。
highlights.en: **A direction note, because I do not want to be vague about it**: your probe scrolling in all five panes is what tells me the stylesheet as a whole is not the culprit, and I verified that independently with `scripts/diagnose_page_scroll.mjs` — loading the real app with the built stylesheet stripped by family (all / without touch-action / without overscroll / without both / without `position: fixed`) scrolls in **every** variant (`scrollHeight=1417 > clientHeight=900`, `scrollTo(200)` takes effect). So the slider rule fixes a **real defect that may not be the main cause of what you saw** — please refresh and tell me whether it persists.

highlights.zh: **步进网格的滚轮按你建议改成主轴判断**：原来是 `if (e.shiftKey && e.deltaY !== 0) preventDefault()`——对鼠标滚轮+Shift 是对的，但**对触控板完全失明**（两指横滑是 `deltaX` 为主、没有修饰键）。现在：横向位移占优 → 平移网格（不需要 Shift）；纵向占优 → **交给浏览器**，让页面继续滚；网格已经滚到头 → **不拦**。反过来「只要 `deltaY !== 0` 就拦」正是网格吞掉整页纵向滚动的写法，两个方向都有测试钉住。
highlights.en: **The step grid's wheel handler is axis-aware, as you suggested**: it was `if (e.shiftKey && e.deltaY !== 0) preventDefault()` — right for a mouse wheel with Shift, and **blind to a trackpad**, whose two-finger swipe arrives as `deltaX` with no modifier. Now: horizontal-dominant pans the grid without needing Shift; vertical-dominant is **left to the browser** so the page keeps scrolling; and a grid already scrolled to its end **does not intercept at all**. The mirror-image mistake — intercepting on `deltaY !== 0` alone — is what makes a grid swallow the page's vertical scroll, so both directions are pinned by tests.

highlights.zh: **新增 `scripts/diagnose_page_scroll.mjs`**：对构建产物按 CSS 规则族剥离后加载真实应用，报告页面是否可滚动。它的价值是**能得出「不是样式表」这个结论**，而不必靠猜——这正是本次需要的。
highlights.en: **New `scripts/diagnose_page_scroll.mjs`**: it loads the real app with the built stylesheet stripped by rule family and reports whether the page scrolls. Its value is being able to reach the conclusion *"it is not the stylesheet"* without guessing, which is what this needed.

highlights.zh: **顺带**：删掉了探针页里一个 `isTouchRule` 死代码（我自己写的），并让 `check:css` 继续守住样式表里无人引用的规则。
highlights.en: **Also**: removed a dead `isTouchRule` helper I had left in the probe script, and `check:css` continues to guard the stylesheet against unreferenced rules.

title.zh: v2.0.69 domain 不再指名 feature：自定义曲风解析改为注入，分层门禁的容忍表清零
title.en: v2.0.69 The Domain Stops Naming a Feature: Custom-Genre Resolution Is Injected, and the Tolerance Table Is Empty

highlights.zh: **还清分层门禁最后一笔债**：`src/data/index/loader.ts` 直接 import `features/customGenre` 的 `getCustomGenre`——数据层因此「指名」了一个功能模块。这个依赖是真的（自定义曲风确实存在创建它的那个功能里），但**方向反了**。现在 loader 暴露 `setCustomGenreResolver`，由 `src/app/installCustomGenreResolver.ts` 在启动时回答它。`src/data` 不再知道任何 feature 的存在。
highlights.en: **The layer gate's last debt is paid**: `src/data/index/loader.ts` imported `getCustomGenre` straight out of `features/customGenre`, so the data layer *named* a feature module. The dependency is real — custom genres are stored with the feature that creates them — but it pointed the wrong way. The loader now exposes `setCustomGenreResolver`, and `src/app/installCustomGenreResolver.ts` answers it at startup. `src/data` no longer knows any feature exists.

highlights.zh: **容忍表清零，并用红线 R6f 守住「必须为空」**：那张表存在的意义是让「真实但暂时无法反转的依赖」被**写明修法**地声明出来，而不是静默破坏门禁。但它一旦变成停车场就会变成坟场——两笔债既已还清，现在非空即失败。同时验证过门禁本身仍然会拦住新增违规（把旧 import 加回去，`check:layers` 退出码 1）。
highlights.en: **The tolerance table is empty, and red line R6f keeps it that way.** The table exists so a real dependency that cannot yet be inverted is declared *with its fix* rather than silently breaking the gate — but a parking space becomes a graveyard. Both entries are paid, so it now fails if non-empty. The gate itself was also verified to still catch a new violation: re-adding the old import makes `check:layers` exit 1.

highlights.zh: **反转依赖会引入一个新的静默失败方式**：如果没人回答 loader 的问题，用户保存的自定义曲风就**解析不出来**——在用户看来是「我的曲风不见了」。所以行为在两个方向都被测试钉住：没有 resolver 时返回 null（而不是抛错，抛错会让整个曲风加载失败）；装了 resolver 时正常解析；内置曲风**不会去问 resolver**（这保证常见路径零开销）；resolver 抛错时（IndexedDB 被禁用）退化为「这个自定义曲风不存在」，而不是「所有曲风都加载不了」。
highlights.en: **Inverting a dependency introduces a new way to fail silently**: if nobody answers the loader's question, a user's saved custom genre stops resolving — which looks to them like their genre has vanished. So the behaviour is pinned in both directions: no resolver returns null rather than throwing (a throw would fail the whole genre load); an installed resolver resolves; built-in genres never consult the resolver, which keeps the common path free; and a resolver that throws (IndexedDB blocked) degrades to "this custom genre is absent", not to "no genre loads at all".

highlights.zh: **顺带抓到一个真实缺陷**：`loadGenre` 的缓存**从来没有失效机制**。这对内置曲风无所谓（它们的分包在页面生命周期内不变），但对**唯一会在运行期变化的类别**——用户刚编辑或删除的自定义曲风——是错的：保存后重新打开会拿到编辑**之前**的对象，用户看到的是「我的修改没保存」。已加 `invalidateGenreCache(id?)` 并在保存路径上调用，测试同时钉住「不失效就会读到旧值」与「失效后读到新值」。
highlights.en: **A real defect caught on the way**: `loadGenre`'s cache had **no eviction at all**. That is fine for the built-in library, whose chunks are immutable for the life of the page, but wrong for the one category that changes while the app runs — a custom genre the user just edited or deleted. Saving and reopening returned the *pre-edit* object, so the change looked unsaved. `invalidateGenreCache(id?)` now exists and the save path calls it; the test pins both that the stale value is served without invalidation and the fresh one with it.

title.zh: v2.0.68 死 CSS 清查：7 条无人引用的规则被删，并加了守门脚本
title.en: v2.0.68 Dead-CSS Sweep: Seven Unreferenced Rules Deleted, and a Gate to Keep It That Way

highlights.zh: **为什么值得做**：`.landscape-compact-bar` 在样式表里躺了五条 `!important` 规则，**没有任何地方引用它**——包括把按钮压到 28px（低于手机端统一的 44px 下限）。它能活下来是因为**死 CSS 是不可见的**：不报错、不警告，下一个人读它只会当成意图。它是改旁边的代码时偶然发现的，那不是流程。
highlights.en: **Why this was worth doing**: `.landscape-compact-bar` sat in the stylesheet as five `!important` rules that **nothing referenced** — including forcing buttons to 28px, below the 44px minimum the phone shell standardised on. It survived because **dead CSS is invisible**: nothing fails, nothing warns, and the next reader takes it for intent. It was found by accident while editing nearby code, which is not a process.

highlights.zh: **新增 `check:css` 门禁**（已接入 `verify`，红线 R6e 守住）：扫描 `src/index.css` 的类选择器，逐个在整棵源码树里找引用。**判断方向刻意保守**——引用检测是子串搜索而不是解析 `className`，因为类名常由片段拼出（`"track-row-" + idx`）。子串搜索偏向「有引用」：**漏掉一条死规则没有代价，删掉一条活规则是视觉回归**。
highlights.en: **New `check:css` gate** (wired into `verify`, guarded by red line R6e): it enumerates the class selectors in `src/index.css` and looks for each one anywhere in the source tree. **The reference test errs deliberately towards "live"** — it is a substring search rather than a `className` parse, because class names are frequently assembled from fragments (`"track-row-" + idx`). A missed dead rule costs nothing; deleting a live one is a visual regression.

highlights.zh: **删掉 7 条**：`.animate-spawn`（连同它专属的 `@keyframes spawn`）、`.touch-action-pan-x` / `.touch-action-pan-y`、四个安全区辅助类（`.safe-pt` / `.safe-pl` / `.safe-pr` / `.bottom-safe`）以及 `.landscape-compact-header`。留下的 `.animate-pulse-glow` / `.animate-orbit` 登记为**刻意保留**：它们是 reduced-motion 守卫选择器表里的冗余分支，删掉会削弱一项可访问性保证，而保留一个永不匹配的分支没有代价。
highlights.en: **Seven deleted**: `.animate-spawn` (with its only consumer, `@keyframes spawn`), `.touch-action-pan-x` / `.touch-action-pan-y`, four safe-area helpers (`.safe-pt` / `.safe-pl` / `.safe-pr` / `.bottom-safe`) and `.landscape-compact-header`. The two that stay — `.animate-pulse-glow` / `.animate-orbit` — are declared **intentional**: they are redundant arms of the reduced-motion guard's selector list, and pruning them would weaken an accessibility guarantee while a never-matching arm costs nothing.

highlights.zh: **顺手修掉扫脚本自己的两个 bug**（都由新测试钉住）：① 它**不剥注释**，于是「说明某条规则已被删除」的注释会被当成引用——它自己的说明文字恰好压制了它自己的发现；② 行号计算用了包含前一个 `}` 的偏移，**每一条报告的行号都是错的**，而且选择器正则排除了 `}`，所以 `@media (prefers-reduced-motion) { … }` **里的规则完全看不见**。已改为按深度扫描的解析器。
highlights.en: **Two bugs in the sweep itself, fixed** (both pinned by new tests): (1) it **did not strip comments**, so a note saying a rule had been deleted counted as a reference — its own explanation suppressed its own finding; (2) line numbers came from an offset that included the preceding `}`, so **every reported line was wrong**, and its selector regex excluded `}` so rules **inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion) { … }` were invisible**. Both replaced by a depth-aware scanner.

highlights.zh: **校验过解析器没有漏报**：我把它的结果与一次独立提取做了对账——它多出的 6 个（`is-flashing`、`meter-seg`、`pb-safe`、`playhead-active`、`reduced-motion`、`sticky`）**全部是真选择器**，只是不在行首所以行首 grep 抓不到。所以最初报告的 39 个是旧正则的虚高，正确的枚举是 28 个。删除后实测三处几何**逐像素不变**（步进格密度三档、底栏合并、冻结列对齐）。
highlights.en: **Verified the parser does not under-report**: I reconciled its output against an independent extraction — its six extras (`is-flashing`, `meter-seg`, `pb-safe`, `playhead-active`, `reduced-motion`, `sticky`) are **all real selectors**, just not at the start of a line so a line-anchored grep misses them. The earlier count of 39 was the old regex inflating the enumeration; 28 is correct. After deleting, three geometry diagnostics measured **pixel-for-pixel unchanged** (step-cell density across three tiers, the merged bottom row, and the frozen-column alignment).

highlights.zh: **顺带**：`check:css` 通过 `vite-node` 运行，因为它 import 的是 `src/utils/cssUsage.ts` —— **测试覆盖的那段代码就是实际运行的那段**，而不是脚本里另写一份。
highlights.en: **Also**: `check:css` runs under `vite-node` because it imports `src/utils/cssUsage.ts`, so **the code the tests cover is the code that runs**, rather than a second copy inside the script.

title.zh: v2.0.67 修掉点版本号就崩：未知发布分类不再把更新面板打进错误边界
title.en: v2.0.67 Fixing the Crash on Clicking the Version: an Unknown Release Category No Longer Kills the Updates Panel

highlights.zh: **用户报的崩溃**：点版本号弹「应用遇到未知错误」，诊断信息是 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'classes')`。根因是更新面板的分类徽章用了一个 `switch`，只处理 `feature` / `audio` / `fix` 且**没有 `default`**，于是未知分类返回 `undefined`，渲染时读 `.classes` 直接抛错，整个面板进错误边界。
highlights.en: **The reported crash**: clicking the version number raised "the app hit an unknown error", with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'classes')`. The cause is that the updates panel's category badge was a `switch` handling only `feature` / `audio` / `fix` with **no `default`**, so an unrecognised category returned `undefined` and the render threw while reading `.classes`, sending the panel to the error boundary.

highlights.zh: **而这个分类是我自己加出来的**：`ChangelogEntry["category"]` 被写成一个封闭联合（只有三种），但归档是**从网络取回的 JSON**——TypeScript 管不到运行时。我在最近几个版本里写了 `category: "refactor"`，类型看着「不可能出问题」，运行时却真的出问题了。**类型是对编辑者的承诺，不是对运行时的保证。**
highlights.en: **And that category was one I introduced**: `ChangelogEntry["category"]` was written as a closed union of three, but the archive is **JSON fetched from the network** — TypeScript cannot vouch for runtime data. I had been writing `category: "refactor"` in recent releases, so the type made the bug *look* impossible while the runtime disagreed. **A type is a promise to the editor, not a guarantee about the runtime.**

highlights.zh: **两层修**：① 数据层加 `normalizeChangelogCategory()`——未知分类**归一**为已知分类，并在 `mergeChangelog` 接受的每一条上应用，因此没有任何一条会带着 UI 渲染不了的分类走到徽章查询；② 界面层把 `switch` 换成**按联合类型索引的 record**，缺一个分支就是**类型错误**而不是运行时崩溃——这正是无 `default` 的 `switch` 从来没有的检查。同时为 `refactor` / `docs` 补上中英文案与徽章样式。
highlights.en: **Fixed at both levels**: (1) a data-level `normalizeChangelogCategory()` maps an unknown category onto a known one, applied to everything `mergeChangelog` accepts, so no entry reaches a badge lookup with a category the UI cannot render; (2) the UI's `switch` became a **record keyed by the union**, so a missing arm is a **type error** instead of a runtime crash — the check a `switch` without a `default` never had. `refactor` and `docs` also gained labels and badge styles.

highlights.zh: **测试用真实的归档文件，而不是 fixture**：新增的守卫读 `public/changelog.json`，断言其中每一个分类都在 `CHANGELOG_CATEGORIES` 里。这条断言**在发布那一刻就会失败**，而不是等到用户点开面板——因为出问题的正是一次**数据**改动，用 fixture 写测试只会一直绿而线上已经崩了。已实测：把联合改回三种，这条立刻红并指名 `refactor`。
highlights.en: **The test reads the real archive rather than a fixture**: the new guard asserts that every category in `public/changelog.json` is one `CHANGELOG_CATEGORIES` names, so it fails **at the moment of the release** instead of in a user's browser. That matters because the defect was a **data** change — a fixture-based test would have stayed green while production broke. Verified by reverting the union to three: the guard goes red and names `refactor`.

highlights.zh: **另一条（macOS Chrome 双指无法滚动）我暂时无法复现，因此没有盲改，而是做了一个定位页**：在本环境里用合成滚轮事件测不出问题——事件正常送达、`defaultPrevented` 为 false、没有任何 handler 取消它、文档高 1433px 而视口 800px、`window.scrollTo(0,300)` 也能滚动。也就是说这里的页面**是可滚动的**，剩下的解释只可能是 macOS/Chrome 手势相关，只能在出问题的机器上二分。`npm run probe:scroll` 会起一个页面，把候选规则**逐屏**应用（基线 → 根 `overscroll-behavior` → 控件 `touch-action` → 仅 `touch-action` → 对照组），**第一屏滚不动的那一屏的标签就是元凶**，并在 console 打印记录。
highlights.en: **The other report — two-finger scrolling failing on macOS Chrome — I could not reproduce, so rather than change things blind I built a bisection page.** Synthetic wheel events here cannot show the fault: the event reaches the element under the cursor, `defaultPrevented` is false, no handler cancels it, the document is 1433px tall in an 800px viewport, and `window.scrollTo(0, 300)` moves it. The page **is** scrollable in this environment, so the remaining explanations are macOS/Chrome-gesture specific and can only be bisected on the machine that shows the problem. `npm run probe:scroll` serves a page that applies the candidate rules **one pane at a time** (baseline → root `overscroll-behavior` → control `touch-action` → `touch-action` only → control), and **the first pane that will not scroll names the culprit**. It also logs each stalled wheel to the console.

highlights.zh: **顺带**：把 `useAuditionPreview` 也抽了出来（试听单音/整和弦/单轨隔离播放），这是 `StudioView` 解耦的继续——那 70 行是音频行为，且编码了四个容易写错的判断（和弦轨要整和弦、隔离播放要让出全局走带、停止只停自己启动的、卸载时要清掉试听范围）。
highlights.en: **Also**: `useAuditionPreview` is extracted (single-note audition, whole-voicing preview, isolated lane playback), continuing the `StudioView` decoupling — those ~70 lines are audio behaviour and encode four decisions that are easy to get subtly wrong: a chords track needs the voicing, an isolated preview yields the transport, stopping only stops what the preview started, and the scope is cleared on unmount.

title.zh: v2.0.66 抽出 useAudioEngineInstance：五个视图不再各自手写引擎生命周期
title.en: v2.0.66 Extracting useAudioEngineInstance: Five Views Stop Hand-Rolling the Engine Lifecycle

highlights.zh:
**实测到的重复**：**五个视图**各自手写同样三行——构造 `new AudioEngine({...})`、挂到 ref、在 effect 的 cleanup 里销毁。其中三个还必须小心保持那个 effect 的依赖列表稳定。

**根因是一处 API 不对称**：`onPlay` / `onStop` 都有 setter，但 **`onStep` 只能在构造函数里设置**。于是「回调捕获了会变的状态」就会逼出**整个引擎重建**——而重建会丢掉所有已排期的声部，并在会话中途重新分配音频图。已补上 `setOnStep`，让回调可以保鲜而不重建。
highlights.en:
**The duplication, measured**: **five views** each wrote the same three lines — construct `new AudioEngine({...})`, assign to a ref, destroy in the effect's cleanup — and three of them had to keep that effect's dependency list carefully stable.

The root cause was one API asymmetry: `onPlay` and `onStop` had setters but **`onStep` could only be set in the constructor**. So a callback that captured changing state forced a **full engine rebuild**, which drops every scheduled voice and re-allocates the audio graph mid-session. `setOnStep` now exists, so a callback can be kept current without rebuilding.

highlights.zh: **新基元 `useAudioEngineInstance`**：一个组件一个引擎，创建与销毁由它负责；回调通过 ref **保鲜而非捕获**，所以闭包可以自由地引用最新状态；`engineRef` 保持同步，因此命令式调用点（走带按钮、试听范围、控制台的增益衰减表）行为完全不变。刻意**不**做成通用音序器——它不持有 pattern、走带或任何状态，那些属于 `useAudioEngineLifecycle`；这一层是更简单的界面（试听、预览、游戏化视图）或未来的新界面可以直接用的原语。
highlights.en: **The new primitive, `useAudioEngineInstance`**: one engine per mount, with creation and teardown owned by the hook; callbacks are kept current through a ref rather than captured, so closures may freely reference the latest state; and `engineRef` stays in sync so imperative callers — transport buttons, preview scopes, the console's gain-reduction meter — behave exactly as before. Deliberately **not** a general sequencer: it holds no pattern, transport or state, which is `useAudioEngineLifecycle`'s job. This is the primitive a simpler surface (an audition, a preview, a game view) or a future surface can use directly.

highlights.zh: **两个视图已迁移**（`CustomGenreMakerView`、`GenreDetailView`）：删掉了各自的 ref 声明、构造 effect 与销毁 cleanup；`GenreDetailView` 的 effect 只保留「确实与曲风有关」的部分（写入 pattern、BPM 与输入框），曲风切换不再伴随任何引擎账务。`CustomGenreMakerView` 失去了对 `AudioEngine` 的直接依赖。
highlights.en: **Two views migrated** (`CustomGenreMakerView`, `GenreDetailView`): each lost its own ref declaration, construction effect and destroy cleanup, and `GenreDetailView`'s effect now keeps only the part that is genuinely about the genre — seeding the pattern, the bpm and the input field — so a genre change no longer involves any engine bookkeeping. `CustomGenreMakerView` no longer depends on `AudioEngine` at all.

highlights.zh: **一处刻意不迁移并说明**：`ChallengeView` **每换一题就销毁并新建引擎**，并且在 `play()` 前不主动初始化音频上下文（依赖播放路径自身的惰性解锁）。改成复用单实例会**改变它的音频行为**，所以保留原样并写进架构文档——不为了「统一」去动它。这正是改架构时该有的克制：能证明行为不变才改。
highlights.en: **One place deliberately left alone, with the reason**: `ChallengeView` **destroys and rebuilds its engine on every question** and does not initialise the audio context before `play()` — it relies on the playback path's own lazy unlock. Reusing a single instance would **change its audio behaviour**, so it stays as it is and the reason is written into the architecture document. That restraint is the point when changing architecture: move something only when the behaviour can be shown to be unchanged.

highlights.zh: **测试**：新增 7 项，锁住三件手写版本曾经做错的事——① 每次挂载**恰好一个**引擎且卸载时被销毁（防的是每导航一次泄漏一个 `AudioContext`）；② 回调身份变化时**不重建**引擎，且调用的是**最新**闭包而不是构造时捕获的那个；③ **先 `stop()` 再 `destroy()`**，不让仍在走带的传输指望图拆卸来静音。另有一项断言未提供的回调保持 `undefined`，而不是用空函数填充——那会让「这个视图不处理 onPlay」与「处理了但什么都不做」变得无法区分。
highlights.en: **Tests**: seven new ones pinning the three things the hand-rolled versions got wrong somewhere — (1) exactly **one** engine per mount, destroyed on unmount (the leak it prevents is a live `AudioContext` per navigation); (2) changing a callback's identity does **not** rebuild the engine, and the invocation reaches the **latest** closure rather than the one captured at construction; (3) **`stop()` before `destroy()`**, so a still-running transport is not relying on graph teardown to silence it. One more asserts an unsupplied callback stays `undefined` rather than being filled with a no-op, which would make "this view does not handle onPlay" indistinguishable from "it handles it and does nothing".

title.zh: v2.0.65 抽出 usePanelVisibility：面板可见性与持久化不再长在视图里
title.en: v2.0.65 Extracting usePanelVisibility: Panel Visibility and Persistence Leave the View

highlights.zh: **为什么抽这一块**：实测 `StudioView` 有 **1255 行**，其中十二个 `useState`（侧栏折叠、最大化、力度抽屉、钢琴卷帘、欧几里得、频谱、高级控件、跟随播放头…）加上一段持久化 effect 直接写在视图里。这些状态**不是某个视图的私事**：三套界面都需要同样这十几个状态、同样的默认值、同样的持久化；新界面要么抄一遍这段 effect，要么（对用户更糟）忘了抄而每次刷新丢布局。
highlights.en: **Why this block**: `StudioView` measured **1255 lines**, with twelve `useState`s (sidebar, maximize, velocity drawer, piano roll, Euclidean, analyzer, advanced controls, playhead follow…) plus a persistence effect written straight into the view. That state is **not a view's private business**: all three surfaces need the same dozen values, the same defaults and the same persistence, so a new surface either copies the effect or — worse for the user — forgets to and loses its layout on every refresh.

highlights.zh: **逐字抽出，行为不变**：默认值仍是**挂载时读一次**（每次渲染重读会让过期或失败的存储读取覆盖用户刚点的东西——原注释专门写明这一点），持久化字段仍是那七个，`velocityActiveTrackIdx` / `pianoRollTrackIdx` **仍不持久化**（它们是光标不是布局）。
highlights.en: **Extracted verbatim**: defaults are still read **once on mount** (re-reading each render would let a stale or failing storage read overwrite what the user just clicked — the original comment called this out), the persisted set is still the same seven fields, and `velocityActiveTrackIdx` / `pianoRollTrackIdx` are still **not** persisted because they are cursors rather than layout.

highlights.zh: **D-06 规则有测试守着**：`isDrumsOnly` / `isRecordArmed` / `isKeyboardMode` 属于现场演奏状态，**不得**被持久化——静默重新武装录音机是个（可能具破坏性的）意外。新测试断言的是**存储里的实际形状**而不是读那段 effect，所以任何字段偷偷出现在存储里都会被发现。
highlights.en: **The D-06 rule is now asserted**: `isDrumsOnly`, `isRecordArmed` and `isKeyboardMode` are live-performance state and must **not** be persisted — silently re-arming the recorder is a surprise, possibly a destructive one. The test asserts the **actual stored shape** rather than reading the effect, so a field that quietly appeared in storage would be caught.

highlights.zh: **测试跟着行为走，而不是钉住文件位置**：`layoutPrefs.test.ts` 里有四条断言原本读 `StudioView.tsx` 的**源码文本**来证明「模块真的被接线了」。抽出之后它们必然失败——但这正是抽出的目的。已迁移为：**接线属于 hook，而 `StudioView` 必须真的挂载这个 hook**。最后一条是关键的一半：把行为搬进一个测试齐全的 hook 然后忘了调用它，是文件级守卫看不见的失败模式（hook 自己的测试全绿，应用却彻底失去持久化）。
highlights.en: **The tests follow the behaviour instead of pinning the file**: four assertions in `layoutPrefs.test.ts` read `StudioView.tsx`'s **source text** to prove the module was actually wired. Extraction necessarily breaks them — which is the point of extracting. They now assert that **the hook owns the wiring and `StudioView` really mounts it**. That last half is the important one: moving behaviour into a well-tested hook and then forgetting to call it is the failure mode a file-level guard cannot see — the hook's own tests stay green while the app loses persistence entirely.

highlights.zh: **顺带确认**：分层门禁保持全绿（无新增违规），PC 三个浏览器目标全过，单元测试 1873 项。
highlights.en: **Also confirmed**: the layering gate stays green with no new violations, the three desktop browser targets pass, and the unit suite is at 1873 tests.

title.zh: v2.0.64 三端架构起步：功能层与界面层解耦，并加分层门禁守住它
title.en: v2.0.64 Starting the Three-Surface Architecture: Decoupling Logic from Presentation, With a Gate to Keep It

highlights.zh: **为什么现在做**：手机端 UI/交互/功能将重做，三端将来会有不同界面、不同交互、甚至不同功能集合（PC 最全）。这只有在**功能层不依赖任何一种界面的形状**时才做得起——否则三端就是一个程序加三套皮肤，每个功能都要写三遍。
highlights.en: **Why now**: the phone UI, interactions and features are being redesigned, and the three surfaces will end up with different interfaces, interactions and even different feature sets (PC fullest). That is only affordable if the logic layer does not depend on any one interface's shape — otherwise the three surfaces are one program with three skins, and every feature costs three times.

highlights.zh: **先说好消息（实测）**：`src/features/` 与 `src/hooks/` **原本已经没有任何文件 import React 组件**。底子比预想的好得多，所以本轮不是大重构，而是把仅剩的几处耦合清掉并把边界固定下来。
highlights.en: **First, the good news (measured)**: `src/features/` and `src/hooks/` **already contained no imports of React components at all**. The foundation was far better than expected, so this was not a large refactor — just clearing the few remaining couplings and pinning the boundary.

highlights.zh: **清掉的耦合**：① `announcer`（屏幕阅读器播报服务）原先定义在 `src/ui/AriaLiveRegion.tsx` 里——**一个 `.tsx`**，于是走带与曲风试听的 hook 为了播报一句话要 import 一个 React 组件。它本质是**事件**不是视图，已移到 `src/platform/announcer.ts`：logic 负责发布，哪个界面在挂载就由哪个界面决定怎么显示。② `NavTab` 从 `components/Header.tsx` 移到 `app/navigation.ts`（「应用有哪些目的地」不是 Header 的 props 形状，domain 的教程数据与 logic 的快捷键 hook 都在用它）。③ `ParameterDimension` / `GenreRailItem` / `UnsavedDecision` 三个类型原来都定义在组件里、被 logic 反向 import，现已回到 `src/features/sequencer/` 的归属地；组件仍 re-export 以兼容既有引用。
highlights.en: **The couplings removed**: (1) `announcer` (the screen-reader announcement service) was defined inside `src/ui/AriaLiveRegion.tsx` — a `.tsx` — so the transport and genre-audition hooks imported a React component just to announce a sentence. It is an *event*, not a view, so it moved to `src/platform/announcer.ts`: logic publishes, and whichever view is mounted decides how to show it. (2) `NavTab` moved from `components/Header.tsx` to `app/navigation.ts` — "which destinations the app has" is not the header's prop shape, and both the domain's tutorial data and a logic shortcut hook needed it. (3) `ParameterDimension`, `GenreRailItem` and `UnsavedDecision` were defined inside components and imported back by logic; each now lives where its meaning does, under `src/features/sequencer/`, with the components re-exporting for compatibility.

highlights.zh: **分层门禁**：新增 `scripts/check_layers.mjs` 并接入 `verify`。四层 `domain / platform / logic / ui`（`src/utils` 单列，因为触感/PWA/遥测是平台包装而不是产品行为）。规则：domain 不得 import logic 或 ui；**logic 不得 import 组件，也不得自己判断设备类型**（要作为参数传入）；ui 可以 import 下面任何一层。只对**新增**违规失败，已存在的登记在 `ALLOW` 里并写明原因与正确修法——所以这张表只会变短。
highlights.en: **A layering gate**: `scripts/check_layers.mjs` is new and wired into `verify`. Four layers — `domain / platform / logic / ui` (`src/utils` is separate, because haptics/PWA/telemetry are platform wrappers rather than product behaviour). Rules: domain may not import logic or ui; **logic may not import a component and may not decide behaviour by asking what device it is on** (that arrives as an argument); ui may import anything below. Only *new* violations fail; existing ones are declared in `ALLOW` with a reason and the correct fix, so the list can only get shorter.

highlights.zh: **一条可检验的判据**（写进新文档 `ARCHITECTURE_SURFACES.md`）：**如果删掉某一端的整个目录，`src/features` 与 `src/audio` 应该仍然能编译通过。** 文档还给了「想知道是不是手机」的正例与反例：产品决策（手机该少一个按钮）属于界面，与设备无关的行为（按播放要先解锁音频）属于 logic。
highlights.en: **A checkable criterion**, written into the new `ARCHITECTURE_SURFACES.md`: **delete an entire surface's directory and `src/features` and `src/audio` should still compile.** The document also gives the worked example for "am I on a phone": a product decision (the phone should have one fewer button) belongs to the interface, while device-independent behaviour (playing must unlock audio first) belongs to logic.

highlights.zh: **测试范围按你的要求临时缩小（刻意、可逆、有守卫）**：`verify` 里的 E2E 只跑 **PC 三个浏览器**；`npm run test:e2e:all` 仍跑全部 7 个目标，`test:e2e:mobile` 只跑手机与 iPad。矩阵定义**完整保留**，并由新增红线 **R6c** 守住：删掉任何手机/iPad 目标、或改掉 `test:e2e:all` 都会让红线失败。新界面落地后把 `test:e2e` 改回 `E2E_PROFILE=all` 即可恢复全量门禁。
highlights.en: **The test scope is temporarily narrowed as you asked — deliberately, reversibly, and guarded**: E2E in `verify` runs only the **three desktop browsers**; `npm run test:e2e:all` still runs all seven targets and `test:e2e:mobile` runs only phone and tablet. The matrix definition is **fully preserved**, guarded by a new red line **R6c**: deleting any phone/iPad target or changing `test:e2e:all` fails it. When the new interface lands, pointing `test:e2e` back at `E2E_PROFILE=all` restores the full gate.

highlights.zh: **顺带修掉一处既有缺陷**：跑部分目标时，汇总信息原本**硬编码**「ALL 7 BROWSER & DEVICE TARGETS PASSED」——也就是只跑了 3 个却宣称 7 个全过。这类「日志说谎」正是本项目一直在清理的问题，现在按实际数目报并提示全量命令。
highlights.en: **Also fixed a pre-existing defect**: on a partial run the summary was **hardcoded** to "ALL 7 BROWSER & DEVICE TARGETS PASSED" — three targets ran and the log claimed all seven. A lying log is exactly the class of problem this project keeps removing; it now reports the real count and names the full-matrix command.

title.zh: v2.0.63 管风琴有了真正的音栓：波表合成（createPeriodicWave）落地
title.en: v2.0.63 The Organs Get Real Drawbars: Wavetable Synthesis via createPeriodicWave

highlights.zh: **为什么先做管风琴**：它们是全库里「机制上做不到」最清楚的例子——哈蒙德管风琴的音色是**在选定音栓长度上的纯分音之和**，而任何内置波形的组合都逼近不了它。所以两个管风琴此前一直是「方波 + 正弦」：方波的分音按 1/n 衰减，既暗得多、又是**错的级数**；那个正弦是为了暗示它根本产生不出来的高音栓。听感因此是「合成器管风琴」，不是音栓乐器。
highlights.en: **Why the organs first**: they are the clearest case in the library of something the engine *could not do*. A Hammond's tone is a sum of **pure partials at chosen footages**, and no combination of the built-in waveforms approximates it — so both organ presets were a square plus a sine: a square's partials fall off as 1/n, which is both far too dark and the wrong *series*, and the sine was there to suggest upper drawbars it could not actually produce. The result read as a synth organ, not a drawbar instrument.

highlights.zh: **新机制**：预设可声明 `harmonics`（0 基分音幅度），第一个振荡器改用 `createPeriodicWave` 构建，`osc1Type` 只在声明时被覆盖。系数由**纯函数** `periodicWaveCoefficients()` 生成，用**正弦级数**（`real` 全零）——音栓是用「长度 + 幅度」描述的，不是相位关系，正弦级数让波形与任意相位选择无关。
highlights.en: **The new mechanism**: a preset may declare `harmonics` (0-based partial amplitudes), and the first oscillator is then built with `createPeriodicWave`, overriding `osc1Type` only when declared. The coefficients come from a **pure function**, `periodicWaveCoefficients()`, as a **sine** series (`real` all zero) — a drawbar is described by footage and amplitude, not by a phase relationship, and a sine series makes the waveform independent of an arbitrary phase choice.

highlights.zh: **归一化按「分音幅度之和」，不按采样峰值**：和是波形峰值的**严格上界**，一次遍历即精确，且无论分音如何都保证不超过 1。按真实峰值归一需要一次采样，而采样分辨率会随分音数量变化——那是实时图与离线图产生分歧的无谓来源。这条取舍写进了函数注释。
highlights.en: **Normalisation is by the sum of the partial amplitudes, not by the sampled peak**: the sum is a strict upper bound on the waveform's peak, it is exact in one pass, and it guarantees the result never exceeds unity whatever the partials are. Peak normalisation would need a sampling pass whose resolution varies with the number of partials — a needless source of disagreement between the realtime and offline graphs. The trade-off is in the function's comment.

highlights.zh: **逐位不变保证**：未声明 `harmonics` 的 **49 个预设不创建任何 periodic wave**，`osc1Type` 照旧，因此逐位不变、已提交基线对它们仍然有效。测试对全库断言这一点（遍历所有未声明的预设，断言 `periodicWave === null` 且 `type` 仍是自己的 `osc1Type`），另有一条断言「只有这两个预设声明了音栓」——音栓是每个预设的**刻意选择**，不是可以到处铺开的默认值。
highlights.en: **Bit-for-bit guarantee for everything else**: the **49 presets that declare no `harmonics` build no periodic wave at all** and keep `osc1Type`, so they render identically and the committed baselines stay meaningful for them. The test asserts this across the library (every undeclared preset must have `periodicWave === null` and its own `type`), plus one that only these two presets declare drawbars — a registration is a *deliberate choice per preset*, not a default to spread around.

highlights.zh: **两条注册不同**：`m1_organ` 是明亮的「全开」（8′ + 5⅓′ + 2′ + 2⅔′ + 1′ + ½′，并在注释里给出 `8′ / 2^i` 的换算表），`organ_lead` 是爵士常用的 8′ + 5⅓′ + 2′ + 少量 2⅔′。测试断言两者**不相等**——否则就是同一个声音配了两种滤波。
highlights.en: **Two different registrations**: `m1_organ` is the bright "full drawbars" setting (8′ + 5⅓′ + 2′ + 2⅔′ + 1′ + ½′, with the `8′ / 2^i` conversion table written into the comment), and `organ_lead` is the jazz 8′ + 5⅓′ + 2′ plus a touch of 2⅔′. The test asserts they are **not equal** — otherwise the two presets are one sound with two filters.

highlights.zh: **16′ 次八度在这里表达不出来，而且这是正确结果**：`createPeriodicWave` 围绕**一个基频**展开，比基频更低的分量需要第二个振荡器。真实管风琴上 16′ 属于另一层手键盘，塞进来会在音符下方产生本应由贝斯声部占有的能量。已写进注释，避免下一个人以为漏了。
highlights.en: **The 16′ sub-octave cannot be expressed here, and that is the right outcome**: `createPeriodicWave` is built around **one fundamental**, so anything below it needs a second oscillator. On a real console the 16′ belongs to its own manual, and folding it in would put energy under the note that the bass part owns. Recorded in the comment so nobody assumes it was forgotten.

highlights.zh: **基线按规矩重录**：159/159 仍互异，平均对距 3.5662 → 3.5798 dB（音栓化让整体分布略更分散），最近一对 0.3266 → 0.2853 dB。**最近一对的收紧要说清楚而不是掩饰**：那一对是 french-house ↔ nu-disco-house，配器分别是 kick+clap+hat 与 kick+clap，**两个管风琴都不在里面**，所以与本次改动基本无关。门禁自己记录的重复稳定度上界是 1.32 dB，远大于这一对的 0.29 dB——**0.25 dB 地板本来就紧贴测量噪声**，这是既有状况，不是本轮引入的，已登记。
highlights.en: **The baseline was re-recorded, as the rule requires**: 159/159 still distinct, mean pair distance 3.5662 → 3.5798 dB (the registrations spread the library slightly further apart), closest pair 0.3266 → 0.2853 dB. **The tightening of the closest pair is stated rather than glossed**: that pair is french-house ↔ nu-disco-house, whose instruments are kick+clap+hat and kick+clap — **neither organ is in either genre**, so the change is essentially unrelated to it. The gate's own recorded repeat-stability bound is 1.32 dB, far larger than that pair's 0.29 dB: the 0.25 dB floor sits close to measurement noise, which is a pre-existing condition and is recorded as such.

highlights.zh: **顺带**：测试桩守卫（v2.0.60 加的）立刻要求给共享 fake 与两份手写桩补上 `createPeriodicWave`——这正是它存在的意义：新增节点类型不再以「崩」的形式出现，而是以「守卫报出缺少哪个工厂」的形式出现。
highlights.en: **Incidentally**: the test-double guard added in v2.0.60 immediately required `createPeriodicWave` in the shared fake and both hand-rolled doubles. That is exactly what it is for — a new node type now surfaces as "the guard names the missing factory" instead of as a crash.

title.zh: v2.0.62 热修：合并后的底栏不再盖住轨道控制台；横屏面板的底部留白补齐
title.en: v2.0.62 Hotfix: the Merged Bottom Row No Longer Covers the Track Inspector, and Landscape Panels Reserve the Bar's Height

highlights.zh: **v2.0.61 引入的缺陷（已在线上，故为热修）**：合并后的底栏照抄了标签栏的 z-[70]，而轨道控制台是 z-50 的浮层、下垫 z-40 遮罩——于是控制台**最下面 52px 被底栏压住**。实测方式是在重叠区做 element-at-point 探针，它返回的是走带条的按钮而不是面板。这与当初给控制台加 bottom 偏移要修的是同一类缺陷，而且**截图看不出来**（底栏不透明、面板停在顶部）。现在底栏用 z-30：它包含标签栏，但不能继承标签栏的层级——独立的标签栏可以站得很高因为它上面没有东西，被浮层覆盖的一行则不行。
highlights.en: **A defect introduced by v2.0.61 (already in production, hence a hotfix)**: the merged row copied the tab bar's z-[70], while the track inspector is a z-50 sheet over a z-40 scrim — so the sheet's **bottom 52px sat under the row**. Measured with an element-at-point probe in the overlap, which returned a transport button rather than the panel. This is the same class of defect the inspector's bottom offset exists for, and it is **invisible in a screenshot** because the row is opaque and the sheet is scrolled to its top. The row is now z-30: it contains the tab bar but must not inherit its layer — a standalone bar can afford a high layer because nothing covers it; a row that a sheet does cover cannot.

highlights.zh: **横屏的面板底部留白此前是 0**：--mobile-tab-bar-h 只在 max-width: 767px 下被设值，而横屏手机是 844px 宽——变量留在 0px，于是所有依赖它的底部浮层（控制台等）在横屏下都少了 53px 留白。现在改由 App 依据「标签栏是否固定」写出的 data-bottom-bar 属性驱动（宽度媒体查询回答不了这个问题：横屏工作台与横屏其他视图都是 844px 宽，一个合并进行内、一个固定贴底），并且合并行**自己声明** data-bottom-chrome="fixed"，两种排布保留同一高度，浮层落在同一位置。
highlights.en: **Landscape panels reserved 0px at the bottom**: --mobile-tab-bar-h was only set under max-width: 767px, and a landscape phone is 844px wide — so the variable stayed 0px and every bottom-anchored overlay that reads it was 53px short in landscape. It is now driven by a data-bottom-bar attribute that App sets from the same state that decides whether the bar is fixed (a width query cannot answer this: a landscape studio and a landscape non-studio view are both 844px wide, one with the bar merged into the row and one with it fixed). The merged row additionally declares data-bottom-chrome="fixed", so both arrangements reserve the same height and overlays land in the same place.

highlights.zh: **两条都补了可失败测试**：底栏的 z-index 必须**小于 40**（控制台遮罩的层级）——这条断言直接锁住「不能继承标签栏层级」；以及**两种排布保留同一高度**、行必须声明自己的高度。
highlights.en: **Both have failing-capable tests**: the row's z-index must be **less than 40** (the inspector's scrim layer), which pins the "must not inherit the bar's layer" rule directly, plus assertions that both arrangements reserve the same height and that the row declares its own.

title.zh: v2.0.61 手机两条固定栏合并到同一行：横屏占用 104px → 52px，每个标签宽度 39px → 104px
title.en: v2.0.61 The Two Phone Bars Share One Row: 104px → 52px of Height, and 39px → 104px per Tab

highlights.zh: **横屏一次性拿回 52px 高度**：走带条与标签栏此前一上一下各占一条，在 390px 高的横屏视口上共占 **104px**，而横向 844px 完全闲置。现在两者共享同一行：走带条固定在左 320px，标签栏取右侧 524px，**纵向占用降到 52px（13%，此前 27%）**。竖屏布局**逐像素不变**。
highlights.en: **52px of height back on a landscape phone**: the transport and the tab bar used to sit at opposite ends of a 390px-tall viewport, costing **104px** between them while 844px of width sat unused. They now share one row — the transport fixed at 320px on the left, the tab bar taking the remaining 524px — so **the vertical footprint drops to 52px (13%, from 27%)**. The portrait layout is **pixel-for-pixel unchanged**.

highlights.zh: **顺带把导航的触摸目标做大了**：因为横向本来就有富余，合并后**每个 tab 的宽度从 39px 升到 104px**（实测），而不是像常见的「省空间」改动那样把按钮压小。全部 44px 触摸下限保持不变。
highlights.en: **The navigation's touch targets got bigger, not smaller**: because the width was already spare, merging the row takes **each tab from 39px to 104px wide** (measured) instead of squeezing buttons the way a "save space" change usually does. Every 44px minimum is unchanged.

highlights.zh: **实施中撞到并修掉的三个真实陷阱**：① `fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0` **无法参与 flex 行**——它无视容器、覆盖容器，第一次合并时标签栏在一个 1px 宽的父元素里自报整屏宽；为此加了 `embedded` 变体（嵌入式不加 `fixed`，定位与安全区留白交给调用方）。② 不设上限时**走带条会赢下整个 flex 行**（按内容拿到 646px，把五个 tab 挤成每个 39px），现在它固定 320px、由测试与 CSS 变量钉为同值。③ **裸 `env()` 会让 React 丢掉整条 style 声明**：安全区内边距原先写作 `env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)`，jsdom 解析不了该值于是整个 `style` 属性消失——测试以「断言失败」的形式暴露了这个真实的序列化问题；改为 `max(0px, env(...))` 后正常，也与会话其余写法一致。
highlights.en: **Three real traps found and fixed during implementation**: (1) `fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0` **cannot take part in a flex row** — it ignores its container and overlays it; the first attempt had the tab bar reporting itself full-width inside a 1px-wide parent. Hence an `embedded` variant, where the caller owns positioning and the safe-area padding. (2) Without a cap **the transport wins the whole flex row** (646px on content size, leaving five 39px tabs); it is now fixed at 320px, with a test pinning that value to the CSS variable. (3) **A bare `env()` makes React drop the entire style declaration**: the safe-area padding was written as `env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)`, jsdom cannot parse that value, and the whole `style` attribute vanished — the test surfaced a real serialisation problem as an assertion failure. `max(0px, env(...))` fixes it and matches how the rest of the codebase writes an inset.

highlights.zh: **未新增任何状态**：计划里原先写着「必须把走带状态提升到 `App`」，复核后发现方向反了——走带条需要的 props 全部已经由 `StudioView` 传下，真正昂贵的是面板抽屉那四十多个 prop，而标签栏只需要三个。因此正确做法是**把标签栏挪进工作台那一行**，`App` 仍是导航的唯一所有者（元素由 `App` 构造，只是决定放在哪里）。已在计划中订正。
highlights.en: **No new state anywhere**: the plan previously said the transport state had to be lifted into `App`. On review that was backwards — every prop the transport needs already comes down from `StudioView`, the expensive part is the sheet builder's forty-odd props, and the tab bar needs three. So the right move is moving the tab bar *into* the studio's row, with `App` still the sole owner of navigation (it builds the element and only decides where it goes). The plan is corrected.

title.zh: v2.0.60 测试桩守卫：新增节点类型不再以「崩」代替「断言不成立」
title.en: v2.0.60 A Guard for Test Doubles: a New Node Type Fails an Assertion Instead of Crashing the Suite

highlights.zh: **问题**：`velocityTimbreCoverage` / `keyTracking` / `audioDspGuards` 各自手写一份「按节点类型逐个打桩」的 AudioContext 假对象。立体声展开一加 `ChannelSplitter`，前两份就以 `ctx.createChannelSplitter is not a function` 崩掉——报错**与它们要测的东西毫无关系**，而且失败形态是「测试崩了」而不是「断言不成立」。更糟的是没被跑到的那部分**等于没测**，不是「跳过」。
highlights.en: **The problem**: `velocityTimbreCoverage`, `keyTracking` and `audioDspGuards` each hand-rolled an AudioContext double with one stub per node type. When the stereo unison stage added a `ChannelSplitter`, two of them died with `ctx.createChannelSplitter is not a function` — an error that says **nothing about what those suites test**, and whose failure mode is a *crash* rather than a failed assertion. Worse, the part that never ran was **not tested at all**, which is not the same as skipped.

highlights.zh: **处置**：`keyTracking` 迁移到共享的 `FakeOfflineAudioContext`（实现完整图 API，并且会像浏览器一样对非法 ramp 目标抛错）。`audioDspGuards` 保留自己的最小桩——它故意只实现「指数 ramp 对 ≤0 抛错」这一条浏览器行为——但补上了缺失的 `createChannelSplitter` / `createChannelMerger`，并新增守卫测试：**桩必须实现这 13 个 `create*` 工厂**，且与共享 fake 的清单一致。
highlights.en: **The fix**: `keyTracking` moved to the shared `FakeOfflineAudioContext`, which implements the whole graph API and throws on the same illegal ramp targets a browser does. `audioDspGuards` keeps its deliberately minimal double — it reproduces exactly one browser behaviour, `exponentialRampToValueAtTime` throwing for a target ≤ 0 — but gained the missing `createChannelSplitter` / `createChannelMerger` plus a guard test asserting the double implements all 13 `create*` factories, and that the shared fake agrees with that list.

highlights.zh: **守卫当场抓到一个真实缺口**：`createBuffer` 也没实现。此前没有任何测试把带 `noiseMix` 的预设喂给这个桩，所以它没爆——也就是说噪声床这条路径在这份桩上是完全空白的。已补上。这正是守卫的价值：它把一个「迟早会以崩的形式出现」的缺口，变成一个**现在就红**的断言。
highlights.en: **The guard immediately found a second real gap**: `createBuffer` was missing too. Nothing had fed a preset with `noiseMix` to that double, so it never crashed — meaning the noise-bed path was entirely blank on it. Now implemented. That is the point of the guard: it turns a gap that would eventually surface as a crash into an assertion that is **red right now**.

highlights.zh: **订正一处过宽的判断**：上一轮把 `drumFidelityTier1` 也列为「手写桩风险」，但它桩的是鼓机引擎（`synthesizeKick` 等），不经过 `playPolySynthNote`，所以立体声级从未影响它。已在计划里订正为「两份需收口、一份无关」，并说明原因。
highlights.en: **Corrected an over-broad claim**: the previous round also listed `drumFidelityTier1` as at risk, but it doubles the *drum* engine (`synthesizeKick` and friends), which never goes through `playPolySynthNote`, so the stereo stage never affected it. The plan now says two needed fixing and one is unrelated, with the reason.

highlights.zh: **顺带删掉一条死配置**：`index.css` 里的 `.landscape-compact-bar`（5 条 `!important` 规则）没有任何地方引用，而且它强制按钮高度 28px——低于手机端统一的 44px 触摸下限，所以正确处置是删掉而不是接线。同类无人引用 CSS 的系统清查仍未做，已登记。
highlights.en: **Also deleted a piece of dead configuration**: `.landscape-compact-bar` in `index.css` (five `!important` rules) was referenced nowhere, and it forced buttons to 28 px — below the 44 px touch minimum the phone shell standardised on — so deleting it was the right disposition rather than wiring it up. A systematic sweep for other unreferenced CSS is still outstanding and recorded.

title.zh: v2.0.59 手机横屏找回 10px 可用高度：走带条瘦身，小节导航移入面板而非删掉
title.en: v2.0.59 Ten Pixels Back on a Landscape Phone: a Slimmer Transport, and Bar Navigation Moved Rather Than Deleted

highlights.zh: **横屏走带条 59px → 49px**：两条固定栏在两种方向上都是 112px，但那是 664px 竖屏的 17%、390px 横屏的 **29%**——横屏才是真正失去工作区的地方。横屏因此去掉小节导航那一簇（◀ 1/4 ▶，88px 宽）并把纵向内边距从 `py-1.5` 收到 `py-0.5`。**控件本身仍然全部 44px**：省的是内边距和一个控件，不是触摸目标。实测两栏之间的可用带 128px → **138px**（33% → 35%）。
highlights.en: **The landscape transport goes 59px → 49px**: the two fixed bars cost 112px in both orientations, but that is 17% of a 664px portrait viewport and **29%** of a 390px landscape one — landscape is where the working area is actually lost. It therefore drops the bar-navigation cluster (◀ 1/4 ▶, 88px wide) and tightens the vertical padding from `py-1.5` to `py-0.5`. **Every control stays 44px**: the saving is padding and one control, never the touch target. Measured free band between the bars: 128px → **138px** (33% → 35%).

highlights.zh: **小节导航是移走，不是删掉**：横屏的工作台面板里多出一组「小节导航」，两行分别是上一小节/下一小节，行描述显示当前位置（「第 2 / 4 小节」），到头自动禁用。竖屏**不注入**这一组——走带条已经在显示它们，再来一份是重复而不是兜底。这条是本次能安全缩小的前提：**只有当能力在别处可达时，才允许把它从主界面移除**。
highlights.en: **Bar navigation was moved, not deleted**: on a landscape phone the studio sheet gains a "Bar navigation" group whose two rows step to the previous and next bar, with the current position in the row description ("Bar 2 of 4") and the ends disabled. Portrait does **not** get the group — the transport already shows those controls, so a second copy would be a duplicate rather than a fallback. This is what makes the shrink safe: a control may leave the main surface only when the capability is reachable elsewhere.

highlights.zh: **修掉一处 JS 与 CSS 断点不一致**：`PHONE_MAX_HEIGHT_PX` 是 480，而样式表里的 `@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape)` 是 500。也就是说 490px 高的横屏视口会拿到压缩后的样式表，而 JS 仍把它当高视口——同一个元素可以被一条规则定尺寸、被另一条规则定位。已统一为 500，并加了**读样式表断言两者相等**的测试：CSS 与 TS 无法共享常量，只能靠测试钉住。
highlights.en: **Fixed a JS/CSS breakpoint mismatch**: `PHONE_MAX_HEIGHT_PX` was 480 while the stylesheet's `@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape)` was 500. A 490px-tall landscape viewport therefore got the compressed stylesheet while JS still classified it as tall — the same element could be sized by one rule and positioned by another. Both are 500 now, with a test that **reads the stylesheet and asserts the two agree**, since CSS and TS cannot share a constant.

highlights.zh: **新增可复现的测量脚本** `scripts/diagnose_mobile_chrome.mjs`：打印两条栏的真实盒子、固定占用百分比，以及**两栏之间的可用带**。最后这个才是该看的指标——步进网格会滚动，它在横屏下的盒子高 747px（整个 pattern），用一个会滚动的元素的盒子高度去谈「占视口多少」是自欺。
highlights.en: **New reproducible measurement** in `scripts/diagnose_mobile_chrome.mjs`: it prints each bar's real box, the fixed total as a percentage, and **the free band between the two bars**. The last is the metric that matters — the step grid *scrolls*, so its landscape box is 747px (the whole pattern), and quoting a scrolling element's box height as a share of the viewport is self-deceiving.

highlights.zh: **仍未做（已查清原因）**：横屏可用带仍只有 138px（35%）。彻底解法是把两条栏合并成一条（省下整整 49px，可用带 → 187px = 48%），需要把走带状态从 `SequencerPanel` 提升到 `App`（两者相隔整个视图树）。本轮另外确认了**不能简单地在横屏隐藏标签栏**：面板的目的地列表里没有 `studio` 与 `galaxy`，隐藏后用户无法离开工作台或进入探索页。详见 `PRODUCT_PLAN_v2.1.0.md` §G.5。
highlights.en: **Still not done, with the reason established**: the landscape free band is still only 138px (35%). The thorough fix is merging the two bars into one (worth the full 49px, taking the band to 187px = 48%), which needs the transport state lifted from `SequencerPanel` into `App` — the two are a whole view tree apart. This round also established that simply hiding the tab bar in landscape is unsafe: the sheet's destination list has no `studio` or `galaxy`, so hiding it would leave the user unable to leave the studio or reach Explore. See `PRODUCT_PLAN_v2.1.0.md` §G.5.

title.zh: v2.0.58 超级锯有了真正的立体声展开；界面密度设置从此真的生效
title.en: v2.0.58 The Supersaw Gets Real Stereo Width, and the Density Setting Finally Does Something

highlights.zh: **超级锯（supersaw）立体声展开**：此前它是两把锯齿相差 26 音分、**完全单声道**。两把失谐锯齿挤在同一声道里只会以单一速率互相拍频，听感是「一把带点合唱的主音」而不是 trance 的声墙——而这个音色是 trance / hardstyle /  euphoric 类曲风的和弦担当。现在增设一对失谐副振荡器（±42 音分，即预设失谐的 1.6 倍）并左右分开摆位，用等功率摆位（居中时两声道各 √½，满足 L²+R²=1，避免线性摆位把居中做得响 3dB）保持总响度不变；原本的一对仍居中垫在下面，副对的混音只取预设的一半，所以加宽不抬电平。
highlights.en: **Real stereo width for the supersaw**: it was two sawtooths 26 cents apart in **complete mono**. Two detuned saws in one channel only beat against each other at a single rate, which reads as 'a lead with a bit of chorus' rather than a trance wall — and that timbre carries the chords in trance, hardstyle and euphoric genres. It now gains a detuned outer pair (±42 cents, 1.6× the preset's own offset) panned apart with equal-power panning (both channels at √½ when centred, L²+R²=1, so a centred pair is not 3 dB louder the way linear panning would make it). The original pair stays centred underneath and the outer pair carries only half the preset's mix, so widening does not raise the level.

highlights.zh: **其余 50 个预设逐位不变**：立体声级只在预设声明 `stereoSpread` 时创建，不需要的预设连一个 splitter 都不多分配。测试以**节点计数**断言这一点（遍历全部未选择加入的预设，断言 splitter/merger 数量为 0），而不是依赖那个 `if`——否则一旦有人把该级改成无条件，158 个预设会静默改声，两份已提交基线同时失效。按仓库规矩重录了两份基线。
highlights.en: **The other 50 presets are bit-for-bit unchanged**: the stereo stage is built only when a preset declares `stereoSpread`, and a preset that does not ask for it allocates not one extra splitter. The test asserts that by **counting nodes** across every preset that does not opt in (splitter and merger counts must be 0) rather than trusting the `if` — otherwise making the stage unconditional would silently change 158 presets and invalidate both committed baselines at the same time. Both baselines were re-recorded, as the repo's rule requires.

highlights.zh: **界面密度设置真正生效（此前是个谎）**：设置里有紧凑/标准/宽松三档、有持久化、有校验、有中英文案，**却没有任何组件读它**——按下紧凑按钮亮起，界面毫无变化。这比不提供该控件更糟。现在它落到 `<html data-density>` 上，由 `index.css` 的几何自定义属性消费，因此不需要任何组件订阅该状态、也不会造成每次改偏好就整树重渲染（与播放头走 DOM 总线同一考虑）。步进格高度实测：桌面 40 / 44 / 48px，手机竖屏同样 40 / 44 / 48px。
highlights.en: **The density setting actually takes effect (it was previously a lie)**: Settings offered compact / standard / comfortable with persistence, validation and bilingual labels, and **no component read it** — pressing compact lit the button up and changed nothing on screen. That is worse than not offering the control. It now lands on `<html data-density>` and is consumed by the geometry custom properties in `index.css`, so no component has to subscribe to it and changing the preference does not re-render the tree (the same reasoning as the DOM-only playhead bus). Measured step-cell height: 40 / 44 / 48 px on desktop and the same on phone portrait.

highlights.zh: **两段式解析，避免只在某个方向失效**：视口与横屏方向决定 `--step-cell-h-dense` / `-base` 这些**输入**，三档密度只负责从输入里选。这个分层是必要的而不是风格问题——媒体查询里的 `:root` 特异性低于 `:root[data-density="compact"]`，所以横屏块若直接写 `--step-cell-h`，用户的密度选择会在**短横屏手机上被静默覆盖**，而且只在那个方向。不变量测试专门守住这条（横屏块不得出现解析后的名字），另有浏览器脚本量测分辨率链条的每一跳。
highlights.en: **A two-level resolution, so it cannot die in one orientation only**: the viewport and the landscape orientation set the *inputs* (`--step-cell-h-dense` / `-base`) and the three tiers merely select from them. That layering is necessary rather than stylistic — `:root` inside a media query has lower specificity than `:root[data-density="compact"]`, so a landscape block that wrote `--step-cell-h` directly would silently override the user's choice **on short landscape phones, and only there**. An invariant test pins this (the landscape block may not contain a resolved name) and a browser script measures every hop of the resolution chain.

title.zh: v2.0.57 冻结列统一宽度修掉和弦轨道遮挡；播放头按真实输出延迟对齐声音；64/128 步不再半空
title.en: v2.0.57 One width for the frozen column, a playhead aligned to real output latency, and no more half-empty 64/128-step grids

highlights.zh: **冻结列只有一个宽度**：标尺标签 138px、轨道头 142px、力度泳道 126px——三个宽度、两种间距同时在用。标尺那列是 `z-30`、轨道头是 `z-20`，所以在手机上标尺压过和弦轨道头 4px（这就是「和弦轨道会被遮挡」），同时标尺的步号比它标注的格子偏移 4px。现在三者共用 `--trk-head-w` / `--trk-head-gap`，滚动条留白也从写死的 126px 改成同一个变量。实测四个端：列宽与首列 x 坐标全部对齐。
highlights.en: **The frozen column now has one width**: the ruler label was 138 px, every track header 142 px and the velocity lane 126 px, with two different gaps. The ruler column is `z-30` and the track headers are `z-20`, so on a phone the ruler painted 4 px over the chords header — the reported occlusion — while the ruler badges sat 4 px away from the cells they label. All three share `--trk-head-w` / `--trk-head-gap` now, and the scrollbar gutter uses the same variable instead of a hardcoded 126 px. Measured on four targets: column width and first-column x both align.

highlights.zh: **手机端轨道头不再溢出到步进格上**：142px 的列里塞了十一个控件，实测内容宽 241px，而列是 `sticky` + `overflow:hidden`——静音、独奏、滑杆按钮全部压在步进格上方，点它们实际是在切步进。现在手机只保留音符身份（折叠、类型、色条、电平、名称）与静音/独奏，其余由每轨控制台承担；试听钮移进控制台，手机上不会失去这个功能。两处原本写了 `hidden md:flex` 仍在溢出的按钮，原因是元素自己的 `flex` 与 `hidden` 同优先级、由 Tailwind 输出顺序决定——所以改用真正的 `display:none !important`。
highlights.en: **The phone track header no longer spills onto the step grid**: eleven controls inside a 142 px column measured 241 px of content, in a `sticky` box with `overflow: hidden`, so mute, solo and the sliders button all landed on top of step cells and tapping them toggled steps. The phone keeps the row identity (fold, type, colour, meter, name) plus mute and solo; everything else lives in the per-track inspector, and auditioning moved there too so the phone does not lose it. Two of those buttons already carried `hidden md:flex` while still overflowing, because an element's own `flex` ties with `hidden` and Tailwind's emit order decides — hence the real `display:none !important`.

highlights.zh: **播放头按真实输出延迟对齐声音**：原来在 `ctx.currentTime` 越过步进时间的那一刻就推进播放头。但排在 `t` 的音是在 `t` 被渲染、在 `t + outputLatency` 才到扬声器，所以画面系统性地早于声音。现在减去 `outputLatency + 限幅器前瞻 + 用户补偿`，并封顶半步；浏览器不报告延迟时结果精确为 0，离线导出与既有测试不受影响（有单测固定这一点）。
highlights.en: **The playhead is aligned to the real output latency**: it advanced the instant `ctx.currentTime` passed a step's scheduled time, but a voice scheduled at `t` is *rendered* at `t` and reaches the speakers at `t + outputLatency`, so the picture was systematically early. It now subtracts `outputLatency + limiter lookahead + user compensation`, capped at half a step; where a browser reports no latency the result is exactly 0, so the offline bounce and every existing test are unaffected (pinned by unit tests).

highlights.zh: **卡顿排查有实测结论，并修掉其中真实的一处**：CPU 采样显示 6 秒播放里主线程几乎空闲（加权总 JS 约 30ms，最重的非空转函数不到 10ms；最坏 RunTask 2.3ms），所以「卡」不是某段代码在算。能确定属于代码的是一处：自动跟随此前每步都调 `scrollTo({behavior:"smooth"})`，而新的平滑请求会取消进行中的动画，于是滚动器持续处于动画中、永不落定，每秒约 8 次、只为几像素位移。改为增量步进直接定位，只在循环回到开头时保留平滑；实测滚动事件从每秒约 8 次降到每 6 秒 1–3 次。仍会出现的 130–370ms 单帧尖峰与 `st @ vendor-react` 的归因（后者单帧自报 blocking 达 656ms，而同一函数在 CPU 采样里自用时仅零点几毫秒）指向浏览器内部/合成与宿主机 I/O（本机 `ps` 无残留 Chromium，负载来自 `iou_exit` 与 `btrfs-endio`），已在附录 F.3 如实登记，未做无证据的结论。新增 `scripts/diagnose_playback_stall.mjs`（CDP CPU 采样 + trace + long-animation-frame + localStorage 写入归属）供后续对比。
highlights.en: **The stutter investigation ends with measurements, and the one real code-side cause is fixed**: CPU sampling shows the main thread almost entirely idle across 6 s of playback (roughly 30 ms of non-idle JS in total, the heaviest real function under 10 ms, worst RunTask 2.3 ms), so nothing in the code is burning time. The one attributable cause was auto-follow calling `scrollTo({behavior:"smooth"})` on every step: a new smooth request cancels the one in flight, so the scroller animated continuously, ~8 times a second, for a few pixels of movement. Incremental steps are now instant and only the loop wrap-around animates; measured scroll events fell from ~8/s to 1–3 per 6 s. The 130–370 ms single-frame spikes that remain, and the `st @ vendor-react` attribution (which self-reports up to 656 ms of blocking in one frame while the same function shows tenths of a millisecond of self time in the CPU profile), point at browser internals/compositing and host I/O (no stray Chromium in `ps`; the load is `iou_exit` and `btrfs-endio`). That is recorded as-is in appendix F.3 rather than dressed up as a fix. Added `scripts/diagnose_playback_stall.mjs` (CDP CPU profile + trace + long-animation-frame + localStorage attribution) for future comparison.

highlights.zh: **首页不再自动滚到页面中间**：钢琴卷帘挂载时的 `scrollIntoView({block:nearest})` 把首页滚到了步进器与钢琴卷帘之间，已移除。
highlights.en: **The home view no longer jumps to the middle of the page**: the piano roll's on-mount `scrollIntoView({block:nearest})` scrolled the entry view down to somewhere between the step grid and the roll. Removed.

highlights.zh: **64/128 步不再大半是空的**：`SET_STEP_COUNT` 用 `steps.slice(0, diff)` 追加，`diff` 超过源数组长度时只能追加那么多——16 步扩到 128 步时 `diff = 112 > 16`，六个并行数组只到 32 步，后四分之三永远是空的。改为按模重复（tiling），任意源长度与目标长度都能填满。修复前该测试确实失败（已用旧代码反向验证）。
highlights.en: **64/128-step grids are no longer mostly empty**: `SET_STEP_COUNT` appended `steps.slice(0, diff)`, which can only deliver `diff` items while `diff` is smaller than the source: 16 → 128 asks for a 112-step tail from a 16-step array, so all six parallel arrays stopped at 32 and the upper three quarters stayed empty forever. Growing now tiles by modulo, which reaches the target for any source and target length. The new tests were verified to fail against the old code before the fix.

highlights.zh: **部署与门禁**：`scripts/deploy.mjs` 现在也读 `.env`（此前只读 `.env.deploy`），凭据已核对，`--dry-run` 通过（67 个资源文件）。E2E 矩阵中打开每轨控制台的那一步改从轨道头触发——它是在所有七端都可见的唯一控件。新增两份几何诊断脚本与三份不变量测试（列宽单一来源、头部不溢出、增长不截断、播放头延迟数学）。
highlights.en: **Deploy and gates**: `scripts/deploy.mjs` now reads `.env` as well as `.env.deploy` (it previously read only the latter); credentials verified and `--dry-run` passes over 67 asset files. The E2E step that opens the per-track inspector now triggers the row header, the one control visible on all seven targets. Three invariant test files and two geometry diagnostics were added (single-source column width, header containment, growth without truncation, playhead-latency math).

title.zh: v2.0.56 力度真正改变音色：51 个预设全部具备演奏动态，不再只有音量变化
title.en: v2.0.56 Velocity Reaches Timbre on All 51 Presets, Not Just Level

highlights.zh: **51 个预设全部具备演奏动态**：此前 21/51 个预设支持「力度→音色」，其余 30 个（模拟主音、风琴、铜管、贝斯、噪声类等）力度只改变音量——轻弹与重弹的差别只是响度，这是「像是编出来的、不是弹出来的」最典型的破绽。现在每个预设都按乐器特性带有各自的动态深度：击弦类（拨弦、钢琴、颤音琴）最深、拉奏/吹奏类次之、垫子与风琴最浅（持续音没有声学理由随力度大幅变亮）、噪声类过渡音色最轻。
highlights.en: **All 51 presets respond to velocity in timbre**: 21 of 51 had it; the other 30 (analogue leads, organ, brass, basses, noise voices) changed only in level, so a soft note and a hard one differed in loudness alone — the most recognisable "programmed, not played" tell. Each preset now carries a depth matched to its instrument: struck patches (plucked, piano, vibraphone) deepest, bowed/blown next, pads and organ shallowest (a sustained tone has no acoustic reason to brighten sharply with force), transition noise voices lightest.

highlights.zh: **实测依据**：出厂 pattern 的力度**本来就**有 12 种取值（50–120，扫描 `src/data/genres/**` 得到），所以这个映射是可听的，不是理论上的。
highlights.en: **Measured basis**: the shipped patterns already use twelve distinct velocity values (50–120, scanned across `src/data/genres/**`), so the mapping is audible rather than theoretical.

highlights.zh: **满力度严格不变**：每个深度项在满力度时都是精确的空操作（因子含 `(velCurve − 1)` 或 `(1 − velCurve)`，在 `velCurve === 1` 时为 0），因此标注不会让任何预设在其最强处变响或变闷。这一点由测试断言，而不是靠算术「应该如此」。
highlights.en: **Strictly unchanged at full velocity**: every depth term is an exact no-op at full velocity (its factor contains `(velCurve − 1)` or `(1 − velCurve)`, which is 0 at `velCurve === 1`), so annotating a preset cannot make it louder or duller at its loudest. That is asserted rather than assumed from the arithmetic.

highlights.zh: **顺手抽出两个纯函数**：`keyTrackedCutoff(preset, note)` 与 `velocityScaledCutoff(preset, note, velocity)`，让音色路径与测试问同一个问题，而不是各自重推公式——这套件的测试此前断言「未标注的预设在任何力度下音色相同」，那正是本次修掉的默认值；现在改为对**剥离了动态的副本**断言短路性质，既保住原保证，又不再依赖库里存在缺陷。
highlights.en: **Two pure functions extracted**: `keyTrackedCutoff(preset, note)` and `velocityScaledCutoff(preset, note, velocity)`, so the voice and its tests ask the same question instead of re-deriving the formula. The suite used to assert "an un-annotated preset is timbre-identical at every velocity" — that was the default this commit changes — so it now asserts the short-circuit property against a *stripped copy*, keeping the guarantee without depending on the library containing a defect.

highlights.zh: **两条基线按规矩重录**：响度中位 −12.98 LUFS、最差真峰值 −1.24 dBTP（0/159 超 −1.0）、159 条 trim 重解并回填；音色指纹 159/159 互异（最近一对 0.3075 dB，地板 0.25）。两个门禁均通过。
highlights.en: **Both baselines re-recorded, as the project's rule requires**: loudness median −12.98 LUFS, worst true peak −1.24 dBTP (0/159 over the ceiling), all 159 trims re-solved and backfilled; timbre fingerprints 159/159 distinct (closest pair 0.3075 dB against a 0.25 floor). Both gates pass.

title.zh: v2.0.55 键盘跟踪：滤波截止频率随音高移动，低音不再又薄又亮、高音不再发闷；并修复播放谎报成功
title.en: v2.0.55 Key Tracking: the Filter Corner Follows Pitch; Playback No Longer Claims Success It Cannot Observe

highlights.zh: **键盘跟踪（Key Tracking）**：滤波截止频率此前是一个**绝对常数**，于是 C2 的贝斯和 C6 的主音都开到同一个 2.6kHz——相对各自的基频，低音是「全开」（薄、亮、没有厚度），高音是「几乎关死」（闷）。真实乐器的共鸣体是固定的，音越高谐波越少，耳朵把这读成一致的音色；而此前的行为正好相反。这不是某个预设没调好，而是**全部 51 个预设共有的系统性偏差**，所以作为默认修复（0.5 深度，即音高移动一个八度、截止频率移动半个八度），单预设可用 `keyTrackFilter: 0` 关闭。参考音为 C4——预设里写的数字因此仍然意味着「C4 时的值」。
highlights.en: **Key tracking**: the low-pass corner used to be an absolute constant, so a C2 bass note and a C6 lead both opened to the same 2.6 kHz. Relative to their own fundamentals the low note was wide open (thin, bright, no body) and the high note nearly closed (dull) — the opposite of a real resonant body, where fewer harmonics survive as pitch rises and the ear reads that as a consistent timbre. That is not one badly voiced preset; it is a systematic bias in all 51 of them, so it is fixed as a default (0.5 depth: an octave of pitch moves the corner half an octave) with `keyTrackFilter: 0` to opt a preset out. The anchor is C4, so the authored numbers keep meaning "the value at C4".

highlights.zh: **和弦因此也有了音色层次**：一副 C-E-G 和弦的三个音现在各自拥有不同的截止频率（三音比根音更亮），而不是三个完全相同的滤波器设置——这在离线与实时两条路径上都已断言。
highlights.en: **Chords gain timbral depth as a result**: the three notes of a C-E-G voicing now each carry their own corner (the third is brighter than the root) instead of one filter setting repeated — asserted on both the live and the offline paths.

highlights.zh: **播放不再谎报成功**：`play()` 会 await `ctx.resume()`，而 iOS 静音开关（或任何需要新一次手势的浏览器）会让它被拒绝、或让上下文保持 suspended。此前调用处不 await、不 catch，却无条件把界面置为「播放中」——按钮亮起、播放头走动、一点声音都没有，且 Promise 拒绝无人处理。现在只有真的开始播放才报告播放；音频被阻止时**停止走带并说明原因**（新增 `AudioEngine.isAudioBlocked()` 直接读上下文的真实状态）。
highlights.en: **Playback no longer claims success it cannot observe**: `play()` awaits `ctx.resume()`, which the iOS silent switch (or any browser wanting a fresh gesture) rejects or leaves suspended. The caller neither awaited nor caught it and set "playing" unconditionally — button lit, playhead moving, no sound, and the rejection unhandled. Playback is now reported only when it actually started, and a blocked context **stops the transport and says why** (new `AudioEngine.isAudioBlocked()` reads the context's real state).

highlights.zh: **两条基线已按规矩重录**：键盘跟踪改变了音色与电平，因此重跑 159 曲风的响度测量（中位 −13.04 LUFS）、重新迭代求解并回填 159 条 trim，并重录音色指纹（159/159 仍互异，最近一对 0.3074 dB，地板 0.25）。响度门禁与音色门禁均通过。
highlights.en: **Both baselines re-recorded, as the project's rule requires**: key tracking changes timbre and level, so the 159-genre loudness measurement was re-run (median −13.04 LUFS), the trims re-solved and all 159 backfilled, and the timbre fingerprints re-recorded (159/159 still distinct, closest pair 0.3074 dB against a 0.25 floor). Both gates pass.

title.zh: v2.0.54 修复「看起来在播却没声音」：播放不再谎报成功，音频被阻止时明确告知
title.en: v2.0.54 Fix "Looks Like It Is Playing But There Is No Sound": Playback No Longer Claims Success It Cannot Observe

highlights.zh: **播放不再谎报成功**：`play()` 是异步的，它会 `await ctx.resume()`——而 iOS 打开静音开关（或任何需要新一次用户手势的浏览器）时，这个 resume 会被拒绝、或只是让音频上下文保持 suspended。此前调用处既不 await 也不 catch，却无条件把界面置为「播放中」：于是按钮亮起、播放头走动、**一点声音都没有**，而且因为 Promise 拒绝无人处理，连一条错误都没有。现在只有真的开始播放才报告播放；若音频被阻止，则**停止走带并把原因告诉用户**——一个在没有声音的轨道上空转的播放头，是音乐类应用能给出的最糟糕的第一印象。
highlights.en: **Playback no longer claims success it cannot observe**: `play()` is async and awaits `ctx.resume()`, which on iOS with the silent switch on — or in any browser that wants a fresh user gesture — either rejects or simply leaves the context suspended. The caller neither awaited nor caught it and set "playing" unconditionally, so the button lit up, the playhead advanced and **nothing was audible**; the rejection was also unhandled, so nothing reported it. Playback is now reported only when it actually started, and when audio is blocked the transport **stops and says why** — a playhead running over silence is the worst first impression a music app can give.

highlights.zh: **新增可检测的「音频被阻止」状态**：`AudioEngine.isAudioBlocked()` 直接读音频上下文的真实状态，而不是靠推断。此前 `initIosAudioUnlock` 与 `ctx.resume()` 其实都已经在 `play()` 里调用，缺的正是「如何知道它没成功」。
highlights.en: **New detectable blocked-audio state**: `AudioEngine.isAudioBlocked()` reads the audio context's real state instead of inferring it. `initIosAudioUnlock` and `ctx.resume()` were already being called inside `play()`; what was missing was any way to know they had not succeeded.

highlights.zh: **测试**：`transportPlaybackTruth.test.ts` 八条，覆盖「先 await 再报播放」「被阻止时不报播放并停止 + 提示」「play() 拒绝时不产生未处理拒绝且走诚实路径」「关闭仍正常」「引擎未就绪时不动」以及 `isAudioBlocked` 的三种上下文状态（未初始化 / running / suspended）。
highlights.en: **Tests**: eight in `transportPlaybackTruth.test.ts` covering "await before reporting started", "blocked stops and explains instead of claiming playback", "a rejected play() produces no unhandled rejection and takes the honest path", clean stop, no-op when the engine is absent, and the three context states for `isAudioBlocked` (uninitialised / running / suspended).

title.zh: v2.0.53 手机端不再提供钢琴卷帘（附替代路径说明），步进格尺寸达标
title.en: v2.0.53 Piano Roll Withdrawn from Phones (With an Explanation), Step Grid Meets Touch Standards

highlights.zh: **手机端不再提供钢琴卷帘**：实测在 390×664 手机上，卷帘抽屉高 **1095px**、音符网格宽 **2304px**、工具栏 **55 个按钮**，且网格必须 `touch-action: none`（单指拖动要用来画音符，因此没有手势留给平移）——结果是绝大部分网格在屏幕外且无法导航。这不是调参能解决的问题，所以按「提供的功能必须好用」的原则，手机端不提供它，而不是提供一个能打开却没法用的界面。取而代之的是：音符仍在步进网格编辑（点按放置、长按调参数），和弦走向用「和弦」视图；抽屉里的入口改为「编辑音符」说明，讲清楚原因并给出前往和弦视图的按钮——被省略的功能要**明确省略并给出去处**，而不是静默消失。E2E 在手机上断言这条说明与去处确实存在。
highlights.en: **The piano roll is no longer offered on phones**: measured on a 390×664 device the roll drawer is 1095 px tall, its note grid 2304 px wide, its toolbar 55 buttons, and the grid must carry `touch-action: none` — a one-finger drag has to paint a note, so no gesture is left to pan with. Most of the grid is therefore off-screen and unreachable. That is not a tuning problem, so rather than shipping a surface that opens and cannot be used, the phone does not offer it. Notes stay editable on the step grid (tap to place, long-press for parameters) and progressions live in the Chords view; the sheet row became an "Editing notes" explanation that states why and links to Chords.
