(2) The live engine and the exporter both play a **stored stack verbatim** (through a new shared `chordNotesForStep`; automatic voicing happens only when nothing is stored), which makes "what the roll shows is what you hear" structural rather than aspirational. (3) The roll's note identity changed from `stepIdx` to **(step, midi)**, so a chord is a stack that can be displayed and edited tone by tone: drawing onto a sounding step **adds to the chord**, the eraser removes one tone (⌥ clears the step), and a chord drags or ⌥-copies as a group.

highlights.zh: **时值上限的根因**：「有 1 拍的、也有多拍的」原本**做不到**——`gate` 被三处各自夹在 2 步（卷帘模型、卷帘 UI、MIDI/Ableton 导出、分享链接写入器），而引擎本身只是 `stepDur * gate`，从不需要这个小上限。现在统一用共享的 `MAX_NOTE_GATE_STEPS = 16`（1/16 下正好一小节），于是 pad 与小节级和弦是**一个长音**而不是十六个连起来的重复音。
highlights.en: **Why multi-beat lengths were impossible:** `gate` was independently clamped to 2 steps in four places (the roll model, the roll UI, the MIDI/Ableton exporters, the share-link writer) even though the engine only ever does `stepDur * gate` and never needed a small cap. They now share `MAX_NOTE_GATE_STEPS = 16` (one bar at 1/16), so a pad or a whole-bar chord is **one long note** rather than sixteen tied retriggers.

highlights.zh: **逐曲风内容：156 条覆盖**（`GENRE_EXPRESSION_GENERATED`，与手写表分开保留来源）。规则表沿用本仓库既有写法：**6 个类别档 + 逐曲风覆盖 + 必填理由**，未知/自建曲风只继承所属类别档。每条覆盖给出：和弦性质（三/七/power/sus/quartal/extended）、演奏法（柱式/扫弦/**琶音**/**分解**/短促/延音）、**按拍**的音长与走向占几小节、音域偏移、琶音速率，以及有特点的轨道乐句规则（连音/断奏/延音/幽灵音/ratchet）。八个并行作者按类别编写（Electronic 93 拆三份 + Rock/Metal 17 + Hip Hop 11 + Jazz/Blues 14 + Pop/R&B 13 + Latin/World 11），合并器 `scripts/merge_expression_parts.mjs` 逐条校验：不存在的曲风 id、缺理由、数值越界、琶音缺速率、role/ratchet 误用、跨文件重复、不存在的 progressionId——**它当场抓出我编造的两个 id**（`trap`/`gospel` → 真实为 `trap-rap`/`soul`）。
highlights.en: **The content: 156 per-genre overrides** (`GENRE_EXPRESSION_GENERATED`, kept separate from the hand-written table so provenance stays visible). The rule table follows the project's existing convention: **six category profiles + per-genre overrides + a required reason**, with unknown or user-created genres inheriting only their own category. Each override states the chord quality (triad/seventh/power/sus/quartal/extended), the articulation (block/strum/**arpeggio**/**broken**/stab/sustain), the length **in beats** and how many bars the progression occupies, the register, the arpeggio rate, and phrase rules for the tracks that have character (legato/staccato/sustain/ghost/ratchet). Eight authors worked per category in parallel (Electronic's 93 split three ways, plus Rock/Metal 17, Hip Hop 11, Jazz/Blues 14, Pop/R&B 13, Latin/World 11); `scripts/merge_expression_parts.mjs` validates every entry — unknown genre ids, missing reasons, out-of-range values, arpeggios without a rate, misused roles/ratchets, duplicate ids across files, unknown progression ids — and **it caught two ids I had invented** (`trap`/`gospel`, really `trap-rap`/`soul`).

highlights.zh: **生成器（纯函数，幂等）**：加载曲风时把作者写的**根音与和弦落点**展开成真音符——和弦写成 `pitches` 音堆、**琶音/分解写成真正的音符**（按你的决定：卷帘可见可改、导出天然一致）、循环类轨道保留作者长度并写 `trackLength` 让 16 步鼓组在 64/128 步走向下自动复行。两条保护：**和弦时值以「到下一个和弦的距离」为上限**（否则 4 拍的和弦会盖住后继和弦、把走向糊掉——第一版如此，被测试抓出）；**已展开或用户改过的和弦轨直接原样返回**（第一版会把琶音当「每步一个和弦」重写，冲掉用户编辑，也被测试抓出）。
highlights.en: **The generator** (pure and idempotent) expands the authored **roots and chord marks** into real notes when a genre loads: stacks in `pitches`, **arpeggios and broken chords as real notes** (your decision: visible and editable in the roll, and export-identical because nothing is expanded at playback any more), and looping tracks keep their authored length as `trackLength` so a 16-step drum part repeats under a 64/128-step progression. Two guards: a chord's length is capped by **the distance to the next chord** (a 4-beat chord written where the harmony moves every beat otherwise smothers its successor — the first version did exactly that, and a test caught it), and a chords track that is **already expanded or edited is returned untouched** (the first version rewrote an arpeggio as a stack per note and would have discarded the user's edits — also caught by a test).

highlights.zh: **你要的两条规矩由测试守住**：① **没内容的轨道保持空**——作者没写和弦的 21 个曲风（ghetto-house、minimal-techno、death-metal、electro…）一根音都不加，FX 之类的轨道从不被发明（第一版生成器把它们全填上了，违反你的要求）；② **和弦必须真的是和弦**——柱式/短促/延音类必须有 ≥3 音的**纵向**音堆，而琶音/分解类是**横向**陈述同一和声（32 个曲风属于此类），所以判据是「≥3 个不同音高」而不是「必须有音堆」（第一版测试判据用错，冤枉了琶音曲风）。
highlights.en: **The two rules you set are held by tests.** (1) **A track with nothing in it stays empty**: the 21 genres whose author wrote no chords (ghetto-house, minimal-techno, death-metal, electro, …) get no notes at all, and an `fx`-style track is never invented (the first version of the generator filled all of them, against your instruction). (2) **A chord has to be a chord**: block/stab/sustain genres must show a **vertical** stack of three or more notes, while arpeggio and broken-chord genres state the same harmony **horizontally** (32 genres are in that group) — so the criterion is "three or more distinct pitches" rather than "must have a stack", which is what the first version of the test wrongly demanded.

highlights.zh: **pattern 长度按走向决定，并相应把上限提到 128**：4 小节走向 64 步、8 小节 128 步（工具栏新增 128 选项，分享链接上限同步从 64 提到 128）。全库检查确认长度**确实不唯一**（你要求「每个曲风长度可以不一致」），且每轨长度与 pattern 长度一致。
highlights.en: **Pattern length follows the progression, and the ceiling moved to 128**: a four-bar progression is 64 steps and an eight-bar one 128 (a 128 option was added to the toolbar and the share-link cap moved from 64 to 128 with it). A library-wide check confirms the lengths genuinely **differ** — you asked for per-genre lengths — and that every track agrees with its pattern's length.

highlights.zh: **证据**：新增/更新单测——`genreExpression`（23 条：长度策略与 3/4、6/8 换算、罗马数字与调内定位、音堆/琶音/分解/stab 写法、性质决定堆叠宽度、时值上限、和弦不越过后继、循环轨 trackLength、空轨恒空、乐句规则、确定性、幂等、全库规则可用性与理由完整性）、`genreChordsLibrary`（**跑全部 159 个曲风**：每个有和弦的曲风都产出真和弦、长度受支持且不唯一、无时值越界、空轨恒空、加载确定）、`rollModel` 46 条（和弦契约）、卷帘组件 35 条，以及 7 端 E2E 的和弦检查（在卷帘往已发声的步再画一个音 → 出音堆且**步进网格步数不变**）。过程中 E2E 自己也暴露三处判据问题并已修：marquee 矩形改成**锚定真实音符**（pattern 变长后固定比例矩形可能一个音都框不到）、拖动限制在**同一行内**（marquee 按格选择，越一行就会多选）、连音改用**音符自身的 gate 值**判断（64/128 步时一格约 8px，用像素宽度等于在测缩放级别）。
highlights.en: **Evidence**: new and updated tests — `genreExpression` (23: length policy and 3/4 & 6/8 arithmetic, roman numerals and placement in the key, stack/arpeggio/broken/stab writing, quality determining stack width, the note-length cap, chords never overrunning the next one, `trackLength` for loopers, empty tracks staying empty, phrase rules, determinism, idempotence, and library-wide usability + reason completeness), `genreChordsLibrary` (**all 159 genres**: every genre with chords produces real ones, lengths are supported and not uniform, nothing exceeds the length cap, silent tracks stay silent, loading is deterministic), the 46 roll-model tests (the chord contract) and the 35 roll component tests, plus the 7-target E2E chord check (draw onto a sounding step → a stack appears while the **step grid's step count is unchanged**). The E2E also exposed three of its own faulty criteria, all fixed: the marquee rectangle now **anchors on a real note** (a fixed fraction of the viewport could enclose nothing once patterns got long), the drag is confined **to one row** (the marquee selects whole cells), and legato is judged on the notes' **own gate values** (at 64/128 steps a cell is ~8 px, so a pixel-width assertion would be testing the zoom level).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 和弦**位置与音域**是规则决定的（根音来自作者写的和弦落点与调式），不是逐个曲风手工写死的具体音符表；要逐音微调可以在卷帘里直接改，改过之后生成器不会再覆盖。② 演奏法里的 **strum 仍是引擎的起音错开**（和弦音在同一格，攻击错位由 articulation 提供），因为数据模型没有子步位置——琶音/分解则如你所选写成了真音符。③ 音长按拍换算依赖 pattern 的 resolution 与拍号（3/4、6/8 已覆盖，6/8 记 3 个四分拍）。④ 慢轨（响度/音色基线重录）按约定交给快机器，本版已启动并将在完成后补上。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) Chord **position and register** come from rules (the root from the authored chord mark and the pattern's key) rather than a hand-written note table per genre; tone-by-tone tweaks are made in the roll, and the generator will not overwrite them afterwards. (2) **Strum** remains the engine's onset stagger (the chord tones share a step; the attack offset comes from the articulation), because the data model has no sub-step position — arpeggios and broken chords, as you chose, are written as real notes. (3) Length arithmetic depends on the pattern's resolution and time signature (3/4 and 6/8 are handled; 6/8 counts three quarter-note beats). (4) The slow track (re-recording the loudness/timbre baselines) runs on the faster machine by agreement; it has been started and will be filled in when it completes.

title.zh: v2.0.22 钢琴卷帘按 Logic 重做：力度泳道、五种工具、框选与成组编辑、量化/连音、音阶高亮、播放头跟随
title.en: v2.0.22 The piano roll is rebuilt against Logic: velocity lane, five tools, marquee and group editing, quantise/legato, scale highlighting and playhead catching

highlights.zh: **力度泳道**（Logic 的标志性部件）：网格下方每个音符一根竖条，条高就是力度；拖动一根改那个音符，拖动的条若属于当前选区则**整段选区一起偏移**。绘制音符的颜色也随之变化（暗石板 → 亮琥珀），所以力度不用读数字也能看出来。
highlights.en: **A velocity lane** — Logic's signature component: one vertical bar per note under the grid, its height being the velocity. Dragging a bar edits that note, and dragging a bar that belongs to the selection offsets **the whole selection**. Note colours follow velocity too (dim slate → bright amber), so the dynamics are visible without reading numbers.

highlights.zh: **五种工具**：铅笔（默认）、指针、橡皮、剪刀、框选——按钮 + 键盘 `1`–`5`。铅笔还会**涂画**：按住拖过空格会连续写音符，整笔**只算一次撤销**。**与 Logic 不同的两处，都是刻意的**：① 默认工具是铅笔而不是指针——这个编辑器的第一动作是往空网格里画（重建前它也只有这一种行为），而 Logic 的钢琴卷帘主要是编辑已有片段；② 剪刀需要**右侧有空位**才能把长音符切成两个（步进网格是单声部的，没有地方放重叠音符），切不了时**弹提示说明原因**，而不是静默无动作。
highlights.en: **Five tools** — pencil (the default), pointer, eraser, scissors, marquee — as buttons and keys `1`–`5`. The pencil also **paints**: holding and dragging across empty cells keeps writing notes, and the whole stroke is **one undo step**. Two deliberate departures from Logic: (1) the default tool is the pencil, not the pointer, because this editor's first act is drawing into an empty grid (and before this rebuild that was its only behaviour), whereas Logic's piano roll mostly edits existing regions; (2) the scissors need a **free slot to the right** to cut a long note into two — a step grid is monophonic, so there is nowhere to put an overlapping note — and when it cannot cut it **says why** instead of silently doing nothing.

highlights.zh: **框选与成组编辑**：拖框（指阵/框选工具）选中一批音符，成组拖动（同时改时间与音高）、**⌥ 拖动复制**、Delete 删除、方向键微移、⌘A 全选；每一次手势**只提交一次**（一条撤销），这是我在实现里专门保证的不变量。选中音符会显示白色描边与计数，右下角是可直接输入的音符检视器（音高 / 起点 / 时长 / 力度），改任一项即提交。
highlights.en: **Marquee and group editing**: drag a rectangle (pointer or marquee tool) to select notes, then move the group in time and pitch together, **⌥-drag to copy**, Delete to remove, arrow keys to nudge, ⌘A to select all — each gesture committing **once** (one undo step), an invariant the implementation protects. Selected notes get a white outline and a count, and the footer is a numeric note inspector (pitch / start / length / velocity) that commits on any edit.

highlights.zh: **量化与连音——按步进网格如实改写**。Logic 的「量化起点」在这里**没有意义**（起点本来就是整数步），所以我没有放一个按了没反应的按钮，而是提供真正会变的那两件事：**量化长度**（把时长吸附到吸附值，如 `1/16`、`1/4`，可选 `自由`）与**连音**（把每个选中音符延到下一个音符的起点，必要时封顶到引擎的两步上限）。连音**也可能把音符变短**——那正是连音的定义，UI 文案如实写着。吸附选择器（`自由/1/4/1/8/1/16/1/32`）同时作用于画与拖。
highlights.en: **Quantise and legato, rewritten honestly for a step grid.** Logic's "quantise start" is **meaningless here** (starts *are* integer steps), so rather than shipping a button that does nothing, the two things that can actually drift are offered: **quantise lengths** (snap durations to the snap value — `1/16`, `1/4`, or free) and **legato** (extend each selected note to the next note's start, capped at the engine's two-step maximum). Legato **can also shorten** a note — that is what legato means, and the UI says so. The snap selector (`free / 1/4 / 1/8 / 1/16 / 1/32`) applies to both drawing and dragging.

highlights.zh: **视觉按 DAW 的路子重做**：左侧音高栏画成**键盘**（黑键有底色），并按调式**高亮音阶**（根音最强、调内次之、调外压暗，`data-scale` 可断言）；网格行同样着色，小节线加重并标小节号；音符在宽度够时**直接写出音名**（按格子宽度决定，不按音符自身宽度——否则缩小时会闪烁）；循环区尾部压暗；右边缘有**改时长的拖柄**；行高可三档切换（纵向缩放）以配合横向缩放。
highlights.en: **The visuals follow DAW conventions**: the pitch gutter is drawn as a **keyboard** (black keys shaded) and **highlights the scale** (root strongest, in-scale next, out-of-scale darkened, assertable through `data-scale`); the grid rows are shaded the same way; bar lines are heavier and numbered; notes **print their name** when the cells are wide enough (decided by the *cell* width, not the note's own width, which would flicker while zooming); the region past the loop end is darkened; the right edge carries a **length drag handle**; and the row height has three steps (vertical zoom) to go with the horizontal one.

highlights.zh: **播放头与跟随**：卷帘的播放头**走 DOM 总线而不是 React 状态**（新增 `playheadBus`）——一拍十六分之一的步进若每次都重渲染，正是之前那批「卡顿」修复要消掉的主线程工作，所以工作台本来就只移动 DOM 节点；卷帘订阅同一条总线移动自己的线与滚动容器，「跟随」开关默认开启。
highlights.en: **Playhead and catching**: the roll's playhead moves through a **DOM-only bus** rather than React state (`playheadBus`); re-rendering on every 1/16 step is exactly the main-thread work the earlier responsiveness fixes removed, which is why the studio itself only moves DOM nodes — the roll subscribes to the same bus to move its own line and scroll its container, with catching on by default.

highlights.zh: **证据**：新增 **30 条模型单测**（选择/框选矩形、成组移动与越界拒绝、复制、删除、力度绝对与相对、量化长度、连音封顶与「连音也会缩短」、剪刀成功与拒绝、吸附、音阶解析）与 **18 条组件测试**（工具切换与 `data-tool`、橡皮只删命中的那个、铅笔涂画「首格立即提交 + 整笔一次撤销」、剪刀成功/拒绝并提示、框选选中全部、成组移动、⌥ 复制、力度泳道增删与读数、量化与连音、音阶高亮、力度着色与音名、检视器数值编辑、播放头总线、跟随开关）。**7 端 E2E** 里真的做手势：键盘切工具、拖框选中**全部**音符、拖力度条（实测 100 → 127）、点连音后音符变宽（39.6 → 44.2px）。
highlights.en: **Evidence**: **30 new model tests** (selections and marquee rects, group moves with out-of-range refusal, copy, delete, absolute and relative velocity, quantise lengths, legato's cap and its ability to shorten, scissors succeeding and refusing, snapping, scale parsing) and **18 component tests** (tool switching and `data-tool`, the eraser removing only the note it hit, pencil painting where the first cell commits at once and the stroke is one undo, scissors succeeding/refusing with a notice, a marquee selecting everything, group move, ⌥-copy, the velocity lane's bars and readings, quantise and legato, scale highlighting, velocity colouring and note names, numeric inspector edits, the playhead bus, the catch toggle). The **7-target E2E** performs real gestures: switching tools by keyboard, dragging a marquee that must select **every** note, dragging a velocity bar (measured 100 → 127) and widening a note with legato (39.6 → 44.2 px).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 步进网格是**单声部且量化**的，所以与 Logic 的差距是结构性的、不是遗漏：音符不能重叠、起点不能落在网格之间、长度是步长的倍数、也没有 Logic 的折叠/智能量化/片段级操作。② 剪刀的「切成两半」是按一半长度切，不是按点击位置精确切（网格上没有可放第二半的中间位置）。③ 力度泳道一次手势作用于命中的条或当前选区，没有 Logic 的「力度工具 + 曲线笔刷」。④ 本机 WebKit 是 Linux WebKitGTK，不等于 macOS Safari。⑤ 慢轨仍按约定交给快机器。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) A step grid is **monophonic and quantised**, so the remaining distance to Logic is structural rather than an omission: notes cannot overlap, cannot start between grid positions, their length is a multiple of one step, and there are no fold/scale-aware quantise/region-level operations. (2) The scissors cut at half the note's length rather than exactly where you clicked, because the grid has no intermediate position to hold the second half. (3) The velocity lane acts on the bar you grabbed or on the current selection; there is no Logic-style velocity tool with a curve brush. (4) The WebKit here is WebKitGTK on Linux, not macOS Safari. (5) The slow track still runs on the faster machine by agreement.

title.zh: v2.0.21 效果检查器重做：Logic 式信号链 + 按级编辑，配真实计算的 EQ 频响曲线、压缩器传输曲线与实时增益衰减表、驱动波形曲线
title.en: v2.0.21 The effects inspector is rebuilt: a Logic-style signal chain with per-stage editing, plus a computed EQ response curve, compressor transfer curve and live gain-reduction meter, and the drive's transfer curve

highlights.zh: **从「一长串滑条」变成一条信号链**。原来的效果页把 6 个处理级堆成一列滑条（每个都带开关），既看不出顺序、也看不出各自在做什么；更别扭的是 EQ 挂在「混音」页、压缩与驱动挂在「效果」页，而它们其实是**同一条串联插入链**。现在页首是一条信号链 `HP → EQ → Comp → Drive`（顺序就是 `ChannelStripDsp` 里实际的接线顺序，不是排版顺序），每级有：**电源圆点**（真正改参数的开关）、名称、以及**当前值摘要**（如 `180 Hz`、`-3.0 · +1.0 · +1.0 dB`、`-18 dB · 4.0:1`）。点某一级切换编辑区；被选中的一级展开，其余**保持挂载**（用 `hidden` 切换），所以切换即时、滑条位置与搜索词都不会丢。
highlights.en: **From a long column of sliders to a signal chain.** The old effects page stacked six processors as rows of sliders (each with a switch), which showed neither their order nor what each was doing — and worse, the EQ lived under the *mix* tab while the compressor and drive lived under *effects*, even though all of them are one serial insert chain. The page now opens with the chain `HP → EQ → Comp → Drive` (the order is `ChannelStripDsp`'s actual wiring, not a layout choice), and each stage shows a **power dot** (which really toggles its parameters), its name, and a **live value summary** (`180 Hz`, `-3.0 · +1.0 · +1.0 dB`, `-18 dB · 4.0:1`). Clicking a stage switches the editor; the selected one expands while the others **stay mounted** (toggled with `hidden`), so switching is instant and slider positions and search text survive.

highlights.zh: **三条曲线都是从真实参数算出来的，不是画的图**。新增 `src/audio/insertCurves.ts`，逐项对齐 `ChannelStripDsp` 而不是近似它：滤波器曲线用浏览器 `BiquadFilterNode` 同一套 RBJ 系数公式、同样的 Q（高通用 `INSERT_HPF_Q`、谐振级用该带自己的 Q）；压缩器曲线用 Web Audio 的**软拐点传输函数**，拐点就是那条链路固定的 6 dB（`INSERT_COMP_KNEE_DB`，所以它不是用户参数）；驱动曲线**直接取自整形器自己的查表**（`makeSaturationCurve`，就是填 `WaveShaperNode` 的那个函数），因此画出来的和听到的不可能漂移；**关闭的级不参与**（DSP 是把它从图上摘掉，不是停在中间值）。**18 条单测断言的是传输函数的已知性质**而不是快照数字：巴特沃斯高通在拐点 −3.01 dB、搁架在频谱两端各自到达增益、谐振级在中心频率到达增益、Q 越大越窄、压缩在拐点以下是单位增益、以上严格 1/ratio、跨拐点连续、永不提升、以及各级响应可加。
highlights.en: **All three curves are computed from the live parameters, not drawn pictures.** `src/audio/insertCurves.ts` mirrors `ChannelStripDsp` point for point instead of approximating it: the filter curves use the same RBJ coefficient formulas the browser's `BiquadFilterNode` implements, at the same Q values (`INSERT_HPF_Q` for the high-pass, each band's own Q for the peaking band); the compressor curve is Web Audio's **soft-knee transfer function** with the chain's fixed 6 dB knee (`INSERT_COMP_KNEE_DB`, which is why it is not a user parameter); and the drive curve is sampled from **the shaper's own table** (`makeSaturationCurve`, the very function that fills the `WaveShaperNode`), so the drawing cannot drift from the sound; a **disabled stage contributes nothing**, because the DSP unwires it rather than parking it at a neutral value. **Eighteen unit tests assert known properties of the transfer functions** rather than snapshotting numbers: a Butterworth high-pass is −3.01 dB at its corner; each shelf reaches its gain at its end of the spectrum; a peaking band reaches its gain at its centre and narrows as Q rises; the compressor is unity below the knee, exactly 1/ratio above it, continuous across both knee edges, never boosts, and the stages' responses add.

highlights.zh: **曲线上可以直接拖频点与增益**：EQ 曲线画出四个频段的圆点手柄，拖动即改该带的频率/增益，拖动期间只在本地草稿里重绘、**松手才提交一次**（与钢琴卷帘同一条「一次手势一条撤销」的规矩；每次 pointermove 都提交会把撤销栈冲爆）。**压缩器的增益衰减表读的是正在跑的节点**（`DynamicsCompressorNode.reduction`），不是二次估算；取样放在表组件内部以 ~20 Hz 轮询，因此这个高频更新不会让整个工作台跟着重渲染。
highlights.en: **The curve is editable directly**: the EQ drawing carries a handle per band, and dragging one moves that band's frequency and gain — redrawing from a local draft during the drag and **committing once on release**, the same "one gesture, one undo step" rule the piano roll follows (committing on every pointermove would flood the undo stack). The **compressor's gain-reduction meter reads the running node** (`DynamicsCompressorNode.reduction`) rather than a second estimate, and it is sampled inside the meter component at ~20 Hz so that this fast update does not re-render the studio around it.

highlights.zh: **E2E 真的拖了一次手柄**：新检查断言信号链的四个槽位顺序、按级切换（选中的可见、其余 hidden 但仍挂载）、三条曲线路径存在，然后**在真实浏览器里按下手柄往上拖 24px，要求 mid 增益的输入值随之改变**（实测 `-3 → 5.5`）。它当场抓到两个自身问题：选择器把信号链容器也算成了槽位；以及检查结束后把检查器留在了「效果」页，导致后面的音色搜索框（在「音色」页，已 hidden）`fill` 超时 30 秒——两个都修了，后者顺手记进注释。
highlights.en: **The E2E really drags a handle**: the new check asserts the four slots in chain order, per-stage switching (the selected one visible, the rest hidden but still mounted), and the presence of all three curve paths, then **presses a handle in a real browser and drags it up 24 px, requiring the mid gain input to follow** (measured `-3 → 5.5`). It immediately caught two problems of its own: the selector counted the chain container as a slot; and the check left the inspector on the Effects tab, so a later step's timbre search box (in the Timbre tab, hence hidden) timed out its `fill` after 30 s — both fixed, the second recorded in a comment.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 这些曲线是**参数所要求的传输函数**，不是对运行中浏览器滤波器的实测响应——浏览器实现同一套公式，但两者不会逐点相同；这一点写在组件注释里，没有暗示它是测量值。② 压缩器的 6 dB 拐点是链路固定值、曲线也按它画；若将来把它做成参数，曲线会自动跟随（它读的是同一个常量）。③ EQ 手柄当前只改频率与增益，**不改 Q**（Q 仍由滑条控制）；也没有画 Q 手柄的交互。④ 本版只做了效果页；**钢琴卷帘的重做（本轮目标的第二项）还没开始**，下一轮继续。⑤ 慢轨仍按约定交给快机器。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) These curves are the transfer functions the *parameters ask for*, not a measurement of the running browser filter — the browser implements the same formulas but the two will not agree point for point, and the component comments say so rather than implying a measurement. (2) The compressor's 6 dB knee is fixed by the chain and the curve is drawn with it; if it ever becomes a parameter the curve follows automatically, because it reads the same constant. (3) An EQ handle changes frequency and gain but **not Q** (Q remains a slider), and there is no Q handle. (4) This release covers the effects page only; **the piano roll rebuild — the second half of this objective — has not started** and continues next round. (5) The slow track still runs on the faster machine by agreement.

title.zh: v2.0.20 修播放中切曲风的老/新曲风来回交换与显示闪烁：一次点击触发 5–13 次导航、最多 9 次 pattern 翻转
title.en: v2.0.20 Fixes the old/new genre swapping and flicker when switching genre during playback: one click caused 5–13 navigations and up to 9 pattern flips

highlights.zh: **根因是 effect 依赖了每次渲染都会新建的回调**。`useGenreSwitching` 的外部同步 effect 把 `performSwitch` 与 `requestGenreGuard` 放进了依赖数组，而 `performSwitch` 闭包里的 `onSelectGenre` 是 App 传的**内联箭头**（`onSelectGenre={(g) => handleSelectGenre(g, "studio")}`）——每次 App 重渲染都是一个新函数。于是一次点击变成：切换 → `onSelectGenre` → `navigate` → App 重渲染 → 新回调身份 → **effect 再跑一次** → 再切一次 → …… 浏览器实测（**Chromium 上就能复现，Safari 更严重**），transport 播放中连续三次点击分别产生 **5 / 11 / 13 次 `pushState`** 与最多 **9 次 pattern 签名翻转**，每个来回都重新执行 `SET_GENRE` + `engine.setPattern(..., resetStates=true)` + 重套该曲风的鼓组与 FX 默认值——所以不只是画面闪，声音也不正常。
highlights.en: **The root cause was an effect depending on callbacks that every render reallocates.** `useGenreSwitching`'s external-sync effect listed `performSwitch` and `requestGenreGuard` as dependencies, and `performSwitch` closes over `onSelectGenre` — which `App` passed as an **inline arrow** (`onSelectGenre={(g) => handleSelectGenre(g, "studio")}`), i.e. a new function on every App render. So one click became: switch → `onSelectGenre` → `navigate` → App re-renders → new callback identity → **the effect runs again** → switch again → … Measured in a browser (**reproducible on Chromium, worse on Safari**), three successive clicks with the transport running produced **5 / 11 / 13 `pushState` calls** and up to **9 pattern-signature flips**, each round-trip re-applying `SET_GENRE` + `engine.setPattern(..., resetStates = true)` + the genre's drum kit and FX defaults — which is why the display flickered *and* the sound broke.

highlights.zh: **修法（两层，缺一不可）**：① 同步 effect 改成**边沿触发、且完全不看回调身份**——`performSwitch` 与 guard 通过 ref 读取，依赖只剩下「请求的曲风」与 store 里的当前曲风，并记住「已经因这次请求同步过」，因此同一请求只落一次；② App 侧把 `onSelectGenre`（studio 与 detail 两个去向）改成 `useCallback` 稳定引用，从源头消掉这类抖动。**证据**：修复后同一套测量在 Chromium 与 WebKit 上都是**每次点击 1 次导航、1 次 pattern 翻转**（修复前 5/11/13 与 1/8/9）。
highlights.en: **The fix, in two layers.** (1) The sync effect is now **edge-triggered and blind to callback identity**: `performSwitch` and the guard are read through refs, the dependency list is down to the requested genre and the store's current genre, and the last satisfied request is remembered so one request lands once. (2) `App` now hands over stable `useCallback` references for `onSelectGenre` (both the studio and detail destinations), removing that class of churn at the source. **Evidence:** the same measurement on Chromium and WebKit now shows **1 navigation and 1 pattern flip per click** (it was 5/11/13 navigations and 1/8/9 flips).

highlights.zh: **为什么它能溜过 7 端矩阵**：矩阵从来没有**在播放中切换曲风**——它检查过视图渲染、控制台、控制台面板、设置面板、检查器、卷帘，唯独没碰这条路径。新增的检查用应用自己的活动量作判据（`pushState` 次数 + 步进网格签名翻转次数），并且**先打印后断言**：一旦某次运行被中断，日志里也已经留下了数字。它自己也踩了两个坑，都已在代码注释里写明：**点击落空**（rail 在之前的步骤里已滚出视口，WebKit 上 `force: true` 的坐标点击什么都没发生 → 改用 `clickVerified` 做投递验证），以及**空转通过**（第一次版本是 0 导航 0 翻转却判绿——「没判」被当成「通过」）；现在「点击后什么都没变」直接判失败。
highlights.en: **Why the 7-target matrix let it through:** the matrix never **switched genre while the transport was running** — it covered view rendering, the console, the mixer, the settings panel, the inspector and the roll, but not this path. The new check judges by the app's own activity (count of `pushState` calls + pattern-signature flips) and **prints before it asserts**, so an interrupted run still leaves the numbers in the log. The check itself hit two traps, both now written into the comments: **the click missed** (the rail had been scrolled out of view by earlier steps, and on WebKit a coordinate click with `force: true` did nothing at all — it now goes through `clickVerified`, which proves delivery), and **passing vacuously** (the first version reported 0 navigations and 0 flips and still went green — "not judged" recorded as "passed"). Clicking a chip that changes nothing now fails.

highlights.zh: **另外发现的一个真实交互事实（不是缺陷，但会造成「切换失败」的错觉）**：如果在切换前编辑过 pattern，守卫会先弹「有未保存的修改」对话框，**此时不会切换**——用户会感觉「点了没反应」。矩阵里因为这个对话框，新检查一度连续两次空转。发布说明里写清这条，是为了让「第一次成功、第二三次失败」的两种成因可以区分：**循环**（本次已修，表现为画面来回闪 + 声音乱）与**守卫在问**（画面正常、只是弹窗等你回答）。
highlights.en: **One real interaction fact worth knowing** (not a defect, but it creates the *impression* of a failed switch): if the pattern was edited before switching, the guard asks "unsaved changes" first and **nothing switches until it is answered**, which feels like "the click did nothing". That dialog is what made the new check go vacuous twice in a row. It is documented here so the two causes of "first switch works, later ones fail" can be told apart: the **loop** (fixed in this release; the display swaps back and forth and the sound breaks) versus the **guard asking** (the display is stable and a dialog is waiting).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 根因与修复都由**浏览器内的活动量测量**确认（导航次数、pattern 翻转次数、双引擎），**没有**用「看起来好了」作为判据；但「耳朵听到的不再乱」仍需你在 Safari 上确认。② 本机的 WebKit 是 Linux 上的 WebKitGTK，**不等于 macOS Safari**；这次能在 WebKit 上复现并修好是加分项，但请在真 Safari 上再走一遍同样的操作。③ 矩阵里这条新检查**依赖应用自己的活动量**：如果将来路由不再使用 `pushState`，导航计数会变成 0 而检查会（正确地）判失败，需要同步更新判据。④ 这次没有重跑慢轨（本机慢轨交给快机器的约定不变）：本版只有 3 个源码文件 + 1 个 E2E 检查的改动，fast 轨、7 端 E2E、redlines/docs/version/budget 与四个证据门禁都已通过。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) Both the root cause and the fix were established by **measuring activity inside the browser** (navigation count, pattern-flip count, two engines) rather than by judging that it "looks better" — but whether it *sounds* right still needs your confirmation on Safari. (2) The WebKit here is WebKitGTK on Linux, **not macOS Safari**; reproducing and fixing it on WebKit is a bonus, but please repeat the same actions in real Safari. (3) The new matrix check **depends on the app's own activity**: if routing ever stops using `pushState`, the navigation count becomes 0 and the check will (correctly) fail, so the criterion needs updating with it. (4) The slow track was not re-run here — the agreement to run it on the faster machine stands. This release changes three source files plus one E2E check, and the fast track, the 7-target matrix, redlines/docs/version/budget and the four evidence gates are all green.

title.zh: v2.0.19 三项使用反馈：钢琴卷帘默认满宽（并可全屏/收起/关闭）、GS-1 与换音色的卡顿根因、轨道检查器改成分类 tab
title.en: v2.0.19 Three pieces of feedback from real use: the piano roll fills the width by default (and can go fullscreen, collapse or close), the root causes behind the GS-1 and timbre-switch stalls, and a tabbed track inspector

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘只有屏幕 1/3 宽——因为格子宽度是写死的像素**。第一版用 `ZOOMS = [14, 20, 26, …]` 直接当格子宽度，于是音符网格永远是 `步数 × 26px`：16 步就是 416px，在 1440px 的屏幕上正好约 1/3，抽屉剩下的地方全空着。现在缩放是**相对容器宽度的倍数**（用 `ResizeObserver` 量抽屉宽度再算格子宽），默认 1× 就是**铺满**，缩放按钮从 0.5× 到 2× 在此基础上放大缩小；格子宽有 10px 下限（32 步在窄屏上不会被压成看不见）。新增两个状态：**全屏**（`fixed inset-0`，带安全区内边距，Esc 先退全屏再关面板，因为那是更小的一步）与**收起**（只留工具栏——轨选择、缩放、移调、关闭都还在，编辑区卸载）。E2E 量的是几何：网格宽度必须 ≥ 抽屉宽度 − 60px、全屏盒子必须覆盖视口、收起后编辑区必须消失而工具栏必须还在。
highlights.en: **The piano roll was about a third of the screen because its cell width was a hard-coded pixel size.** The first version used `ZOOMS = [14, 20, 26, …]` as the cell width directly, so the note grid was always `steps × 26px` — 416 px for a 16-step pattern, almost exactly a third of a 1440 px screen, with the rest of the drawer empty. Zoom is now a **factor on a cell width derived from the measured container** (a `ResizeObserver` watches the drawer), so the default 1× **fills** it and the zoom buttons scale from 0.5× to 2×; the cell width has a 10 px floor so a 32-step pattern on a phone does not collapse into nothing. Two new states came with it: **fullscreen** (`fixed inset-0` with safe-area padding; Escape leaves fullscreen first, because that is the smaller step) and **collapsed** (toolbar only — track selector, zoom, transpose and close all remain — with the editor unmounted). The E2E checks the geometry: the grid must be at least the drawer width minus 60 px, the fullscreen box must cover the viewport, and collapsing must remove the editor while keeping the toolbar.

highlights.zh: **GS-1 开关与播放中换音色的卡顿，根因有三个，都在主线程的生命周期上**。① **每次换音色都在重建 host**：`ensureTrack`/`tryPlay` 把「乐器名不同」当成「拆掉这个 slot、重新加载一个 host」，于是从一个 GS-1 patch 换到另一个，会先销毁一个完全可用的 worklet、让接下来几个音**回退到原生引擎**、等新 host 编译完再切回来——听感就是「换音色没反应，过一会儿才变」。host 与乐器无关（patch 只是一组参数），现在**就地把新 patch 推给同一个 host**；新乐器若没有 GS-1 patch（例如钢琴这类刻意保留原生的），也只是**不用**它发声，host 仍然留着，切回来是即时的。② **关闭 GS-1 时同步销毁**：`releaseAll()` + `dispose()` 原本都写在点击处理里，正在播放时等于在主线程上拆掉每个 worklet 节点并释放 WASM——这就是「一切就像卡住」。现在**先静音、后释放**：`releaseAll()` 立即执行（声音立刻停），销毁延后 3 秒；在这 3 秒内切回来则**取消销毁**，已加载的 host 留着，等于白得一次瞬时开关。③ **每次 pattern 提交都重推 8 条插入链**：`setPattern` 在**每一次**提交时都会跑（切一步、换音色、拖完一次力度），而它逐轨调 `setTrackInsert`。现在只重推**真正变了**的轨，并把 `resolveTrackInsertForGenre` 的结果按「曲风|角色」记忆化（它每次都新建对象，而这里正是靠对象标识判断「没变」）；诊断计数 `getPatternInsertApplications()` 让省下来的工作量可被测试断言（改一条轨的链条 = 1 次而不是 8 次）。
highlights.en: **The stalls around the GS-1 switch and around switching timbre during playback have three root causes, all of them main-thread lifecycle work.** (1) **Every timbre change rebuilt the host**: `ensureTrack`/`tryPlay` treated "a different instrument" as "tear this slot down and load another host", so switching from one GS-1 patch to another disposed a perfectly usable worklet, played the next notes on the **native** engine while the replacement compiled, and only then switched back — heard as "the timbre did not change, then it did". A host is instrument-agnostic (a patch is just parameters), so the new patch is now pushed **into the same host**; if the new instrument has no GS-1 patch at all (a piano, deliberately left native), the host is simply not used for it and **stays alive**, which makes switching back immediate. (2) **Switching GS-1 off disposed synchronously**, inside the click handler: tearing down every worklet node and freeing its WASM on the main thread while the transport runs is precisely the "it feels stuck" report. It is now **silence first, release later**: `releaseAll()` runs immediately (the sound stops at once) and the disposal is deferred by three seconds; rejoining inside that window **cancels** it and keeps the loaded hosts, so a quick off/on is free. (3) **Every pattern commit re-pushed all eight insert chains.** `setPattern` runs on *every* commit (a step, a timbre, a coalesced drag) and it called `setTrackInsert` per track. It now re-applies only the tracks that actually changed, and memoises `resolveTrackInsertForGenre` per (genre, role) — that resolver allocates, and object identity is exactly how "unchanged" is decided here. The diagnostic counter `getPatternInsertApplications()` makes the saving assertable in tests (editing one track's chain is 1 application, not 8).

highlights.zh: **一个可复用的测量脚本，因为「卡」不能靠读代码断言**：`scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs` 在真实浏览器里量每个交互的 **点击→DOM 真的反映变化** 的延迟，以及期间主线程的 **long task**（>50ms 的阻塞；那正是「卡住」的感觉，也是会饿死调度器前瞻的东西）。第一次写它时我把固定 `setTimeout` 当成 settle，于是把一个几毫秒的状态翻转量成了 8 秒——现在的 inspect 等的是**可观测状态**（`aria-pressed` 翻转、选项 `aria-selected` 变 true、格子 `aria-selected` 改变）。本机（无头 Chromium，桌面视口，同一脚本同一条件）修复前后：**GS-1 关 119.5 → 38.8 ms、开 71.5 → 23.9 ms**（约 3 倍）；**换音色 81/160/215/108 → 89/81/63/59 ms**（最差那个从 215 ms 降到 63 ms）；切一步 59.6 → 45.1 ms；long task 前后都是 0。**诚实说明：在开发机上没有复现出用户描述的那种卡顿**（0 个 long task），所以这次修的是**会产生该卡顿的机制**，而不是「我看到了同一个现象」；脚本已入库，可以在真正出问题的那台机器上直接跑。
highlights.en: **A reusable probe, because "it stutters" cannot be asserted by reading code.** `scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs` measures, in a real browser, each interaction's **click → the DOM actually reflecting it** latency plus the main thread's **long tasks** during it (>50 ms of blocking is what "stuck" feels like, and it is what starves the scheduler's lookahead). The first version of the probe used a fixed `setTimeout` as its settle, which is how it reported eight seconds for a toggle that settles in milliseconds; it now waits for the **observable** state (`aria-pressed` flipping, an option's `aria-selected` becoming true, a cell's `aria-selected` changing). On this machine (headless Chromium, desktop viewport, same probe and conditions), before → after: **GS-1 off 119.5 → 38.8 ms and on 71.5 → 23.9 ms** (about 3x faster); **timbre switches 81/160/215/108 → 89/81/63/59 ms** (the worst case drops from 215 ms to 63 ms); toggling a step 59.6 → 45.1 ms; long tasks were zero in both runs. **Stated honestly: the stall the user described was not reproduced on the development machine** (no long tasks at all), so what this release fixes are the *mechanisms that would produce it* rather than an observed reproduction — and the probe ships so it can be run where it happens.

highlights.zh: **轨道检查器改成三个 tab**（音色 / 混音 / 效果），并按「切换要即时、状态不能丢」来做：三个分组**始终挂载**，用 `hidden` 属性切换可见性——所以切 tab 不会重新挂载（滑条位置、音色搜索框里的关键词、正在拖动的状态都还在），切换是瞬时的。**M/S 移到了头部**：静音和独奏是随时要按的东西，不该藏在某个 tab 后面（E2E 断言它们不在任何 `[hidden]` 祖先里）。分组标题复用了已有的 `track_inspector_section_*` 文案，没有新增重复的 i18n。
highlights.en: **The track inspector is now three tabs** (Timbre / Mix / Effects), built so that switching is instant and nothing is thrown away: all three groups stay **mounted** and are toggled with the `hidden` attribute, so changing tabs does not remount them — a slider keeps its position, the timbre search keeps its query, a drag in progress survives. **Mute and solo moved into the header**: those are pressed constantly and must not be behind a tab (the E2E asserts neither has a `[hidden]` ancestor). The tab labels reuse the existing `track_inspector_section_*` strings rather than adding parallel i18n.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① ② 的三个修复里，**没有任何一条是靠听感确认的**：单测断言的是「不再做的工作」（host 不再重建、关闭不再同步销毁、未变的链路不再重推），浏览器里量的是几何与 long task；「现在听上去不卡了」仍需在你那台机器上确认，`node scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs --url <线上地址>` 可以直接对着线上跑。② 本机测得的延迟是**点击到 DOM 变化**，不是音频故障（真正的爆音/丢步需要音频线程侧的测量，本版没做）。③ 钢琴卷帘的全屏状态**不持久化**（每次打开都是普通抽屉）；「收起」同理，但在一次会话内保持。④ 检查器的三个 tab **不做记忆**：每次打开都回到「音色」页。⑤ GS-1 关闭后的 3 秒宽限期是一个取舍（切回来免费 vs 关掉后最多 3 秒才释放内存）；如果更在意常驻内存，可以把它改成 0 并接受每次开关都重新加载。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) None of the three fixes was confirmed by listening: the unit tests assert the work that is *no longer done* (no host rebuild, no synchronous teardown, no re-push of unchanged chains) and the browser measures geometry and long tasks; that it now *sounds* responsive still needs to be confirmed on your machine, and `node scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs --url <live url>` can be pointed at production for exactly that. (2) What was measured here is click-to-DOM-change latency, not audio glitches — real dropouts would need measurement on the audio thread, which this release does not do. (3) The piano roll's fullscreen state is **not persisted** (every open starts as a normal drawer), and neither is the collapsed state, though both persist within a session. (4) The inspector does **not** remember the last tab: it opens on Timbre each time. (5) The three-second grace period after switching GS-1 off is a trade-off (instant switching back vs up to three seconds before the memory is released); if resident memory matters more, set it to zero and accept a reload on every toggle.

title.zh: v2.0.18 快机器慢轨包读回（并修掉它暴露的两个工具缺陷）+ 用户报告的 8 项：GS-1 三个现场缺陷、设置面板、和弦时值可见、检查器浮层/停靠、未保存提醒、钢琴卷帘
title.en: v2.0.18 The fast-machine slow-track pack read back (and the two tooling defects it exposed) + the eight reported items: three live GS-1 defects, the settings panel, visible chord length, a floating/docked inspector, an unsaved-changes guard, and a piano roll

highlights.zh: **M2 Max 上的慢轨包读回，四个小时级测量跨机复现**（15 门禁过 / 1 红 / 36 个文件哈希校验通过）：响度 trim 后 max |Δ| **0.115 dB**、mean 0.002；音色 13 段形状 max **0.14 dB**，最近一对**完全相同**（future-house ↔ acid-techno 0.2759）；GS-1 时序中位 −198.6 → −198.7 ms。**最有价值的一条是 GS-1 负载**：16 复音的 p90 从本机 0.336 掉到 **0.035**、实时比 0.578 → **0.998**——也就是说 E3 得出的「8 复音上限」是**我这台 2011 年 CPU 的上限，不是代码的上限**。红的那一个门禁是全量套件：**167 个失败全部是存储类测试**，真因是那台机器是 **Node v26.8.2**，较新的 Node 暴露了自己的全局 `localStorage`，而 Vitest 的 jsdom 环境只为「globalThis 上尚不存在的键」安装 jsdom 全局，于是可用实现永远没落地。测试套件对宿主 Node 版本敏感是不可接受的：`src/test/webStorage.ts` 现在显式安装（优先 jsdom 自己的实现，否则完整语义的 Map 实现），并用 6 条测试覆盖，其中一条**直接复现 Node 26 的形态**。
highlights.en: **The slow-track pack from the M2 Max was read back, and all four hour-long measurements reproduce across machines** (15 gates passed / 1 red / 36 files hash-verified): post-trim loudness max |delta| **0.115 dB**, mean 0.002; timbre 13-band shape max **0.14 dB** with the closest pair **identical** (future-house vs acid-techno, 0.2759); GS-1 jitter median -198.6 to -198.7 ms. **The most valuable number is the GS-1 load**: at 16 voices p90 fell from 0.336 here to **0.035**, and the real-time ratio from 0.578 to **0.998** — meaning the "8-voice ceiling" E3 derived is a limit of **this 2011-era CPU, not of the code**. The one red gate was the full suite: **all 167 failures were storage-backed tests**, and the cause is that the machine runs **Node v26.8.2**, where newer Node exposes its own global `localStorage` while Vitest's jsdom environment only installs jsdom globals for keys *not already present* on `globalThis` — so the working implementation never landed. A test suite that depends on the host's Node version is not acceptable, so `src/test/webStorage.ts` now installs it explicitly (jsdom's own when usable, otherwise a full-semantics Map implementation) with six tests, one of which **reproduces the Node 26 shape directly**.

highlights.zh: **同一个包还暴露了我自己工具的一个真实缺陷**：`--measure` 花 22 分钟跑完四份测量，包里四项「新测量 vs 已提交基线」**全部返回 no matching genre ids**——第一版对比函数在**猜报告结构**（找 `genres` 数组和 `id` 字段），而四份报告实际都按**对象映射**按曲风 id 索引，GS-1 两份更不是按曲风索引的。现在每个报告一个显式适配器（响度 `trimmedLufs` / 音色 13 段形状距离 / GS-1 负载按复音数 / GS-1 时序按策略），字段名写死，无法识别就明确报不可比；`verify` 还会**用本仓库的基线重算一遍**再打印，所以旧打包器产出的包也能被正确解读，适配器坏掉会显示成 NOT COMPARABLE 而不是四个沉默的空答案。
highlights.en: **The same pack exposed a real defect in my own tooling.** `--measure` spent 22 minutes producing four measurements, and all four "fresh measurement vs committed baseline" comparisons came back `no matching genre ids`: the first version of the comparison *guessed* at the report shapes (looking for a `genres` array and an `id` field), whereas every report actually keys its genres by **object map** — and the two GS-1 reports are not genre-keyed at all. Each report now has an explicit adapter (loudness `trimmedLufs`, timbre 13-band shape distance, GS-1 load by voice count, GS-1 jitter by strategy) with the field names written out; an unrecognised shape reports NOT COMPARABLE instead of comparing nothing. `verify` also **recomputes the comparison against this repository's baselines**, so a package made by an older packer is still read correctly and a broken adapter shows up loudly rather than as four silent non-answers.

highlights.zh: **GS-1 三个现场缺陷，全部是接线/归属问题而不是合成器问题**：① **和弦时值被平方**——`chordNoteDuration()` 内部已经乘过发音法的 `gateScale`，GS-1 这条路又乘了一次，于是 stab(0.3) 变成 0.09×（13 ms 的咔哒）、sustain(3.0) 变成 9×（近一秒长鸣），而且**现场与导出不再对等**（导出只乘一次），违反本仓库的硬规则；现在两条路共用 `chordNoteDuration` 与 `chordVoiceOnset`。② **试听会拆掉正在用的 host**——试听走 master 输出、播放走轨道通道条，而 voice pool 把「目标节点不同」当成「重建这个 slot」，于是试听与播放互相拆 host，下一次音符发现 slot 不匹配就回退原生并再次触发重建，形成抖动循环（正是「试听有延迟或不响」）；host 输出只连一次，目标节点不再作为重建理由，真实变化（换乐器）仍然重建，试听也改为走轨道通道条。③ **停止后还有几个音**——GS-1 声部在 worklet 自己的分配器里，不在原生 `voiceRegistry`，`panic()` 从来没碰过它们；sustain 和弦计划长 3 步，停止后自然还在响，现在 `panic()` 一并 `releaseAll()`（allNotesOff，不拆 host，可立即续播）。
highlights.en: **Three live GS-1 defects, all wiring/ownership rather than synth problems.** (1) **Chord length was squared**: `chordNoteDuration()` already multiplies by the articulation's `gateScale`, and the GS-1 path multiplied by it again, so a stab (0.3) became 0.09x — a 13 ms click — and a sustain (3.0) became 9x, ringing for most of a second; it also meant **live and export no longer agreed** (the exporter multiplies once), breaking a hard rule of this repository. Both paths now share `chordNoteDuration` and `chordVoiceOnset`. (2) **Auditioning tore down the live host**: audition routes to the master output while playback routes to the track strip, and the voice pool treated "different destination" as "rebuild this slot", so audition and playback destroyed each other's hosts — the next note found a mismatched slot, fell back to native and triggered another rebuild, a churn loop that is exactly the reported "audition has latency or does not sound". A host's output is connected once, so the destination is no longer a rebuild reason; a real change (a different instrument) still rebuilds, and audition now goes through the track strip where a preview belongs. (3) **Notes kept sounding after stop**: GS-1 voices live in the worklet's own allocator, not in the native `voiceRegistry`, so `panic()` never touched them — and a sustain chord is scheduled three steps long. `panic()` now calls `releaseAll()` too (all-notes-off, hosts kept alive, playback resumes immediately).

highlights.zh: **四个界面/交互问题**：① **找不到新架构总开关**——开关确实存在，但藏在工作台工具栏**收起的**高级抽屉里，对全局引擎开关来说位置就是错的；新增四类 tab 的 `SettingsModal`（音频/演奏/界面/关于），入口放在用户点名的位置——**语言切换与版本号之间**（有单测与 E2E 断言位置顺序，不只是存在）。GS-1 开关此前每个界面各存一份 `useState` 镜像，正是「面板关了、工具栏还显示开」的成因；现在 `useGs1Setting` 订阅调度器真正读取的模块状态，工具栏/音频页/关于页同增同减，E2E 里真的做了「面板关掉 → 工具栏芯片必须变 OFF → 复原」。② **和弦长度看不到**：数据差 10 倍（56 stab / 44 sustain / 27 comp / 23 block / 8 strum / 1 roll），引擎也照此演奏，但界面画的是原始 `gate`（所有曲风默认 0.8）且 0.8 时整条隐藏——显示说「所有曲风一样」而声音不是；现在时值条显示引擎真正使用的 `gate × 1.5 × 发音法`，超过一步改成琥珀色「会响过这一格」，tooltip 写明倍数。③ **检查器位置**：它此前在文档流里、渲染在音序器**之后**（手机上出现在整页最下面、桌面上把布局顶来顶去）；现在手机=贴底满宽底部抽屉（遮罩/Esc/× 可关），桌面=左侧全高停靠（刻意不加遮罩，因为检查器的意义就是边看边改）。④ **音色选择**：115 项扁平 `<select>` 变成搜索框 + 分类标签 + GS-1 徽章，分类表用「命名规则 + 显式例外」并配完整性测试（0 遗漏 0 重复），只有 E2E 抓得到的一个真实缺陷是**搜索原本受当前分类限制**——在键盘轨上搜 `reese` 什么也搜不到，读起来像「这个音色不存在」，现在搜索是全局的。
highlights.en: **Four interface problems.** (1) **The new-architecture switch could not be found** — it existed, but inside the studio toolbar's *collapsed* advanced drawer, which is the wrong place for a global engine setting. A four-tab `SettingsModal` (Audio / Feel / Interface / About) now sits exactly where the user asked for it: **between the language switch and the version button** (asserted by unit test *and* by an E2E check of their left-to-right order, not merely their existence). The GS-1 switch had been mirrored in a `useState` per surface, which is how a panel can say OFF while the toolbar says ON; `useGs1Setting` now subscribes to the module state the schedulers actually read, so the toolbar, the audio tab and the About tab move together — and the E2E really does "turn it off in the panel, require the toolbar chip to read OFF, then restore". (2) **Chord length was invisible**: the data spans 10x (56 stab / 44 sustain / 27 comp / 23 block / 8 strum / 1 roll) and the engine plays it, but the UI drew the raw `gate` — 0.8 for every genre's defaults, and hidden entirely at exactly 0.8 — so the display claimed every genre was identical while the audio was not. The bar now shows the length the engine actually uses (`gate x 1.5 x articulation`), turns amber with a tail marker when it rings past its step, and states the multiplier in its tooltip. (3) **Inspector placement**: it used to render in normal flow *after* the sequencer (below everything on a phone, shoving the layout on desktop). It is now a bottom sheet on phones (dismissible by scrim, Escape or the close button) and a full-height left dock on desktop, deliberately without a scrim because watching the track while editing is the point. (4) **Timbre selection**: a flat 115-row `<select>` became a search box, category chips and GS-1 badges, backed by a rule-plus-overrides table with a completeness test (zero omissions, zero duplicates). The one real defect only the E2E could catch: **search was scoped to the current category**, so typing `reese` on a keys track found nothing and read as "this timbre does not exist" — search is global now.

highlights.zh: **两个更大的功能，都以「编辑同一份数据」为硬前提**。① **未保存修改提醒**：`SET_GENRE` 会把 A/B **两个**槽位都替换成新曲风的默认值，所以点击另一个曲风是**全丢**、而且当时没有任何询问。新增守卫覆盖同类动作（切换曲风、载入工程、Inspire Me 生成变体、导入 MIDI、重置预设；**切换 A/B 槽位不算**，因为两个槽位都保留）；排查同类场景时把守卫**下沉到 `switchGenre` 这个唯一收口**，于是轨道栏、骰子随机、以及**导航路径**（从探索/搜索/随机曲风进工作台）都被问到——顺带发现并修掉那条路径上的第二个缺陷：它此前只做 `SET_GENRE`，**不应用新曲风的鼓组与 FX 默认值**，于是从探索页进来会得到「新曲风的 pattern + 上一个曲风的鼓组和机架」，UI 是保存/丢弃/取消 + 「下次不再提醒」（持久化，读取仍是防御式：损坏或版本不认识就回落到**继续询问**）。判定刻意**不用脏标记**——脏标记要让二十多个变更动作各自记得置位、每个载入动作记得清零，漏掉一个就让提示在错误方向上说谎；这里改成**重新生成该曲风的默认值再比对**（`patternFromGenre` 是确定的），无状态且自我校正，实测**159 个曲风刚载入时 0 个误报**。保存失败或用户还没有工程时**绝不执行**破坏性动作（没有工程就先打开工程中心让你命名，保存不能是死路）。② **钢琴卷帘**：调研了姊妹项目 `synth` 的卷帘（MIT），结论是**借鉴思路、重写实现**——它那两个纯模块（`roll.ts`/`selection.ts`）可以近乎原样移植，但它的数据模型是绝对节拍的自由音符（可重叠、任意起点），而本仓库是**每步单音网格**（`steps[i]`/`pitch[i]`/`gate[i]` 为一步的倍数）；忠实移植约 2200–2800 行且要双向映射两套模型，等于同时维护两份真相。本版的做法是 450 行贴合本仓库模型的实现，**直接编辑工作台那份数据**（整体 `COMMIT_PATTERN` 提交，一次手势一条撤销，撤销用同一套历史），限制在界面上明说：起点对齐网格、音长以「步」为单位、每轨单音。E2E 断言的是**跨视图**：在卷帘里画一个音，**步进网格必须出现该步**。
highlights.en: **Two larger features, both requiring that they edit the same data.** (1) **Unsaved-changes guard**: `SET_GENRE` replaces **both** A and B slots with the new genre's defaults, so clicking another genre lost everything — with no question asked. A guard now covers that and the same class of actions (genre switch, project load, Inspire Me, MIDI import, reset preset; **switching A/B slots is not gated**, because both slots are kept). Auditing the similar cases moved the guard down to `switchGenre`, the single choke point, so the rail, the dice button and **navigation** (Explore / search / a random genre opening the studio) are all asked — which surfaced a second defect on that path: it only ran `SET_GENRE`, **without applying the new genre's drum kit or FX defaults**, so arriving from Explore gave you the new pattern with the previous genre's kit and rack, offering save / discard / cancel plus a persisted "do not ask again" (read defensively: a corrupt or unknown-version payload falls back to **asking** again). Detection deliberately avoids a dirty flag: a flag requires twenty-odd mutating actions to remember to set it and every load path to clear it, and one omission makes the prompt lie in the expensive direction. Instead the genre's default is **regenerated and compared** (`patternFromGenre` is deterministic) — stateless and self-correcting, measured at **zero false positives across all 159 freshly loaded genres**. A failed save, or a user with no project yet, **never** proceeds with the destructive action (no project opens the hub to name one first; saving must not be a dead end). (2) **Piano roll**: the sibling `synth` project's roll (MIT) was investigated, and the verdict is *borrow the idea, rewrite the implementation* — its two pure modules (`roll.ts`, `selection.ts`) would port almost verbatim, but its model is free-floating notes in absolute beats (overlapping, arbitrary starts) while this repository is a **per-step monophonic grid** (`steps[i]`, `pitch[i]`, and `gate[i]` as a multiple of one step). A faithful port is ~2,200–2,800 lines plus bidirectional mapping between two models — two sources of truth to keep honest. This release ships a 450-line implementation fitted to this repository's model that **edits the studio's own data** (one whole-`COMMIT_PATTERN` per gesture, so undo comes from the same history), with its limits stated in the UI: starts snap to the grid, length is counted in steps, one note per step per track. The E2E assertion is **cross-view**: draw a note in the roll and the **step grid must show that step**.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① ③④⑥ 这三个「听感」问题的修复，在无头浏览器里可验证的是**引擎被要求演奏什么**（帧、时值、目标节点、静音调用），**不是听感**——「听起来对齐了、不响了」仍需人耳确认。② 钢琴卷帘是**最小可用版**：无框选、无复制粘贴、无量化菜单、无多轨叠显；姊妹项目那两个纯模块已确认可移植，是下一版加这些能力的低成本路径。③ 检查器的桌面停靠**没有**「收起成侧边标签」的折叠态。④ 设置面板里的「布局默认值」写入的是**下次启动**的偏好（本次会话仍以工作台里的开关为准），界面上写明了。⑤ GS-1 复音上限按设备分档需要**移动端数据**，本版没有改上限（现代机器 16 复音有余量这条已经记录在 §5.18.1）。⑥ 慢轨仍未在本机跑，按约定交给快机器执行（`node scripts/slow_pack.mjs run`）。⑦ 既有未验证项未变：移动端未实测、`loudness_live_baseline.json` 未重测、GS-1 请求 24/32 复音只出 16 个音的成因未查明。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) For the three listening complaints (3, 4 and 6), what a headless browser can verify is **what the engine was asked to play** — frames, durations, destination nodes, the all-notes-off call — **not what it sounds like**. "It lines up now" and "it stops ringing now" still need a human ear. (2) The piano roll is a **minimal usable version**: no marquee selection, no copy/paste, no quantise menu, no multi-track overlay. The sibling project's two pure modules are confirmed portable and are the cheap path to those features next. (3) The inspector's desktop dock has **no** collapse-to-a-side-tab state. (4) The settings panel's layout defaults are written for the **next launch** (the current session still follows the studio's own toggles), and the UI says so. (5) Tiering the GS-1 polyphony ceiling by device needs **mobile data**; this release does not change the ceiling (that modern machines have headroom at 16 voices is recorded in the plan, §5.18.1). (6) The slow track still has not run on this machine — by agreement it runs on the faster one (`node scripts/slow_pack.mjs run`). (7) Previously recorded unverified items are unchanged: mobile remains unmeasured, `loudness_live_baseline.json` has never been re-measured, and why 24/32 requested GS-1 voices produce only 16 sounding voices is still unexplained.

title.zh: v2.0.17 音频设置面板：在引擎里躺了很久的三个设置第一次有了 UI，GS-1 开关搬进设置；另附慢轨交接打包器
title.en: v2.0.17 The audio settings panel: three settings that had been sitting in the engine get a UI at last, the GS-1 switch moves into settings, and the slow track gets a handoff packer

highlights.zh: **三个设置实现了、持久化了、却没有任何 UI**：`latencyCompensationMs`、`hearingProtection`、`maxVolumeLimit` 自 P4-05 起就在 `AudioEngine` 里（连 `groove_audio_settings_v1` 的持久化都写好了），但全仓库没有一个控件能改它们——想调只能开控制台。GS-1 的开关（用户要求「默认开启、用户可以手动关」）此前只落在工具栏抽屉里。新增 `AudioSettingsModal`：四个设置一处集中，工具栏保留一个齿轮入口与 GS-1 快捷开关。**关键约束：面板显示的是引擎的值，不是它自己的猜测**——每次打开都从引擎重读（工具栏/调音台可能刚改过），每次写入后**重新读回**，所以显示的是引擎**夹取后**的结果而不是用户拖到的数字（上限夹在 0.1–1.0、延迟补偿夹在 ±100 ms）。听力保护关闭时上限滑条**禁用**——那个上限此时真的不生效，让它可拖就是在骗人。GS-1 的读写只有**一条**路径（由视图持有，工具栏与面板共用），两处显示不可能不一致。
highlights.en: **Three settings were implemented, persisted, and unreachable.** `latencyCompensationMs`, `hearingProtection` and `maxVolumeLimit` have lived in `AudioEngine` since P4-05 — persistence into `groove_audio_settings_v1` included — with no control anywhere in the app, so changing them meant opening the console. The GS-1 switch (the user asked for on-by-default with a manual off) existed only in the toolbar drawer. The new `AudioSettingsModal` gathers all four in one place, with a gear entry point and the GS-1 quick toggle left in the toolbar. **The binding constraint: the panel shows the engine's values, never its own guesses** — it re-reads from the engine on every open (the toolbar or console may have just changed them) and re-reads after every write, so it displays what the engine actually *clamped* to rather than the number the user dragged to (the limit is clamped to 0.1-1.0, compensation to +/-100 ms). The limit slider is **disabled** while hearing protection is off, because the limit genuinely does not apply then and a draggable control would be a lie. The GS-1 value has exactly **one** write path, owned by the view and shared with the toolbar, so the two can never disagree.

highlights.zh: **这一版没有给引擎加任何能力，它只是**把已有的能力接出来**——所以测试断言的是接线而不是新 DSP：面板渲染的是引擎的当前值而非默认值；改总音量会走 `setMasterVolume` 并显示被上限压住的**有效**电平；关掉听力保护会调用 `setHearingProtection(false)` 且禁用上限滑条（且不去写上限）；延迟超范围时显示夹取后的值；限幅器状态如实显示（worklet 真峰值 / 压缩器降级方案）；GS-1 开关只委托给视图、**不**自己去改引擎；以及用**真实 `AudioEngine`** 跑一遍端到端夹取（上限 0.5 + 总音量 1.0 → 面板必须显示 50%）。
highlights.en: **This release adds no engine capability — it only connects one up** — so the tests assert wiring, not new DSP: the panel renders the engine's current values rather than its own defaults; moving the master fader goes through `setMasterVolume` and shows the **effective** level held down by the limit; switching hearing protection off calls `setHearingProtection(false)` and disables the limit slider (without writing the limit); an out-of-range latency request displays the clamped value; the limiter state is reported honestly (true-peak worklet vs compressor fallback); the GS-1 switch delegates to the view and does **not** touch the engine itself; and a **real `AudioEngine`** exercises the clamping end to end (limit 0.5 with the fader at 1.0 must read 50%).

highlights.zh: **慢轨交接打包器 `scripts/slow_pack.mjs`**：`npm run slow` 有两个不适合长跑的性质——第一个红门禁直接退出（你拿不到「还坏了哪些」），证据只存在于会滚掉的终端里。新脚本**每个门禁都跑**，各自落一份完整日志，把关键数字抽进 `SUMMARY.md`，并把日志 + 实测产物 + **精确 git 状态（含未提交改动的 patch）** + **逐文件 SHA-256** 打成带校验和的压缩包。四个模式：`export`（把当前这棵树打包带走，因为仓库**没有 remote**）、`run`（跑门禁并打包，退出码 0 全绿 / 3 有红门禁但包可用 / 4 打包器自身出错）、`verify`（回来时校验：容器摘要、逐文件哈希、门禁完整性、以及这份结果**能不能归属到某个提交**）、`list`。`--measure` 会把小时级的四个测量**写进包里**（`--out`），因此**已提交的基线永远不会被另一台机器静默改写**；包回来时 `SUMMARY.md` 会给出「新测量 vs 已提交基线」的逐曲风对比——这是第二台机器**唯一**能回答的问题：我们提交的基线是代码的性质，还是那台机器的怪癖。
highlights.en: **A slow-track handoff packer, `scripts/slow_pack.mjs`.** `npm run slow` has two properties that make it a poor long run: it exits at the first red gate (so you never learn what *else* is broken) and its evidence exists only in a scrolling terminal. The new script runs **every gate regardless**, writes a full log per gate, extracts the numbers that matter into `SUMMARY.md`, and packs the logs plus measurement artifacts plus the **exact git state (including a patch of uncommitted changes)** and a **per-file SHA-256** into a checksummed tarball. Four modes: `export` (package this tree for transfer, because the repository has **no remote**), `run` (run the gates and package; exit 0 all green / 3 red gates but the package is usable / 4 the packer itself failed), `verify` (on the way back: container digest, per-file hashes, gate completeness, and whether the results can be **attributed to a commit**), and `list`. `--measure` writes the four hours-long measurements **into the package** via `--out`, so the **committed baselines can never be silently rewritten by another machine**; when the package returns, `SUMMARY.md` carries a per-genre comparison of the fresh measurement against the committed baseline — the one question a second machine is uniquely able to answer: is our baseline a property of the code, or a quirk of that machine?

highlights.zh: **打包器自己是被自检抓出来的**（五个真实缺陷，全部在交付前修掉）：① `git diff` 被通用的 `trim()` 去掉尾换行，`git apply` 判定为 **corrupt patch**，于是包**无法归属到任何提交**——这正是这个包存在的意义，必须修；② `SUMMARY.md` 在生成哈希清单**之后**才写，于是**人唯一会读的那份文件恰好是唯一没有哈希担保的文件**；③ `--only` 的子集包被当成「缺门禁」判为完整性失败，而**诚实的子集不是缺陷**——现在按它自己声明的范围核对，并显眼标成 **PARTIAL**；④ 反向可应用的 patch（= 这棵树本来就含这份改动，是本地核对的**正常**情形）被误判为不可归属，现在正向/反向分别判定，只有**两个方向都不行**才报错。自检手段：`--selftest`（一绿一红两条假门禁，验证失败路径与退出码 3）、一次真实的 `run --only docs,redlines`、以及 `verify` 对上述两个包的校验。⑤ `export` 用 `git archive` 打包，快机器上的树里**根本没有 `.git`**，结果包会带着空的 commit sha 回来——同样等于无法归属；现在无 `.git` 时从 `export` 写下的 `COMMIT.txt` 读取提交信息，并在 MANIFEST/SUMMARY/终端里写明归属来源。
highlights.en: **The packer was caught by its own self-check** — five real defects, all fixed before delivery. (1) `git diff` went through a generic `trim()`, losing its trailing newline, so `git apply` called it a **corrupt patch** and the package could **not be attributed to any commit** — precisely the thing the package exists to establish. (2) `SUMMARY.md` was written *after* the hash list was generated, making the one document a human reads the one file nothing vouched for. (3) A `--only` subset package was judged an integrity failure for "missing gates", but **an honest subset is not a defect** — it is now checked against the scope it declared and marked **PARTIAL** prominently. (4) A reverse-applicable patch (meaning the tree already contains the change — the *normal* local case) was misread as unattributable; forward and reverse are now judged separately and only "neither direction applies" is an error. How this was established: `--selftest` (two fake gates, one green and one red, exercising the failure path and exit code 3), a real `run --only docs,redlines`, and `verify` against both of those packages. (5) `export` packages the tree with `git archive`, so the faster machine has **no `.git` at all** and the results package came back with an empty commit sha — equally unattributable; a tree without `.git` now reads the commit from the `COMMIT.txt` the export writes, and MANIFEST/SUMMARY/terminal all state where the attribution came from.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① `scripts/slow_pack.mjs` **没有单元测试**——它的正确性目前由上面那三样自检证明；`verify` 能证明包**没被改动过**，不能证明包里的门禁**判断正确**。② 面板只有 jsdom 级测试，**没有浏览器级断言**（弹窗的开关、焦点陷阱、Esc/遮罩关闭都应由共享的 `Modal` 组件自己的覆盖负责；本仓库的 7 端 E2E 矩阵目前**没有**音频设置面板的用例）。③ 打包器**不会让门禁变快**，它只是去掉 fail-fast 与证据丢失；把慢轨搬到快机器仍是人工动作。④ `--measure` 的跨机对比只**报告**差异（比较了多少曲风、最大/平均 |Δ|、差得最远的五个），**不判断**差异算不算 bug——那是人的决定，因为换浏览器/换 CPU 本来就会动数字。⑤ 既有未验证项未变：移动端仍未实测、`loudness_live_baseline.json` 仍未重测、GS-1 请求 24/32 复音只出 16 个音的成因仍未查明。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) `scripts/slow_pack.mjs` has **no unit tests** — its correctness currently rests on the three self-checks above; `verify` can prove the package **was not altered**, not that the gate verdicts inside it are **right**. (2) The panel has jsdom-level tests only and **no browser-level assertion** (opening, focus trapping and Esc/backdrop closing belong to the shared `Modal` component's own coverage; this repository's seven-target E2E matrix has **no** case for the audio settings panel). (3) The packer **does not make the gates faster** — it removes the fail-fast and the evidence loss; moving the slow track to a faster machine is still a manual step. (4) The cross-machine comparison in `--measure` only **reports** drift (genres compared, max/mean |delta|, the five worst); it does **not judge** whether drift is a bug — that is a human call, since a different browser or CPU moves the numbers by itself. (5) Previously recorded unverified items are unchanged: mobile remains unmeasured, `loudness_live_baseline.json` has still never been re-measured, and why 24/32 requested GS-1 voices produce only 16 sounding voices is still unexplained.

title.zh: v2.0.16 GS-1 正式默认接管 chords/lead：全库响度与音色重测通过（p90−p10 0.319 dB），工具栏可一键关闭
title.en: v2.0.16 GS-1 now voices chords/lead by default: the library was re-measured and re-balanced (p90-p10 0.319 dB), with a one-click switch in the toolbar

highlights.zh: **GS-1 正式生效**：`chords`/`lead` 默认由 GS-1 演奏——按帧寻址（采样精确：实测调度时刻发消息会早 198.6 ms、临响发消息仍有 11.8 ms 极差，现在两条路都不走）、8 复音上限（E3 实测可持续上限）、未就绪/超载/无 patch 一律回退原生。**工具栏高级抽屉里、触感开关旁有 `GS-1` 开关，可随时关闭并持久化**；关闭立即释放已加载的宿主。
highlights.en: **GS-1 is live by default**: `chords` and `lead` are voiced by GS-1 — frame-addressed (sample-accurate; the measured alternatives were 198.6 ms early when posting at scheduling time and an 11.8 ms spread posting at the last moment, and neither is used now), an 8-voice ceiling (E3's measured sustainable limit), and a native fallback whenever a host is not ready, is overloaded or has no patch. A **GS-1 switch sits beside the haptics toggle in the toolbar's advanced drawer**, can be turned off at any time and persists; turning it off releases the loaded hosts immediately.

highlights.zh: **重测与重配平（硬规则）**：开启改变电平与音色 ⇒ 重录两份基线并重配 159 条 trim。响度 **p90−p10 0.319 dB**（门禁 1.5）、全距 **2.82 dB**（门禁 4）、clamp **0/159**、削波 **0/159**、最差真峰值 **−1.094 dBTP**（0/159 超 −1.0）、目标 −15.716 LUFS；音色 **159/159 互异**。
highlights.en: **Re-measured and re-balanced (the hard rule).** Enabling it changes level and timbre, so both baselines were re-recorded and all 159 trims re-fit: loudness **p90-p10 0.319 dB** (limit 1.5), full range **2.82 dB** (limit 4), trim clamp **0/159**, clipping **0/159**, worst true peak **-1.094 dBTP** (0/159 over -1.0), target -15.716 LUFS; timbre **159/159 distinct**.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 音色最近一对距离从 GS-1 前的 0.3535 收到 **0.2759 dB**，相对 0.25 地板的余量只剩 **1.10×**——10 个 patch 覆盖 39 个乐器名让全库在这两个声部上更趋同，这是「统一乐器换一致性」的代价；要恢复辨识度应给 patch 加分化，不是放宽地板。② GS-1 的 patch 仍是**按参数语义写的、没有做过听感 A/B**——默认开启是产品决定，不是已证明更好听。③ 首次重测被我的 2 小时超时切断并留下不完整报告（p90−p10 1.65、部分 null），我没有用它配 trim，而是还原报告、提高到 4 小时重跑并加了进度落盘。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) The closest timbre pair tightened from 0.3535 before GS-1 to **0.2759 dB**, leaving only **1.10x** of margin over the 0.25 floor — ten patches covering 39 instrument names made the library more uniform in those two voices, which is the price of one consistent instrument. Recovering distinctness means differentiating the patches, not lowering the floor. (2) The GS-1 patches are still **written from parameter semantics with no listening A/B** — enabling by default is a product decision, not a claim that it sounds better. (3) The first re-run was cut off by my own two-hour timeout and left an incomplete report (p90-p10 1.65, some nulls); it was not used to fit trims — the report was restored, the budget raised to four hours, and progress flushing added.

title.zh: v2.0.15 GS-1 定点接入完成：按帧寻址的实时调度 + 离线对等 + parity 测试（默认关闭，等你决定是否开启）
title.en: v2.0.15 GS-1 integration complete: frame-addressed live scheduling, an offline-equivalent path and a parity test (off by default, awaiting your call on enabling it)

highlights.zh: **接线三块拼齐，代码路径完整**：① 上游 GS-1 v2.1.5 提供按帧寻址的 `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` 并报告常数延迟；② 本仓 `gs1Tracks.ts` 是**唯一**的帧算术实现（秒→帧、**减去延迟补偿**、顺序确定、8 复音上限）；③ **实时**：`Gs1VoicePool` 每轨一个 host，输出接该轨 insert 输入，命中路由即 `return`（否则与原生双重发声），未就绪时返回 false 让原生接手并在后台加载；④ **离线**：`WavExporter` 在 `startRendering()` 之前建好并 await host，渲染循环内保持同步、同样按帧寻址、同样命中即 return。
highlights.en: **All three pieces are in place.** (1) Upstream GS-1 v2.1.5 provides frame-addressed `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` and reports its constant latency. (2) This repo's `gs1Tracks.ts` is the **only** implementation of the frame arithmetic (seconds to frames, **latency subtraction**, deterministic ordering, the 8-voice ceiling). (3) **Live**: `Gs1VoicePool` keeps one host per track, feeds that track's insert input, and returns early when routing hits (otherwise GS-1 and the native engine would both sound); while a host is still loading it returns false so the native voice covers the note and the load continues in the background. (4) **Offline**: `WavExporter` creates and awaits its hosts before `startRendering()`, keeps the render loop synchronous, addresses events at the same frames and returns early the same way.

highlights.zh: **parity 由测试钉死**（`gs1ExportParity.test.ts`）：开关关闭时导出连 host 都不找（与以前逐字节一致）；开启时**离线事件帧 === 共享 planner 的帧 === 实时 pool 拿同样输入产生的帧**——这才是 parity 的正面表述：帧算术两边只有一份实现，谁再自己算一遍就是播放与导出漂移的开始；GS-1 接管的轨道不再产生原生振荡器（没有双重发声）。另外补上 `fakeAudio` 离线 context 缺失的 `audioWorklet` 表面——否则 GS-1 导出路径会跳过自身，parity 测试会「在没有图的情况下通过」。
highlights.en: **Parity is pinned by tests** (`gs1ExportParity.test.ts`): with routing off the exporter does not even look for a host (bit-for-bit as before); with it on, **the offline event frames equal the shared planner's frames, which equal what the live pool produces from the same input** — the positive statement of parity, since the frame arithmetic has exactly one implementation and re-deriving it on either side is how playback and export drift apart. A GS-1 track also stops creating native oscillators, so nothing is doubled. The fake offline context also gained the `audioWorklet` surface it was missing, without which the GS-1 export path would skip itself and the parity test would have passed on an empty graph.

highlights.zh: **仍默认关闭，这是本版唯一的有意留白**：开启会改变 159 曲风 `chords`/`lead` 的听感（换合成器、换 patch），而这些 patch 从未做过听感 A/B，本仓库也无法测量「更好听」；且开启按硬规则必须**重测响度 + 音色基线并重配 trim**。开启只需一行（`setGs1RoutingEnabled(true)`），但**不该由我单方面决定**。本版没有任何一轨的声音发生变化。
highlights.en: **Still off by default, and that is this release's one deliberate omission.** Enabling it changes how `chords`/`lead` sound in all 159 genres (different synthesis, different patches), those patches have never been judged by ear, and this repository cannot measure \"sounds better\"; enabling it also triggers the hard rule that loudness and timbre must be re-measured and the trims re-fit. It is a one-line change (`setGs1RoutingEnabled(true)`) but **not a decision I should make unilaterally**. No track's sound changes in this release.

title.zh: v2.0.14 GS-1 接线第一块：按帧寻址的调度核心（含延迟补偿与 8 复音上限），默认关闭、行为零变化
title.en: v2.0.14 GS-1 wiring, part one: the frame-addressed scheduling core (latency compensation and an 8-voice ceiling), off by default, zero behaviour change

highlights.zh: **新增 `src/audio/gs1/gs1Tracks.ts`（P6 Phase 2 的调度核心）**：把音高/时间/时长/力度翻译成**按帧寻址**的 `noteAt`/`noteOffAt`，并**减去 worklet 报告的 `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`**——这一步就是「在拍上」和「每个音晚 2.7 ms」的全部差别，而且实时与离线必须完全一致，所以它被放进纯函数、由 13 条测试锁定（秒→帧换算、延迟补偿、首块不排到过去、顺序确定、力度夹紧、非法输入返回 null）。另含 **`capPlanPolyphony`**：超过 **8 复音**（E3 实测上限）时**丢最旧的音**——丢尾巴听起来是变薄，丢新音听起来是和弦卡住。
highlights.en: **New `src/audio/gs1/gs1Tracks.ts` (the P6 Phase 2 scheduling core)**: it turns pitch/time/duration/velocity into **frame-addressed** `noteAt`/`noteOffAt`, **subtracting the worklet-reported `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`** — that subtraction is the entire difference between \"in the pocket\" and \"every note 2.7 ms late\", and live and offline must agree on it exactly, so it lives in a pure function pinned by 13 tests (seconds-to-frames, latency compensation, never scheduling into the past, deterministic ordering, velocity clamping, and `null` for unusable input). It also adds **`capPlanPolyphony`**: past the **8-voice** measured ceiling the *oldest* notes are dropped — a dropped tail thins out, whereas dropping the new notes sounds like a stuck chord.

highlights.zh: **默认关闭（重要）**：打开它会**改变绝大多数曲风的听感**（换合成器、换 patch），而这些 patch 从未做过听感对比，本仓库也无法测量「更好听」。默认开启等于用一次没人验证过的判断改动 159 个曲风，并让音色基线作废。因此开关是**有意的动作**，代价（重测响度 + 音色 + 重配 trim）明确写在模块头与计划 §5.14 里。**本版没有任何一轨的声音发生变化。**
highlights.en: **Off by default (and that matters).** Enabling it **changes how most genres sound** (different synthesis, different patches), and those patches have never been judged by ear — this repository cannot measure \"sounds better\". Shipping it enabled would change 159 genres on an unverified judgement and invalidate the measured timbre baseline. The switch is therefore a deliberate act, with its cost (re-measure loudness and timbre, re-fit trims) stated in the module header and plan §5.14. **No track's sound changes in this release.**

highlights.zh: **所有失败路径都返回 `null`（= 用原生引擎）**：未接线的角色（kick/snare/hihat/percussion/bass/fx）、没有 GS-1 patch 的乐器（钢琴、西塔琴、长笛、颤音琴等**有意保留原生**的原声乐器）、非法采样率、空音列表、全零力度。另外修掉上一轮的 fast 轨崩溃：GS-1 运行时资源（worklet + 两个 wasm）改为 `public/gs1/` 静态提供，同步脚本自动发布、门禁断言与 pin **逐字节相同**（契约门禁 22 → 25 项）。
highlights.en: **Every failure path returns `null` (= use the native engine)**: roles GS-1 does not voice (kick/snare/hihat/percussion/bass/fx), instruments with no GS-1 patch (piano, sitar, flute, vibraphone and the other acoustic instruments **deliberately kept native**), a nonsense sample rate, an empty note list, or all-zero velocities. This release also fixes the previous round's fast-lane crash: GS-1's runtime assets (the worklet and both cores) are now served statically from `public/gs1/`, published by the sync script and asserted **byte-identical** to the pin by the gate (22 -> 25 contract checks).

highlights.zh: **尚未做（下一步）**：两个引擎的接线本身——`AudioEngine` 的 `playChord`/`playLead` 与 `WavExporter` 的对等路径，以及「实时 vs 离线逐样本一致」的 parity 测试。核心已就绪并有测试，接线是下一轮的事。
highlights.en: **What is not done (the next step)**: the engine wiring itself — `playChord`/`playLead` in `AudioEngine` and the matching path in `WavExporter`, plus a sample-for-sample live-vs-offline parity test. The core is in place and tested; wiring it is next round's work.

title.zh: v2.0.13 阻塞解除：上游 GS-1 v2.1.5 落地按帧寻址的 note 事件（noteAt/noteOffAt），本仓已同步并把守卫翻转为「必须存在定时事件」
title.en: v2.0.13 Unblocked: upstream GS-1 v2.1.5 ships frame-addressed note events (noteAt/noteOffAt); the pin is synced and the guard flips to requiring them

highlights.zh: **上游实现了 §5.9 的提案**（GS-1 **v2.1.5 @ e073df5**，**ABI 仍为 8**）：`worklet-processor.js` 现在接受 `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` 并携带**绝对帧号**，内部维护按帧排序、上限 1024 条的队列，并在 `process()` 里**按事件切分渲染块**，因此事件落在它指定的那一帧而不是下一个 128 帧边界。`panic` 清空队列；非法帧号被忽略而不是当成 0；静音期间帧游标仍推进（否则静音结束后所有事件整体迟到）。
highlights.en: **Upstream implemented the §5.9 proposal** (GS-1 **v2.1.5 @ e073df5**, **ABI still 8**): `worklet-processor.js` now accepts `noteAt`/`noteOffAt` carrying an **absolute frame**, keeps a frame-sorted queue capped at 1024 entries, and **splits the render block at each due event**, so an event lands on the frame it names rather than on the next 128-frame boundary. A panic clears the queue; a malformed frame is ignored rather than treated as zero; the frame cursor advances while muted, or every queued event would slide late by the length of the mute.

highlights.zh: **实测契约（已写进上游测试）**：声部起点恒为 `atFrame + 128`——一个渲染量子的**常数**延迟，且**与事件落在块内哪个位置无关**（`atFrame` = 0/100/128/200/384/500 全部如此），块内位置被逐样本保留。这个常数由 `ready` 消息的 `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames` **报告给宿主**，宿主提前寻址即可与采样精确的原生声部对齐，不必硬编码。上游新增 7 条测试，其中最关键的一条是**「早发/晚发消息产生逐样本相同的输出」**——这正是导出 parity 能成立的前提。
highlights.en: **The measured contract, pinned by upstream tests**: the voice starts at exactly `atFrame + 128` — a **constant** one-quantum latency that is **independent of where in the block the event falls** (`atFrame` = 0/100/128/200/384/500 all behave this way) — while the in-block position is preserved sample-exactly. That constant is **reported to the host** in the `ready` message as `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`, so a host can address events early and stay aligned with sample-accurate native voices without hard-coding it. Seven upstream tests were added, the most important being that **posting the message early or late produces sample-identical output**, which is what makes export parity possible at all.

highlights.zh: **本仓侧**：`scripts/sync-gs1.mjs --from ../synth` 单向同步完成（6 个文件重新哈希，22 项契约断言全绿）；`Gs1Host` 增加 `noteOnAt`/`noteOffAt` 与 `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`；`gs1Scheduling.test.ts` 的守卫**按设计自动翻转**——从「协议必须没有时间字段」变为「协议必须有定时事件对」。**顺带修掉一个真实缺陷**：同步脚本的 `pruneToManagedSet` 会删除不在清单里的文件，于是它**静默删掉了 `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`**——正是用来补上游许可缺口的那份；现在 `KEEP_FILES` 显式列出我们自己的文档。
highlights.en: **On this side**: the one-directional `sync-gs1.mjs --from ../synth` completed (six files re-hashed, all 22 contract assertions green); `Gs1Host` gained `noteOnAt`/`noteOffAt` and `scheduledNoteLatencyFrames`; and the `gs1Scheduling.test.ts` guard **flipped automatically by design**, from \"the protocol must have no time field\" to \"the protocol must have the timed pair\". **A real defect was fixed along the way**: the sync script's `pruneToManagedSet` deletes anything not in the manifest, so it had **silently removed `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`** — the very file that discharges the upstream licence gap; `KEEP_FILES` now names our own documents explicitly.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（下一步）**：本版**仍未接线**——`chords`/`lead` 目前依旧由原生引擎发声，接线（两个引擎 + 逐音对准 + parity 测试 + 响度/音色重测）是下一步要做的独立改动；本版交付的是**解除阻塞的全部前置条件**：可用的定时协议、宿主侧的 API、以及翻转为「期待接线」的守卫。
highlights.en: **Honest note on what is next**: **nothing is wired yet** — `chords`/`lead` are still voiced by the native engine, and the wiring (both engines, per-note alignment, parity tests, re-measured loudness and timbre) is a separate change for the next step. What this release delivers is **every precondition for it**: the timed protocol, the host-side API, and a guard that has flipped to expecting the wiring.

title.zh: v2.0.12 E7 第二轮：主线程繁忙时的抖动尾巴被量出来了——有界（12–14 ms）但仍是采样分辨率的 4–5 倍
title.en: v2.0.12 E7 round two: the jitter tail under a busy main thread is now measured — bounded (12-14 ms), but still 4-5x the sample resolution

highlights.zh: **把 E7 的「下界」变成实测**：上一轮自我批评过——11.8 ms 的抖动极差来自**空闲页面**，而 200 ms 前瞻存在的理由正是「拖动 UI 时主线程会卡」。新增 `last-moment-loaded` 策略：在等待目标时刻的循环里**故意阻塞主线程**（25 ms/50 ms 与 80 ms/100 ms 两档）。结果：尾巴**确实随负载变长但有界**——空闲 11.6 / 3.9 ms → 加载后 **13.5 / 12.2 ms**，两档都饱和在 **12–14 ms** 附近，而不是「只会更长」。原因清楚：抖动循环每轮 `await` 让出，定时器总能在间隙触发，延迟由「一次阻塞多长」决定而非累积。**但这仍约为 onset 分辨率（2.90 ms）的 4–5 倍**，与「采样精确」是类别差异。**不能证明什么**：只模拟了**协作式**周期阻塞；真实的长停顿（一次大布局/GC）可能更长，本实验给不出那种上界。E7 证据门禁现在**要求三种策略都在**（只报空闲那种会低估尾巴）。
highlights.en: **The lower bound became a measurement.** Last round flagged its own weakness: the 11.8 ms jitter spread came from an **idle page**, while the whole reason the engine keeps a 200 ms lookahead is that the main thread stalls during UI drags. A new `last-moment-loaded` strategy blocks the main thread on purpose while waiting for the note's due time (25 ms/50 ms and 80 ms/100 ms). The tail **does grow with load but stays bounded** — idle 11.6 / 3.9 ms becomes **13.5 / 12.2 ms**, saturating around **12-14 ms** rather than getting worse without limit. The mechanism is clear: the jank loop awaits between bursts, so the note's timer fires in a gap and the delay is set by how long one block lasts, not accumulated. **It is still 4-5x the 2.90 ms onset resolution**, a difference in kind from sample-accurate. **What it cannot show**: only *cooperative* periodic blocking was simulated; a real long stall (a big layout, a GC) could be longer, and this experiment gives no bound for that. The E7 evidence gate now **requires all three strategies** (reporting only the idle one would understate the tail).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 只模拟了**协作式**周期阻塞，真实长停顿（大布局/GC）可能更长，本实验**给不出上界**；② 数字仍来自**一台 8 核桌面 + headless Chromium**，不是手机；③ 本版**依然没有接线**，`chords`/`lead` 仍由原生引擎发声，P6 的接线继续被上游协议阻塞（§5.9）；④ P1–P5 已全部交付，计划内**不依赖上游的剩余工作已不存在**。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) Only *cooperative* periodic blocking was simulated; a real long stall (big layout, GC) could be longer and this experiment **provides no upper bound** for that. (2) The numbers still come from **an 8-core desktop with headless Chromium**, not a phone. (3) **Nothing is wired in this release either**: `chords`/`lead` are still voiced by the native engine, and P6's wiring remains blocked on the upstream protocol (§5.9). (4) P1-P5 are all delivered, and **no in-scope work that does not depend on upstream remains**.

title.zh: v2.0.11 逐预设滤波器包络 + 谐振增益补偿 + 可选 24 dB（E-14，P5 收尾）：303 终于会咬、铜管终于会 bloom、垫子不再像拨弦；谐振旋钮不再等于音量旋钮
title.en: v2.0.11 Per-preset filter envelopes, resonance gain compensation and an optional 24 dB slope (E-14, closing P5): the 303 finally snaps, brass finally blooms, pads stop behaving like plucks, and the resonance knob stops being a volume knob

highlights.zh: **缺陷**：滤波器包络是**硬编码**的 `cutoff · 2.5` 扫描、与放大器 ADSR 死绑——垫子像拨弦一样 bloom，303 无法咬；而且没有任何东西补偿「谐振双二阶滤波器 Q 升高时峰值增益也升高」，于是**把谐振拧大听到的主要是「更响」**。现在三项都落地：**逐预设包络**（`filterEnvOctaves` 深度、`0` = 不扫描、起攻/衰减可独立于放大器缩放；**不写这些字段的预设渲染结果逐比特不变**，由测试钉死——全库响度与音色基线描述的是那 159 个曲风，全库预设一起变会静默作废它们）；**谐振增益补偿**（Q 每高于 1 一单位扣 0.6 dB、上限 6 dB，放在**滤波器前**，因为峰值正是随 Q 升的部分；预设可 `resonanceCompDbPerQ: 0` 退出）；**可选 24 dB**（再串一颗**同样的** 12 dB 双二阶，所以实时/导出 parity 是结构性的，代价恰好每声部多一个节点；**谐振只留在第二级**、第一级 Q 减半，避免两个谐振峰叠加）。
highlights.en: **The defect**: the filter envelope was a hardcoded `cutoff · 2.5` sweep tied to the amplifier ADSR — pads bloomed like plucks and a 303 could not snap. Worse, nothing compensated for a resonant biquad's peak gain rising with Q, so **turning resonance up was heard mostly as louder**. All three parts now land: **per-preset envelopes** (`filterEnvOctaves` for depth, `0` meaning no sweep, with attack/decay scalable independently of the amp; a preset that omits these fields renders **bit-for-bit as before**, enforced by tests, because the library's loudness and timbre baselines describe those 159 genres and changing every preset at once would silently invalidate them); **resonance gain compensation** (0.6 dB per unit of Q above 1, capped at 6 dB, applied **before** the filter since the peak is what rises with Q, with a per-preset opt-out); and an **optional 24 dB slope** (a second, identical 12 dB biquad, so live/export parity is structural and the cost is exactly one node per voice, with the resonance kept on the second stage only and the first stage's Q halved so two peaks never stack).

highlights.zh: **4 个刻意的重新配声**（每个都有理由，不是随手调参）：`acidBass` 得到 24 dB 梯形 + 深度 4.6× + 起攻 0.25× + 衰减 0.45×（303 的性格就是快而深的包络回落）；`brassSynth` 起攻 2.4×（铜管的 bloom **就是**滤波器比放大器更慢地打开）；`warmPad` 深度降到 1.5× + 起攻 2.0×（垫子不咬，浅而慢才仍是垫子）；`supersaw` 深度降到 1.6×（锯齿墙是静态亮度，扫描在和 unison 失谐打架）。其余 46 个预设**仍用历史扫描**。
highlights.en: **Four deliberate re-voicings**, each with a reason rather than a tweak: `acidBass` gets the 24 dB ladder plus a 4.6x-deep envelope with a 0.25x attack and 0.45x decay (a 303's character *is* a fast, deep envelope return); `brassSynth` gets a 2.4x attack (a brass bloom **is** the filter opening slower than the amp); `warmPad` drops to a 1.5x depth with a 2.0x attack (pads do not snap — shallow and slow is what keeps it a pad); `supersaw` drops to 1.6x (a saw wall is static brightness, and sweeping it fights the unison detune). The other 46 presets keep the historical sweep.

highlights.zh: **重测与重配平**：响度 **trim 后 p90−p10 0.34 dB**（门禁 1.5）、全距 3.13 dB（门禁 4）、clamp **0/159**、削波 **0/159**、最差真峰值 **−1.094 dBTP**（0/159 超 −1.0）；音色 **159/159 形状互异**，最近一对 `grunge ↔ progressive-rock` **0.3535 dB**（地板 0.25），平均对距 3.27 dB。**P5 至此全部交付**（E-10/E-11/E-13/E-14/E-15/C-03），计划里**不依赖上游的剩余工作已经没有了**。
highlights.en: **Re-measured and re-balanced**: post-trim loudness **p90-p10 0.34 dB** (limit 1.5), full range 3.13 dB (limit 4), trim clamp **0/159**, clipping **0/159**, worst true peak **-1.094 dBTP** (0/159 over -1.0); timbre **159/159 distinct shapes**, closest pair `grunge` vs `progressive-rock` at **0.3535 dB** (floor 0.25), mean pairwise distance 3.27 dB. **P5 is now complete** (E-10/E-11/E-13/E-14/E-15/C-03), and the plan has **no remaining work that does not depend on upstream**.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① 补偿系数 0.6 dB/单位与 6 dB 上限是**近似 + 保守**的取舍，不是解析解——「多少最好」需要听感判断。② **只有 4 个预设置被重新配声，其余 46 个仍用历史 `·2.5` 扫描**：E-14 交付的是**能力**，而「每个预设都该有自己的包络」只完成了最明显的 4 个。③ `filterSlope24` 目前**只有 `acidBass` 在用**，「24 dB 在其他音色上是否更好」没有证据。④ 这 4 个预设的改动**改变了音色与电平**，已由重测覆盖，但意味着 v2.0.11 之前任何逐曲风听感结论对新版本不再逐比特成立。⑤ P6 的 GS-1 接线仍被上游协议阻塞（§5.9/§5.10）。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) The 0.6 dB-per-unit coefficient and the 6 dB cap are an **approximation plus a conservative choice**, not a closed-form solution — how much is best is a listening judgement.
