(2) **Only four presets were re-voiced; the other 46 keep the historical `·2.5` sweep**: E-14 delivers the *capability*, while "every preset should have its own envelope" is done for the four most obvious cases. (3) `filterSlope24` is currently used by **`acidBass` alone**, so there is no evidence about whether 24 dB suits other timbres. (4) Those four changes **alter timbre and level** and are covered by the re-measurement, which also means any per-genre listening conclusion recorded before v2.0.11 no longer holds bit-for-bit. (5) P6's GS-1 wiring remains blocked on the upstream protocol (§5.9/§5.10).

title.zh: v2.0.10 分组总线与胶水压缩（E-11）：鼓组与音乐各自有了一条真正把它们粘起来的总线，鼓组另有并联压缩；顺带查出并修掉并联路径把真峰值顶出承诺的问题
title.en: v2.0.10 Group buses and glue compression (E-11): drums and music each get a bus that actually glues them together, with a parallel drum path — and a real defect the parallel path exposed in the true-peak promise

highlights.zh: **缺陷**：每一轨都**直接**汇入母带推子——没有任何东西把鼓组粘在一起，也没有东西阻止垫子、贝斯、旋律各占一个峰值。全项目唯一的一级动态处理是总线上那个真峰值限幅器，一个安全装置被迫干混音的活。现在轨道路由到两条总线：**鼓组总线**（glue 3:1 / 12 ms 起攻 + 一条 **8:1 并联路径** blend 0.22，用被压扁的信号增加密度而不牺牲起攻）与**音乐总线**（2:1 / 30 ms）。两条都是**胶水而不是限制器**：慢起攻是刻意的（快起攻会把鼓组最该保留的瞬态压平），测试断言「比率低、起攻慢、音乐比鼓更温和」以及「总线不得自称天花板」。**角色→总线的判定只有一处**（`trackBuses.ts`），两个引擎都调它，测试断言实时引擎的三条 strip 路径全部经由总线、导出器不再有直连母带的路径、并且**节拍器不进总线**（它是监听辅助，像控制室的 talkback）。送出返回也不经过总线，直接进推子——真实调音台对 FX 返回正是如此。
highlights.en: **The defect**: every track summed **directly** into the master fader — nothing glued the kit together, and nothing stopped a pad, a bass and a lead from each claiming their own peak. The only dynamics stage in the entire application was the true-peak limiter on the sum, a safety device being asked to do a mixing job. Tracks now route into two buses: a **drum bus** (glue at 3:1 with a 12 ms attack, plus a **parallel 8:1 path** blended at 0.22 so density rises without losing attack) and a **music bus** (2:1 / 30 ms). Both are **glue rather than limiters**: the slow attack is deliberate, because a fast one would flatten exactly the transients a drum bus exists to keep, and tests assert the low ratios, the slow attacks, that music is gentler than drums, and that no bus makes a ceiling claim. The **role-to-bus decision lives in exactly one place** (`trackBuses.ts`) and both engines call it; tests assert that every live strip path goes through a bus, that the exporter no longer has a direct master connection, and that the **metronome stays out of the buses** (it is a monitoring aid, like talkback on a console). The send returns also bypass the buses and join the fader directly, which is what a real console does with an FX return.

highlights.zh: **并联路径顺带暴露出一个真实缺陷，已修**：总线落地后同一次 159 曲风测量里，最差真峰值从 −1.027 变成 **−0.95 dBTP（1/159 超过承诺的 −1.0 dBTP）**。原因是鼓组并联路径让限幅器前的波形更密、瞬态更多，而限幅器自己的检测器（4 点插值）比验收用的 4× 过采样标准表**低读得更多**：从 0.12 dB 涨到 **0.20 dB**。修法是把 `MASTER_LIMITER_DETECTOR_MARGIN_DB` 从 0.15 提到 **0.30**（内部目标 −1.30 dBTP），依据是这次测量加 0.1 dB 余量，不是口味。改完**重录了两份基线**（改限幅器就必须重测响度与音色）：最差真峰值 **−1.105 dBTP，0/159 超标**。
highlights.en: **The parallel path exposed a real defect, now fixed.** In the same 159-genre measurement that landed the buses, the worst true peak moved from -1.027 to **-0.95 dBTP — one genre above the promised -1.0 dBTP**. The cause: the parallel drum path makes the pre-limiter waveform denser and more transient-rich, and the limiter's own detector (4-point interpolation) under-reads the 4x-oversampled reference meter by *more* on that material — 0.12 dB became **0.20 dB**. The fix raises `MASTER_LIMITER_DETECTOR_MARGIN_DB` from 0.15 to **0.30** (internal target -1.30 dBTP), set from that measurement plus 0.1 dB of slack rather than from taste. Because a limiter change forces it, **both baselines were re-recorded**: worst true peak **-1.105 dBTP, 0/159 over the ceiling**.

highlights.zh: **重测与重配平（硬规则）**：重跑 159 曲风响度（迭代求解）→ **trim 后 p90−p10 0.35 dB**（门禁 1.5）、全距 **3.05 dB**（门禁 4）、clamp **0/159**、削波 **0/159**、最差真峰值 **−1.105 dBTP**；重录音色基线 → **159/159 形状互异**，最近一对 `alternative-rock ↔ math-rock` **0.3599 dB**（地板 0.25）。诚实备注：平均对距从 3.49 降到 **3.22 dB**——胶水压缩的本意就是让全库**更凝聚**，代价就是**更相似**，仍在门禁内但余量从 1.8× 收到 **1.44×**，记录下来而不是藏起来。
highlights.en: **Re-measured and re-balanced (the hard rule).** The 159-genre loudness run (iterative solve) gives **post-trim p90-p10 0.35 dB** (limit 1.5), full range **3.05 dB** (limit 4), trim clamp **0/159**, clipping **0/159** and worst true peak **-1.105 dBTP**; the timbre baseline was re-recorded at **159/159 distinct shapes**, closest pair `alternative-rock` vs `math-rock` at **0.3599 dB** (floor 0.25). An honest note: mean pairwise distance fell from 3.49 to **3.22 dB** — glue compression exists to make the library *more cohesive*, and the price is that it becomes *more similar*; still inside the gate, but the margin narrowed from 1.8x to **1.44x**, which is recorded rather than hidden.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① 总线参数（阈值/比率/起攻释放/并联 blend）是**按混音常识与代码语义取的**，没有做听感 AB——它们是「合理起点」而不是「调好的终点」；并联 blend 0.22 尤其是一个**保守猜测**，「多少最好」需要听感判断，本仓库无法测量。② 15 个曲风（如 `microhouse`）在 5 轮迭代后仍未收敛到内部 ±0.2 dB（最差 2.85 dB，偏轻），都在门禁口径内，已记入报告。③ **E-11 之外，P5 还差 E-14**（逐预设滤波器包络 + 谐振增益补偿 + 可选 24 dB）——那是 P5 唯一剩下的项，也是**唯一不依赖上游、可以立刻开工**的剩余项。④ P6 的 GS-1 接线仍被上游协议阻塞（§5.9/§5.10）。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) The bus parameters (thresholds, ratios, attack/release, parallel blend) are **chosen from mixing common sense and parameter semantics**, with no listening A/B — they are a reasonable starting point rather than a finished one, and the 0.22 parallel blend in particular is a **conservative guess**: how much is best is a judgement this repository cannot measure. (2) Fifteen genres (e.g. `microhouse`) still sit outside the internal +/-0.2 dB tolerance after five rounds (worst 2.85 dB, on the quiet side), all inside the gated thresholds and recorded in the report. (3) **Beyond E-11, P5 still lacks E-14** (per-preset filter envelope, resonance gain compensation, optional 24 dB) — the only item left in P5 and the only remaining work that **does not depend on upstream**. (4) P6's GS-1 wiring remains blocked on the upstream protocol (§5.9/§5.10).

title.zh: v2.0.9 E7 实测：消息投递型 note 的实时时序误差被量出来了——「一决定就发」早 198.6 ms，「临响再发」仍有 11.8 ms 极差，而原生调度是采样精确的
title.en: v2.0.9 E7 measured: the live timing error of a message-delivered note is now a number — posting at scheduling time lands 198.6 ms early, posting at the last moment still scatters by 11.8 ms, while native scheduling is sample-accurate

highlights.zh: **把估计变成数字**。v2.0.8 里「在调度时刻发消息会早最多 200 ms、临响再发则晚一个量子加抖动」是**从代码结构推出的量级估计**，不是实测。现在实测了：新增一个极小的 AudioWorklet 探针（`public/gs1OnsetProbe.js`），在**音频线程**上用 `currentFrame` 报告越过阈值的第一个样本的绝对帧号——主线程 `rAF` 轮询的分辨率约 16 ms，而要测的效应就是这个量级，所以必须这样做；探针分辨率是**一个 128 帧块（2.90 ms）**，且这个界随每个数字一起报告。测量脚本在真实浏览器里加载 vendored GS-1（8 复音上限），把输出接进探针（末端静音但探针仍看得到信号），两种宿主策略各 40 次、每次之间留 420 ms 让尾巴衰减。
highlights.en: **The estimate became a number.** In v2.0.8, "a message posted at scheduling time lands up to 200 ms early, and one posted at the last moment lands late by a quantum plus jitter" was a **magnitude estimate derived from the code structure**, not a measurement. Now it is measured: a tiny AudioWorklet probe (`public/gs1OnsetProbe.js`) reports the absolute frame index of the first sample past a threshold using `currentFrame` **on the audio rendering thread** — main-thread `rAF` polling quantises to about 16 ms, which is the size of the effect, so nothing coarser would do. The probe's resolution is **one 128-frame block (2.90 ms)** and that bound travels with every number. The harness loads the vendored GS-1 in a real browser (8-voice ceiling), routes its output through the probe (silent at the end, still visible to the probe), and runs 40 trials per strategy with 420 ms of decay between them.

highlights.zh: **结果：schedule-ahead 中位数 −198.6 ms（早），与引擎 200 ms 前瞻完全吻合**。也就是说「一决定就发消息」= 每个音早 200 ms 发声——在一个 16 分音符只有 94–125 ms 的音序器里，这不是「略有偏差」而是灾难。范围 −199.1…−187.3 ms。**last-moment（目标前 20 ms 发）中位数 −19.6 ms，但极差 11.8 ms**：40 次里绝大多数落在 lead 的 1 ms 内（消息投递本身极快），尾巴来自**一次晚约 11 ms 的主线程定时器**——而这还是在**空闲页面**上测的。那 200 ms 前瞻存在的理由正是「拖动 UI 时主线程会卡」，所以真实使用下尾巴只会更长，本次数字应视为**下界**。
highlights.en: **Result: schedule-ahead's median is -198.6 ms (early), matching the engine's 200 ms lookahead exactly.** Posting a message the moment the scheduler decides therefore makes every note sound 200 ms early — in a sequencer where a 16th note lasts 94-125 ms, that is not a slight offset but a catastrophe (full range -199.1 to -187.3 ms). **Last-moment posting (20 ms before the target) has a median of -19.6 ms but a spread of 11.8 ms**: almost every trial landed within a millisecond of the tuned lead — message delivery itself is fast — while the tail came from **one main-thread timer running about 11 ms late**. And that was measured on an **idle page**. The whole reason the 200 ms lookahead exists is that the main thread stalls while the UI is being dragged, so the real-world tail can only be longer: treat this number as a **lower bound**.

highlights.zh: **门禁 + 结论**：`scripts/check_gs1_jitter.mjs`（已接入慢轨）检查这是完整运行、**两种策略都在**（只报对自己有利的那一种是显而易见的作弊）、**每次试验都真的捕获到 onset**（漏检会静默砍掉最差的尾巴）、schedule-ahead 的中位数确实≈前瞻（§5.9 的机制仍成立）、last-moment 极差在 60 ms 内（这是**定时器健康度**检查而非产品阈值，5× 余量给共享 CI），以及最重要的一条：**last-moment 的极差大于 onset 分辨率，即这个变通办法实测上不是采样精确的**。于是 Phase 2 的顺序被实测钉住：**上游加定时 note 消息 →（已完成 E7）→ 接线 + parity 测试**；在协议能表达「第 N 帧发声」之前接线，等于让这两个角色比现在更差（现在是采样精确的），并且播放与导出对不齐。
highlights.en: **Gate and conclusion.** `scripts/check_gs1_jitter.mjs` (wired into the slow track) checks that this is a full run, that **both strategies are present** (reporting only the flattering one is the obvious way to cheat), that **every trial actually captured an onset** (a missed detection silently drops the worst tails), that the schedule-ahead median really does match the lookahead (the §5.9 mechanism still holds), that the last-moment spread stays inside 60 ms (a **timer-health** check rather than a product threshold, with 5x allowance for shared CI), and — most importantly — that the last-moment spread is **larger than the onset resolution**, i.e. that this workaround is measurably not sample-accurate. Phase 2's order is therefore pinned by measurement: **upstream timed note message -> (E7 done) -> wiring plus parity tests**. Wiring before the protocol can name a frame would make these two roles worse than they are today (sample-accurate) and would leave playback and export disagreeing.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① 数字来自**一台 8 核桌面 + headless Chromium 的空闲页面**，不是手机、也不是 UI 繁忙状态——如上所述应视为**下界**；「主线程繁忙时尾巴有多长」需要一个**在负载下**的专门测量（可在同一脚本加 `--load` 模式）。② 探针分辨率是一个 128 帧块，**小于 2.9 ms 的差异测不出来**，本节所有早晚数字都带这个界。③ 探针阈值固定 0.01（两次连续采样确认），对本次的快起音短音足够；换慢起音 pad 需重新标定阈值，否则 onset 会被判晚——这一点写在探针文件里，没有偷偷假设。④ **本版依然没有接线、没有改任何一轨的声音**；v2.0.6/v2.0.7 的适配器与 patch 表仍是死代码。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) The numbers come from **an 8-core desktop running headless Chromium on an idle page** — not a phone, not a busy UI — and should be read as a **lower bound**; how long the tail gets under load needs a dedicated loaded measurement (a `--load` mode could be added to the same script). (2) The probe resolves one 128-frame block, so **differences below 2.9 ms are invisible**; every early/late figure here carries that bound. (3) The probe threshold is fixed at 0.01 (confirmed over two consecutive samples), which is fine for the fast-attack short note used here; a slow-attack pad would need re-calibration or its onset would read late — stated in the probe file rather than assumed. (4) **Nothing is wired and no track's sound changes in this release either**; the adapter and patch table from v2.0.6/v2.0.7 remain dead code.

title.zh: v2.0.8 查出 GS-1 接线的真正阻塞点：vendored 协议的 note 消息无法定点调度，接线会同时破坏采样精确播放与实时/导出 parity——附上游提案与一条会自我解除的守卫
title.en: v2.0.8 The real blocker for wiring GS-1: the vendored note protocol cannot be scheduled, so wiring would break both sample-accurate playback and live/export parity — with an upstream proposal and a guard that clears itself

highlights.zh: **P6 Phase 2 卡在一个协议事实，而不是工程量**。适配器、实测复音上限（8）、署名合规、39 个乐器名的路由表都已就绪（v2.0.6/v2.0.7），但接线本身会让 `chords`/`lead` 违反本仓库的硬性 parity 规则。证据（**全部可复验**）：① Groove Lab 的调度是**采样精确**的，每个音带确切 `AudioContext` 时间入队、**前瞻 200 ms**（`AudioEngine.ts:201`）；② vendored worklet 的**每一条入站消息都是「到达即生效」**——逐条解析 `handleMessage` 的 `case` 标签，`noteOn`/`noteOnPan`/`noteOff`/`pitchBend`/… **没有任何一条**能表达「在第 N 帧发声」；③ 所以在调度时刻发消息会**早最多 200 ms**，推迟到临响再发则晚一个量子加主线程抖动（那 200 ms 前瞻存在的理由正是「拖动 UI 不能掉音」）；④ **唯一能精确指定渲染时刻的机制是 `OfflineAudioContext.suspend(t)`**，而上游自己的离线渲染器正是这么做的——`suspend` **没有实时对应物**。结论：接上 GS-1，播放与导出**必然在时间上不一致**；这不是音色取舍，是**节奏准确性**取舍，而 `chords`/`lead` 恰恰最依赖准时入拍。
highlights.en: **P6 Phase 2 is blocked by a protocol fact, not by the amount of work.** The adapter, the measured polyphony ceiling (8), attribution compliance and the 39-name routing table are all in place (v2.0.6/v2.0.7), but wiring the roles would make `chords`/`lead` violate this repository's hard parity rule. The evidence, all re-verifiable here: (1) Groove Lab schedules **sample-accurately** — every note is enqueued with an exact `AudioContext` time and a **200 ms lookahead** (`AudioEngine.ts:201`); (2) every inbound message of the vendored worklet **acts on arrival** — parsing the `case` labels of `handleMessage` yields `noteOn`, `noteOnPan`, `noteOff`, `pitchBend`, ... and **not one** can express "sound at frame N"; (3) so a message posted at scheduling time fires up to **200 ms early**, and one posted at the last moment fires late by a quantum plus main-thread jitter (the very reason that 200 ms lookahead exists is "do not drop notes while the UI is being dragged"); (4) **the only mechanism that can name an exact render time is `OfflineAudioContext.suspend(t)`**, which is exactly what upstream's own offline renderer uses — and `suspend` has **no live counterpart**. Wiring GS-1 therefore makes playback and export disagree about *when* notes happen; that is not a timbre trade-off but a timing one, on the two roles that most depend on landing in the pocket.

highlights.zh: **不接线，但把前置条件做成可检查、且会自我解除的守卫**。新增 `src/test/gs1Scheduling.test.ts`（5 条）：先解析 worklet 的入站消息类型证明解析器活着；断言**没有任何入站 note 消息读取 `data.at`/`data.frame`/`data.time` 之类的字段**；从 `AudioEngine` 读出真实前瞻秒数并要求 ≥0.1 s（把结论钉在数字上）；**自我解除的守卫**——协议里没有定时消息时两个引擎**不得**引用 GS-1 host，一旦上游加了定时消息（`noteAt`/`noteOnAt`/`noteOffAt`/`scheduleNote`/`eventsAt`），**同一条测试自动转为允许并期待接线**；最后要求导出器里仍写着 parity 主张，否则这条守卫的理由本身需要重写而不是默默过期。它是一张待办清单，不是一道永久围栏。
highlights.en: **No wiring, but the precondition is now machine-checkable and clears itself.** A new `src/test/gs1Scheduling.test.ts` (5 cases) parses the worklet's inbound message types to prove the parser is alive, asserts that **no inbound note message reads a field like `data.at`/`data.frame`/`data.time`**, reads the real lookahead out of `AudioEngine` and requires >= 0.1 s (tying the conclusion to a number), and installs a **self-clearing guard**: while the protocol has no timed message the two engines **may not** import the GS-1 host, and the moment upstream adds one (`noteAt`/`noteOnAt`/`noteOffAt`/`scheduleNote`/`eventsAt`) **the same test flips to allowing — and expecting — the wiring**. It finally requires that the exporter still states its parity claim, so the guard's rationale is rewritten rather than silently outliving its reason.

highlights.zh: **给上游的提案（worklet-only，不需要动 ABI）**：在 `handleMessage` 里新增 `{type:'noteAt', note, velocity, pan?, atFrame}` 与 `{type:'noteOffAt', note, atFrame}`（宿主把 `AudioContext` 时间换算成绝对帧），处理器维护 `this.frame`（每块累加）并在每块开头消费一个按帧排序的事件队列、跨块事件留在队列里。要点：**这是处理器层的排队，不新增 `gs_*` 导出，因此 ABI 可以仍是 8**；但 `worklet-processor.js` 的哈希会变，`check-gs1.mjs` 会**如实报出上游文件变化**——这正是 vendor 纪律想要的行为。上游落地后走既有单向同步流程即可解除本阻塞。
highlights.en: **The upstream proposal (worklet-only, no ABI bump needed)**: add `{type:'noteAt', note, velocity, pan?, atFrame}` and `{type:'noteOffAt', note, atFrame}` to `handleMessage` (the host converts `AudioContext` time into an absolute frame), with the processor tracking `this.frame` (accumulated per block) and draining a frame-ordered event queue at the start of each block, leaving cross-block events queued. The key point: this is queuing **inside the processor**, adding no `gs_*` export, so the ABI can stay at 8 — while the `worklet-processor.js` hash necessarily changes and `check-gs1.mjs` will **report the upstream file change truthfully**, which is exactly what the vendor discipline exists to do. Once upstream lands it, the existing one-directional sync flow clears this blocker.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① **本版没有接线，也没有改任何一轨的声音**——交付的是「接线被什么挡住、怎么解」的确证结论加一条会自我解除的守卫。② 上面第 4 条事实（`suspend` 是唯一精确机制）来自**姊妹仓库的上游源码**，本仓的测试**无法**断言它，已在测试注释与计划 §5.9 标注为「上游代码事实、非本仓可验证」；前三条事实全部可在本仓复验。③ 我**没有实测**「用 `setTimeout` 抢在临响前发消息」的实际抖动分布——「晚一个量子加抖动」是**从代码结构推出的量级估计，不是实测值**；要把它变成数字需要先做 **E7（实时时序抖动测量）**。④ 因此 Phase 2 的正确下一步顺序是：**上游加定时 note 消息 → E7 实测抖动 → 接线 + parity 测试**，而不是先接线再解释为什么导出和播放对不齐。⑤ v2.0.6/v2.0.7 交付的适配器与 patch 表**仍是死代码（无消费方）**，这一点没有变化。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) **Nothing is wired and no track's sound changes in this release** — what ships is the verified conclusion about what blocks the wiring and how to unblock it, plus a self-clearing guard. (2) Fact 4 above (that `suspend` is the only exact mechanism) comes from the **sibling repository's upstream source**, which tests in this repository **cannot** assert; it is labelled as an upstream code fact in both the test comments and plan §5.9, while facts 1-3 are fully re-verifiable here. (3) I did **not** measure the actual jitter distribution of "post the message from a `setTimeout` just before the note is due" — "late by a quantum plus jitter" is a **magnitude estimate derived from the code structure, not a measurement**; turning it into a number requires **E7, a live timing-jitter measurement**. (4) The correct order for Phase 2 is therefore **upstream timed note message -> E7 jitter measurement -> wiring plus parity tests**, rather than wiring first and then explaining why export and playback disagree. (5) The adapter and patch table shipped in v2.0.6/v2.0.7 are **still dead code with no consumer**; that is unchanged.

title.zh: v2.0.7 GS-1 接线的两个前置条件落地：第三方署名合规（上游缺失的 DaisySP/Soundpipe notice）与 39 个乐器名的逐条路由决策
title.en: v2.0.7 The two preconditions for wiring GS-1 land: third-party attribution compliance (the DaisySP/Soundpipe notices upstream does not ship) and an explicit routing decision for all 39 instrument names

highlights.zh: **补上上游缺失的署名（发布阻断项，E5）**：GS-1 的 WASM 把 **DaisySP**（含 Plaits 来源）与 **Soundpipe** 直接链进二进制，而上游产物只带自己的 MIT LICENSE，**不带这两家的 notice**——重新分发这个 wasm 是我们必须自己补的义务，而且它天然隐形：wasm 照样加载、门禁照样全绿、仓库里没有任何东西提示缺了什么。新增 `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`，**逐字**复制四段 MIT 正文（版权行取自上游各自的 LICENSE 文件而非记忆），并写明**为什么这个文件必须存在**，免得后来者当作冗余删掉；`public/` 下有**逐字节相同**的一份（用测试强制相等——两份手写的法律文本迟早会有一份过期）。配 5 条测试：四段版权行齐全、MIT 授权句与免责句齐全、两份逐字节相同、以及「适配器存在 ⇒ notice 必须存在」。
highlights.en: **The attribution gap upstream leaves behind is closed (a release blocker, E5).** GS-1's WASM links **DaisySP** (and Plaits sources) and **Soundpipe** directly into the binary, while the upstream artifacts ship only GS-1's own MIT LICENSE and **neither library's notice** — redistributing that binary is an obligation we have to discharge ourselves, and it is invisible by nature: the WASM loads, every gate stays green, and nothing in the repo says anything is missing. A new `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` reproduces all four MIT texts **verbatim** (copyright lines taken from upstream's own LICENSE files, not from memory) and states **why the file must exist**, so a later reader does not delete it as redundant; `public/` carries a **byte-identical** copy, enforced by a test, because two hand-maintained legal notices eventually disagree. Five tests check the four copyright lines, the MIT grant and disclaimer, byte-equality, and the rule that an existing adapter implies existing notices.

highlights.zh: **39 个乐器名的逐条路由决策**：先实测统计 `chords`/`lead` 在 159 曲风里**真正出现**的乐器名——**chords 12 个、lead 27 个**（计划预估 11/27）。新增 `src/data/gs1Patches.ts`：**10 个手写 patch**（warmPad / electricPiano / sustainedStrings / cleanPluck / supersawStack / drivenGuitar / analogLead / squareLead / acidLead / bellMallet / organStack），参数 id 与取值域全部取自 vendored 参数表。决策分两类且各自写明理由：合成器本就是对的工具 → 上 GS-1（chords 8/12、lead 17/27）；身份来自**声学琴体或木质/槌击瞬态**的 → **保留原生**（piano、vibraphone、marimba、accordion、brass_section、sax、trumpet、muted trumpet、harmonica、flute、pan flute、sitar）——`sax_lead` 这类「减法合成没有诚实对应物」的，宁可留原生也不硬塞 patch。**不 vendor 上游 91 个工厂预设**：它们是为 GS-1 自己的 UI 写的、是它树里最大的单个文件、每次上游同步都要重新 review；10 个一屏读完、每个都写了它在追求什么音色的 patch 是更小也更诚实的依赖。
highlights.en: **All 39 instrument names get an explicit decision.** Measurement first: the instrument names that actually appear on `chords` and `lead` across the 159 genres are **12 for chords and 27 for lead** (the plan estimated 11/27). A new `src/data/gs1Patches.ts` adds **ten hand-written patches** (warmPad, electricPiano, sustainedStrings, cleanPluck, supersawStack, drivenGuitar, analogLead, squareLead, acidLead, bellMallet, organStack) whose parameter ids and value ranges all come from the vendored parameter table. Decisions fall into two documented classes: where a subtractive synth is the right tool, GS-1 voices it (8 of 12 chords names, 17 of 27 lead names); where the identity is an **acoustic body or a wooden/mallet transient**, the track **stays on the native engine** (piano, vibraphone, marimba, accordion, brass_section, sax, trumpet, muted trumpet, harmonica, flute, pan flute, sitar) — `sax_lead` and friends have no honest subtractive analogue, and forcing a patch on them would be worse than leaving them alone. Upstream's 91 factory presets are deliberately **not** vendored: they are authored for GS-1's own UI, they are the largest single file in its tree, and every one would need re-reviewing on each upstream sync. Ten patches readable in one screen, each stating what character it is going for, is the smaller and more honest dependency.

highlights.zh: **映射不再可能悄悄失效**：14 条测试**从 `ALL_GENRES` 反查**两个角色的乐器名，要求**零遗漏、零孤儿**——新曲风带一个没映射过的乐器名进来必然变红；每个 native 决策必须有真实理由（不能靠「没写」来表达）；**每个 patch 的每个取值必须落在 worklet `PARAMS` 表声明的 min/max 内**（计划风险 R5：核心对越界值会**静默换算法**而不是报错，所以不能写未经范围检查的值）；每个 patch 必须真的构成一个声音（osc + filter + env + ≥12 个参数）；`PATCH_GAIN ≤ 0.6` 给母带留余量。
highlights.en: **The mapping can no longer fail quietly.** Fourteen tests read the instrument names for both roles **out of `ALL_GENRES`** and require **zero omissions and zero orphans** — a new genre bringing an unmapped instrument name turns them red; every native decision must carry a real reason (the decision cannot be expressed by omission); **every patch value must fall inside the min/max the worklet's own `PARAMS` table declares** (plan risk R5: the core silently switches algorithm on an out-of-range value rather than erroring, so unchecked values are not acceptable); every patch must actually constitute a voice (oscillator + filter + envelope + at least 12 parameters); and `PATCH_GAIN` stays at or below 0.6 to leave the master chain headroom.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① **引擎接线尚未开始**，`chords`/`lead` 仍由原生引擎发声——**本版没有任何一轨的声音发生变化**，交付的是「可以接线」的全部前置物（适配器、实测上限、合规、路由表）。② 这 10 个 patch 是**按参数语义写的，不是靠听感调出来的**：`gs1Patches.ts` 目前是**死代码（无消费方）**，且**不在** `scripts/timbre.baseline.json` 的描述范围内——那份基线指纹的是原生链路。「GS-1 的 pad 是否比原生预设更好听」这个问题，本仓库目前**没有能力测量**；这正是接线必须带 per-role 开关、原生引擎作回退的原因（回退是一个常量，不是一次 revert）。③ 路由表按**乐器名**决策、不区分曲风：同一个 `warm_pad` 在 ambient 与在 house 里拿到同一个 patch；逐曲风 patch 微调属后续工作。④ `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 已被两个「vendor 目录不许有未登记文件」的检查列入白名单——它是**我们自己的**合规文件，不是上游 pin，因此不进哈希清单（文件里也写了这一点）。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) **Engine wiring has not started**: `chords` and `lead` are still voiced by the native engine, and **no track's sound changes in this release** — what ships is every precondition for wiring (adapter, measured ceiling, compliance, routing table). (2) The ten patches are **written from parameter semantics, not tuned by ear**: `gs1Patches.ts` is currently **dead code with no consumer** and is **not** within the scope of `scripts/timbre.baseline.json`, which fingerprints the native chain. Whether GS-1's pad actually sounds better than the native preset is a question **this repository cannot currently measure**, which is exactly why the wiring must ship behind a per-role switch with the native engine as the fallback (reverting is a constant, not a revert). (3) The routing table decides by **instrument name, not by genre**: the same `warm_pad` gets the same patch in ambient and in house; per-genre patch refinement is later work. (4) `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is allow-listed in the two checks that forbid unlisted files under `vendor/` — it is **our** compliance file rather than an upstream pin, so it is not hashed into the manifest (the file says so itself).

title.zh: v2.0.6 GS-1 接入预算实测（P6 Phase 0）：适配器手写落地、E2 通过、E3 给出「8 复音上限」这个可执行的结论——而不是一句「能不能接」
title.en: v2.0.6 GS-1 integration budget measured (P6 Phase 0): the hand-written adapter lands, E2 passes, and E3 returns an actionable answer — a polyphony ceiling of 8, not a yes/no on the whole integration

highlights.zh: **手写的九方法窄接口**（`src/audio/gs1/Gs1Host.ts`）：直接对接 vendored worklet 的消息协议，**不 import** 上游那个 40+ 方法的 `engine.ts`——于是计划里那 4 个非 vendored 的 host 依赖（`./settle`、`./wasmFetch`、`@/pwa/register`、`@/i18n`）从根上就不存在。它**不创建 AudioContext**（建在应用已有的 context 上，避免第 6 个 context 与 iOS 上两个 audio session 打架）；参数 id → AudioParam 名称直接读 vendored `PARAM_NAMES`，**不手写第二份参数表**（计划风险 R4）；SIMD→标量回退以 `WebAssembly.validate` 的实际结果为准，不靠特性探测；**不暴露 `noteBend`/微分音**——ABI 8 根本没导出，暴露它们就是撒谎。
highlights.en: **A hand-written nine-method narrow adapter** (`src/audio/gs1/Gs1Host.ts`) talks straight to the vendored worklet's message protocol and does **not** import the upstream 40-plus-method `engine.ts` — so the four non-vendored host dependencies the plan flagged (`./settle`, `./wasmFetch`, `@/pwa/register`, `@/i18n`) simply do not exist here. It **never creates an AudioContext** (it builds on the app's existing one, avoiding a sixth context and two audio sessions fighting on iOS); it maps parameter ids to AudioParam names by reading the vendored `PARAM_NAMES` rather than writing a second parameter table (plan risk R4); its SIMD-to-scalar fallback trusts `WebAssembly.validate` over feature detection; and it **does not expose `noteBend` or microtuning** — ABI 8 does not export them, so exposing them would be a lie.

highlights.zh: **E2 通过：在 Groove Lab 自己的构建与应用自己的 AudioContext 上，GS-1 真的能跑**。走 Vite dev server 加载 vendored worklet，**SIMD 核**、**ABI 8**、每个配置都真的出声（peak 0.22–0.44）、**分配器违规 0**、页面错误 0。此前对它的最强证据只是「WASM 在 Node 里能 validate」。
highlights.en: **E2 passes: GS-1 really runs on Groove Lab's own build and on the app's own AudioContext.** The vendored worklet loads through the Vite dev server, the **SIMD core** comes up, it reports **ABI 8**, every configuration actually makes sound (peak 0.22–0.44), **allocator violations are 0** and there are no page errors. The strongest prior evidence was only that the WASM validates in Node.

highlights.zh: **E3 的决定性数字：满 8 轨（heavy-metal，8 个角色全开 + 母带饱和 + 驱动插入）同时播放时，GS-1 的负载曲线是 4 复音 p90 0.028 / 8 复音 0.054 / 12 复音 0.124 / 16 复音 0.336**。16 复音的 `load` 中位数只有 0.205，看着还有余量，但**实时比掉到 0.58——音频线程已经在丢帧**，这是「看着有余量、实际在丢帧」的典型误判。结论因此不是「能不能接」，而是**把 GS-1 的复音上限定在 8（最多 12）**：8 复音足够覆盖 chords（3–5 音声部）+ lead（1 音），p90 仅 0.054、实时比 1.00。计划原文「超 0.35 就只做单声部 lead」的二元规则，在实测面前放宽为「chords+lead 共用一个 8 复音实例」，但仍**不**做 16 复音持续和弦。
highlights.en: **E3's decisive numbers.** With the full 8-track arrangement playing (heavy-metal: all eight roles, master saturation, driven inserts), GS-1's load curve is p90 **0.028 at 4 voices, 0.054 at 8, 0.124 at 12 and 0.336 at 16**. At 16 voices the *median* load is only 0.205, which looks like headroom — but the **real-time ratio collapses to 0.58, i.e. the audio thread is already dropping frames**. That is the classic headroom illusion. So the answer is not yes/no but a **polyphony ceiling of 8 (12 at the very most)**: eight voices already cover chords (a 3-5 note voicing) plus a lead, at p90 0.054 and real-time ratio 1.00. The plan's binary rule (above 0.35, restrict to a single lead voice) is relaxed by measurement to "chords and lead share one 8-voice instance" — but 16 sustained voices are still off the table.

highlights.zh: **两个只有实测才会暴露的坑，都已固化进门禁**：① 处理器在**前 2000 ms 渲染音频里故意把 `load` 报成 0**（`WARMUP_MS`，为了不让首次触发的 JIT 误判过载），且开销估计是非对称跟随器——1.5 s 的测量窗口会得到「全程 0.000」，第一版脚本正是如此，等于「证明了 GS-1 免费」；现在测量强制 hold−postWarmup ≥ 2 s，门禁也会拒绝窗口不足的报告。② **源节点不连到 destination 就永远不会被拉取**，worklet 不跑、分析帧全缺、load 是 NaN——第一版适配器就踩了这个。新增的 `scripts/check_gs1_load.mjs` 检查的正是「这份证据还有没有资格说话」：窗口长度、warmup 常量与处理器是否一致、每个配置是否真的出声/零违规/有 settled 帧，以及文档化复音上限处的 p90 与实时比（已接入慢轨）。
highlights.en: **Two pitfalls that only measurement could expose, now enforced by a gate.** (1) The processor deliberately reports `load = 0` for the first **2000 ms of rendered audio** (`WARMUP_MS`, so first-touch JIT cannot trigger a false overload verdict) and its cost estimate is an asymmetric follower — a 1.5 s window therefore reports a flat 0.000, which is exactly what the first version of the script did, effectively "proving" GS-1 is free. The measurement now insists on hold-minus-post-warmup >= 2 s and the gate rejects a report whose window is too short. (2) **A source node that reaches no destination is never pulled**, so the worklet never runs, every analysis frame is missing and `load` is NaN — the first adapter version did that too. The new `scripts/check_gs1_load.mjs` checks whether the evidence is still entitled to speak: window length, agreement with the processor's warm-up constant, and per-configuration audibility, zero violations and settled frames, plus p90 and real-time ratio at the documented polyphony ceiling (wired into the slow track).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① **请求 24/32 复音时只有 16 个音真的发声**，即使显式发了 `setPolyphony`；`gs_max_voices()` 报 32，实际停在 16，**本次测量无法区分是核心内部上限还是 worklet 的夹取**——Phase 2 若要超过 8 复音必须先查清。② 数据来自**一台 8 核桌面 + 无头 Chromium，不是手机**；移动端未测，因此在移动端把上限从 8 往上调没有依据。③ **Phase 2 的引擎接线尚未开始**：本版只交付适配器与实测结论，`chords`/`lead` 仍由原生引擎发声。④ 接线前还缺两件事：`lead` 的 **27 个乐器名 → GS-1 patch 映射表**（计划已指出这是最大一块工作），以及 **署名合规**——`vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`（DaisySP + Soundpipe 的 MIT 署名）**目前不存在**，上游产物里也没有，必须我们补；**在补上之前不得发布任何让 GS-1 发声的构建**。⑤ 证据门禁**不检测「GS-1 变慢了」**——那需要重跑测量（与响度、音色两个门禁同一个盲区）。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) **Requesting 24 or 32 voices produced only 16 sounding voices**, even after an explicit `setPolyphony`; `gs_max_voices()` reports 32 but the sounding count stops at 16, and **this measurement cannot tell whether that is a core limit or a clamp in the worklet** — Phase 2 must settle it before going above 8 voices. (2) The data comes from **an 8-core desktop with headless Chromium, not a phone**; mobile was not measured, so raising the ceiling above 8 there would be unevidenced. (3) **Phase 2 engine wiring has not started**: this release ships the adapter and the measurement verdict only, and `chords`/`lead` are still voiced by the native engine. (4) Two things are still missing before wiring: the **27 lead instrument names to GS-1 patch mapping** (the plan already flags it as the largest single piece of work), and **attribution compliance** — `vendor/gs1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` (the MIT notices for DaisySP and Soundpipe) **does not exist** and is absent from the upstream artifacts too, so we must add it; **no build that makes GS-1 audible may ship before that is in place**. (5) The evidence gate **cannot detect that GS-1 got slower** — that needs a re-measurement, the same blind spot the loudness and timbre gates have.

title.zh: v2.0.5 每个曲风有自己的一条通道条；159 个曲风首次有了可测的音色基线；顺带修好响度匹配被饱和吃掉、以及真峰值超出承诺这两个真实缺陷
title.en: v2.0.5 Every genre gets its own channel strip; the 159 genres get a measurable timbre baseline for the first time; and two real defects are fixed — loudness matching absorbed by saturation, and true peaks above the promised ceiling

highlights.zh: **逐曲风通道条**（需求 9 阶段 D / `src/data/genreInsert.ts`）：此前通道条只有「角色」一层——金属的节奏吉他和爵士的伴奏共用同一套 EQ/压缩/驱动设置。现在 **159 个曲风逐一手写**（14 个命名 patch 复用，每条带一行理由）：金属节奏吉他驱动 **4.5**、爵士伴奏**不驱动**、dub 贝斯 **2.2**（当音色而非失真）+ 450 Hz 挖空、808 类曲风压缩释放拉长到 0.25 s、lo-fi 压暗 6.5 kHz 并轻推、拉丁打击乐在 1.4 k/9 k 各 +2.5 dB。用户存过的逐轨设置仍然优先。**驱动一律 ≤ 0.6 混合比**，避免把音色变化做成电平跳变——实测 159 曲风的中位数电平只动了约 0.2 dB。
highlights.en: **Per-genre channel strips** (requirement 9 phase D / `src/data/genreInsert.ts`). The channel strip previously had only a *role* layer, so a metal rhythm guitar and a jazz comp shared one EQ/compressor/drive setting. All **159 genres are now written out by hand** (14 named patches reused, each entry carrying its reason): metal rhythm guitar driven at **4.5**, jazz comp **undriven**, dub bass at **2.2** as colour rather than distortion with a 450 Hz scoop, 808 genres given a 0.25 s compressor release, lo-fi dulled at 6.5 kHz with a little grit, Latin percussion lifted +2.5 dB at 1.4 k and 9 k. A per-track chain the user has stored still wins. **Drive mix stays <= 0.6** so the change is character and not a level jump — the measured median level across the 159 genres moved by about 0.2 dB.

highlights.zh: **159 个曲风第一次有了可测的音色基线（V-10）**：新增 13 段 2/3 倍频程滤波器组的音色指纹（电平无关的形状向量 + 质心 + 滚降 + 立体声相关度），在真实浏览器里离线渲染全部曲风写成 `scripts/timbre.baseline.json`，并配一个不渲染的快速门禁（已接入慢轨）。实测 **159/159 形状互异**，最近一对 `brostep ↔ glitch-hop` 相距 0.4552 dB（地板 0.25），平均对距 3.49 dB，重复渲染极差 ≤ 1e-4 dB，质心跨度 100 Hz（schranz）→ 1022 Hz（free-jazz）。这就是「全量听感复核」的客观替身：如果 159 个曲风的默认值退化成一个样子，门禁会红。门禁还会核对插入链源码摘要与每个曲风的乐器清单，插入默认值被改动时**指名到曲风**。
highlights.en: **The 159 genres get a measurable timbre baseline for the first time (V-10).** A new 13-band (2/3-octave) filterbank fingerprint — a level-independent shape vector plus centroid, rolloff and stereo correlation — renders every genre offline in a real browser into `scripts/timbre.baseline.json`, backed by a browser-free gate wired into the slow track. Measured: **159/159 shapes are distinct**, the closest pair (`brostep` vs `glitch-hop`) sits 0.4552 dB apart against a 0.25 dB floor, mean pairwise distance 3.49 dB, repeat-to-repeat spread <= 1e-4 dB, centroid span 100 Hz (schranz) to 1022 Hz (free-jazz). It is the objective stand-in for a full listening review: if the 159 genres' defaults ever collapse into one sound, the gate goes red. It also reconciles the insert-chain source digest and each genre's instrument list, naming the affected genres when an insert default changes.

highlights.zh: **查出并修好两个真实缺陷（都是靠重测发现的）**。① **响度补偿被饱和吃掉**：补偿增益原本站在母带 FX 机架**之前**，而机架里的饱和是非线性的——一个需要 +7.07 dB 补偿的曲风实测只涨了 **1.74 dB**，于是安静又带饱和的曲风（dubstep / doom-metal / riddim / metalcore）永远追不上目标，而削减却几乎精确。链路改为「推子 → FX 机架 → 响度 trim → 真峰值限幅器」，trim 成为最后一个线性级。附带收益：音色不再依赖「这个曲风需要多少响度补偿」，V-10 基线因此对每个曲风都如实成立。② **真峰值超出承诺**：限幅器自己的检测器比验收用的 4× 过采样标准表低读约 0.12 dB，实测最差 **−0.88 dBTP**，即超过了承诺的 −1.0 dBTP。不争论谁更对：给限幅器加 0.15 dB 检测余量（内部目标 −1.15 dBTP），让**承诺由测量兑现**。
highlights.en: **Two real defects found and fixed — both only visible by re-measuring.** (1) **Loudness matching was being eaten by saturation**: the correction gain sat *before* the master FX rack, and the rack's saturation is nonlinear, so a genre that needed +7.07 dB moved by only **1.74 dB** — the quiet, saturating genres (dubstep, doom-metal, riddim, metalcore) could never reach the target while the cuts landed almost exactly. The chain is now fader -> FX rack -> loudness trim -> true-peak limiter, making the trim the last linear stage. Side benefit: timbre no longer depends on how much loudness matching a genre needed, so the V-10 baseline describes what the user actually hears for every genre. (2) **True peaks above the promise**: the limiter's own detector under-reads the 4x-oversampled reference meter by about 0.12 dB, measuring as much as **-0.88 dBTP** — above the promised -1.0 dBTP. Rather than argue about which estimator is right, the limiter now carries a 0.15 dB detector margin (internal target -1.15 dBTP) so the promise is kept by measurement.

highlights.zh: **响度重配平到历史最好水平**：`p90−p10` 从上一份基线的 **0.59 → 0.40 LU**（门禁 1.5），全距 3.22 → **2.68 dB**（门禁 4），clamp 命中 **0/159**，采样峰值超 0 dBFS **0/159**，最差真峰值 **−1.027 dBTP**（0/159 超出 −1.0）。绝对电平比上一份基线高约 5.7 dB，回到本计划第 4 节最初记录的 −15.80 LUFS 附近——**这不是「调响」，是把参考电平拉回原始设计点**。同时修好了测量脚本自身的两个缺陷：`--genres=` 子集运行此前会静默覆盖提交的基线；trim 求解此前假设响度对增益线性（BS.1770 的相对门使其非线性），单次相减会残留近 2 dB——现在改为**迭代求解**（每轮只重渲越界曲风、按实测残差修正），并保证报告里每个 trim 都有自己的实测值。
highlights.en: **Loudness re-balanced to the best it has ever measured.** Post-trim `p90-p10` goes from the previous baseline's **0.59 to 0.40 LU** (limit 1.5), full range 3.22 -> **2.68 dB** (limit 4), trim clamp hits **0/159**, sample peaks above 0 dBFS **0/159**, worst true peak **-1.027 dBTP** (0/159 over -1.0). The absolute level rose about 5.7 dB against the previous baseline, landing back near the -15.80 LUFS this plan originally recorded — **that is the reference level returning to its design point, not the library being turned up**. Two defects in the measurement script itself were also fixed: a `--genres=` subset run used to silently overwrite the committed baseline, and the trim solve assumed loudness is linear in gain (BS.1770's relative gate makes it nonlinear), leaving nearly 2 dB of residual after a single subtraction — it is now an **iterative solve** that re-renders only the out-of-tolerance genres and corrects by the measured residual, and every reported trim now has its own measurement.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① **门禁盲区**：响度门禁与音色门禁都**只读已提交的报告，从不重渲染**——它们保证「报告自洽 + 拓扑正确 + 源码未漂移」，**不能**发现「代码改动让实际响度/音色变了」。上一份响度基线正是在门禁全绿的情况下过期了 5.7 dB，这就是本次重测的直接原因。② 迭代 5 轮后仍有 **20 个曲风**没收敛到内部 ±0.2 dB（最差 2.43 dB，microhouse 偏轻），都在门禁口径内，已记入报告的 `trimConvergence.stillOutside`。③ 逐曲风插入的取值是**音乐常识级判断**，没有听感 AB 测试，也没有引用级考证；只有计划 §3.4 点名的几个案例（金属 4–5、爵士关、dub 1.6、house 1.4）有文档依据。④ V-10 是**整段描述子**，不做分帧分析，编曲密度变化若频谱相近则形状几乎不动。⑤ `scripts/loudness_live_baseline.json`（实时路径探针）**未重测**，仍描述旧链路，无门禁读取它。⑥ 母带总线级（鼓组/音乐双总线 + 胶水压缩，E-11）仍未做。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) **Gate blind spot**: both the loudness and timbre gates only read the committed reports and never re-render — they guarantee the report is self-consistent, the topology is right and the sources have not drifted, but they **cannot** notice that a code change altered the actual loudness or timbre. The previous loudness baseline went 5.7 dB stale while every gate stayed green, which is exactly why this re-measurement happened. (2) After 5 rounds, **20 genres** still sit outside the internal +/-0.2 dB tolerance (worst 2.43 dB, microhouse on the quiet side); all are inside the gated thresholds and are recorded in the report's `trimConvergence.stillOutside`. (3) The per-genre insert values are **musical-common-knowledge judgements** with no listening A/B and no citation-level research; only the cases the plan names in section 3.4 (metal 4-5, jazz off, dub, house) have documented backing. (4) V-10 is a **single whole-buffer descriptor** with no per-frame analysis, so an arrangement-density change with similar spectra barely moves it. (5) `scripts/loudness_live_baseline.json` (the live-path probe) was **not** re-measured and still describes the old chain; no gate reads it. (6) The bus-level work (drum/music buses plus glue compression, E-11) is still not done.

title.zh: v2.0.4 工具栏频率分层落表（C-01/G-01）并首次完整登记全部键位；159 个曲风的「经典走向」不再是同一对
title.en: v2.0.4 Toolbar frequency tiers land as data (C-01/G-01) with every key binding recorded at last; the 159 genres stop sharing one chord-progression pair

highlights.zh: **工具栏 55 个控件按三级频率落成常量表**（`src/components/sequencer/toolbarTiers.ts`）：Tier 1 **12** 项（侧栏/播放/BPM/槽位/小节 + 力度/欧几里得/分析仪/撤销/重做/最大化/更多）、Tier 2 **17** 项、Tier 3 **26** 项，并导出 `DEFAULT_VISIBLE_IDS` 供下一步「一级行瘦身 + 更多面板」消费。**`Toolbar.tsx` 一行未改**——这一版只建表，UI 不变，所以没有任何可见回归面。
highlights.en: **All 55 toolbar controls are now a three-tier constant table** (`toolbarTiers.ts`): Tier 1 **12** (sidebar/play/BPM/slot/bar + velocity/euclid/analyzer/undo/redo/maximize/more), Tier 2 **17**, Tier 3 **26**, plus `DEFAULT_VISIBLE_IDS` for the upcoming slim-the-primary-row + more-panel milestone. **`Toolbar.tsx` is untouched** — this release only builds the table, so there is no visible surface to regress.

highlights.zh: **一处必须纠正的计划冲突**：计划要求「凡有单键快捷键的控件必须在 Tier 1」，但 `useTransportShortcuts` 实际绑定了 **5 个**单键，其中 3 个（**D** 只鼓、**P** 工程中心、**C** 浮窗调音台）不在计划点名的 Tier 1 名单里。照字面执行 Tier 1 会变成 15 项，突破同一份计划里 ≤14 的硬指标。现在规则改为它真正想要的形式：**任何带键位的控件要么本身在 Tier 1，要么声明一个 Tier 1 的入口**（新增 `reachableVia`）。三个键位因此带**真实键位 + reachableVia 指向 more** 记录在案。**子代理的第一版是把这三个键位从表里删掉**——那会让这张「唯一真相表」对应用自己的键位模型说谎，已修正。
highlights.en: **A plan conflict that had to be corrected.** The plan says any control with a single-key binding must be Tier 1, but `useTransportShortcuts` actually binds **five** single keys, three of which (**D** drums-only, **P** project hub, **C** floating console) the plan's Tier 1 list does not name. Taken literally, Tier 1 becomes 15 items and breaks the same plan's own <= 14 exit criterion. The rule is now stated in the form it was aiming at: **a shortcut-bearing control is either Tier 1 itself or declares a Tier 1 entry point** (new `reachableVia`). All three bindings are therefore recorded with their **real tokens plus reachableVia: more**. The first revision produced by the subagent simply *deleted* those three bindings from the table, which would have made the single source of truth lie about the app's own keyboard model.

highlights.zh: **键位表不再可能与代码脱节**：新增测试直接读 `useTransportShortcuts.ts`，把 hook 里声明的每一个单键键位与表逐一对账，少一个就红；顺带补上了重做的第二个绑定 **Cmd/Ctrl+Y**（新增 `shortcutAliases`，因为 `shortcut` 是单值）。共 **27** 条用例，其中 **9** 条是变异守卫（重复 id、无入口的键位、入口指向不存在的控件、入口指向非 Tier 1、Tier 1 超限、键位重复……），保证「表是合法的」这句绿是有意义的绿。
highlights.en: **The table can no longer drift from the code.** A new test reads `useTransportShortcuts.ts` and reconciles every single-key binding it declares against the table; one missing key turns it red. It also surfaced redo's second binding, **Cmd/Ctrl+Y**, now recorded via `shortcutAliases` (since `shortcut` is single-valued). **27** cases, **9** of them mutation-style guards (duplicate id, shortcut with no entry point, entry point naming an unknown control, entry point that is not Tier 1, Tier 1 over the cap, duplicated tokens, ...), so the green assertion that the table is valid actually means something.

highlights.zh: **曲风「经典走向」数据修复**：实测发现 159 个曲风的 `common_chords` 只有 **1** 种取值——**全部**都是 `i–VI–III–VII` / `i–v–VI–VII`。bebop、salsa、K-pop、black metal、ambient 在曲风详情页上写着同一条小调进行。现在逐曲风给出 2–3 条该曲风真正使用的套路（`bebop` → `ii–V–I`、`chicago-blues` → `I–IV–V–IV`、`black-metal` → `i–♭II–♭VII–i`、`j-pop` → `IV–V–iii–vi` 王道进行、`uk-drill` → `i–VI–iv–v`），不同取值集合数 **1 → 110**，没有任何一个集合被超过 **7** 个曲风共用。新增 7 条守卫并**接入 `npm run lint:data`**：语法必须是罗马数字、每曲风 2–3 条、且「不同集合数 > 40 且无集合被 > 10 个曲风共用」——这条才是防止退回「全库一个默认值」的哨兵。
highlights.en: **Genre classic-progressions data fix.** Measurement showed all 159 genres shared **exactly one** `common_chords` value set — every single one read `i–VI–III–VII` / `i–v–VI–VII`, so bebop, salsa, K-pop, black metal and ambient all displayed the same minor-key vamp on their genre page. Each genre now carries 2-3 progressions its idiom actually uses (`bebop` -> `ii–V–I`, `chicago-blues` -> `I–IV–V–IV`, `black-metal` -> `i–♭II–♭VII–i`, `j-pop` -> the royal-road `IV–V–iii–vi`, `uk-drill` -> `i–VI–iv–v`). Distinct value sets went **1 -> 110**, and no set is shared by more than **7** genres. Seven guards were added and **wired into `npm run lint:data`**: roman-numeral grammar, 2-3 entries per genre, and more than 40 distinct sets with none shared by more than 10 genres — the sentinel that stops the library sliding back to one default.

highlights.zh: **本版走了合并慢轨（v2.0.2 之后第一次）并全绿**：全量单测 + 覆盖率、全量 lint 与数据 lint、生产构建、包体预算（含 wasm 行）、**3 浏览器 × 7 端** e2e 矩阵（Chromium/Firefox/WebKit + iPhone 14 竖横 + iPad Pro 11 竖横，7/7 PASS）、真实浏览器性能门（桌面 LCP 1644 ms / 移动 LCP 3572 ms，首屏仅拉 1 个曲风 chunk）、**23 条红线**、以及响度门（159 曲风 **0** 个削波，最差真峰值 **−1.000 dBTP**，trim 触顶 0/159）。按「多个版本走一次慢轨」的节奏，这一次同时覆盖了 v2.0.3 的轨道头改动。
highlights.en: **This release ran the batched slow track (the first since v2.0.2) and passed everything**: the full unit suite plus coverage, full lint and data lint, production build, bundle budgets (wasm rows included), the **3-browser x 7-target** e2e matrix (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, iPhone 14 portrait+landscape, iPad Pro 11 portrait+landscape — 7/7 PASS), the real-browser perf gate (desktop LCP 1644 ms, mobile LCP 3572 ms, still only one genre chunk on first paint), **23 red lines**, and the loudness gate (159 genres, **0** clipping, worst true peak **-1.000 dBTP**, trim clamp 0/159). Per the run-the-slow-track-once-per-few-versions cadence, this run also covered v2.0.3's track-header change.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未做 / 未验证）**：① 曲风进行是**纯展示字段**，不经过音频链路（引擎的和声来自曲风音阶与 `genreVoicing.ts`），所以**不需要重测响度**，159 曲风 trim 基线未动——改这些字符串不会让任何曲风更好听，它修的是「应用在教用户什么」；这 159 条属**音乐常识级**取舍，**没有引用级考证**。② `toolbarTiers.ts` 目前**没有消费方**，三级分层尚未作用于界面；实际「常显控件 ≤14 / 工具栏 ≤56 px」要等瘦身里程碑，本版**未做任何像素测量**。③ 中等频率控件的归档是**判断**，仓库里没有使用遥测。④ 有几个控件只在传入可选 prop 时才渲染，分层假设的是完整工作台配置。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) The progressions are a **display-only field** that never reaches the audio path (engine harmony comes from the genre's scale and `genreVoicing.ts`), so **no loudness re-measurement was needed** and the 159-genre trim baseline is untouched — changing these strings does not make any genre sound better, it changes what the app teaches. The 159 sets are **musical-common-knowledge level**, not citation-level research. (2) `toolbarTiers.ts` currently has **no consumer**: the tiers do not affect the UI yet, and the actual <= 14 visible controls / toolbar <= 56 px targets belong to the slimming milestone — **no pixel measurement was done here**. (3) Assigning medium-frequency controls to a tier is a **judgement call**; the repo has no usage telemetry. (4) Several controls only render when an optional prop is supplied, so the tiers assume the full studio configuration.

title.zh: v2.0.3 点击轨道头就打开该轨道的详细设置（音色 / 混音 / 效果），试听移到独立的 ▶ 按钮
title.en: v2.0.3 Click a track header to open that track's settings (timbre / mix / effects); auditioning moves to its own ▶ button

highlights.zh: **轨道头成为检查器入口（Logic 式）**：此前打开一条轨道的详细设置只能靠轨道头里一个 16px 的滑块图标——用户明确要求「点击每个轨道头要可以打开这个轨道的详细配置信息和参数」。现在点击轨道头的色条/电平表/名称区域即打开该轨道的检查器：**音色**（乐器预设）、**混音**（音量、声像、两路发送、静音、独奏）、**效果**（通道条 insert 链），三组共 31 个控件；支持键盘 Enter/Space 打开，当前打开的行带同色高亮描边与 aria-expanded 状态。
highlights.en: **The track header is now the inspector entry point (Logic style).** Before, the only way into a track's detailed settings was a 16px sliders icon inside the header — the user asked for "clicking each track header to open that track's detailed configuration and parameters". Clicking the header's colour bar / level meter / name area now opens the inspector for that track: **timbre** (instrument preset), **mix** (volume, pan, two sends, mute, solo) and **effects** (the channel-strip insert chain), 31 controls across three sections, openable from the keyboard with Enter/Space, with the open row ringed in its own track colour and exposed as `aria-expanded`.

highlights.zh: **试听独立成一个 ▶ 按钮**：轨道头点击此前是「试听音色」，两个动作共用一个手势必然要牺牲一个。现在 ▶ 专管试听、轨道头专管设置，各有明确入口，语义也不再互相污染（`track_audition_title` 从轨道头移到了 ▶ 按钮上）。
highlights.en: **Auditioning gets its own ▶ button.** The header click used to mean "audition this timbre", and one gesture cannot carry both jobs without losing one. The ▶ button now owns auditioning and the header owns settings, so neither is a hidden mode (the `track_audition_title` hint moved from the header onto the ▶ button).

highlights.zh: **重排轨道时检查器跟随同一轨道**：检查器按行号定位，而 `REORDER_TRACKS` 交换两行——此前把轨道上移或下移一次，面板就会静默改成编辑相邻轨道。现在索引跟随被移动的那一行；边界上的空操作（第 0 行上移、最后一行下移）不会把索引顶出范围。规则抽成纯函数 `followReorderedRow`，7 条单测覆盖跟随、被挤开、无关行与空操作。
highlights.en: **The inspector follows the same track across reorders.** It is addressed by row index while `REORDER_TRACKS` swaps two rows, so one move-up/down silently retargeted the panel at the neighbouring track. The index now follows the moved row, and the clamped no-ops at either end (▲ on row 0, ▼ on the last row) can no longer push it out of range. The rule is a pure function, `followReorderedRow`, with 7 unit tests covering follow, displaced, unrelated and no-op cases.

highlights.zh: **测试**：修复 `sequencerMemo` 因为轨道头新增图标而失败的 4 条用例（mock 缺少新导出的图标）；新增 `trackRowHeader`（7 条，钉住「轨道头开面板、▶ 试听、两者不互相触发、键盘可达」）与 `inspectorFollow`（7 条）。
highlights.en: **Tests.** Fixed the 4 `sequencerMemo` cases that broke when the header gained an icon (the lucide mock was missing the new export), and added `trackRowHeader` (7 cases pinning header-opens-panel, ▶-auditions, neither cross-firing, and keyboard reachability) plus `inspectorFollow` (7 cases).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明（未验证项）**：本版按新规则只走**快轨**（类型检查、变更文件 lint、相关用例、红线），慢轨（全量测试 / 覆盖率 / 构建 / 3 浏览器 e2e / 性能与响度门）合并到下次发布前一次执行，因此本版的回归可能在 1–2 个增量内不被发现。检查器面板本身仍是纯展示组件，`color-mix` 高亮在很旧的浏览器上会退化为「无高亮」而不是报错；真实 Web Audio 插入链由 E-10 的快照与接线测试覆盖，未在 jsdom 中做真实音频渲染验证。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** Per the new rule this release runs the **fast track only** (typecheck, changed-file lint, affected tests, red lines); the slow track (full suite, coverage, build, 3-browser e2e, perf and loudness gates) is batched into the next release, so a regression here can sit undetected for one or two increments. The inspector stays a presentational component, and the `color-mix` highlight degrades to "no highlight" rather than an error on very old browsers; the real Web Audio insert chain is covered by E-10's snapshot and wiring tests, not by a real audio render in jsdom.

title.zh: v2.0.2 真混响与真延迟上线、逐曲风母带效果默认值（dub 长延迟 / ambient 长混响 / metal 饱和）、力度终于改变音色
title.en: v2.0.2 Real reverb and delay, per-genre master FX defaults (dub's long delay, ambient's long reverb, metal's saturation), and velocity that finally changes timbre

highlights.zh: **每个曲风终于有自己的母带效果默认值**（登记项 N-14）。此前全库共用一套机架、四个效果**全部默认关闭**，159 个曲风零声明——「混音按曲风特色」到效果这一层就断了。现在 6 个分类 profile + **55 条逐曲风编排**，三个点名案例：**dub** 用四分音符长延迟、反馈 0.68、反馈环低通 2 kHz（重复逐次变暗）加 ping-pong；**ambient** 用 **9 秒**混响、预延迟 70 ms、返回 0.50；**金属**（death/thrash/heavy/black/metalcore）**饱和开启**（drive 4.5–6）配极小房间。切换曲风即载入该曲风默认（与换 patch 同义）。
highlights.en: **Every genre finally has its own master FX defaults** (registered as N-14). One shared rack with all four effects **off by default** and zero declarations across 159 genres meant "the mix reflects the genre" stopped at the effects layer. There are now six category profiles plus **55 per-genre arrangements**: **dub** gets a quarter-note delay at 0.68 feedback with a 2 kHz low-pass in the loop so repeats darken as they travel, plus ping-pong; **ambient** gets a **9-second** reverb with 70 ms pre-delay and 0.50 return; the **metal** genres get **saturation on** (drive 4.5–6) with a tiny room. Changing genre loads that genre's defaults, exactly like changing a patch.

highlights.zh: **混响和延迟本身也换掉了**。旧混响是一个固定 1.5 秒的**白噪声**脉冲响应：没有频率相关衰减，尾巴一直是亮的、像加了噪声而不是空间；也没有预延迟和早期反射，返回量硬编码。旧延迟固定 250 ms、反馈环里**没有滤波**（每次重复都全带宽、越来越刺耳）、单声道。现在：混响有预延迟 + 5 个早期反射 + **分频段衰减**（高频先衰减，这才是「尾巴随时间变暗」）、可控立体声宽度、确定性种子；延迟可设音乐分割、**反馈环内置低通**、可选 ping-pong。实测 RT60 精度 ~0.2%（0.6 s→0.599、10 s→9.988）。
highlights.en: **The reverb and delay themselves were replaced.** The old reverb was a fixed 1.5 s **white-noise** impulse: no frequency-dependent decay, so the tail stayed bright and read as added noise rather than space, plus no pre-delay, no early reflections and a hard-coded return. The old delay was a fixed 250 ms with **no filter in the feedback loop** (every repeat full-bandwidth, progressively harsher) and mono. Now: pre-delay, five early reflections, **per-band decay** (highs fade first — that is what makes a tail darken), controllable stereo width and a deterministic seed; the delay takes musical divisions, has a **low-pass inside the loop**, and offers ping-pong. Measured RT60 is accurate to ~0.2% (0.6 s→0.599, 10 s→9.988).

highlights.zh: **导出终于和试听是同一条链路**（关闭 N-16）。此前离线导出器**根本没有送出总线、也没有主 FX 机架**：159 个曲风精心编排的混响/延迟送出在成品里完全不存在，用户拧的 FLT/DRIVE/CHORUS/LO-FI 也不在成品里；而且导出用 0.85 推子、实时用 0.8，还有一个无关的 ~0.5 dB 偏差。现在实时与离线共用**同一个** `buildMasterGraph`，链路与逐曲风效果都由同一函数应用。
highlights.en: **Export and audition are finally the same chain** (closing N-16). The offline renderer had **no send buses and no master FX rack at all**: the reverb/delay sends curated for all 159 genres simply were not in the file, and neither was anything dialled into FLT/DRIVE/CHORUS/LO-FI. It also ran a 0.85 fader against playback's 0.8 — an unrelated ~0.5 dB offset. Both now share one `buildMasterGraph`, and the per-genre effects are applied by one shared function.

highlights.zh: **力度终于改变音色，不再只是音量**。此前力度只映射到音量且是线性（力度 64 = −6 dB）。现在有 `v²` 的感知曲线，以及 4 个可选的逐预设力度响应：低通截止、滤波包络深度、起音、衰减。**21 个拟真类预设**（钢琴、Rhodes、立式贝斯、萨克斯、小号、长笛、弦乐、颤音琴、马林巴、钟琴、西塔琴、手风琴、口琴、管风琴、吉他等）已标注，重音更亮更短、弱音更暗更绵。**满力度输出逐字节不变**（对 51 预设 × 3 音高 × 4 时值比较全部调度参数：612/612 一致）。
highlights.en: **Velocity finally changes timbre, not just level.** It previously mapped to amplitude alone and linearly (velocity 64 = −6 dB). There is now a perceptual `v²` curve plus four optional per-preset velocity responses: low-pass cutoff, filter-envelope depth, attack and decay. **21 emulative presets** are annotated (piano, Rhodes, upright bass, sax, trumpet, flute, strings, vibraphone, marimba, bells, sitar, accordion, harmonica, organ, guitars), so accents are brighter and shorter while soft notes are darker and rounder. **Full-velocity output is byte-identical** (verified across 51 presets × 3 pitches × 4 durations, comparing every scheduled parameter: 612/612).

highlights.zh: **打击乐轨从「两种声音」变成 16 个模型**。此前 percussion 轨只能是 808 牛铃或拍手——而拉丁/世界、爵士、Afrobeat 这些曲风**就是**由康加、天巴鼓、沙锤、Clave、Agogo 构成的。现在按轨道声明的乐器名分派：复合 `rim_shaker`（全部 159 个曲风实际用的名字）、膜类（康加/邦戈/天巴/通鼓）、金属类（Agogo/三角铁）、木质类（Clave/边击/木鱼）、沙锤类（沙锤/Cabasa/Guiro/铃鼓），未知名字保持原有回退。鼓也获得力度→音色（亮度/衰减/瞬态），满力度逐参数与旧实现 0 差异。
highlights.en: **The percussion track goes from two sounds to 16 models.** It could only be an 808 cowbell or a handclap — while Latin/World, Jazz and Afrobeat are *built on* congas, timbales, shakers, claves and agogo. Dispatch is now by the track's declared instrument: a composite `rim_shaker` (the name every one of the 159 genres actually uses), membranes (conga/bongo/timbale/tom), metals (agogo/triangle), woods (clave/rimshot/woodblock), shakers (shaker/cabasa/guiro/tambourine), with the original fallback preserved for unknown names. Drums also gained velocity→timbre (brightness, decay, transient), with full velocity unchanged parameter-for-parameter.

highlights.zh: **工作台：FX 机架不再「有壳无芯」**。此前引擎接受 7 个参数，UI 只暴露 4 个开关，于是截止频率永远停在 16 kHz、驱动/混合/位深永远停在默认值。现在抽屉里接出了**对数**截止频率滑条、滤波类型、饱和驱动、合唱混合、比特深度（Q 与合唱速率在高级区），并让 FX 改动**进入撤销栈**——此前改 FX 再按 Ctrl+Z 只回退音符、不回退效果，是个半吊子撤销。这个缺陷是**先写会红的测试**证明的：修改前 7 个参数**0/7** 有写入点。
highlights.en: **Studio: the FX rack is no longer a shell with no core.** The engine accepted seven parameters while the UI exposed four on/off toggles, so cutoff sat at 16 kHz and drive/mix/bit-depth at their defaults forever. The drawer now exposes a **logarithmic** cutoff slider, filter type, saturation drive, chorus mix and bit depth (with Q and chorus rate in an advanced row), and FX edits **join the undo stack** — previously undo rolled back the notes while leaving the effect in place, a half-undo. The defect was proven by a test written to fail first: **0/7** parameters had a write point before the change.

highlights.zh: **GS-1 合成器整合的第一步落地**：vendor 管线与契约门禁。上游 GS-1（MIT、ABI 8）被钉死到 `v2.1.4 @ 2b5b3550`，含两个 wasm（SIMD 217 KB / scalar 203 KB）与许可证；`scripts/sync-gs1.mjs` 是**单向**的（结构上不可能写回上游），`scripts/check-gs1.mjs` 有 **22 项**断言（哈希、ABI、从模块读出的上限、参数表无重复、渲染非静音、零分配违规）。同时给包体门禁**补上 wasm 行**——此前它只看 `.js`，几百 KB 的 wasm 对它完全不可见（实测 147.2 KB）。真正的引擎接入仍待多轨 CPU 实测后再决定范围。
highlights.en: **First step of the GS-1 synth integration lands:** the vendor pipeline and its contract gate. Upstream GS-1 (MIT, ABI 8) is pinned to `v2.1.4 @ 2b5b3550`, including both wasm builds (SIMD 217 KB / scalar 203 KB) and the licence. `scripts/sync-gs1.mjs` is one-directional by construction, and `scripts/check-gs1.mjs` runs **22 assertions** (hashes, ABI, limits read out of the module, no duplicate parameter ids, non-silent render, zero allocation violations). The bundle-budget gate also gained a wasm line — it previously only looked at `.js`, so a few hundred KB of wasm was completely invisible to it (measured: 147.2 KB). Wiring the engine in still waits on a multi-track CPU measurement.

highlights.zh: **全库重新配平**（所有改变电平的改动都必须走这一步）：配平后 p90−p10 **0.59 LU**、全距 3.22 LU、clamp 命中 **0/159**；样本峰值超 0 dBFS **0/159**、最差真峰值 −1.000 dBTP（天花板 −1.0，即限幅器正在工作）。trim 上限由 +6 放宽到 +9，因为新的逐曲风效果把极值拉宽了（`doom-metal` 需要 +6.7 dB），而**被 clamp 的 trim 会静默破坏那个曲风的响度承诺**。
highlights.en: **The library was re-matched** (mandatory for any level-changing work): post-trim spread **0.59 LU** p90−p10, 3.22 LU full range, **0/159** clamp hits; **0/159** genres above 0 dBFS sample peak and a worst true peak of −1.000 dBTP (against a −1.0 ceiling, i.e. the limiter working). The trim ceiling was widened from +6 to +9 because the new per-genre effects widened the extremes (`doom-metal` needs +6.7 dB), and a clamped trim silently breaks the loudness promise for that genre.

title.zh: v2.0.1 和弦按曲风的奏法与乐器：金属闷音不再长鸣、雷鬼不再像垫子、失真节奏吉他上线
title.en: v2.0.1 Chords now use each genre's articulation and instrument: metal mutes stop ringing, reggae stops sounding like a pad, and a high-gain rhythm guitar arrives

highlights.zh: **159 个曲风此前共用一套和弦奏法**：所有音一律「一步的 1.5 倍」长、起始错开固定 3 ms。于是雷鬼的 skank 像垫子一样长鸣、funk 的短促和弦糊成一片、金属的闷音却在延音——音高对了，奏法还是错的。现在有 6 种奏法，按「和弦是在承担节奏还是和声」判定：**stab**（0.30 倍长，1 ms）给 house/techno 短促和弦、funk、雷鬼 skank、蒙图诺与金属闷音；**comp**（0.55 倍、8 ms）给爵士伴奏；**strum**（0.80 倍、22 ms，约一次真实下扫的时长）给吉他；**block**（1.0 倍）是原来的行为；**roll**（1.3 倍、90 ms）给琶音滚奏；**sustain**（**3.0 倍**）给垫子、弦乐、ambient/shoegaze 音墙与黑金属颤音拨弦。
highlights.en: **All 159 genres shared one chord articulation.** Every note was `stepDur · gate · 1.5` long with a flat 3 ms onset stagger — so a reggae skank rang like a pad, funk stabs smeared, and metal's palm mutes sustained. The notes were right; the playing was wrong. There are now six articulations chosen by asking whether the chord carries the *rhythm* or the *harmony*: **stab** (0.30x length, 1 ms) for house/techno stabs, funk, the reggae skank, montuno and palm-muted metal; **comp** (0.55x, 8 ms) for jazz; **strum** (0.80x, 22 ms — roughly a real downstroke) for guitar; **block** (1.0x) as the previous behaviour; **roll** (1.3x, 90 ms) for arpeggiated ripples; and **sustain** (**3.0x**) for pads, strings, ambient/shoegaze walls and tremolo-picked black metal.

highlights.zh: **乐器：数据早就写明每把琴的音色，轨道却一律用同一把**。N-12 的策展为每个金属曲风写了具体音箱——`death-metal` 是「HM-2 Buzzsaw Guitar」、`metalcore` 是「High-Gain 5150 Guitar」、`thrash-metal` 是「Scooped-Mid High-Gain Guitar」——但它们的和弦轨**全部**指向通用的主音吉他预设。新增 **`distortedGuitar` 高增益节奏吉他**：截止 1500 Hz（远低于主音的 2700，power chord 活在低中频，这是它不刺耳的原因）、Q 6.5（远高于 3.5，那个中频鼻音让它切得出来）、双锯齿厚墙、快起音短释放。**定点改 9 个高增益曲风**（hard-rock / punk-rock / heavy-metal / thrash / death / black / doom-metal / metalcore / grunge）；非高增益吉他曲风与所有主音轨**不动**。
highlights.en: **Instruments: the data already described each amplifier, but every track used the same generic guitar.** The N-12 curation names a specific amp per metal genre — "HM-2 Buzzsaw Guitar" for death metal, "High-Gain 5150 Guitar" for metalcore, "Scooped-Mid High-Gain Guitar" for thrash — yet all of their chords tracks pointed at the generic lead-guitar preset. A new **`distortedGuitar` high-gain rhythm voice** lands: 1500 Hz cutoff (far below the lead's 2700 — a power chord lives in the low-mids, which is why it does not fizz), Q 6.5 (vs 3.5 — that midrange honk is what makes it cut), a thick two-saw stack, fast attack and short release. **Nine high-gain genres** are switched over; non-high-gain guitar genres and every lead track are left alone.

highlights.zh: **既有门禁把「器材意图」和「轨道」绑在了一起**：`distorted_guitar` 的允许短语直接取自策展文案里已有的词（high-gain / buzzsaw / fuzz / overdriven guitar / tremolo-picked / down-tuned），所以「轨道乐器必须被该曲风的配器清单点名」这条老门禁现在会自动要求两者一致。新增乐器的钉死清单也如期拦下并要求显式更新——这正是它们存在的意义。
highlights.en: **Existing gates now tie amplifier intent to the track.** The new instrument's allowed phrases are taken straight from the curation text (high-gain, buzzsaw, fuzz, overdriven guitar, tremolo-picked, down-tuned), so the long-standing rule that a track's instrument must be *named* by its genre's instrumentation list now enforces the two agree. The pinned instrument survey also caught the new voice and demanded a deliberate update — which is exactly why it exists.

highlights.zh: **重新配平**：奏法显著改变能量分布（stab 只有原来的 30% 长度、sustain 是 300%），因此按流程重测 159 曲风并回填 trim。配平后 p90−p10 **0.69 LU**（上限 1.5）、全距 2.77 LU、clamp 0/159；样本峰值超 0 dBFS 仍为 **0/159**，最差真峰值 −0.983 dBTP。
highlights.en: **Re-matched.** Articulation changes the energy distribution materially (a stab is 30% of the old length, a sustain 300%), so all 159 genres were re-measured and the trims refitted: post-trim spread **0.69 LU** p90−p10 (limit 1.5), 2.77 LU full range, 0/159 clamp hits — and clipping remains **0/159** with a worst true peak of −0.983 dBTP.

highlights.zh: **测试覆盖三层且断言的是音乐主张**：奏法按音长正确排序（stab < comp < strum < block < sustain）；funk/雷鬼/salsa/techno/金属的 gateScale ≤ 0.6，ambient/trance/shoegaze/doom/black 的 ≥ 1.5；**端到端**渲染出的音长与起始展开和解析器一致（用同乐器对照隔离奏法，避免被预设自身的释放时间混淆）；失真吉他**可测地更重**（更暗、更冲、更厚、更紧）而不只是改了标签。
highlights.en: **Three layers of tests, asserting musical claims.** Articulations order correctly by length (stab < comp < strum < block < sustain); funk/reggae/salsa/techno/metal sit at gateScale ≤ 0.6 while ambient/trance/shoegaze/doom/black sit at ≥ 1.5; the **rendered** note length and onset spread match the resolver (compared on a matched instrument so the preset's own release cannot confound it); and the distorted guitar is **measurably** heavier — darker, more aggressive, thicker, tighter — not merely relabelled.

highlights.zh: 顺带修掉一个自己写的静默失效：真峰值汇总块用 `arrangedTruePeakDb` 过滤，但序列化报告里只写了 `trimmedTruePeakDb`，于是整块被悄悄跳过。已修，并把两个字段都写进报告。
highlights.en: Also fixed a silent self-inflicted failure: the true-peak summary filtered on `arrangedTruePeakDb` while the serialized report only wrote `trimmedTruePeakDb`, so the whole block was quietly skipped. Both fields are now reported.

title.zh: v2.0.0 工作台重构启动：布局偏好持久化（刷新不再丢失侧栏/力度条/高级抽屉状态）
title.en: v2.0.0 Studio refactor begins: layout preferences persist (no more re-collapsing the sidebar after every refresh)

highlights.zh: **工作台重构规划正式启动，版本序列进入 2.0**：原计划的 v1.17.0–v1.17.13 改为 **v2.0.0–v2.0.12**，首个里程碑为布局偏好持久化。这一版是 2.0 序列的起点，后续每个里程碑都是可独立发布的小版本。
highlights.en: **The studio refactor officially starts and versioning moves to 2.0.** The plan's v1.17.0–v1.17.13 milestones become **v2.0.0–v2.0.12**, beginning with layout-preference persistence. Each milestone ships as its own small release.

highlights.zh: **布局不再每次刷新都归零**：侧栏折叠、工作台最大化、力度泳道、分析仪、高级抽屉这 5 个开关此前全是裸 `useState(false)`，全仓库没有任何持久化——每次刷新、每次从调音台/对比视图回来，都要重新收侧栏、重新开力度条。现在挂载时读一次、变更即写。
highlights.en: **Layout no longer resets on every refresh.** All five toggles — sidebar collapse, editor maximise, velocity lane, analyser, advanced drawer — were plain `useState(false)` with no persistence anywhere in the repo, so every refresh (and every trip to the console or compare view) meant re-collapsing the sidebar and re-opening the velocity lane. They are now read once on mount and written on change.

highlights.zh: **存储损坏绝不会弄坏工作台**：读取失败（无 storage／隐私模式抛错／配额）一律回落默认且**绝不抛错**；一个字段类型不对时**逐字段修复**，而不是把其余四个好设置一起丢掉；遇到未知的 `version` 则整体回落——形状不认识就不猜。键为 `groove_layout_prefs_v1` 且载荷内含 `version`，按计划「一旦写到用户机器上就永不删除」的纪律，未来改形状要加 v2 并保留 v1 作迁移源。
highlights.en: **Corrupt storage can never break the studio.** Any read failure (no storage, a privacy mode that throws, quota) falls back to defaults and **never throws**; a single wrong-typed field is repaired **in place** rather than discarding the other four good settings; an unknown `version` falls back wholesale, because guessing at an unrecognised shape is worse than resetting. The key is `groove_layout_prefs_v1` with the version also inside the payload, so a future shape change must add v2 and keep v1 as a migration source.

highlights.zh: **演奏状态明确不持久化**：「只听鼓组」「键盘模式」「录音待命」被有意排除在偏好之外，并在代码里写明理由——它们描述的是演奏中的实时状态，静默恢复会在下次打开时重新武装录音或重进只听鼓组。测试从两个方向守护：类型层拒绝，以及绕开类型（模拟从解析出的 JSON 展开）时运行时过滤器仍拦下。
highlights.en: **Performance state is deliberately not persisted.** Drums-only, keyboard mode and record-armed are excluded on purpose, with the reasoning in the code: they describe live performance state, and silently restoring them would re-arm the recorder or re-enter drums-only on the next visit. Tests guard this from both directions — the type system rejects them, and the runtime filter still catches them when the types are bypassed.

highlights.zh: **验证强度如实说明**：本版交付了模块级往返测试（走真实 `localStorage`）与源码级接线守护（断言 5 个开关全部落盘、会话态不落盘），共 35 条。**浏览器级「刷新后原样恢复」的端到端断言按计划归属后续里程碑的 7 端 E2E 矩阵**，因此这里不把「单元测试通过」表述为「浏览器已验收」。
highlights.en: **Verification strength, stated honestly.** This release ships module-level round-trip tests through the real `localStorage` plus a source-level wiring guard asserting all five toggles are persisted and the session-only flags are not — 35 cases. The **browser-level "still collapsed after a refresh" end-to-end assertion belongs to a later milestone's seven-target E2E matrix**, so unit tests passing is not presented here as browser acceptance.

title.zh: v1.16.21 母带换上真正的真峰值前瞻限幅器（削波 121→0 个曲风），和弦开始按曲风选声部
title.en: v1.16.21 A real true-peak lookahead limiter (clipping 121 genres → 0), and chords voiced for the genre

highlights.zh: **母带限幅器原来不是限幅器（已登记的 N-15）**：它是个 `DynamicsCompressorNode`，20:1、**3 ms 起攻**且无前瞻——底鼓/军鼓的瞬态在增益衰减介入前就已经过去了，超量还按 1/20 放行。实测后果：**159 个曲风里有 121 个渲染出的样本峰值超过 0 dBFS**，被 16-bit 编码器硬削平。现在换成真正的**前瞻式真峰值砖墙限幅器**：3 ms 前瞻（增益在瞬态到达输出前就已压低）、4× 过采样真峰值检测（能看见**采样间过冲**，而不只是采样点）、−1.0 dBTP 硬天花板、立体声联动、分级释放。
highlights.en: **The master "limiter" was not a limiter (registered as N-15).** It was a `DynamicsCompressorNode` at 20:1 with a **3 ms attack** and no lookahead — kick and snare transients had already passed before the detector closed, and 1/20 of the excess sailed through. Measured result: **121 of 159 genres rendered sample peaks above 0 dBFS**, hard-clipped by the 16-bit encoder. It is now a real **lookahead true-peak brickwall**: 3 ms of lookahead (gain is down before the transient reaches the output), 4x-oversampled true-peak detection (so **inter-sample** overshoots are caught, not just sample points), a −1.0 dBTP hard ceiling, stereo-linked gain, and programme-dependent release.

highlights.zh: **实测：削波从 121/159 降到 0/159，最差真峰值 −0.996 dBTP**（天花板 −1.0）。全库重新实测并回填 159 条响度 trim：配平后 p90−p10 0.80 LU、全距 2.53 LU、clamp 命中 0/159。库整体电平下降约 0.7 dB——真正的前瞻天花板比原来那个压缩器严格，这是预期且正确的方向。
highlights.en: **Measured: clipping falls from 121/159 to 0/159, worst true peak −0.996 dBTP** against a −1.0 ceiling. All 159 loudness trims were re-measured and refitted: post-trim spread 0.80 LU p90−p10, 2.53 LU full range, 0/159 clamp hits. The library sits about 0.7 dB lower overall — a genuine lookahead ceiling is stricter than the compressor it replaced, which is the intended direction.

highlights.zh: **新增真峰值表（V-03）并把它接成门禁**：此前无真峰值度量，所以「采样间过冲」这类问题**看不见**。现在 `loudness` 助手提供 4× 过采样真峰值，门禁新增两条会失败的断言——0 个曲风超 0 dBFS 样本峰值、无曲风超出 −1 dBTP（容差 0.02 dB）。只有真峰值能看见限幅器存在的意义，只看样本峰值恰好漏掉它。
highlights.en: **A true-peak meter (V-03), wired in as a gate.** There was no true-peak measurement, so inter-sample overshoot was **invisible**. The loudness helper now reports 4x-oversampled true peak, and the gate gained two assertions that can fail: zero genres above 0 dBFS sample peak, and none beyond −1 dBTP (0.02 dB tolerance). Only a true-peak meter can see the failure the limiter exists to prevent.

highlights.zh: **和弦按曲风选声部形态（用户反馈）**：此前一律是自然音阶 1-3-5，对大多数曲风都不对。现在有 9 种形态：**power**（根音+纯五+八度，**无三度**——摇滚/金属的失真下三度会糊成一团）、**shell**/**extended**（爵士只留 3 度与 7 度、再叠 9 度）、**quartal**（叠四度，modal/free jazz）、**seventh**（布鲁斯/灵魂/迪斯科/boom-bap）、**sus**/**open**（环境与 shoegaze 的无三度音墙）、**add9**（city pop / j-pop / trance）。新增 `src/data/genreVoicing.ts`：6 个分类默认 + 约 80 条逐曲风 override。
highlights.en: **Chords are now voiced for the genre (user feedback).** A generic diatonic 1-3-5 was wrong for most of the library. There are now nine voices: **power** (root + fifth + octave, **no third** — under distortion the third is what turns a chord to mush), **shell**/**extended** (jazz keeps the 3rd and 7th, adding the 9th), **quartal** (stacked fourths for modal/free jazz), **seventh** (blues, soul, disco, boom-bap), **sus**/**open** (the thirdless ambient/shoegaze wall), **add9** (city pop, J-pop, trance). New `src/data/genreVoicing.ts`: six category defaults plus ~80 per-genre overrides.

highlights.zh: **但曲风数据本身给不出这个信息**：`common_chords` 在 159 个曲风里**只有 2 个互不相同的字符串**，连 Jazz/Blues 与 Rock/Metal 都完全一样。所以爵士的和声变化只能来自上面那张按曲风键控的表；`common_chords` 的退化已登记为后续数据项（与 instrumentation 在 N-12 之前的状态同类）。
highlights.en: **The genre data itself cannot supply this.** `common_chords` holds only **two distinct strings across all 159 genres**, identical even for Jazz/Blues and Rock/Metal. Jazz harmony therefore has to come from the genre-keyed table above; the degeneracy of `common_chords` is registered as a follow-up data item (the same state `instrumentation` was in before N-12).

highlights.zh: **实时与导出必须给出同一组音**：声部形态在实时引擎与离线导出器各自解析（一个实时、一个离线），所以除了单元测试，另加**端到端断言**——直接检查渲染出来的音：`death-metal` → 根音+五度+八度、`bebop` → C-Eb-Bb-D、`ambient` 无三度，且两个引擎对 5 个曲风给出完全相同的音。
highlights.en: **Playback and export must produce the same notes.** The two engines resolve the voicing independently (one realtime, one offline), so beyond unit tests there are **end-to-end assertions** on the rendered pitches: `death-metal` gives root+fifth+octave, `bebop` gives C-Eb-Bb-D, `ambient` has no third, and both engines agree exactly on five genres.

title.zh: v1.16.20 让每个曲风真的弹出和声、修掉一批能听见的音质缺陷，并让更新记录不再看不到最新版
title.en: v1.16.20 Real harmony for every genre, a batch of audible audio defects fixed, and release notes that can no longer miss the newest entry

highlights.zh: **和弦轨第一次真的有和声**：此前 `chords` 轨只触发一个音，159 个曲风声明的 `common_chords` 走向从未到达引擎——所谓「垫子」其实是穿着 pad 音色的单音旋律。现在按曲风自己的调式做自然音阶和声（定位根音音级，再叠 1-3-5），实时与离线导出调用同一模块，**零曲风文件改动**。
highlights.en: **The chords track finally has harmony.** It triggered a single note, so the `common_chords` progression every genre declares never reached the engine — the "pad" was a single-note melody wearing a pad preset. It now builds a diatonic voicing in the genre's own scale, from one module shared by playback and export, with **zero genre-file edits**.

highlights.zh: **修掉每个长音都在响的咔哒声**：衰减比音符长时，包络会从衰减曲线硬跳到延持电平——`bass808` 在 1/16 音符上约 **−4.6 dB 阶跃**，等于一个宽带脉冲。808 贝斯、钢琴、Rhodes、颤音琴、钟琴、西塔琴、立式贝斯都受影响。改为从解析求出的真实值开始释放。
highlights.en: **Fixed a click that fired on every sustained note.** When the decay outlasted the note, the envelope hard-stepped to the sustain level — about **−4.6 dB** on `bass808`, i.e. a broadband impulse. The 808 bass, piano, Rhodes, vibraphone, bells, sitar and upright bass were all affected. The release now starts from the envelope's analytically computed value.

highlights.zh: **母带主滤波此前从未真正旁通**：`DEFAULT_FX_STATE` 说它是关的，但节点按状态值构造，于是**实时母带一直挂着一个 16 kHz 双极点低通**，而离线导出器整条机架都不存在。现在按接线真旁通（BiquadFilter 没有透明类型，改频率只是假旁通），并修掉非 lowpass 类型的旁通值错误。
highlights.en: **The master filter was never actually bypassed.** The node was built from the state values even though `DEFAULT_FX_STATE` says it is off, so **the live master always carried a 16 kHz low-pass** while the exporter has no rack at all. Bypass is now a true re-route (a BiquadFilter has no transparent type), and the wrong bypass value for non-lowpass types is fixed.

highlights.zh: **降比特器其实没在降比特**：量化表只有 2048 点而量化级数可达 65536，`bits ≥ 11` 的设置完全失效——**出厂默认就是 12**。表长改为按级数自适应，并补 4× 过采样消除折叠失真；注释明确记录「采样率抽取未实现」及原因（WaveShaper 无记忆）。
highlights.en: **The bitcrusher did not actually crush.** Its 2048-point table could not resolve a quantizer reaching 65536 levels, so any `bits ≥ 11` was meaningless — **the default was 12**. The table is now sized from the level count, 4x oversampling stops harmonic fold-back, and the comment states plainly that sample-rate decimation is not implemented and why.

highlights.zh: **鼓噪声可复现且每击不同**：噪声床、混响 IR 与离线噪声此前全部来自 `Math.random()`，两次渲染都不一致、导出也无法保证与试听相同；而每个鼓点又从 buffer 的 0 偏移读起，16 分踩镲是**逐字节相同**的一段。现在统一用种子生成器，并给每击一个由「轨/步/连击」确定性推出的读取偏移，实时与离线共用同一公式。
highlights.en: **Drum noise is reproducible and varies per hit.** The noise bed, reverb impulse and offline noise all came from `Math.random()`, so renders disagreed and an export could not match the audition; separately every hit read from offset 0, making a 16th-note hat pattern byte-identical repetition. Both now use one seeded generator, with a per-hit offset derived deterministically from track/step/ratchet.

highlights.zh: **「更新后看不到最新更新记录」的根因修复**：① `/changelog.json` 允许缓存 1 小时；② Service Worker 走 stale-while-revalidate 先返回旧副本、回填后不重渲染；③ **弹窗把「归档」的优先级放在刚用 `no-store` 校验过的 `latest` 之上**，旧归档直接顶掉最新一条——这解释了为何版本号正确、只有记录是旧的。现在归档 URL 按版本作键、渲染改为「归档 ∪ latest」按版本降序、两个文件在 SW 中改为 Network First（对已部署的旧前端同样生效）。
highlights.en: **Root cause of "I updated but cannot see the newest release note".** (1) `/changelog.json` cached for an hour; (2) the service worker served it stale-while-revalidate, returning the old copy and never re-rendering after the refresh; (3) **the modal ranked the archive above the `latest` entry just revalidated with `no-store`**, so a stale archive displaced the newest entry — which is why the version was right and only the notes were old. The archive URL is now version-keyed, rendering is a version-descending union, and both files are network-first in the worker.

highlights.zh: **其余可听/可测修复**：踢鼓逐 voice 饱和补 4× 过采样并把失真曲线改为缓存（此前每次踩击分配 4096 个 float）；调音台声相与两条送出改为斜坡写入，拖推子不再有阶梯噪声；`VoiceRegistry` 增加复音上限与**无咔哒抢音**（优先抢最接近自然结束的 voice）。
highlights.en: **Other audible/measurable fixes.** The per-voice kick saturation gained 4x oversampling and a cached distortion curve (it allocated 4096 floats per hit). Console pan and both sends now ramp instead of stepping, removing zipper noise. `VoiceRegistry` gained a polyphony ceiling with **click-free stealing**, preferring the voice closest to finishing.

highlights.zh: **全库响度重新配平且更整齐**：加入和声抬高和弦轨峰值，因而**更狠地触发母带限幅器**把整个混音压低（全量实测 arranged 平均 −1.42 dB，最差 techstep −4.98）——这是 N-15 的又一次实证。按流程重测 159 曲风并回填 trim：配平后 p90−p10 由 0.51 LU 收到 **0.32 LU**，全距 1.11 LU，clamp 0/159。
highlights.en: **The library was re-matched — and is now tighter.** Harmony raises the chord peak, which **drives the master limiter harder and pumps the whole mix down** (−1.42 dB average arranged, worst `techstep` −4.98) — more evidence for N-15. All 159 genres were re-measured and trims refitted: post-trim p90−p10 improved from 0.51 LU to **0.32 LU**, range 1.11 LU, 0/159 clamp hits.

title.zh: v1.16.19 每个曲风一套按曲风编排的混音，并把 159 个曲风的总响度配平
title.en: v1.16.19 A genre-arranged mix for every genre, and loudness matched across all 159

highlights.zh: 每个曲风一套自己的混音（用户需求）：此前 159 个曲风共用同一套默认值——底鼓一律 0.90、主音一律偏右 0.10、混响与延迟送出**全部为 0**（两条送出总线其实是死的）。现在每个曲风按自己的性格编排：159 个曲风里 (音量, 声相) 组合有 157 种互不相同。爵士把立式贝斯推到 0.96~0.98 而鼓组后撤到 0.60~0.68；萨尔萨的打击乐推满并铺到左侧；雷鬼低音推到 1.00；金属把和弦与主音分别拉硬左硬右（双轨吉他）；ambient 的鼓组几乎退场而垫子挑大梁；trap 的底鼓与低音推到 0.98/0.99、踩镲铺宽
highlights.en: A mix of its own for every genre: all 159 genres used to share one set of defaults — kick always 0.90, lead always panned +0.10, and the reverb/delay sends all zero (the two send buses were effectively dead). Each genre is now arranged to its own character, with 157 distinct (volume, pan) combinations across the 159. Jazz pushes the upright bass to 0.96–0.98 and pulls the kit back to 0.60–0.68; salsa pushes percussion to full and spreads it left; reggae takes the bass to 1.00; metal splits chords and lead hard left and right as double-tracked guitars; ambient all but removes the kit and lets the pads carry it; trap runs kick and bass at 0.98/0.99 with wide hats

highlights.zh: 总响度配平（用户需求）：切换曲风时总响度不再跳变。做法是逐个曲风离线渲染其默认 pattern，按 ITU-R BS.1770-4 门控积分响度（LUFS，含 400ms/75% 分块、−70 LUFS 绝对门与 −10 LU 相对门）实测，以全库中位数为目标生成每个曲风的母带微调。配平前 p90−p10 为 4.69 LU、全距 9.96 LU；配平后为 **0.51 LU / 1.25 LU**，且没有任何一个曲风撞到 ±clamp 边界
highlights.en: Loudness matching: the total level no longer jumps when you switch genres. Each genre's default pattern is rendered offline and measured as ITU-R BS.1770-4 gated integrated loudness (LUFS — 400 ms blocks at 75% overlap, −70 LUFS absolute gate, −10 LU relative gate); a per-genre master trim is derived against the library median. Before matching the p90−p10 spread was 4.69 LU with a 9.96 LU full range; after, it is **0.51 LU / 1.25 LU**, with no genre hitting the clamp bounds

highlights.zh: 曲风比对也一起配平：单曲风试听各自使用本曲风的微调；同步 A/B 模式按当前**实际在响**的曲风重算（只独奏某一侧时就用那一侧自己的微调）。此前同步模式固定用两首的均值，独奏一侧时最差会偏 4.98 dB——即为了对比而独奏时反而最不准
highlights.en: The compare view is matched too: a single-genre audition uses that genre's own trim, and the synchronised A/B mode recomputes from whichever genres are actually audible — isolating one side uses that side's own trim. It previously pinned the average of the two, which left isolating a side off by up to 4.98 dB — exactly when you isolate to compare

highlights.zh: 微调是一个独立于音量的母带级（在用户推子与听力保护钳制之后、母带限幅器之前），因此推子始终只表示你要的音量，而导出与试听一致：离线 WAV 导出在同一相对位置套用同一个微调。「响度配平」不会被误当成用户调过音量
highlights.en: The trim is a separate master stage from the volume fader (after the user fader and hearing-protection clamp, before the master limiter), so the fader keeps meaning exactly the level you asked for, and bounces match auditions: the offline WAV exporter applies the same trim in the same relative position

highlights.zh: 旧会话的兼容：老用户上次存下的会话快照里那套旧占位混音会按轨迁移到新编排——只迁移「从未被用户动过」的通道（音量、声相、两条送出都还是旧占位值的那些），你在调音台里动过的通道保留你自己的值。否则老用户会一直听到旧的扁平混音，新表根本到不了耳朵里
highlights.en: Existing sessions are migrated per channel: a saved session's old placeholder values move to the new arrangement only on channels the user never touched (volume, pan and both sends still matching the old placeholder); channels you moved in the console keep your values. Without this, a returning user would keep hearing the old flat mix and the new table would never reach their ears

highlights.zh: 修正分享链接的另一半：工具栏分享按钮此前丢掉了声相、混响/延迟送出、门限、连击、概率、轨道长度与摇摆八个字段（编解码器一直支持、工程中心也映射齐全，只有工作台这个入口是内联拼装漏了）。现在两处共用同一映射实现，并有三条端到端测试直接对生成的链接断言——否则按曲风编排好的声相与送出一分享就没了
highlights.en: The other half of the share fix: the studio toolbar's share button was dropping eight per-track fields (pan, reverb/delay sends, gate, ratchet, probability, track length, swing) even though the codec always supported them and the project hub mapped them all. Both entry points now share one mapper, with three end-to-end tests asserting on the generated link — otherwise the genre-arranged pan and sends would vanish the moment you shared a pattern

title.zh: v1.16.18 159 个曲风改用本命音色与真实配器清单：爵士用萨克斯小号、拉丁用铜管长笛、电子保留模拟合成
title.en: v1.16.18 All 159 genres re-voiced with their own idioms and real instrumentation lists: horns for jazz, brass and flute for Latin, analog synths kept for electronic

highlights.zh: 曲风音色策展（核心）：上一版让引擎开始按曲风数据里声明的乐器发声，但数据本身并不「曲风惯用」——爵士家族的 lead 是锯齿合成主音、全库 159 个曲风的 FX 都是同一条合成 riser。这一版把 159 个曲风逐一改成本命音色：主音从 5 种扩到 27 种（锯齿从 92 个曲风降到 28 个），FX 从 1 种扩到 9 种，低音 9→14 种、和弦 6→11 种
highlights.en: Genre timbre curation (core): the previous release made the engine honour the instrument each genre declares, but the data itself was not idiomatic — the jazz family's lead was a saw synth and every one of the 159 genres used the same synth riser for FX. This release re-voices all 159 genres: leads go from 5 kinds to 27 (saw leads drop from 92 genres to 28), FX from 1 to 9, bass 9 to 14, chords 6 to 11

highlights.zh: 具体到你会在意的听感：bebop、hard-bop、cool-jazz、modal-jazz、free-jazz、traditional-jazz 现在的主音是萨克斯、小号与弱音小号，芝加哥蓝调是口琴，拉丁与世界音乐改用铜管组、长笛与手风琴，摇滚金属保持双吉他（本来就对，没有乱动）。电子分支中真有模拟合成传统的那 28 个曲风保留锯齿主音，理由逐个写在 TIMBRE_NOTES.md 里
